items.title: GPT Image 韩式人像
items.prompt:
[整体风格]
9:16 竖版，单一独立场景，超写实韩式成年女性室内生活照，清冷温柔的空气感，低饱和奶油粉与冷蓝灰色调，柔和自然窗光，轻微胶片柔焦，真实相机摄影质感。

[面部特征]
一位 23-25 岁的漂亮东亚成年女性，精致小巧的鹅蛋脸，下颌线柔和流畅，下巴圆润小巧，清透冷白瓷肌，泛着淡淡的蜜桃粉腮红。
明亮清澈的深灰棕色杏眼，自然双眼皮，精致的卧蚕，纤长自然的睫毛，浅粉棕色眼影，眼线微微上挑。
鼻梁纤细挺直，鼻头小巧，双唇饱满柔软，呈玫瑰豆沙粉色且水润有光泽。
双唇自然闭合，神情温柔清冷，带着一丝慵懒感，目光安静地直视镜头，保留真实的皮肤微纹理。

[发型发丝]
浓密蓬松的乌黑及腰长发，呈现自然的深红茶色光泽，头顶具有真实的空气感。
自然中分，额头前是轻薄不规则的八字碎刘海，几缕细碎发丝轻轻拂过额头与脸颊。
长发自然垂落于肩头与胸前，整体顺滑，发尾带有松散的大弧度卷曲，保留真实的根根分明发丝与自然蓬松感。

[服装与饰品]
身穿浅樱花粉色细吊带修身短款上衣，柔软棉质面料，简约浅圆领设计。
外搭一件奶油白色宽松针织开衫，前襟自然敞开，衣袖松垮滑落至上臂处，露出自然的肩颈线条与锁骨。
佩戴小巧银色圈形耳环与精致的银色细手链。

[姿势动作]
人物坐在卧室窗边的梳妆台前，身体微微转向镜头，双肩自然放松。
头部轻柔倾斜，下巴微收，双眼直视镜头。
双手自然抬至胸前，一只手轻轻拢住肩前的长发，另一只手温柔地整理着发尾。
姿态温柔松弛，手部结构准确，动作自然流畅。

[背景环境]
现代简约的浅灰白色卧室，画面左侧是明亮的大窗户，窗台上摆放着一束浅粉色与奶油白色的鲜花。
画面右侧为白色梳妆台，台面上放着化妆刷、粉饼、护肤品及部分化妆品。
梳妆台上方挂着一面大圆镜，隐约映照出人物的背影与乌黑的长发。
背景充满真实的生活气息，整体干净、柔和、自然。

[镜头与光影]
9:16 竖版，等效 35-50mm 镜头，平视视角拍摄，人物居中，采用从头部到腰部的半身构图。
柔和的冷白自然窗光从画面左侧照入，面部明亮清晰，肌肤呈现自然的冷白质感。
头发带有细腻的深棕色反光，窗框边缘与浅色背景处有轻微的泛光溢出效果。
整体采用低对比度的冷蓝灰调色，阴影柔和，带有轻微胶片颗粒感与自然的光学柔焦效果。
保留真实的皮肤纹理、细碎发丝、自然的衣物褶皱以及真实的空间透视，避免过度磨皮与明显的 AI 生成痕迹。

[负面提示词]
动漫，插画，3D 渲染，CG 假脸，塑料感皮肤，过度磨皮，夸张网红脸，眼睛异常偏大，下巴过尖，五官错位，假发套，头发结块毛躁，手指畸形，多指，手部结构错误，身体比例失调，衣物穿模，镜中倒影变形，镜面反射错误，化妆品糊成一团，严重过曝，强 HDR，过度锐化，商业影棚打光，明显 AI 感，文字，水印，LOGO，拼贴画。
tags: 生成年轻女性写实韩式室内人像的详细提示词。

items.title: 水彩动漫时尚插画提示词
items.prompt:
将上传的照片转化为可爱、手绘水彩风格的日系动漫时尚插画。

重要提示 —— 保留原照片特征：
请仔细分析上传的图片，真实还原人物本身，完整保留其可辨识的面部特征、发型、发色、肤色、身材比例、姿势、穿搭、配饰及整体外观。切勿随意更改人物的服装或造型。

艺术风格：
- 日系甜美时尚插画与柔和动漫美学的完美融合。
- 手绘水彩与彩色铅笔质感。
- 精致且略带随性笔触的深棕色素描轮廓线。
- 柔和的水彩晕染效果，透出清晰的纸张纹理。
- 细节丰富的秀发，发丝飘逸、层次分明。
- 简化的可爱五官，双眼微闭或流露温柔神态。
- 淡淡的粉嫩腮红与自然甜美的浅笑。
- 采用温暖治愈的柔和色调进行细腻 shading（明暗过渡）。
- 略带夸张却不失自然的时尚人物比例。
- 精细刻画衣物褶皱、缝线、图案与面料质感。

装饰元素：
在人物周围添加可爱的手绘涂鸦，例如红色描边爱心、黄色星星、细碎闪光以及俏皮的点缀线条。注意保持视觉平衡，分布自然错落。

背景与构图：
- 纯净的白色背景。
- 全身人物插画。
- 人物居中放置。
- 预留充足的白色留白空间。
- 2:3 竖版构图。
- 不添加任何背景场景或多余物件。

最终视觉效果：
一张充满魅力的 Pinterest 风日韩系时尚贴纸插画，宛如传统水彩速写本中的手绘作品。整体氛围柔和、治愈、可爱、唯美、富有表现力，尽显手工绘制的精致感。

避免：照片级写实、3D 渲染、高光数字绘画、过于锐利的矢量轮廓线、过度堆砌细节、人体结构变形、多出的手指、文字、水印或 logo。
tags: 将照片转化为可爱的手绘水彩动漫风格时尚插画，同时保留人物特征

人物锐利清晰，背景带有轻微的真实动态模糊和夜景数码噪点。

真实的手机夜景质感，曝光自然，保留皮肤纹理、细腻的发丝以及环境光影。

[反向提示词]

9:16 竖版构图，单幅独立画面，超写实韩式成年女性室内人像摄影，温柔成熟气质，奶油暖白色调，真实智能手机自拍质感，柔和自然补光，细腻肌肤纹理，轻微柔焦效果，温暖静谧的卧室氛围。

[面部特征]

一位 23-25 岁的东亚美女，明显为成年人，精致小巧的鹅蛋脸，面部轮廓柔和流畅，颧骨平缓，下颌线自然收窄，下巴小巧圆润。

清透冷白皮透着淡淡的蜜桃粉腮红，鼻梁纤细挺直，鼻头小巧自然。

明亮清澈的深灰棕色杏眼，自然双眼皮，柔和卧蚕，睫毛纤长卷翘，浅粉棕色眼影，自然平眉。

双唇饱满柔软，呈玫瑰豆沙粉色，带有细腻自然的润泽光泽。

嘴角微微上扬，神态温柔恬静，双眼直视镜头，流露自然亲切感。

保留真实皮肤微肌理，避免夸张美颜滤镜与过度幼态化特征。

[发型 - 核心]

浓密蓬松的深栗棕色长发，泛有自然巧克力棕光泽，长度垂至胸部以下、接近腰部。

头顶发量丰盈蓬松感明显，发根松散不贴头皮，整体发量充足。

自然中分造型，部分头发在脑后随意拢起，形成轻微的半扎发效果。

几缕细碎发丝自然垂落在额头与脸颊两侧。

画面左侧的头发自然别至耳后，露出耳朵与小巧珍珠耳环。

画面右侧大量浓密长发自然披散于肩头与胸前，形成柔和松散的大波浪。

发丝需具备真实粗细变化、自然光泽及细微碎发；切勿使用过于整齐的卷发或假发质感。

[服装与首饰]

身穿奶油白/浅燕麦色一字领修身针织上衣。

面料为柔软细密的针织材质，宽松的一字领口自然滑落至肩部以下，露出一侧肩膀与清晰柔和的锁骨。

长袖设计，袖口自然贴合手腕，面料呈现细腻真实的编织纹理与柔软褶皱。

颈部佩戴极细银色锁骨链，一侧耳朵戴着小巧的白色珍珠耳钉。

整体穿搭简约、温柔、优雅。

[姿势 - 重点]

人物坐在卧室床沿，上半身微微转向镜头，双肩自然放松下沉。

头部轻轻偏向画面右侧，下巴微收，目光温柔地直视镜头。

画面左侧的一只手自然抬起，掌心轻触脸颊与耳下，手指顺着下颌线自然舒展，形成温柔的托腮姿势。

另一只手抬至肩侧，手指轻轻拨弄胸前的长发，指尖自然弯曲。

长发自然垂落于身体右侧，双手位置高低错落，构成自然柔和的画面构图。

保持真实的手指数量、自然的手腕角度以及合理的肩颈比例。

[背景环境]

温馨简约的现代卧室或酒店房间。

画面左侧是一扇大型落地窗，挂着半透明白色纱帘，窗帘带有柔和自然的垂直褶皱。

人物身后是一张铺着纯白床品的柔软大床。

画面右后方可见浅米色床头板与暖黄色床头灯光。

墙面为奶油白与浅米色，室内干净整洁，无繁杂杂物。

整体营造出真实居家夜晚休憩的温暖氛围。

[镜头与光影]

9:16 竖版，上半身特写人像构图，等效 35-50mm 镜头，平视视角，人物居中。

头顶预留少量空间，长发自然延伸至画面底部。

采用柔和冷白正面补光，均匀照亮眼部、脸颊与嘴唇，使肌肤呈现干净通透的冷白质感。

右侧背景的床头灯散发柔和暖黄环境光，形成自然的冷暖色温对比。

头发受光面呈现细腻的栗棕色高光，暗部保留浓郁的深棕色。

整体亮度适中，对比度略微降低，保留自然阴影、真实发丝、细腻面料纹理以及轻微的智能手机摄影颗粒感。

[负面提示词]

动漫，插画，3D 渲染，CG 假脸，塑料感皮肤，过度磨皮，夸张网红脸，眼睛异常偏大，下巴过尖，五官错位，双眼不对称，浓妆，假发，头发结块，过于规则的卷发，手指畸形，多指，手部融合，手腕扭曲，肩膀脱臼，身体比例失调，针织纹理错误，衣服穿模，背景杂乱，强 HDR，严重过曝，过度锐化，商业影棚布光，明显 AI 生成痕迹，文字，水印，logo，拼贴画。

长发呈现柔和的大弧度波浪，发量丰盈，两侧长卷发自然披散于肩头与胸前。

几缕银灰发丝被微风轻轻吹起，数根细长碎发拂过脸颊与唇边。

柔软细腻的罗纹针织面料，简约圆领，贴合自然身体曲线。

服装色彩轻柔淡雅，带有真实针织纹理与自然褶皱。

人物正面朝向镜头，身体微微倾斜，双肩放松。

头部微倾，目光直视镜头，神情平静温柔。

手指自然纤长，关节结构准确。

[背景]

极简现代冷蓝灰色室内空间，浅灰蓝色墙面，深灰色柜门与自然阴影。

背景干净，无复杂家具或装饰。

人物居中构图，银灰色长卷发占据画面两侧，背景保留轻微自然虚化。

[光影与摄影]

柔和冷白侧前自然光，面部明亮，肌肤呈现清透冷白质感。

银灰色长发在柔光照射下，泛出细腻的银白与香槟灰反光。

面部保留自然的浅灰色阴影，眼部有清晰的柔和反光点。

整体低饱和冷蓝灰调色，对比度柔和，轻微光学柔焦，真实相机颗粒感。

等效 50mm 人像镜头，近景半身构图，平视视角，面部清晰，真实景深。

[负面提示词]

动漫，插画，3D 渲染，CG 假脸，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，夸张大眼，锥子脸，五官扭曲，双眼不对称，假发，僵硬卷发，头发结块，过于整齐的刘海，手指畸形，多余手指，手部融合，身体比例失调，衣物穿模，强 HDR，过度锐化，商业影棚光，严重过曝，明显 AI 感，文字，水印，logo，拼贴画。

items.prompt:

[整体视觉风格]

一位 23 至 25 岁的成年东亚美女，拥有精致的小鹅蛋脸、清透的冷白皮、深灰棕色杏眼、柔和的玫瑰粉色双唇，以及浓密及腰的乌黑长发。

她站在夏日森林的浅溪旁，身穿纯白色短款修身针织开衫，内搭浅粉色上衣。

身体侧对镜头，头部自然回转，目光安静地直视相机。

一只手抬起靠近耳畔，轻轻整理黑色长发；另一只手自然弯曲，置于身前。

明亮的夏日阳光穿透树林，在人物发丝、脸颊、肩膀和溪流水面上形成真实的斑驳光影。

整体画面清新、安静、自然，带有柔和的韩式初恋感与清冷气质。

真实摄影光学质感，自然的皮肤纹理，细腻的发丝，轻微的柔焦与真实相机颗粒感，避免商业影棚质感和明显的 AI 生成痕迹。

[面部特征]

23 至 25 岁的成年东亚美女。

精致小巧的鹅蛋脸，头身比例自然，额头饱满柔和，颧骨平滑，面颊带有轻微的自然柔和肉感。

下颌线从两侧自然收窄，下巴小巧微圆，面部轮廓精致流畅。

五官和谐精致，散发着安静、清冷的韩式美女气质。

肌肤呈现清透的奶油冷白色，双颊带有极淡的蜜桃粉色红晕。

保留真实的皮肤微观纹理、自然毛孔以及细腻的面部光影过渡。

眼睛为深灰棕色杏眼，瞳孔清澈明亮，眼型自然偏大，眼尾微微上扬。

自然细致的双眼皮，柔和的卧蚕，浅灰棕色眼影，紧贴睫毛根部的细眼线。

睫毛自然纤长分明，眉毛为柔和自然的深灰棕色平眉。

鼻梁纤细挺直，山根过渡自然，鼻尖小巧圆润。

双唇自然饱满，唇峰柔和，涂抹低饱和度的玫瑰豆沙粉色口红。

上下唇轻轻闭合，嘴角放松，不刻意微笑。

目光清冷、温柔且安静，带有一丝若有所思的神态。

人物直视镜头，面部表情自然放松。

[发型设计 - 重点]

极其浓密的乌黑长发，发色为自然的深黑茶棕色。

头发长度及腰以下，发量丰厚但具有自然的蓬松感。

头顶发量丰盈，发根自然挺立，呈现真实的头发体积感。

发型采用自然的中分设计。

额头留有少量轻薄、不规则的空气感碎刘海。

阳光从人物左上方照射，在头顶和外层发丝上形成自然的银白色与深棕色反光。

头发层次分明，能看清每一根真实的细软发丝。

避免过于死板的直发、假发般的质感以及僵硬的头发轮廓。

[服装搭配]

身穿纯白色短款修身针织开衫。

开衫采用致密柔软的棉质针织面料，具有真实的细罗纹结构。

人物站在清澈溪流旁的浅水石滩上。

上半身自然挺直，腰部呈现柔和的自然曲线。

头部轻轻向后回转，面部朝向镜头。

下巴微收，双眼平静地注视相机。

画面右侧的手臂自然抬起，手肘向外弯曲。

手掌轻轻放在耳畔的长发上。

食指、中指及其余手指自然弯曲，轻轻拢起一束黑色长发。

手指与头发之间呈现真实自然的接触关系。

画面左侧的另一只手臂自然向上弯曲。

手掌位于胸部左侧，手指微卷，呈现放松自然的姿态。

双肩放松下沉，不刻意耸肩。

浓密的乌黑长发顺着肩膀和背部自然垂落，部分发丝遮挡住背部轮廓。

整体姿态宛如朋友在溪边随手抓拍下的一个自然回眸瞬间。

肩膀、手臂、手腕、手指和脖颈的比例真实，符合人体解剖学结构。

[背景环境 - 重点]

写实的夏日山林溪流环境。

人物站在一条清澈、缓缓流淌的小溪旁。

溪水从画面左上方的远处自然流向底部。

水面透明清澈，呈现浅灰绿、淡青绿以及自然的银白色反光。

溪流中分布着许多大小不一的圆润石头。

林间上方的阳光穿过树叶缝隙，在溪水和石头表面投下不规则的斑驳光斑。

整体环境原始、自然、清透，具备真实山谷溪流的空灵感。

[镜头与构图]

严格的 1:1 正方形画幅比例，单张独立人像。

采用等效 50mm 至 70mm 人像镜头视角。

机位接近人物视平线，呈现自然的平视视角。

构图从头顶上方保留少许背景开始，向下延伸至人物腰部附近。

人物头顶靠近画面上边缘。

面部位于画面居中偏上的位置，双眼作为视觉焦点。

人物身体转向画面左侧，头部自然回转。

一只手在耳畔整理头发，另一只手自然抬至胸前。

溪流和近处的石头具有一定的自然清晰度，远处的树木适度虚化。

[自然光影设计 - 最重要]

明亮的夏日森林自然光摄影。

左侧背景的溪流被强烈的阳光照亮，形成大量明亮的银白色水面反光。

右侧背景的树林处于自然阴影中，保持着浓郁的深绿色调。

人物位于阳光与树荫的交界处。

面部受到柔和的天空漫射光和溪面反射光照亮，整体肤色明亮自然。

额头、鼻梁、脸颊和下巴带有细腻自然的高光。

人物头顶呈现明显但不刺眼的阳光反光，照亮了细小的散发。

溪面出现轻微的局部过曝和真实的高光闪烁。

背景明暗对比鲜明，但面部曝光始终保持自然。

不使用商业影棚补光、夸张的逆光光束或人造柔光滤镜。

[色彩与摄影质感]

整体采用低饱和度的韩式森林清冷绿色调。

主色调为深林绿、浅青绿、自然灰、纯白、乌黑和淡玫瑰粉。

背景森林呈现浓郁的墨绿色和深青绿色。

溪水为透明的浅绿灰色，在阳光下泛着银白色高光。

人物肤色清透冷白，双颊带有淡淡的粉色红晕。

头发为浓郁的乌黑色，受光区域呈现细腻的深棕色反光。

白色针织上衣明亮干净，浅粉色内搭保持柔和的低饱和色调。

整体亮度适中，人物比背景稍微明亮一些。

保留真实的阴影和自然的高光，适度降低饱和度。

细腻的皮肤纹理、根根分明的发丝、真实的水波纹和鹅卵石质感。

轻微的真实相机颗粒感，适度的自然柔焦，不过度锐化。

拒绝过度修图、塑料感皮肤以及明显的 CG 或 AI 渲染质感。

items.title: GPT Image 2 提示词：实验性纹理双联画
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
为每张上传的照片生成一张 3:4 竖版双联画，上下两半等分且无缝衔接。无需分隔线、边框或拼贴效果。整体风格融合瑞士平面设计、实验摄影与复古印刷美学。

上半部分 —— 原始照片
完整保留原图的人物特征、姿态、场景、构图、透视、光影与色彩。仅允许进行细微的调色和背景延展。不添加任何文字。

下半部分 —— 七个实验性纹理区域
完整重复一次原图。在图像像素上直接叠加七个大小不一的非对称矩形区域，可覆盖非关键细节。确保每个区域内外的视觉连贯性。严禁对图像进行裁剪、缩放、位移、复制或重绘。务必保留所有重要的视觉焦点。

七种编号技法

01. Reeded Glass（竖纹玻璃）：垂直光学折射效果。

02. Black-and-White Engraving（黑白雕版）：精细蚀刻线条与交叉排线。

03. American Stipple（美式点刻）：黑白微点纹理。

04. Vintage Halftone（复古半调）：CMYK 印刷网点。

05. Pixel Mosaic（像素马赛克）：方形像素块。

06. Transparent Overlay（透明叠层）：2–4 层半透明叠加。

07. Duotone Screen Print（双色调丝网印）：双色丝网印刷效果。

设计细节
添加极细边框、微小角标方块以及精细指引线，以标示各个矩形区域。为每种技法标注对应的编号与英文名称。七个区域之外的画面须保持真实的摄影质感。

严格要求
不得出现 logo、水印、多余图片或无谓的装饰元素。维护原图的完整性，呈现干净、高级的杂志排版风格。

输出：一张高清 3:4 竖版海报，上下两半等分。

items.title: 矿泉水轮廓折射海报
items.prompt:
制作一张 4:5 竖版、完成度极高的瓶装矿泉水宣传海报。以“等高线折射谷”作为唯一核心构图，采用略微俯视的垂直视角。一个无标签、结构简约的透明玻璃水瓶竖直立于画面中下方，瓶盖为雾银色金属材质。整个背景铺满极细、等距且连续的冰蓝色水平等高线。线条在靠近瓶身处向内凹陷，形成被瓶身重量压出的柔和峡谷，向远处延伸后恢复平直。线条不得断裂、交叉或产生杂乱的波纹。

水瓶并非悬浮的抠图素材，底部需真实压在浅灰蓝色的矿物表面上，瓶身与线条场处于同一空间。只有透过瓶内清水看到的等高线才会发生真实的折射、轻微放大和水平位移，外部线条保持精准连续。左侧凝结少量自然水珠，右侧带有清晰的高光边缘。整体质感对标高端饮用水广告摄影，杜绝塑料感的 CGI 效果。

将窄体无衬线大标题“{argument name="title" default="FLOW"}”置于上方安静的留白区域，字间距拉宽，颜色为深海军蓝。标题下方仅保留小字“{argument name="subtitle" default="MINERAL WATER"}”。文字不得嵌入瓶身，也不能与线条争夺视觉中心。色彩严格限制在冰蓝、雾白、深海军蓝及少许银色之间。

使用柔和的顶部天光与左后方轮廓光，让瓶身通透而不隐形。整体氛围精准、利落、极简，呈现当代编辑设计风格。采用全不透明的矩形背景覆盖整个画布，不得出现透明像素、黑角、Alpha 蒙版、边缘羽化或不规则裁切。禁止加入山景照片、人物、悬浮水花、冗余文案、现有品牌 Logo 或水印。

items.title: 灯光投影海报
items.prompt:
创作一张 4:5 竖版高端台灯宣传海报。核心构图采用“光束字母槽”设计。画面左下方放置一盏极简金属台灯，灯杆纤细，搭配哑光深红色半圆柱形灯罩，逼真的电源线沿桌面自然延伸。灯头向右上方投射出暖白色锥形光束，光斑边缘清晰但不过于锐利。

四块深靛蓝色哑光薄板在画面中央等距垂直排列。薄板本身不印任何文字；只有当光束穿过四块板上精确的镂空切口时，后方暖灰色墙面上的投影才会拼出完整的单词“{argument name="word" default="BEAM"}”。每个字母均由光线投射而成，而非贴在墙上的普通发光字体。光束穿过不同切口后，宽度会产生细微变化，并呈现真实的柔和边缘。薄板边缘的高光需克制处理，表面保留清晰的投影方向感。

除标题外，仅在右下角添加小字信息“{argument name="subtitle" default="ARC LAMP / LIGHT SHAPED BY FORM"}”。不使用任何图标、参数卡片或装饰线条。色彩严格限定为深靛蓝、哑光红、暖灰与暖白光。

整体呈现静谧的室内夜景摄影质感。台灯材质需逼真写实。光学关系必须严谨：光源、镂空切口与墙面投影须处于同一直线上。构图简洁且富有空间纵深感。背景为覆盖整个画布的不透明矩形，无透明像素、无黑角、无 Alpha 蒙版、无边缘羽化。不得出现霓虹灯牌、舞台烟雾、赛博朋克元素、人物、现有品牌 Logo 或水印。

items.title: 耳机产品海报提示词
items.prompt:
输出一个独立的 {argument name="aspect_ratio" default="4:5"} 竖版商业海报，无拼贴，无多格布局。使用原创虚构品牌，不得模仿现有品牌的包装、Logo 或广告。文本仅可使用提示词中明确列出的品牌名、主标题和类别；不得编造价格、奖项、规格、日期、产地或标语。图像需达到创意总监审核标准：结构真实、材质可信、排版清晰、无水印。

主题：耳机评测样片。原创品牌 "{argument name="brand_name" default="SONA"}"，产品 "{argument name="product_model" default="ARC H1"}"，主标题 "{argument name="main_title" default="LISTEN"}"。

在奶油白摄影棚中放置一副石墨黑头戴式耳机。耳罩面向镜头，头梁略微后倾，真实的缓冲垫和金属铰链清晰可见。一条哑光钴蓝色实体声波带从左下角进入，宽度由窄变宽，依次穿过左耳罩、头梁后方空间及右侧背景，形成柔和起伏。它不是发光音频波形或装饰曲线，而是具有厚度、边缘和阴影的柔性材质。

构图核心：“产品悬浮于实体声波带上——标题构成声腔。”巨大的压缩字体 "{argument name="main_title" default="LISTEN"}" 以六个字符框架的形式排列在场景深处作为背景。耳机和声波带在这些框架前后交替穿插，形成清晰的遮挡关系和空间层次。顶部为品牌 "{argument name="brand_name" default="SONA"}"，底部文字仅为 "{argument name="product_model" default="ARC H1"} / HEADPHONES"。配色：黑色、暖白色、钴蓝色。直接柔光照明，静物广告品质。

禁止出现人物、舞台灯光、音乐节、EQ UI、频谱图、红色偶像封面、霓虹灯、多余耳机或无意义标签。

items.title: Taiwan Breakfast Shop Candid Portrait
items.titleZh: A candid smartphone photo of a young East Asian woman seated at a small round table inside a busy old-fashioned Taiwanese breakfast shop. She is the main subject, framed from mid-thigh upward, facing the camera in a casual seated pose. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. She has straight shoulder-length black hair with a center part, small gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a tiny heart pendant. She wears a fitted white spaghetti-strap tank top and high-waisted blue denim cutoff shorts with light distressing. In one hand she holds a piece of fried cruller near her mouth, and in the other hand she holds another broken piece over the table. On the table are 4 visible food and drink items: a plate with fried cruller pieces, a wrapped scallion pancake with black sesame seeds, a white foam takeout tray containing 2 pancakes including one covered with dark soy-based sauce and chopped scallions, and a large takeaway cup of soy milk with a red straw and red Chinese logo. The restaurant interior is compact and brightly lit with fluorescent ceiling lights, terrazzo-style flooring, and tightly packed diners in the background. Behind her are large windows and wall signage with bold red traditional Chinese characters, including breakfast items such as soy milk, youtiao, rice rolls, shaobing, and egg pancake. There are several seated customers eating, staff working behind a metal counter, a small wall-mounted television showing a female news anchor, and a hanging menu board with red Chinese text and prices. Realistic photography, natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, lively local atmosphere, slight wide-angle phone camera perspective, documentary food-travel aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 一张智能手机的偷拍照片，照片中一位年轻的东亚女性坐在一家繁忙的老式台湾早餐店的小圆桌旁。她是主要拍摄对象，从大腿中部向上取景，以随意的坐姿面向镜头。她的脸故意被柔和的矩形模糊所遮挡。她有一头齐肩的黑色直发，中间戴着小金圈耳环，还有一条精致的金项链，上面有一个小心形吊坠。她穿着一件合身的白色细肩带背心和带有轻微做旧效果的高腰蓝色牛仔短裤。她一只手把一块炸油条放在嘴边，另一只手把另一块碎油条放在桌子上。桌子上摆着四件看得见的食物和饮料：一盘炸油条、一份裹着黑芝麻的葱油饼、一个白色泡沫外卖托盘，里面有两块煎饼，其中一块是用老抽和葱花覆盖的，还有一大杯带有红色吸管和红色中文标志的外卖豆浆。餐厅内部空间紧凑，光线明亮，配有荧光天花板灯、水磨石风格的地板，背景中的食客挤得水泄不通。她身后是大窗户和墙上的标牌，上面有醒目的红色繁体字，包括豆浆、油条、肠粉、烧饼和蛋饼等早餐食品。有几位坐着的顾客在吃饭，工作人员在金属柜台后面工作，一台小型壁挂式电视上显示着一位女新闻主播，还有一个悬挂着的菜单板，上面写着红色的中文文字和价格。写实的摄影，自然的室内光线，浅景深，热闹的当地气氛，轻微的广角手机镜头视角，纪实的美食旅行美学。

She is the main subject, framed from mid-thigh upward, facing the camera in a casual seated pose. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. She has straight shoulder-length black hair with a center part, small gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a tiny heart pendant. She wears a fitted white spaghetti-strap tank top and high-waisted blue denim cutoff shorts with light distressing. In one hand she holds a piece of fried cruller near her mouth, and in the other hand she holds another broken piece over the table. On the table are 4 visible food and drink items: a plate with fried cruller pieces, a wrapped scallion pancake with black sesame seeds, a white foam takeout tray containing 2 pancakes including one covered with dark soy-based sauce and chopped scallions, and a large takeaway cup of soy milk with a red straw and red Chinese logo. The restaurant interior is compact and brightly lit with fluorescent ceiling lights, terrazzo-style flooring, and tightly packed diners in the background. Behind her are large windows and wall signage with bold red traditional Chinese characters, including breakfast items such as soy milk, youtiao, rice rolls, shaobing, and egg pancake. There are several seated customers eating, staff working behind a metal counter, a small wall-mounted television showing a female news anchor, and a hanging menu board with red Chinese text and prices. Realistic photography, natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, lively local atmosphere, slight wide-angle phone camera perspective, documentary food-travel aesthetic.

The background is an abstract nightlife energy burst of swirling liquid, neon splashes, and luminous particles rather than a realistic location. items.title: Epic Fantasy Mecha Light Novel Cover
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration for a fantasy mecha isekai story. Vertical poster composition with a huge heroic humanoid robot dominating the center foreground, viewed from a slightly low angle to make it monumental. The robot is sleek and ornate, with white and silver armor, rich gold trim, glowing cyan energy lines, a radiant emerald-green core in the chest, a crown-like crest on the helmet, and a long royal blue cape with gold edging. Behind its back spread multiple crystalline energy wings, about 8 large translucent green shards fanning out symmetrically like luminous blades. In its left hand it holds a long fantasy-tech spear with a blue glowing blade and gold mechanical detailing. At the robot’s feet are 2 human characters: on the left, a red-haired fantasy heroine with very long braided hair, leather-and-fabric adventurer clothing, and a determined expression, looking up at the robot; on the right, a young male protagonist with short dark hair in a fantasy tunic and cloak, reaching one hand up toward the giant machine in awe and urgency, seen mostly from behind. The setting is an epic ruined sci-fi fantasy world with towering gothic spires, broken city structures, drifting smoke, dramatic clouds, and a sky filled with stars, planets, streaks of lightning, and 8 small flying warships scattered in the distance. Highly polished anime key visual style, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, intense contrast, blue-green-gold color palette, heroic atmosphere, intricate mechanical rendering, fantasy worldbuilding, premium game or novel cover finish. Add large Japanese title typography at the top: 《{argument name="tagline text" default="本格異世界SFロボット戦記"}》 above a massive metallic logo reading {argument name="series title" default="ASTRAIA"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle line beneath it. Add a large dramatic Japanese catchphrase at the bottom in glowing white and gold text over 2 lines: {argument name="bottom catchphrase" default="乗って！ユウキ！ その叫びが、世界の運命を決めた！"}. Keep the overall design dense, premium, and readable as a commercial cover, with the central robot as the unmistakable focal point.

items.title: Two-Page School Band Manga Spread
items.titleZh: A two-page black-and-white manga spread set in a nighttime high school band rehearsal studio, drawn in polished modern shonen/seinen manga style with detailed screentones, dramatic lighting, expressive speed lines, and glossy instrument rendering. The scene shows 4 visible band members in school uniforms: a surprised teenage boy with messy short hair at guitar and vocal mic, a calm beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing light hair playing electric guitar in the foreground, a petite long-haired teenage girl at a keyboard, and a drummer in the back whose face is intentionally obscured by a soft blur. The studio has large windows revealing a city skyline at night, hanging ceiling lights, amps including a visible Marshall stack, a drum kit with a band logo on the bass drum, cables, and a wall sign reading “Beat Box.” Compose it as a printed manga spread with 7 panels total across 2 pages, including gutters, page borders, and page numbers 13 and 14 at the bottom. Left page: 3 panels — top panel with the shocked boy turning toward the girls and a large Japanese speech bubble saying “え!?”; middle panel is a close-up of the long-haired guitarist girl with a calm expression and a Japanese speech bubble saying “……別にいいよ”; bottom panel is a wider full-band rehearsal shot with all 4 members in the studio. Right page: 4 panels — top panel is an explosive performance shot with the boy singing and playing while the long-haired girl plays guitar, with large sound-effect text “ジャッ”; middle panel is a dynamic close-up of the long-haired guitarist playing intensely, with flowing hair, musical note symbols, radiant speed lines, and the keyboard girl visible in the back; bottom panel is a close-up of the boy’s stunned face with soft bokeh and a vertical Japanese speech bubble saying “……あれ”. Emphasize the emotional contrast: awkward surprise turning into admiration as the girl’s guitar performance changes the mood. Use monochrome only, no color, authentic manga lettering, cinematic framing, layered depth, and highly detailed hair and instrument strings.

items.title: Chicken Tikka Masala Mug Desk Photo
items.titleZh: A casual smartphone photo in a home office or gaming desk setup, shot vertically from a first-person perspective. A left hand in the foreground is holding a black ceramic mug with partial white logo text, and the mug is absurdly filled to the brim with thick chicken tikka masala instead of a drink. The curry is rich orange-red, creamy, with 3 visible chunks of chicken, a white yogurt swirl on top, and a small garnish of fresh cilantro leaves centered on the surface. The mug is positioned near the center-left of the frame above a medium-brown wooden desk. In the background, show a realistic desk scene: 1 black articulated desk lamp on the left, 1 black wall light switch on an off-white wall, visible white radiator pipes and a radiator, 1 red audio interface with knobs and cables near the back of the desk, 1 white game controller behind the mug, 1 computer monitor on the right edge showing a messaging app interface, several loose cables on the desk, and 1 large dark desk mat with a subtle red ornamental pattern in the lower right. Use warm late-afternoon indoor lighting with soft shadows, slight wide-angle phone camera distortion, shallow depth from the close foreground hand and mug, and a humorous but highly photorealistic everyday snapshot aesthetic.

items.title: Anime Summer Soda Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A bright, high-energy anime-style summer advertisement poster for a sparkling soft drink, set at the seaside under a vivid cobalt-blue sky with towering white cumulus clouds and a blazing sun near the top center creating lens flare and radiant beams. Feature exactly 3 Japanese high school girls in matching summer sailor uniforms: short-sleeved white blouses with navy ribbon bows and dark navy pleated skirts. All three have dark, windblown shoulder-length to long hair and youthful, lively poses. In the left foreground, show one girl from a dramatic low angle thrusting a large plastic soda bottle toward the viewer so it dominates the composition; her hand and the bottle are oversized by perspective. In the middle, show a second girl seated low near the water, one knee raised, drinking from a smaller bottle. On the right, show a third girl standing in profile or three-quarter view, also sipping from a bottle while her hair and skirt stream in the sea breeze. Make the ocean water intensely turquoise and sunlit, with energetic splashes framing the bottom left and bottom right edges, scattered droplets and sparkling highlights across the scene. Add a few small white seabirds in the distant sky. The overall mood is refreshing, nostalgic, youthful, and cinematic, like a premium Japanese beverage commercial key visual. The bottle label should be clean and minimalist white with modern sans-serif typography reading {argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"}, with smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="Yuzu White Peach Soda"} and a subtle 500 mL marking. Place the brand logo in the upper left in thin uppercase letters, and add a handwritten-style Japanese tagline in white at the lower left reading {argument name="tagline text" default="夏がくれる、はじけるひととき。"}. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering mixed with painterly light effects, ultra-detailed water droplets on the bottle, condensation, transparent plastic, glittering carbonation bubbles, and dramatic foreshortening.

items.title: Empowerment Sports Campaign Poster
items.titleZh: Create a high-end global sportswear campaign poster on a clean light gray studio background with a full-body female athlete crouching in the foreground, photographed in a fashion-advertising style. She is a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length slightly tousled hair, wearing a fitted white short-sleeve athletic t-shirt with a small black puma logo on the chest, black leggings, a light gray sweatshirt tied around her waist, and gray running shoes with subtle white branding. Her pose is low and powerful, one knee raised, one hand resting on the lifted knee and the other hanging loosely, facing camera with confident energy. Behind and around her, fill most of the composition with oversized black hand-painted brush lettering in an expressive activist style. The text must read exactly: "WE ARE THE VOICE OF" above, then the huge central word "STRENGTH," then beneath it "UNITY," and "AND CHANGE." Add a bold handwritten hashtag "#OWNYOURPOWER" near the middle-right. In the lower-right corner place the black Puma leaping cat logo above the wordmark "PUMA" and the tagline "FOREVER. FASTER." At the very bottom add 3 small footer text blocks: left "PUMA.COM", center "FOREVER. FASTER. TOGETHER. A GLOBAL MOVEMENT FOR EQUALITY, EMPOWERMENT AND CHANGE.", right "JOIN THE MOVEMENT. #OWNYOURPOWER". Composition should feel like a contemporary empowerment campaign, blending sports fashion editorial photography with protest-style brush typography, minimal palette of white, black, and gray, crisp studio lighting, premium ad layout, vertical poster format.
items.promptZh: 在干净的浅灰色工作室背景上创建高端全球运动装活动海报，前景是蹲伏的全身女运动员，以时尚广告风格拍摄。她是一位年轻女性，一头{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown"}齐肩的头发，略显凌乱，穿着一件合身的白色短袖运动 T 恤，胸前有一个黑色小美洲狮标志，下着黑色打底裤，腰间系着一件浅灰色运动衫，脚踩带有微妙白色品牌标识的灰色跑鞋。她的姿势低而有力，一只膝盖抬起，一只手放在抬起的膝盖上，另一只手松散地悬挂着，充满自信的能量面对镜头。在她的身后和周围，以富有表现力的激进风格用超大的黑色手绘毛笔字体填充大部分构图。文字必须准确地写为：上面是“我们是声音”，然后是巨大的中心词“力量”，然后是下面的“团结”和“和变化”。在右中附近添加一个粗体手写主题标签“#OWNYOURPOWER”。在右下角，将黑色 Puma 跳跃猫标志置于文字标记“PUMA”和标语“FOREVER。FASTER”之上。在最底部添加 3 个小页脚文本块：左侧“PUMA.COM”，中间“FOREVER.FASTER.TOGETHER.A GLOBAL MOVMENT FOR EQUALITY, EMPOWERMENT AND CHANGE.”，右侧“JOIN THE MOVMENT.#OWNYOURPOWER”。构图应该感觉像是一场当代赋权运动，将运动时尚编辑摄影与抗议风格的画笔排版、白色、黑色和灰色的最小调色板、清晰的工作室灯光、优质的广告布局、垂直海报格式融为一体。

items.title: Cyberpunk Fashion Campaign Poster
items.titleZh:
Ultra-realistic luxury fashion campaign poster featuring a young male model with textured wavy hair, sharp jawline, and minimal beard, wearing slim futuristic visor glasses. He stands in a composed yet powerful pose, slightly turned, eyes locked with the camera.

Outfit: oversized matte-finish charcoal techwear trench coat with layered panels, magnetic closures, and subtle reflective piping. Inner layer includes a high-neck tactical knit and structured cargo trousers, creating a futuristic urban silhouette.

Branding elements: subtle co-branded identity of {argument name="brands" default="Acronym × Adidas Originals"} placed minimally on coat sleeve and top corner of composition. Add small futuristic patches, barcodes, and geometric tech symbols for a clean cyber aesthetic.

Composition: medium shot, slightly low angle for dominance, coat flowing and occupying most of the frame with strong structure and depth. Model positioned slightly off-center.

Background: dark gradient concrete wall with neon cyan and white holographic-style typography behind the subject, slightly defocused for depth.

Lighting: cinematic high-contrast lighting with cool cyan and teal tones, combined with a sharp white rim light outlining the coat edges. Subtle reflections enhance the fabric’s technical texture. HDR, ultra-sharp focus, premium editorial finish.

Typography layout:
• Top right: co-branded logos
• Left vertical block: technical product specs text
• Right side: minimal tagline “{argument name="tagline" default="Engineered for the unseen"}”
• Bottom: “{argument name="label" default="Urban Tech Capsule"}” label

Style: futuristic streetwear campaign, cyberpunk editorial, ultra-detailed, 8k resolution, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, clean yet bold composition, modern UI-inspired overlays

items.title: Photorealistic beauty campaign portrait prompt
items.titleZh:
Photorealistic close-up beauty campaign portrait of a stunning young Western woman with long, voluminous curly dark hair, defined cheekbones, thick expressive eyebrows, and flawless luminous skin. Her features are sharp yet feminine, with a confident, slightly rebellious expression.

She wears a premium black and {argument name="color scheme" default="hot-pink"} baseball cap featuring bold, glowing {argument name="accent color" default="hot-pink"} 3D lettering “{argument name="name" default="SHARON"}” on the front, designed like a high-end streetwear brand logo. Trendy translucent pink-tinted round glasses sit perfectly on her face. A beige band-aid is placed on the bridge of her nose and another on her left cheek, adding a stylized edgy aesthetic. A lit cigarette rests between her slightly parted lips, revealing perfect white teeth.

Highly detailed miniature anime-style figurines (cute detective-inspired girl character: short brown bob haircut, oversized sparkling blue eyes, round glasses, bright red overalls, white shirt, yellow gloves) interact playfully across the composition: one sitting on the brim of the cap, one climbing her ear, one pulling her lower lip, one tucked inside her shirt collar, and one posed on her shoulder. A bold, oversized cyan pencil is tucked under the cap strap, acting as a striking graphic element.

Wardrobe styling: luxury streetwear aesthetic — black structured jacket layered over a crisp white-and-pink striped collared shirt, finished with a neatly tied pink scarf.

Color palette: deep blacks, vibrant hot-pink highlights, electric cyan accents, and warm yellow pops for contrast.

Lighting: high-end studio lighting with soft frontal illumination and dramatic rim lighting for depth and separation. Clean white seamless background.

Composition: ultra-sharp focus, editorial framing, luxury fashion advertisement style, cinematic depth, hyper-realistic textures (visible skin pores, detailed fabric weave, individual hair strands), 8K resolution, extremely intricate detailing.

Mood: bold, playful, high-fashion, Gen-Z luxury streetwear campaign, blending realism with surreal miniature storytelling.

高度细致的微型动漫风格雕像（可爱的侦探风格女孩角色：棕色短发、超大的闪亮蓝眼睛、圆形眼镜、鲜红色工作服、白衬衫、黄色手套）在整个构图中有趣地互动：一个坐在帽檐上，一个爬上她的耳朵，一个拉着她的下唇，一个塞在她的衬衫领子里，一个摆在她的肩膀上。一支大胆的超大青色铅笔塞在帽带下方，充当引人注目的图形元素。

衣橱造型：奢华街头服饰美学——黑色结构夹克搭配清爽的白粉色条纹领衬衫，最后搭配一条系得整齐的粉色围巾。

items.title: Japanese Summer Sports Drink Poster
items.titleZh:
A photorealistic Japanese summer beverage advertisement poster in a tall vertical layout, designed like an official sports drink campaign. Show a full-body teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors on a sunny hilltop road overlooking a coastal town and the ocean under a vivid blue sky with large white clouds. She is centered slightly left, posed confidently with one leg relaxed, looking off into the distance, holding a clear plastic bottle of {argument name="drink brand" default="POCARI SWEAT"} in her right hand near shoulder height. She wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: 1 white short-sleeve sailor blouse, 1 navy sailor collar with white stripes, 1 large navy neckerchief bow, 1 navy pleated skirt to the knees, 2 white knee-high socks, and 2 dark navy or black loafers. Her hair is long, straight, and black with a glossy sheen. Bright midday lighting, crisp shadows, fresh clean atmosphere, high realism, commercial poster finish.

Use a strong brand-forward composition. In the top left, place a large bold white logo reading "ION SUPPLY DRINK" above oversized {argument name="main logo text" default="POCARI SWEAT"} with a white wave shape beneath it. In the top right, add a small white corporate mark and the text {argument name="company name" default="Otsuka"}. On the right side, set a vertical Japanese headline in dark blue reading {argument name="headline text" default="渇いたからだに、水よりうれしい。"}. In the lower left, add a Japanese body copy block in blue, including a larger subheading and several smaller lines of explanatory text, styled like authentic ad copy. Near that text, include 1 white circular information badge with blue Japanese text and 2 small inner circles labeled "水分" and "イオン" joined by a plus sign. At the very bottom left, add small blue recycling-related fine print and iconography; at the bottom right, add the website URL {argument name="website" default="www.pocarisweat.jp"}. Make the overall design feel like a believable premium Japanese poster for a refreshing ion supply drink, suitable as a desktop wallpaper.

The entire image has a high-energy, motion-blur-effect aesthetic with graphic textures and a clean, commercial design.

items.title: Luxury Minimalist Footwear Ad
items.titleZh: A hyper realistic luxury editorial advertisement for Nike, executed with a restrained, high-fashion aesthetic. A male leg is suspended mid-air at a precise 45-degree angle toward the camera, styled with immaculate white athletic crew socks featuring a subtle, tonal Nike logo. The composition is clean and intentional, with generous negative space. The sneaker occupies the lower half of the frame, positioned slightly off-center for a balanced editorial layout. The footwear is a premium Nike low-top silhouette with glacier teal suede overlays and off-white tumbled leather panels. The iridescent chrome Swoosh reflects soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a refined, mirror-like highlight without harsh glare. Shot with a shallow depth of field: the sneaker remains perfectly sharp, while the leg transitions into a soft, elegant blur. Background & Atmosphere: A deep matte charcoal background with a subtle gradient falloff. No visible graffiti or noise—only a faint, almost imperceptible texture to avoid flatness. A soft vignette gently draws focus toward the sneaker. Lighting: Soft, controlled, diffused lighting from camera-left. Low contrast compared to sports ads, but with precise highlight control. Gentle specular highlight on chrome Swoosh. Soft glow on white leather. Minimal shadow harshness. Studio-quality, fashion editorial lighting. Typography & Layout (Luxury Minimalism). Top center (very small, spaced serif): “PRECISION · FORM · MOTION”. Center-right headline (elegant hierarchy): “FORM” (ultra-bold, clean sans-serif), “IN MOTION” (thin, high tracking). Microtext (extremely subtle, small scale): “Engineered simplicity. Refined movement.” Graphic Style: No bright accent colors. No arrows or aggressive elements. No clutter. No zine-style overlays. Pure, editorial restraint. Bottom-left Lockup: “LESS, BUT BETTER.” (bold, minimal sans-serif). Subline (small, refined): “Every detail serves a purpose.” Branding: Upper right: Nike wordmark and Swoosh in soft white or light gray. Small, understated—never overpowering Finish. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography. Luxury fashion campaign aesthetic. Ultra-clean composition. 4K resolution. Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Optimized for premium digital campaigns and editorial placements

items.title: Anthro Idol Group Concert Poster
items.titleZh:
A polished anime idol concert key visual on a glowing stage staircase, featuring exactly 5 anthropomorphic performers posed in a dynamic diagonal formation under dramatic purple-blue concert lighting and sparkling spotlights. The scene is viewed from a slightly low, wide-angle perspective to emphasize depth and stage presence, with neon-lit steps leading upward and metal truss structures framing the background. At center back is a large illuminated crest with a pawprint inside a geometric star emblem, flanked by laurel motifs, suggesting an idol group logo. The floor and stair edges glow with violet and blue rim light, and tiny glitter particles plus a few gold confetti pieces float through the air. The mood is energetic, triumphant, and glamorous, like a promotional poster for a live performance.

The 5 performers are all kemonomimi or furry idol characters in coordinated fantasy-stage costumes with belts, chains, layered fabrics, fingerless gloves, and tailored accessories, each color-themed individually while sharing a unified group design language. From left to right: a gray wolf boy in a deep blue outfit, closest to camera, smiling confidently and reaching one paw forward toward the viewer; an orange fox boy in black, white, and orange, stepping forward with a playful grin and one hand extended; a gray-and-white wolf boy in black, white, and green, standing slightly behind center and pointing upward/outward; a white rabbit girl in black, white, and pink, with tall bunny ears, fluffy tail, short skirt layers, and one arm raised high in an idol pose; and a brown bear boy in navy and gold, turned mostly away in a cool over-the-shoulder stance with one arm extended sideways. All characters should have expressive anime faces, fluffy fur rendering, detailed tails and paws, and high-end polished illustration quality.

Give each outfit a distinct accent color: blue for the left wolf, orange for the fox, green for the center wolf, pink for the rabbit, and gold for the bear. Costumes should mix idol fashion with fantasy military stagewear: fitted jackets or vests, asymmetrical panels, short trousers or layered skirts, harness straps, metallic trims, hanging chains, decorative cords, and patterned fabric inserts. The characters should look like a cohesive idol unit named {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}. Use {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} as the dominant lighting palette, with bright white spotlights from above and subtle lens glow. Place {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel branches"} on the back screen. The overall style should be {argument name="art style" default="high-detail anime idol promotional illustration"}, and the atmosphere should feel like {argument name="performance mood" default="a climactic live show finale"}.
items.promptZh:
在发光的舞台楼梯上呈现精美的动漫偶像音乐会主视觉，在戏剧性的紫蓝色音乐会灯光和闪闪发光的聚光灯下，恰好有 5 名拟人化表演者以动态对角线姿势摆出姿势。该场景是从略低的广角视角观看的，以强调深度和舞台存在感，霓虹灯照亮的台阶通向上方，金属桁架结构构成了背景。背面中央是一个巨大的发光徽章，几何星徽内有爪印，两侧是月桂树图案，暗示着偶像团体的标志。地板和楼梯边缘闪烁着紫色和蓝色的边缘光，微小的闪光颗粒和一些金色的五彩纸屑漂浮在空气中。气氛充满活力，得意洋洋，魅力四射，就像现场表演的宣传海报一样。

5 名表演者都是 kemonomimi 或毛茸茸的偶像角色，穿着协调的奇幻舞台服装，配有腰带、链条、分层面料、无指手套和定制配饰，每个人都有单独的颜色主题，同时共享统一的团体设计语言。从左到右：一个身穿深蓝色服装的灰太狼男孩，距离镜头最近，自信地微笑着，向前伸出一只爪子朝向观众；一个身穿黑、白、橙三色衣服的橙色狐狸男孩向前走来，脸上挂着俏皮的笑容，伸出了一只手；一个灰白相间的狼童，身着黑、白、绿，站在中心稍靠后的位置，手指向上/向外；黑、白、粉红的白兔女郎，兔耳朵高高的，尾巴毛茸茸的，短裙层层叠叠，一只手臂高高举起，摆出偶像的姿势；还有一个穿着海军蓝和金色衣服的棕熊男孩，以一种冷静的过肩姿势，一只手臂侧向一侧，几乎转过身去。所有角色都应具有富有表现力的动漫面孔、蓬松的皮毛渲染、细致的尾巴和爪子以及高端抛光的插图质量。

为每件衣服赋予独特的强调色：蓝色代表左边的狼，橙色代表狐狸，绿色代表中间的狼，粉色代表兔子，金色代表熊。服装应将偶像时尚与幻想军事舞台服装相结合：合身的夹克或背心、不对称镶片、短裤或分层裙子、吊带、金属饰边、挂链、装饰绳和图案织物嵌片。这些角色应该看起来像一个有凝聚力的偶像单位，名为 {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}。使用 {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} 作为主要灯光调色板，上面有明亮的白色聚光灯和微妙的镜头发光。将 {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel trees"} 放在背面屏幕上。整体风格应该是{argument name="art style" default="高细节动漫偶像宣传插画"}，气氛应该是{argument name="performance Mood" default="a climatic live show Finale"}。
items.prompt:
A polished anime idol concert key visual on a glowing stage staircase, featuring exactly 5 anthropomorphic performers posed in a dynamic diagonal formation under dramatic purple-blue concert lighting and sparkling spotlights. The scene is viewed from a slightly low, wide-angle perspective to emphasize depth and stage presence, with neon-lit steps leading upward and metal truss structures framing the background. At center back is a large illuminated crest with a pawprint inside a geometric star emblem, flanked by laurel motifs, suggesting an idol group logo. The floor and stair edges glow with violet and blue rim light, and tiny glitter particles plus a few gold confetti pieces float through the air. The mood is energetic, triumphant, and glamorous, like a promotional poster for a live performance.

The 5 performers are all kemonomimi or furry idol characters in coordinated fantasy-stage costumes with belts, chains, layered fabrics, fingerless gloves, and tailored accessories, each color-themed individually while sharing a unified group design language. From left to right: a gray wolf boy in a deep blue outfit, closest to camera, smiling confidently and reaching one paw forward toward the viewer; an orange fox boy in black, white, and orange, stepping forward with a playful grin and one hand extended; a gray-and-white wolf boy in black, white, and green, standing slightly behind center and pointing upward/outward; a white rabbit girl in black, white, and pink, with tall bunny ears, fluffy tail, short skirt layers, and one arm raised high in an idol pose; and a brown bear boy in navy and gold, turned mostly away in a cool over-the-shoulder stance with one arm extended sideways. All characters should have expressive anime faces, fluffy fur rendering, detailed tails and paws, and high-end polished illustration quality.

Give each outfit a distinct accent color: blue for the left wolf, orange for the fox, green for the center wolf, pink for the rabbit, and gold for the bear. Costumes should mix idol fashion with fantasy military stagewear: fitted jackets or vests, asymmetrical panels, short trousers or layered skirts, harness straps, metallic trims, hanging chains, decorative cords, and patterned fabric inserts. The characters should look like a cohesive idol unit named {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}. Use {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} as the dominant lighting palette, with bright white spotlights from above and subtle lens glow. Place {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel branches"} on the back screen. The overall style should be {argument name="art style" default="high-detail anime idol promotional illustration"}, and the atmosphere should feel like {argument name="performance mood" default="a climactic live show finale"}.

items.title: BMW Performance Social Poster
items.titleZh: Create a 4:5 vertical social poster in ultra high resolution, 8K print quality sharpness. Use the {argument name="car model" default="BMW car"} from the reference image as the main subject and use the background structure/composition from the reference image, but transform it into a BMW themed design. Replace all black tones with a flat {argument name="background color" default="high-saturation BMW blue"} background. Keep the same layout, spacing, visual balance, and poster composition from the reference image. Background should use a smooth gradient from slightly lighter electric blue at the top to deep navy blue at the bottom. Add subtle grain texture (2 to 3%) and faint rectangular overlays (2 to 4% opacity). Keep it clean, graphic, premium, and non-realistic. Add a soft contact shadow under the car. Use the same BMW from the reference image, changing only the {argument name="paint finish" default="matte frozen blue"} or deep metallic navy. Keep the original body shape, wheels, stance, and design details from the reference image. Show the car in a rear 3/4 perspective matching the reference image angle exactly. Use a slightly elevated camera angle. Position the car slightly right of center. Include visible carbon roof, aggressive rear diffuser, sharp controlled reflections, and subtle brake details. Keep composition identical to the reference image: Top: branding Middle: giant type Center: car overlapping text Bottom: editorial block and specs Typography: Primary text: “BMW” Ultra condensed bold sans serif, tall vertical scaling like the reference poster. Color deep navy or near black. Static text with no distortion. Acts as structural backdrop. Secondary header: “BMW M4 G82” Thin font with wide tracking. Logo area: BMW roundel centered above. Editorial block: Headline: “BMW — Where Driving Becomes Instinct” Body copy focused on: driver connection control performance precision Use the same boxed editorial layout as the reference image. Background faded text: “M4” large scale with 3 to 5% opacity behind the box. Bottom left: “ M4 G82” Bottom right specs: 405 kW / 550 PS 3.4 s 307 km/h Lighting should be clean studio lighting with sharp but controlled highlights. Color grading should use deep blues, high contrast, clean blacks. Camera lens: 50mm, slightly elevated rear 3/4 angle. Mood: Performance. Precision. Driver focus. Add Bottom-right watermark: harboriis , with small x and Instagram logo
items.promptZh: 以超高分辨率、8K 打印质量清晰度创建 4:5 垂直社交海报。使用参考图像中的{argument name="car model" default="BMW car"}作为主要主题，并使用参考图像中的背景结构/构图，但将其转换为宝马主题设计。将所有黑色调替换为平坦的{argument name="background color" default="高饱和度宝马蓝"}背景。与参考图像保持相同的布局、间距、视觉平衡和海报构图。背景应使用从顶部稍浅的电蓝色到底部深海军蓝色的平滑渐变。添加微妙的颗粒纹理（2% 到 3%）和微弱的矩形覆盖层（2% 到 4% 的不透明度）。保持干净、图形化、优质且不切实际。在汽车下方添加柔和的接触阴影。使用参考图像中的相同宝马，仅更改{argument name="paint finish" default="matte freeze blue"}或深金属海军蓝。保留参考图像中的原始车身形状、车轮、姿势和设计细节。以与参考图像角度完全匹配的后 3/4 视角显示汽车。使用稍微升高的相机角度。将汽车定位在中心稍偏右的位置。包括可见的碳纤维车顶、激进的后扩散器、锐利的受控反射和微妙的制动细节。保持构图与参考图像相同： 顶部：品牌 中间：巨型字体 中心：汽车重叠文本 底部：编辑块和规格 版式：主要文本：“BMW” 超压缩粗体无衬线，高垂直缩放，如参考海报。颜色深海军蓝或接近黑色。静态文本，不变形。充当结构背景。辅助标题：“BMW M4 G82”细字体，宽跟踪。标志区域：BMW 圆形图案位于上方中央。编辑部分：标题：“宝马——驾驶成为本能”正文重点关注：驾驶员连接控制性能精度使用与参考图像相同的盒装编辑布局。背景褪色文本：“M4”大尺寸，框后面不透明度为 3 至 5%。左下：“ M4 G82” 右下规格：405 kW / 550 PS 3.4 s 307 km/h 照明应该是干净的工作室照明，具有清晰但受控的亮点。颜色分级应使用深蓝色、高对比度、干净的黑色。摄像头镜头：50mm，后3/4角稍高。心情：表现。精确。驾驶员焦点。添加右下水印：harboriis，带有小x和Instagram标志

items.title: Cinematic Fiery Momo Street Food Ad
items.titleZh: A cinematic street-food advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="WOW! momo"}, shot at night on a rain-slick urban street with warm neon bokeh and a dramatic food-photography look. The composition is square and poster-like, with a black textured background overlaid by faint repeating words such as STEAM, SIZZLE, REPEAT, and SPICE. At the top left, place a bold white-and-red {argument name="logo text" default="WOW! momo"} logo. Dominating the center, huge distressed block letters read {argument name="headline text" default="BITE THE FIRE"} in tall off-white typography. Below and to the left of the headline, smaller stacked text reads {argument name="tagline text" default="STREET HEAT. FULL POWER."}. Show 4 momos in total: 3 whole pan-fried momos flying above a black skillet and 1 cut-open momo at the center top, revealing a richly textured filling. The cut-open momo erupts with glossy red chili sauce splashing outward in midair, with droplets frozen around it. The 3 whole momos are golden-brown, pleated, blistered, and slightly charred, coated with oil and spice, arranged dynamically above the pan as if tossed upward by heat and motion. The skillet sits in the lower center foreground, filled with sizzling chili oil, sauce, and scattered seasoning, with a metal spatula entering from the right side. Add sparks, steam, oil droplets, and a burst of sauce at pan level for high-energy action. Flames rise beneath the pan at the very bottom edge. In the lower left foreground, show an open takeout box branded with the same logo, containing 4 pale steamed momos, beside a small black dipping bowl of red sauce. In the right background, include a vertical glowing red neon sign reading MOMO. Along the left border, add a slim vertical red text strip reading STREET HEAT • SPICY • FRESH. Along the bottom border, include small footer text: STEAMED & PAN-FRIED MOMOS • SIGNATURE SPICE • {argument name="edition text" default="2026 EDITION"} and the website wowmomo.com. Style: hyper-realistic commercial food photography mixed with action poster design, dramatic contrast, fiery orange-red highlights, deep blacks, wet reflections, crisp textures, shallow depth of field, suspended motion, appetizing glaze, premium fast-food campaign aesthetic.

items.titleZh: A cinematic street food advertisement at night in a rainy city street, shot in a dramatic close-up food photography style with shallow depth of field. In the foreground, a bamboo steamer basket sits on a wet reflective table, filled with exactly 4 plump steamed momos, while a human hand from the right side lifts a fifth momo above the basket. Thick steam rises visibly from the dumplings. To the right front, place a small black bowl of glossy red chili sauce. To the left, include an open yellow takeaway box with the stylized WOW! momo logo printed in black and red, with one momo visible inside. The tabletop is covered with rain droplets, scattered chili flakes, and warm reflections. In the background, show a blurred urban street with car headlights, storefront glow, and falling rain, creating a moody blue-and-amber contrast. Add large distressed bold condensed white typography in the center reading {argument name="headline text" default="CRAVE THE MOMENT"}. At the top left, place the WOW! momo logo. Along the left vertical edge, add the words {argument name="side text" default="WARM • SOFT • COMFORT"} in a narrow vertical layout. Across the top background, faintly repeat the atmospheric words {argument name="background text" default="HEAT / COMFORT / AGAIN / RAIN"}. items.title: 4K Nike Sneaker Advertisement Prompt
items.titleZh:
A hyperrealistic Nike sneaker advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A male leg wearing crisp white athletic crew socks with subtle Nike logo detail is suspended mid-air against a near-black charcoal background, angled diagonally toward the camera at a bold 45-degree perspective. The sneaker — a Nike low-top silhouette featuring a clean two-tone colorway of {argument name="color scheme" default="glacier teal suede panels and off-white tumbled leather"}, with an iridescent chrome Swoosh catching ambient light — dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame.
The composition uses shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the shoe and soft blur on the upper leg. The background is layered with subtle urban texture - faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive, barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the sneaker at different angles, reading phrases like "{argument name="slogan" default="THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"}" - evoking motion, speed, and energy. Some text runs vertically, some at 30-degree angles, giving the composition a chaotic yet intentional graphic design feeling.
At the upper right, the bold Nike wordmark and Swoosh logo appear in clean white against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads: "PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large, commanding headline is placed center-right in contrasting weight typography - "MOVE" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "BEYOND" in lighter weight, creating dramatic type hierarchy.
Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout the composition as accent details, adding a contemporary graphic zine aesthetic. Bottom left features a bold brand slogan lockup: "DEFINE YOUR STRIDE" in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline: "An inspiring reminder that speed is a mindset. Every step forward is a statement." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional - a single cold key light from the left, causing the Swoosh to shimmer and the white leather to glow against the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution, 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.
items.promptZh:
超现实的耐克运动鞋广告，以黑暗、喜怒无常的编辑风格拍摄。一条男性腿穿着清爽的白色运动袜，带有微妙的耐克标志细节，在近乎黑色的木炭背景下悬浮在半空中，以大胆的 45 度视角斜向镜头。这款运动鞋是一款 Nike 低帮鞋款，采用简洁的双色配色（{argument name="配色方案" default="冰川青色绒面革面板和灰白色翻滚皮革"}），并带有可捕捉环境光线的虹彩镀铬 Swoosh 标志，占据了框架下三分之二的位置。
该构图使用浅景深，鞋子上的焦点清晰，大腿上的柔和模糊。背景具有微妙的城市质感——电黄色和柔和的橄榄色的微弱涂鸦笔触，透过厚重的深色小插图几乎看不见。多排超小全大写文字以不同角度环绕运动鞋，阅读诸如“{argument name="slogan" default="THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE OneS YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"}”之类的短语 - 唤起运动、速度和能量。有些文字是垂直的，有些是 30 度角，给构图一种混乱但有意的图形设计感觉。
在右上角，醒目的 Nike 字标和 Swoosh 标志在深色背景的衬托下以干净的白色呈现。在顶部中心，有一个细长的水平导航式文本栏，上面写着：“PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW”，采用间隔全大写衬线字体。一个大的、居高临下的标题被放置在对比粗细字体的中间偏右——“MOVE”是巨大的超粗体白色字母，后面是较轻的粗体字母“BEYOND”，创造了戏剧性的字体层次结构。
小黄色加号 (+) 符号和对角箭头 (↗) 作为强调细节散布在整个构图中，增添了当代图形杂志美感。左下角有一个大胆的品牌口号锁定：“DEFINE YOUR STRIDE”，采用大号粗体无衬线白色文本，带有细副线：“鼓舞人心的提醒，速度是一种心态。每一步前进都是一个声明。”整体灯光戏剧性且具有方向性——来自左侧的一盏冷键灯，使 Swoosh 闪闪发光，白色皮革在黑暗中闪闪发光。逼真。商业摄影品质。高对比度。 4K 分辨率、3:4 垂直格式，针对社交媒体进行了优化。

items.title: Cinematic Summer Lifestyle Photo
items.titleZh:
A cinematic, high-end lifestyle visual of a young woman walking along a sunlit road on a hot summer day. She is mid-action, drinking from a chilled {argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} can, with visible condensation droplets emphasizing the heat and refreshment contrast. She has wireless earbuds in her ears, immersed in her own vibe.

Her face must closely match the provided reference image — accurate facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and expression — polished, natural, and visually appealing.

She is wearing a coordinated {argument name="outfit color" default="red"} outfit: a stylish crop top (half sleeves, ending above the belly) paired with a short skirt that extends to just above the knees. The outfit is modern, clean, and fashion-forward. She also wears a matching cap, adding a sporty street-style aesthetic.

Environment: an open road under strong sunlight, subtle heat haze in the background, warm tones suggesting a hot day. The lighting is bright and slightly harsh, with realistic shadows and highlights on skin and clothing.

The {argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} can is detailed with a crisp logo, metallic reflections, and condensation. Her interaction with it feels natural and candid, like a moment captured during a walk.

Composition is dynamic and lifestyle-oriented, with slight motion (hair movement, walking posture). Background softly blurred for depth, keeping focus on the subject.

Color grading: warm, summery tones balanced with the bold {argument name="outfit color" default="red"} outfit and cool blue of the {argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} branding for contrast.

Style: cinematic lifestyle photography, commercial beverage ad, street fashion aesthetic

Resolution: ultra high resolution, 4K, highly detailed, photorealistic
items.promptZh:
一个年轻女子在炎热的夏日沿着阳光明媚的道路行走的电影般的高端生活方式视觉效果。她正忙着喝一罐冰镇的{argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"}罐头饮料，可见的冷凝水滴强调了热量和清爽的对比。她的耳朵里戴着无线耳机，沉浸在自己的氛围中。

她的脸必须与提供的参考图像紧密匹配——准确的面部结构、肤色、发型和表情——优雅、自然且具有视觉吸引力。

她穿着一套协调的{argument name="outfit color" default="red"}服装：时尚的露脐上衣（半袖，末端位于腹部上方）搭配延伸至膝盖上方的短裙。这套服装现代、干净、时尚。她还戴着配套的帽子，增添了运动街头风格的美感。

环境：强烈阳光下的开阔道路，背景中有淡淡的热雾，温暖的色调暗示着炎热的天气。灯光明亮且略显刺眼，皮肤和衣服上有逼真的阴影和高光。

{argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} 罐头饰有清晰的徽标、金属反射和冷凝效果。她与它的互动感觉自然而坦诚，就像散步时捕捉到的瞬间。

构图充满活力，以生活方式为导向，有轻微的动作（头发的移动、行走的姿势）。背景柔和模糊以增强深度，将焦点集中在主题上。

颜色分级：温暖的夏日色调与大胆的{argument name="outfit color" default="red"}服装和{argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"}品牌的冷蓝色形成对比。

风格：电影生活摄影、商业饮料广告、街头时尚美学

分辨率：超高分辨率、4K、高细节、逼真

items.title: Dark Fantasy PS5 RPG Cover Art
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG key art designed like a PlayStation 5 game cover poster. Vertical composition, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, cinematic dark fantasy. In the background, count 2 enormous black-purple dragons: one dominant dragon on the upper right with mouth wide open, glowing orange fire in its throat, jagged obsidian scales, and blazing eyes; one second dragon silhouette on the upper left with wings spread across the sky. Full moon in the center-top sky, purple nebula clouds, embers, ash, magical sparks, and a ruined gothic castle city on the right background. In the foreground, count 3 female elf warriors standing in a heroic triangular formation, all wearing ornate metallic armor with glossy magenta, silver, and violet tones. Center character: blonde elf princess-warrior, short to medium hair, small crown or jeweled tiara, white fur mantle over shoulders, polished silver armor exposing midriff, black gloves, confident battle stance, wielding a gigantic double-bladed ceremonial axe with intricate filigree, turquoise crystal core, and engraved silver-blue blades. Left character: taller elf archer-warrior with long light brown hair, pointed ears, elaborate rose-magenta armor, large curved fantasy sword in her right hand, and a quiver of pink-fletched arrows on her back. Right character: long dark magenta-haired elf swordswoman with floral hair ornaments, violet-magenta armor, black cape, holding a slender sword angled downward. The image should feel like premium box art for an original game titled {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}. Include visible game-package typography and branding elements: top left white PS5 logo; top right small bracketed studio tag [O-prompt laboratory]; large vertical Japanese slogan on the right side; count 2 lines of Japanese promotional copy on the upper left; the main title in huge glowing gold serif letters across the bottom center reading {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}; a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it; bottom left CERO C rating badge; bottom center count 3 short Japanese feature blurbs separated by diamond icons; bottom right OPL logo. Use a lavish painted-anime-meets-hyperreal style, dense detail, polished reflections, fiery rim light, purple and orange color contrast, and the overall feel of a mature-rated epic console fantasy adventure cover.
items.promptZh: 一款戏剧性的日本奇幻动作角色扮演游戏，其关键艺术设计类似于 PlayStation 5 游戏封面海报。垂直构图，超细致，高对比度，电影般的黑暗幻想。在背景中，数着两条巨大的黑紫色龙：右上方的一条占主导地位的龙，张着大嘴，喉咙里闪烁着橙色的火焰，锯齿状的黑曜石鳞片和炽热的眼睛；另一条则在右上方。左上方的一秒龙剪影，展翅翱翔于天空。天空中央的满月，紫色的星云，余烬，灰烬，魔法的火花，以及右侧背景上一座被毁坏的哥特式城堡城市。在前景中，有 3 名女性精灵战士站成英勇的三角形队形，她们都穿着华丽的金属盔甲，有光泽的洋红色、银色和紫色色调。中心人物：金发精灵公主战士，短发至中长发，头戴小皇冠或宝石头饰，肩上披着白色毛皮斗篷，身穿抛光银色铠甲，露出腹部，戴着黑色手套，自信的战斗姿态，挥舞着一把巨大的双刃礼仪斧，上面有复杂的花丝、绿松石水晶芯和雕刻的银蓝色刀片。左边的角色：身材较高的精灵弓箭手战士，浅棕色长发，尖耳朵，精致的玫瑰洋红色盔甲，右手握着巨大的弯曲奇幻剑，背上有一袋粉红色羽毛的箭。右侧角色：长长的深紫红色头发，头戴花卉发饰，身穿紫红色铠甲，黑色斗篷，手持向下倾斜的细长剑。该图片应该感觉像是一款名为 {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} 的原创游戏的高级盒装艺术。包括可见的游戏包版式和品牌元素：左上角白色 PS5 徽标；右上角小括号工作室标签 [O-提示实验室]；右侧大型竖式日文标语；数一下左上角有2行日文宣传文案；主标题位于底部中心，以巨大的发光金色衬线字母显示：{argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}；下面有一个较小的日文字幕；左下角 CERO C 评级徽章；底部中心有 3 个简短的日语功能简介，由菱形图标分隔；右下角 OPL 徽标。使用奢华的动漫与超现实的绘画风格、密集的细节、抛光的反射、火热的边缘光、紫色和橙色的色彩对比，以及成熟评级的史诗控制台奇幻冒险封面的整体感觉。

items.title: Anime McDonald's Recommendation Poster
items.titleZh: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional anime poster in a vertical layout, themed around McDonald's recommendations. The background is a bold red and white graphic design with golden sparkles, sweeping shapes, and energetic ad-style composition. In the upper left corner, show the McDonald's golden arches logo inside a red square. On the left half, feature a stylish anime girl with fox or wolf ears and a fluffy tail, shown from mid-thigh up, wearing a modern dark navy and black streetwear outfit with blue accents: cropped top exposing the midriff, layered jacket, belt, straps, and small decorative pins. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple"}, medium-length and tousled. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft blurred rectangular censor block. She holds a large sesame-seed burger in her left hand and gestures invitingly with her right hand toward the food items. Across the top right, include large Japanese headline text reading 彩葉のおすすめ！マクドナルド, with a smaller black banner beneath it reading 食べたくなる定番メニューをチェック！. Arrange 4 numbered menu callouts in rounded white speech-bubble labels with red and yellow accents: item 1 is ビッグマック next to a Big Mac image near the center-right; item 2 is マックフライポテト next to a tall red fries carton on the right; item 3 is チキンマックナゲット next to an open nugget box containing exactly 6 chicken nuggets and a cup of red dipping sauce near the lower center-right; item 4 is てりやきマックバーガー next to a glossy teriyaki burger near the lower left-center. Also place a white McDonald's drink cup with ice and dark soda in the bottom left. On the right side, include 2 small informational badges stacked vertically: one badge with a sun and moon icon and Japanese text 朝は朝マック、夜は夜マックも楽しめる！, and one badge with a smartphone icon and Japanese text アプリでモバイルオーダーも便利！. At the very bottom, add a large bold Japanese slogan in white and yellow on a red banner: 今日はマックに行きたくなる！. Add tiny disclaimer text along the lower edge. The illustration style is polished, colorful anime key visual art mixed with commercial food photography rendering for the burgers, fries, nuggets, and drink; highly appetizing, glossy lighting, clean outlines, dynamic ad composition, and a cheerful promotional mood.

items.title: Anime KFC Princess Promo Poster
items.titleZh: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional poster in glossy anime advertising style, themed around KFC and a magical princess mascot. The composition is vertical and packed but still a single unified ad scene. At center-right, a cheerful young anime woman inspired by Princess Kaguya poses energetically toward the viewer with one hand reaching forward and the other arm lifted. She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, large sparkling amber-red eyes, a bright open smile, and ornate hair accessories including red floral ornaments, dangling beads, green ribbons, and a small gold crescent-moon crown. She wears a festive kimono-inspired outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative cords, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with a flower knot. Her hair and sleeves sweep dramatically as if caught in a lively breeze. In the lower left foreground, show 1 large KFC bucket overflowing with 4 pieces of crispy fried chicken, rendered extra crunchy, golden, juicy, and appetizing. Along the bottom foreground, include 3 side items: 1 chicken burger with sesame bun and lettuce, 1 small carton of fries, and 1 biscuit or pie-like pastry topped with glossy syrup. Use the KFC logo in the top right and on the bucket and fries carton, with the Colonel face partially censored by a rectangular blur on the bucket. Surround the scene with celebratory red-and-gold graphics, sparkles, brushstroke flourishes, and festive Japanese New Year-like motifs. Add large bold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading ケンタッキーの魅力 in thick red characters with white and gold outline. Add 2 white brushstroke callout bubbles on the left with red text: サクッと香ばしい！ and ジューシーで大満足！. Add a red flower-shaped badge on the right reading 今日のごほうびに. Add a red bottom banner with white text listing オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット. Extremely polished commercial illustration, high saturation, warm lighting, clean line art, glossy food rendering, energetic composition, premium poster finish.

items.title: Anime MOS Burger Promo Poster
items.titleZh:
A polished Japanese fast-food promotional poster in a bright anime-advertisement style, combining a fantasy princess character with clean product photography and cheerful branding. The composition is landscape and split visually: on the left, a full-body anime girl inspired by a moon-princess or bamboo-princess aesthetic stands in a welcoming pose with one hand extended toward the viewer and the other hand near her face. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white with pastel pink and lavender gradients"} hair, large expressive eyes, and an elegant floral-and-ribbon hair ornament in dark blue, gold, pink, and turquoise. Her outfit is a luxurious modernized kimono dress in white, teal, navy, and pink with translucent sleeves, floral patterns, layered obi bows, tassels, and gold ornaments, with a magical sparkling atmosphere around her. Behind her is a dreamy teal-and-cream background with soft circles, starry sparkles, faint floral motifs, sweeping decorative lines, and a subtle silhouette of a Japanese pagoda.

On the right is a neat food-ad layout for {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"}, with the red MOS BURGER logo at the top left corner and again at the bottom right. At the top center-right, place a green ribbon banner with the Japanese text "モスバーガー特集". Below it, add a large elegant handwritten-style Japanese headline: "行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。" with the middle phrase "できたて" emphasized in vivid pink-red while the rest is black. Under that, add a smaller subheadline in Japanese: "ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー". 

Feature exactly 4 food items arranged horizontally across the middle-right, each rendered as appetizing semi-photorealistic product shots with soft shadows and crisp detail. Item 1: a classic burger with bun, thick meat patty, sauce, mayonnaise, and a large tomato slice, with a red circular badge reading "定番人気" and the label "モスバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 2: a teriyaki burger with lettuce and glossy sauce, with a green circular badge reading "和風人気" and the label "テリヤキバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 3: a white paper carton of onion rings with a yellow circular badge reading "サイドも最高" and the label "オニポテ" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 4: a pink milkshake in a clear cup with straw, with a blue circular badge reading "ひんやり甘い" and the label "モスシェイク" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. 

Below the products, add a rounded rectangular recommendation box with a teal border and a teal ribbon title reading "おすすめポイント". Inside, include exactly 4 bullet points in Japanese with pink flower-like bullets, describing made-to-order freshness, the appeal of the classic meat sauce and tomato burger, the Japanese-style popularity of teriyaki burger, and that onion rings and shake are also must-try items. To the right inside the same lower area, include a smaller rounded box with line-art icons of cutlery, a drink, and a burger, plus Japanese copy that reads "モスのこだわり" and "おいしさは、まごころから。" followed by smaller explanatory Japanese text.

Across the bottom, place a large curved banner with a teal gradient and white center glow containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the lower right, add a small orange-red circular callout with Japanese text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!". Use a crisp commercial poster layout, vivid teal, aqua, white, pink, and gold accents, glossy food rendering, decorative sparkles, and a premium collaboration feel between anime fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

Use warm golden-brown lighting, dramatic shadows, and a luxurious editorial mood. Add strong radial motion blur along both side walls to create speed and momentum while keeping the man mostly sharp. His face is obscured by a rectangular blur block, giving the image a mysterious branded-campaign look. Overlay large bold condensed white uppercase text across the center reading {argument name="headline text" default="UNSTOPPABLE."}. Beneath it, add smaller spaced uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="JUGGERNAUT. LORD OF THE UNIVERSE."}. Place vertical white brand text along the right edge reading {argument name="brand name" default="JUGGERKNOT"}, with a minimal curved logo mark near the top right. In the bottom left, add small uppercase copy reading {argument name="product copy" default="COTTON TEE. 365-DAY WARRANTY."}. In the bottom center, add a tiny premium-fabric line with 4 materials separated by vertical bars: {argument name="fabric line" default="SUPIMA | MERINO | LYOCELL | PIMA"}. High-end streetwear campaign aesthetic, symmetrical composition, shallow depth of field, rich sepia grading, poster-ready typography, ultra-detailed, photorealistic.

items.title: Japanese Anime AI Launch Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vibrant Japanese promotional poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Sousaku.ai"} announcing {argument name="product name" default="GPT Image 2.0"}. Use a vertical 3:4 layout with a flashy anime-tech advertising style, bright cyan, blue, purple, pink, and white gradients, glowing sparkles, lens flares, halftone dots, and dynamic diagonal light streaks. On the right side, feature a large half-body anime girl mascot in a futuristic streetwear outfit, silver-white long wavy hair with cool blue highlights, pale skin, blue eyes, a confident smile, and one hand thrust toward the viewer with an extended pointing finger in strong foreshortened perspective. She wears a glossy white and blue jacket over a dark inner outfit, a black choker, layered accessories, and a visible badge or tag with an S logo and the text Sousaku.ai. Her face area is covered by a plain square censor block. On the left, place a large stacked headline in bold Japanese display typography with thick outlines and drop shadows reading exactly: "Sousaku.aiに", "GPT Image 2.0", "が来た！". Below it, add a blue ribbon banner with white text reading "話題の現最強モデル". Under that, add a rounded blue header box with white text reading "GPT Image 2.0のここがすごい！". Beneath the header, create 4 rounded rectangular feature panels stacked vertically, each with a pastel icon circle on the left, Japanese text in the center, and a sample image thumbnail on the right. Panel 1: icon is a speech bubble with a Japanese flag, headline text in pink-red "日本語プロンプトOK", smaller black explanatory text in 3 lines, and a thumbnail of a traditional Japanese street with a pagoda and cherry blossoms. Panel 2: icon is a yellow lightning bolt, headline text in orange "即座に高品質生成", smaller black explanatory text in 3 lines, and a thumbnail of a futuristic neon city at night. Panel 3: icon is an artist palette and brush, headline text in green "多彩な表現力", smaller black explanatory text in 3 lines, and a thumbnail of an anime fantasy girl in a snowy or bright scenic setting, with the face lightly obscured. Panel 4: icon is a magic wand with sparkles, headline text in purple "高い一貫性と精度", smaller black explanatory text in 2 lines, and a thumbnail row containing exactly 3 close-up anime character portrait variants side by side, each face obscured. At the very bottom, add a bold call-to-action on a dark blue strip reading exactly "→ {argument name="call to action" default="Sousaku.ai で試してみよう"}" with the brand name in large yellow letters and the remaining text in white. items.titleZh: Analyze the uploaded X (Twitter) profile screenshot. First, extract my profile picture, display name, and bio text. Design it to look like a Japanese news program (similar to NHK News or News Zero style). All text must be in Japanese. Include the following elements: 1. A red "速報" banner at the top of the screen. 2. A large headline in Japanese summarizing who I am based on my bio (e.g., "AI時代の案内人 ○○氏 独占取材"). 3. A fictional Japanese news channel logo in the corner (e.g., "プロフィールTV" or "X速報チャンネル"). 6. A "生中継" or "LIVE" indicator in red in the upper corner. The overall look should be a photorealistic Japanese TV news broadcast screen with clean, modern Japanese typography. Ensure all Japanese text is perfectly legible and accurately reflects my profile information.

items.title: Pastel Blue Crocs Fashion Ad
items.titleZh: A high-end studio advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}, in a monochrome pastel blue and white color palette, with a glossy reflective floor and a soft sky-blue backdrop. The background is dominated by the word {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"} in gigantic bold white condensed sans-serif letters spanning nearly the full height of the image. In the top-right corner, add small white text reading "Designed with ChatGPT". Feature 3 adult women with shoulder-length wavy light brown to dark blonde hair, all wearing loose oversized white long-sleeve tops and flowing white wide-leg pants, styled as minimalist fashion models with relaxed neutral expressions. Their faces are intentionally obscured or blurred. One model reclines against an enormous upright white clog shoe on the left side, one model sits casually on top of a giant white clog on the upper right, and one model lounges on the floor at the lower right, leaning back on one arm while seated partly on a glossy blue sphere. Include 2 oversized white clog shoes as hero props: one standing vertically on the left showing the sole and side profile, and one angled on blue crystalline blocks at center-right showing the upper and toe box. Both clogs are classic foam slip-on style with perforation holes, chunky tread, heel straps, and circular logo rivets. The center-right clog is decorated with exactly 8 visible charms pinned to the upper: a blue-green iridescent round charm, a white daisy with yellow center, a black-and-white round emblem near the strap, a small "CROCS" word charm, a dark flower, a peace-hand sign, an orange smiley face, a white cloud, and an orange flower. Scatter exactly 7 glossy floating or grounded blue spheres of varying sizes around the set: one large sphere behind the left model, one medium sphere floating near center, one medium sphere at bottom left foreground, one medium sphere used as a seat under the lower-right model, one small sphere near the upper left, and 2 additional blue spheres integrated into the composition. Add translucent sculptural gel-like forms at the far left and far right edges, plus angular blue crystal-like rocks beneath the right shoe. At the bottom center, place white promotional copy in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} on the first line and {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} on the second line. Beneath that, show 4 minimalist feature icons with labels in white: "ICONIC COMFORT", "LIGHTWEIGHT", "EASY TO CLEAN", and "UNIQUELY YOU". Place the {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} logo in bold lowercase white at the bottom center with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should feel like a premium surreal fashion campaign, clean editorial lighting, soft shadows, glossy textures, airy composition, and modern lifestyle product advertising.

items.title: Pixel Art Bolirana Night Scene
items.titleZh: A moody retro pixel art scene inside a Colombian neighborhood bar at night, shown in portrait orientation from a first-person perspective. In the foreground, a human hand at the bottom center holds a small shiny metal bolirana ball between the thumb and fingers, aimed toward a full bolirana lane machine in the middle of the room. The machine is custom themed with The Simpsons and Duff Beer branding: a red and yellow wooden lane with a large circular scoring hole at the front edge, several smaller scoring holes arranged near the backboard, three upright metal pins or bumpers, a backboard logo that says "Duff," and the text "THE SIMPSONS" near the lower front. The top marquee of the machine says "Tomate tu" and has a built-in digital score screen showing exactly 3 player labels: "JUGADOR 1", "JUGADOR 0", and "JUGADOR 2" with colorful pixelated score graphics. items.title: Japanese Space Conference Poster
items.titleZh: A polished Japanese event poster in a dramatic, aspirational sci-fi tourism style for {argument name="event year" default="2026"}, vertical layout, rich deep-blue space background blending into a bright daytime cityscape. At the top, outer space with a detailed Earth seen from orbit at upper left, a radiant sun flare at the planet’s edge, dense stars and faint nebulae across the sky. Large bold central Japanese headline text in white with subtle gold accents and a strong drop shadow: 「宇宙科学技術 連合講演会 {argument name="event year" default="2026"}」, with a smaller slogan above reading 「宇宙の未来を、ともに拓く。」. Surrounding the title, exactly 4 space elements: 1 lunar lander descending at left, 1 small satellite with blue solar panels near center-left, 1 larger satellite at upper right, and 1 white rocket launching vertically on the right with bright exhaust and billowing smoke. Add elegant golden orbital swoosh lines circling around the title and spacecraft. Below the title, place a gold badge reading 「宇科連」 and several centered lines of smaller Japanese descriptive text about Japan’s largest academic event for space science and technology, involving space science, JAXA space policy, space development startups, and comprehensive discussions on Japan’s space development strategy. The lower half transitions to a realistic panoramic view of Utsunomiya, Japan, with mountains in the distance and Mount Fuji-like snowy peak visible on the horizon, modern mid-rise city buildings, and a wide tram corridor. Feature a sleek modern yellow-and-black light rail tram prominently in the lower right foreground, angled toward the viewer, glossy reflective windows, destination sign reading 「宇都宮駅東口」, with overhead lines absent for a clean futuristic feel. Near the right midground behind the tram, include a large white satellite dish antenna facility. At the lower left, show a plated serving of exactly 6 golden-brown gyoza dumplings on a white dish with a small soy sauce dipping bowl in front; add a curved red Japanese label on the plate rim reading 「宇都宮餃子」. Near the gyoza and tram, include a circular dark-blue callout with gold trim describing the host city and specialties, with Japanese text indicating 「開催地 宇都宮市」 and noting famous local items: gyoza and the Utsunomiya light rail. Along the bottom, create a structured navy information band with gold and white text. Include exactly 5 major information blocks: 1) date block on the left with Japanese text 「会期 2026年 11月10日(火)〜11月13日(金)」 in large high-contrast type, 2) organizer/sponsor block listing 「主催 JSASS 一般社団法人 日本航空宇宙学会」 and co-host logos/text for JAXA and NICT plus a smaller line for additional participating academic societies and organizations, 3) venue block with Japanese text 「会場 ライトキューブ宇都宮 栃木県宇都宮市宮みらい1-20」 plus a small rectangular inset photo of a modern glass building, 4) a row of exactly 5 icon-labeled topic categories reading 「宇宙科学」「宇宙探査・観測」「宇宙開発ミッション（JAXA等）」「宇宙政策・制度」「宇宙ビジネス・スタートアップ」 with simple white line icons above each label, and 5) a website/QR block at the bottom right with a search-bar style URL area showing a JSASS conference URL, a visible QR code, and a yellow circular sticker saying 「今後の情報をお届け！」. Use clean commercial-poster composition, glossy photorealistic montage, crisp typography, realistic lighting, strong contrast, gold highlight accents, and a premium official event-poster finish.

items.titleZh: Create a high-impact Japanese anime magazine cover in a futuristic cyberpunk style, vertical portrait format, featuring a close-up ensemble composition of {argument name="main character" default="a pink-haired anime girl"} as the dominant subject. She has a short bob with layered bangs, large violet-pink eyes, pale skin, and a calm but intense expression, wearing a black baseball cap with white text, black X-shaped hairpins, a glossy black streetwear jacket with reflective graphic patches, and a magenta hood. She leans toward the viewer from the upper right-center, with one hand extended toward the camera in dramatic foreshortened perspective. Around her are 4 additional character panels total: 1 partially hidden silver-haired character in the center foreground beneath her, wearing a black cap; 1 silver-haired male character in the lower left triangular panel with dark clothing and earrings; 1 black-haired male character with a bold white forelock and golden eyes in the lower center panel; and 1 blonde female character in the lower right panel with a dark choker and layered fashion styling. Design the image as a glossy magazine cover with dense Japanese typography and editorial layout. Place a very large bold white Japanese headline on the upper left reading {argument name="main headline" default="交差する未来線"}, with smaller Japanese subhead text nearby. Add a top-right issue block reading “FEATURE”, “VOL. 03”, “2024 SPRING”, and “創刊号”. Add vertical Japanese sidebar text along the right edge, a left-side feature box with multiple lines of Japanese copy and a large magenta “5”, a bottom-left page marker reading “3/5 PAGE”, and small English tag labels near the lower panels such as “+ CONNECT”, “+ IDENTITY”, and “+ RESONANCE”. Include a bottom-center Japanese caption strip and a small emblem logo at the bottom right. Use a neon color palette dominated by {argument name="primary color palette" default="electric magenta, violet, black, and cyan"}, with glowing rim light, ink splatter accents, sharp graphic diagonals, halftone textures, glossy highlights, and layered UI-like editorial details. The overall feeling should be edgy, youthful, stylish, and cinematic, like a premium sci-fi visual culture magazine cover.
