items.title: Neon Energy Drink Sports Poster
items.titleZh: Create a hyper-dynamic commercial poster for a {argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"} energy drink, in a high-contrast neon sports-advertising style. Use a vertical poster layout with a dark electric-blue and black background, dramatic lighting, rain droplets, motion streaks, lightning, and liquid splash effects. The centerpiece is one oversized aluminum can tilted diagonally to the right, floating above a glowing splash impact. The can is matte black with water condensation, a metallic silver rim, a bright lime-green pull tab, and a huge jagged X logo in lime green and electric blue across the front. On the can, include the text "EXTREME ENERGY" near the top rim, the main brand name "{argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"}", the subtitle "ENERGY DRINK", the flavor line "{argument name="flavor text" default="CITRUS BLAST"}", the phrase "NATURALLY FLAVORED", and the size "16 FL OZ (473 mL)". Behind and around the can, show explosive blue and neon-green liquid splashes, electric arcs, glowing particles, and speed energy trails. In the top left, place a small brand mark reading "Pollo AI" with "GPT Image 2" beneath it. Across the upper left to center, add a huge brush-lettered headline in layered colors: "{argument name="headline text" default="UNLEASH YOUR ENERGY"}", with "UNLEASH" in acid lime, "YOUR" in white, and "ENERGY" in vivid electric blue, all in rough painted typography. Under the headline, add the slogan "POWER. FOCUS. DOMINATE." with the three words colored lime, blue, and orange. In the top right, place an angled lime-green sticker with black text reading "NEW EXTREME FORMULA". On the left side, add one slanted dark feature panel with the heading "FUEL YOUR EVERY MOVE" and exactly 3 feature bullets with icons: 1) a yellow lightning bolt icon with "EXPLOSIVE ENERGY", 2) a blue target icon with "SHARP FOCUS", 3) an orange running figure icon with "MAXIMUM PERFORMANCE". On the right side, add exactly 3 standalone circular icon callouts stacked vertically: 1) yellow lightning icon with "MORE ENERGY MORE YOU", 2) blue brain icon with "MENTAL CLARITY ALL DAY", 3) orange flexed arm icon with "BUILT FOR CHAMPIONS". At the bottom left, include a silhouetted male runner sprinting forward with green, blue, and orange speed trails behind him. Along the bottom edge, show a futuristic city skyline with glowing windows reflected on a wet street surface. Add a bright lime brushstroke banner at the bottom with the text "RISE ABOVE. STAY UNSTOPPABLE." Overall mood: aggressive, exhilarating, powerful, premium fitness marketing, ultra-polished product poster, precise text rendering, crisp print-ready composition.
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"}能量饮料制作一张超动态的商业海报，采用高对比度霓虹灯运动广告风格。使用具有深电蓝色和黑色背景、戏剧性灯光、雨滴、运动条纹、闪电和液体飞溅效果的垂直海报布局。中心装饰是一个向右对角倾斜的超大铝罐，漂浮在发光的飞溅冲击上方。罐子呈哑光黑色，带有水凝结，金属银色边缘，明亮的石灰绿色拉环，正面有一个巨大的锯齿状 X 标志，采用石灰绿和电蓝色。在罐头上，包括顶部边缘附近的文字“EXTREME ENERGY”、主要品牌名称“{argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"}”、副标题“ENERGY DRINK”、风味线“{argument name="flavor text" default="CITRUS BLAST"}”、短语“NATURALLY FLAVORED”和尺寸“16 FL OZ (473 mL)”。在罐子的后面和周围，展示了爆炸性的蓝色和霓虹绿色液体飞溅、电弧、发光粒子和速度能量痕迹。在左上角放置一个小品牌标记，上面写着“Pollo AI”，其下方带有“GPT Image 2”。从左上角到中间，添加一个巨大的分层颜色的毛笔标题：“{argument name=”headline text”default=”UNLEASH YOUR ENERGY”}”，其中“UNLEASH”为酸性石灰，“YOUR”为白色，“ENERGY”为生动的电蓝色，所有字体均采用粗糙的彩绘字体。在标题下添加口号“力量、聚焦、统治”。上面写着石灰、蓝色和橙色这三个词。在右上角，放置一个有角度的石灰绿色贴纸，上面写着黑色文字“NEW EXTREME FORMULA”。在左侧，添加一个倾斜的深色功能面板，标题为“为您的每一步加油”，并且恰好有 3 个带有图标的功能项目符号：1) 带有“爆炸能量”的黄色闪电图标，2) 带有“锐利聚焦”的蓝色目标图标，3) 带有“最大性能”的橙色跑步人物图标。在右侧，添加 3 个垂直堆叠的独立圆形图标标注：1) 带有“MORE ENERGY MORE YOU”的黄色闪电图标，2) 带有“全天思维清晰”的蓝色大脑图标，3) 带有“BUILT FOR CHAMPIONS”的橙色弯曲手臂图标。左下角有一位男性跑步者的剪影，他向前冲刺，身后有绿色、蓝色和橙色的速度轨迹。沿着底部边缘，展示了未来的城市天际线，发光的窗户反射在潮湿的街道表面上。在底部添加明亮的石灰笔触横幅，上面写着“崛起。保持不可阻挡。”整体情绪：进取、令人兴奋、强大、优质的健身营销、超精致的产品海报、精确的文本渲染、清晰的可打印构图。

items.title: Retro Super Famicom RPG Ad
items.titleZh: Create a full-page vintage Japanese Super Famicom game box advertisement designed like a worn 1990s magazine spread or game package front, on aged yellowed paper with creases, stains, frayed corners, fold marks, and slight print fading. The layout should feel authentically retro and densely composed, with bold Japanese promotional copy, a fake fantasy RPG logo, a character lineup on the right, a gameplay screenshot on the left, and pricing and feature callouts near the bottom. At the top left, place a large black “SUPER FAMICOM” header with smaller Japanese subtitle text beneath it, and nearby a red Japanese slogan line. At the top right, include a small Super Famicom style logo badge in a black rectangle with the English text “SUPER FAMICOM LICENSED BY NINTENDO” underneath. In the upper center, feature the game title logo “Epic 7 Seven” in ornate fantasy typography, dark teal and black, layered over a circular magical crest or sigil in pale blue. Under the logo, add small Japanese katakana subtitle text. On the right half, show 4 anime fantasy party members in a polished JRPG promotional illustration style: 1 white-haired young male hero in a white cloak and blue-black outfit holding a sword, 1 pink-haired female knight or mage in dark armor with gold trim, 1 tall long-black-haired swordsman in dark layered robes, and 1 blonde twin-tailed maid girl in a black-and-white frilled dress reaching one hand forward. Their faces should be generic and soft-featured, front-facing or three-quarter view, grouped in a heroic composition. Add 4 dark blue nameplates with Japanese character names and short class descriptions near each character. Place a tall vertical yellow Japanese slogan with black outline between the screenshot and the character group. On the left lower-middle, include 1 in-game battle screenshot framed in a dark blue rounded rectangle: a pixel-art dungeon battle scene showing 1 purple dragon monster facing a 4-character party in a stone corridor. At the bottom of the battle screen, show a classic RPG interface with 4 command options in Japanese and a party status list with character names, HP, and MP values. In the lower left, add a red Japanese headline followed by 4 black square bullet points of Japanese feature text. Near the bottom center, place a red circular burst sticker with white Japanese text indicating strong sales, beside a large printed price reading “9,800円” with smaller surrounding Japanese retail text. At the bottom right, include 1 yellow information box labeled “RPG” with additional Japanese text and a separate dark box below for player count reading “1人”. Use a muted retro print palette of cream, dark blue, teal, red, gold, black, and faded pastel character colors. The whole image should resemble a highly convincing fictional Super Famicom advertisement for a classic fantasy RPG titled {argument name="game title" default="Epic 7 Seven"}, with visible Japanese text, nostalgic print imperfections, and authentic 1990s console game marketing design.

items.title: Cute Gamelist App Logo Mockup
items.titleZh: Create a clean flat vector app logo presentation on a dark UI background. Center a large rounded-rectangle preview card in warm light beige. Inside the card, place a cute minimalist gaming logo: on the left, a stylized handheld game console icon drawn as a rounded rectangular device stacked over 2 visible offset layers like pages or cards, with a small ribbon bookmark hanging from the bottom edge. The console body is coral red with cream screen details, thin dark brown outlines, and tiny dark brown controller symbols: 1 cross-shaped D-pad on the left, 4 small circular buttons on the right, plus 4 tiny decorative dots in the center forming a smiling playful face impression. To the right of the icon, place the lowercase brand wordmark {argument name="brand name" default="gamelist"} in thick rounded geometric sans-serif letters, colored coral red to match the icon. Keep the spacing balanced so the icon and text read as one cohesive modern startup logo. Use a soft, friendly, vector-only aesthetic with no gradients, no photorealism, no texture, and high SVG-friendly simplicity. The palette should be limited to 4 colors: {argument name="primary color" default="coral red"}, cream, dark brown, and warm light beige. Show 4 small vertical thumbnail variations aligned along the right side of the dark interface, each showing the same logo on slightly different light neutral backgrounds. Add subtle UI framing only: a circular gray Edit button at bottom left of the large preview card, a circular gray share/upload button at bottom right of the card, and small monochrome action icons below the card on the dark background. Overall composition should look like a screenshot of an AI image generation result showcasing an app logo concept.
items.promptZh: 在深色 UI 背景上创建干净的平面矢量应用程序徽标演示。居中放置一张大圆角矩形预览卡，颜色为暖浅米色。在卡片内部，放置一个可爱的简约游戏徽标：左侧是一个风格化的手持游戏机图标，绘制为圆角矩形设备，堆叠在 2 个可见的偏移层（如页面或卡片）上，底部边缘悬挂着一个小丝带书签。主机主体为珊瑚红色，带有奶油色屏幕细节、细长的深棕色轮廓和微小的深棕色控制器符号：左侧 1 个十字形方向键，右侧 4 个小圆形按钮，加上中央的 4 个微小装饰点，形成笑脸俏皮的印象。在图标的右侧，将小写品牌文字标记 {argument name="brand name" default="gamelist"} 放置在厚圆形几何无衬线字母中，颜色为珊瑚红色以与图标相匹配。保持间距平衡，使图标和文本看起来像一个有凝聚力的现代初创公司徽标。使用柔和、友好、纯矢量的美感，没有渐变、没有真实感、没有纹理，并且具有高度 SVG 友好的简单性。调色板应限制为 4 种颜色：{argument name="primary color" default="coral red"}、奶油色、深棕色和暖浅米色。显示沿深色界面右侧对齐的 4 个小的垂直缩略图变化，每个变化在略有不同的浅色中性背景上显示相同的徽标。仅添加微妙的 UI 框架：大预览卡左下角的圆形灰色编辑按钮、卡右下角的圆形灰色共享/上传按钮以及深色背景上的卡下方的小型单色操作图标。整体构图应该看起来像展示应用程序徽标概念的人工智能图像生成结果的屏幕截图。

items.titleZh: A cinematic parody streaming-poster in vertical 2:3 format, styled like a dark Netflix original teaser poster for a humorous AI programming drama. At the very top, small white text reads {argument name="top banner text" default="A NETFLIX ORIGINAL"}. Centered and dominating the composition, huge glowing sci-fi sans serif title text in icy white with a faint lavender-blue neon bloom reads {argument name="title text" default="VIBE CODER"}, stacked on two lines. Below it, smaller white text says "STARRING" and beneath that a pink cast name in bold all caps reads {argument name="cast name" default="HUNKINS"}. The scene shows a dim moody programmer bedroom or office at night lit by monitors and purple-blue neon. In the center foreground, a plush teddy-bear-like mascot with white fuzzy paws sits slouched in a black desk chair wearing a black hoodie, face mostly hidden in shadow for a mysterious comedic look. On the hoodie chest, 4 lines of small off-white text read exactly: "// SHIP IT", "// VIBE CHECK", "// NO BUGS", "// JUST VIBES". In front of the character is an open laptop covered with 4 visible stickers: "vibe > spec", "DON'T THINK JUST PROMPT", a smiley face sticker, and "Claude 3.5", plus an abstract AI-style logo sticker. Behind the laptop are 2 widescreen monitors displaying dense code on dark themes. The background includes 2 wall notes/signs on the left: a sticky note reading "IDEAS > PLANS" and, on the right, a whiteboard with 3 stacked handwritten lines reading "BUILD FAST", "BREAK THINGS", "ASK AI", and a fourth line "REPEAT" beneath, plus a hand-drawn smiley. Next to the whiteboard is a pink-purple neon </> code icon sign. On the desk at lower right sits a matte black drink can with pink text reading "FOCUS (optional)" and a cardboard pizza box edge labeled "ITERATE LATER". Use rich shadows, soft practical light, purple and cyan rim light, subtle monitor glow, shallow depth of field, high contrast, glossy premium poster finish, and a slightly absurd, self-aware startup-comedy tone. At the bottom, centered white tagline text reads {argument name="tagline text" default="HE’S NOT A PROGRAMMER. HE’S A VIBE CODER."}, with the word "VIBE" highlighted in pink. Below that, a release line in white and red reads {argument name="release line" default="ONLY ON NETFLIX | COMING SOON"}, with "NETFLIX" in bold red. Make it look like a polished official teaser one-sheet for a fictional streaming series.

items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical sci-fi anime poster in a gritty Evangelion-inspired hangar corridor, showing a pale blue short-bob girl in a glossy white futuristic plugsuit walking forward in the exact center foreground with a calm, emotionless posture, arms relaxed at her sides, while a towering orange-and-black biomechanical mecha crouches protectively and menacingly behind her, filling most of the background. The girl should resemble {argument name="character design" default="a Rei Ayanami-inspired pilot"}, with short icy blue hair, very pale skin, and a skintight white suit with black side panels, subtle gray seam lines, and 4 colored circular chest details in red, green, blue, and dark metallic tones. Use cinematic low-angle composition, strong depth, photorealistic materials, hard rim lighting from above, cool steel-blue shadows, warm spark highlights, volumetric haze, ultra-detailed textures, high contrast, ominous atmosphere, and premium movie-poster polish. Make it feel like {argument name="franchise mood" default="a dark live-action Evangelion poster"}, hyper-detailed, realistic, intense, and iconic.

items.title: Office Transfer Announcement Poster
items.titleZh: Design a dramatic square promotional poster in the style of a TV sitcom cast transfer announcement, with a dark navy and black office-themed background, gritty sports-poster energy, bold blue paint strokes, white distressed typography, and layered collage composition. At the center, place a confident woman named {argument name="character name" default="Penny"} standing from the waist up with arms crossed, wearing a light cream floral V-neck dress, messy blonde hair in a high bun, softly rim-lit with a subtle glow around her silhouette. Behind her, show exactly 8 office coworkers arranged as a blurred ensemble cast in staggered rows inside a corporate office interior with blinds, desks, and framed company signage; keep them secondary and slightly shadowed so the central woman dominates the composition. At the top left, include a tilted blue company logo block reading "DUNDER MIFFLIN INC. PAPER COMPANY" with a small office icon. Across the top center, add a huge distressed white headline "TRANSFER" and beneath it an even larger blue brush-script word "CONFIRMED". At the top right, add the small stacked slogan "NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON." On the left side, place a torn-paper transfer slip with a stamped, photocopied look; it should contain exactly 2 labeled sections, "FROM:" with "DUNDER MIFFLIN PAPER COMPANY, SCRANTON, PA, EST. 1949" and "TO:" with "THE OFFICE, SCRANTON, PA", plus a small office icon at the bottom. Add a hand-drawn blue arrow from this slip pointing toward the central woman. Across the woman's torso, place a blue paint-stroke nameplate with "{argument name="character name" default="Penny"}" in white script, followed by a small black strip with "IS", then a large stacked headline in distressed white and blue block text reading "JOINING THE OFFICE". On the right side, add a glowing dark info panel with exactly 3 labeled lines: "NEW ROLE" with "{argument name="job title" default="SALES REPRESENTATIVE"}", "NEW TEAM" with "{argument name="team tagline" default="SAME PAPER"}", and "NEW MEMORIES" with "LOADING...", plus a horizontal progress bar beneath. Along the bottom center, include a narrow blue banner reading "DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="Penny"}". At the very bottom, create a footer strip with exactly 4 elements: a briefcase icon and "NEW JOB", a team icon and "NEW TEAM", a document icon and "NEW MEMORIES", and on the far right a handwritten blue script phrase "{argument name="footer text" default="LET'S GO!"}". Use a high-contrast blue-white-black palette, cinematic compositing, subtle dust and texture overlays, energetic paint smears, and a premium fan-edit social media announcement aesthetic.

WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="Penny"}”。在最底部，创建一个包含 4 个元素的页脚条：公文包图标和“新工作”、团队图标和“新团队”、文档图标和“新记忆”，以及最右侧的手写蓝色脚本短语“{argument name="footer text" default="LET'S GO!"}”。使用高对比度的蓝白黑调色板、电影合成、微妙的灰尘和纹理叠加、充满活力的油漆涂抹以及优质的粉丝编辑社交媒体公告美学。

items.title: Kawaii Street Fashion Duo Portrait
items.titleZh: A candid street-fashion portrait of two cute anime-inspired girls standing close together in front of a colorful urban graffiti wall on a city sidewalk in Japan, photographed at eye level with a shallow depth of field and soft overcast daylight. Both have smooth pale skin and short blunt bob haircuts with straight ends, their bangs covering part of the forehead, and their faces intentionally simplified or blurred for an anonymous doll-like look. The girl on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="silver gray"} hair, wears a black knit beanie with a rectangular patch logo reading "Nightfall", a black leather jacket over a white graphic T-shirt with a dark distressed illustration and purple accent graphic, layered silver chain necklaces including a heart pendant, a black choker, and a black backpack strap over one shoulder. items.title: Fictional Design Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: A hyper-realistic modern magazine cover for a fictional design magazine titled {argument name="magazine title" default="FORM"}, shot like a premium editorial portrait in a minimalist architect’s studio. The cover uses a clean, restrained European design aesthetic with lots of white space, sharp typography, and warm natural indoor lighting. At the top, place an enormous bold black sans-serif masthead spanning nearly the full width. Beneath the left side of the masthead, add small uppercase text reading “THE MAGAZINE OF DESIGN” and “APRIL 2026”. The main cover line on the left reads {argument name="cover headline" default="The Last Analog Designer"} in large black sans-serif text stacked over multiple lines. Below it, add a smaller teaser paragraph: “In a world of algorithms and automated tools, one designer still believes in pencil, paper, and the power of thought.” In the lower left, include 3 secondary cover lines in small white sans-serif text over the darker desk area: “MILAN PREVIEW” with “What to See in 2026”, “MATERIAL INTELLIGENCE” with “The Next Surface Revolution”, and “STUDIO VISIT” with “Inside the Practice of Space Popular”. In the bottom right, add a realistic white barcode box with small price text above it reading “$8.99 US   $10.99 CAN” and the issue number “04”. The scene shows 1 seated middle-aged male designer at a worktable, wearing a dark navy or black knit sweater, with salt-and-pepper curly hair, leaning forward and sketching on white paper with a pencil. His face is obscured by a square blur block, creating an anonymous portrait. On the desk are exactly 8 visible object groups: scattered sketch papers with geometric chair drawings, 1 pencil cup holding several pencils, 1 rolled white blueprint on the right, 1 closed dark notebook on the left, 1 small brown eraser near the center, 1 blurred black object in the front-left foreground, 1 large flat book or material sample in the front-right foreground, and the active drawing sheet under his hand. Behind him is a warm wooden credenza with neat stacks of books, 1 white dome desk lamp on the far left, and a white wall displaying exactly 4 pinned design references: 1 small dark photo of a chair, 1 light sketch beneath it, and 2 larger minimal line drawings on the right. Use muted neutral tones, off-white walls, walnut wood, black clothing, and a calm contemplative mood. The composition should feel like a believable high-end magazine cover, straight-on and carefully art-directed, with editorial realism and no visible publisher logos other than the fictional masthead.
items.promptZh: 一本名为 {argument name="magazine title" default="FORM"} 的虚构设计杂志的超现实主义现代杂志封面，拍摄得就像极简主义建筑师工作室中的高级社论肖像。封面采用干净、内敛的欧洲设计美学，有大量的留白、清晰的版式和温暖的自然室内灯光。在顶部放置一个巨大的粗体黑色无衬线标头，几乎横跨整个宽度。在刊头左侧下方，添加小写大写文字“THE MAGAZINE OF DESIGN”和“APRIL 2026”。左侧的主封面行以多行堆叠的黑色大号无衬线文本显示 {argument name="cover title" default="The Last Analog Designer"}。在其下方，添加一个较小的预告片段落：“在算法和自动化工具的世界中，一位设计师仍然相信铅笔、纸和思想的力量。”在左下角，在较暗的桌面区域上包含 3 条白色小无衬线文本的辅助封面线：“米兰预览”和“2026 年会看到什么”，“物质智能”和“下一个表面革命”，以及“工作室参观”和“流行空间实践内部”。在右下角，添加一个逼真的白色条形码框，上面有小价格文本，上面写着“$8.99 US $10.99 CAN”和发行号“04”。场景中，一名中年男性设计师坐在工作台前，身穿深海军蓝或黑色针织衫，留着椒盐卷发，身体前倾，用铅笔在白纸上画着草图。他的脸被一个方形模糊块遮挡，形成了一幅匿名肖像。桌子上正好有8个可见的物体组：散落的素描纸，上面有几何椅子图画，1个铅笔杯，里面装着几支铅笔，右边1个卷起的白色蓝图，左边1个闭合的深色笔记本，靠近中心的1个棕色小橡皮，左前前景中的1个模糊的黑色物体，右前前景中的1个大平书或材料样本，以及他手下的活动绘图纸。他身后是一个温暖的木制书柜，里面放着整齐的书堆，最左边有一盏白色圆顶台灯，白色的墙壁上正好展示着 4 个固定的设计参考：一张椅子的深色小照片，椅子下面的一张浅色草图，以及右边两张较大的最小线条图。使用柔和的中性色调、米白色的墙壁、胡桃木、黑色的衣服和平静的沉思情绪。构图应该感觉像一个可信的高端杂志封面，直接且经过精心的艺术指导，具有编辑现实主义，除了虚构的报头之外没有可见的出版商徽标。

items.title: Healthy Nutrition App Logo Grid
items.titleZh: A clean presentation grid of 20 modern mobile app logo concepts for nutrition, calorie tracking, healthy eating, food recognition, and AI wellness tools, shown on a vivid electric-blue background with soft studio lighting and subtle shadows. Arrange the icons in 4 rows by 5 columns, evenly spaced, each as a glossy rounded-square app tile with premium iOS-style depth, smooth gradients, glassy highlights, and crisp 3D-rendered detail. The color palette should center on saturated blues, cyan, teal, white, lime green, and small accents of orange and yellow. Include exactly 20 distinct icon designs: 1) a meal bowl with avocado, grains, broccoli, and cherry tomatoes framed by a camera scan bracket, 2) a white fork beside four horizontal nutrition bars in green, yellow, red, and blue on a dark navy tile, 3) a camera lens with a small bowl of vegetables in front, 4) a circular blue badge with the text {argument name="headline text" default="kcal"} and a green leaf overlapping the lower edge, 5) a teal-blue icon with the text {argument name="brand text" default="Ai"} above a white bowl and two sparkles, 6) a glossy green apple with circuit traces and nodes suggesting food-tech AI, 7) a halved avocado centered inside a glowing scan frame, 8) a metallic spoon with a blue lightning bolt symbol and curved tracking lines, 9) a circular segmented nutrition meter in green, orange, and red around salmon and broccoli, 10) a divided plate containing grilled chicken, broccoli, rice, blueberries, and a small ascending analytics bar chart, 11) a camera lens on a white tile with a green leaf attached, 12) a glowing green apple inside a scan bracket with a sparkle, 13) a luminous circular activity ring in blue, green, yellow, and orange on a dark tile, 14) a blue shield with a white fork in the center, 15) a yogurt or oatmeal bowl topped with strawberries, blueberries, and granola inside a scan bracket, 16) a dark navy calorie icon with the text {argument name="calorie text" default="kcal"}, a curved glow, one sparkle, and a tiny bar chart, 17) a mint-green square with a white circuit-tree or branching chip motif, 18) a plated healthy meal with grilled chicken, avocado, tomatoes, and greens inside a scan bracket, 19) a dark bowl of blueberries and white yogurt or cream with a bright electric lightning bolt overlay, 20) a pastel aqua 3D cube icon featuring a fork-and-plate symbol on one face and a green leaf on another. Make the overall style highly polished, slightly futuristic, commercially viable for App Store branding, with consistent visual language across all 20 icons, no extra text beyond the visible short labels, and a premium AI-generated product-design aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 一个干净的演示网格，包含 20 个现代移动应用徽标概念，用于营养、卡路里跟踪、健康饮食、食物识别和人工智能健康工具，显示在生动的电蓝色背景上，具有柔和的工作室灯光和微妙的阴影。将图标排列为 4 行 x 5 列，间隔均匀，每个图标都是光滑的圆角方形应用程序磁贴，具有优质 iOS 风格的深度、平滑的渐变、玻璃般的高光和清晰的 3D 渲染细节。调色板应以饱和的蓝色、青色、青色、白色、柠檬绿以及少量的橙色和黄色为主。包括 20 个不同的图标设计：1) 一个盛有鳄梨、谷物、西兰花和樱桃番茄的碗，由相机扫描支架框起来；2) 深蓝色瓷砖上有四个水平营养条，旁边有一个白色叉子，旁边有绿色、黄色、红色和蓝色的四个水平营养条；3) 前面有一小碗蔬菜的相机镜头；4) 一个圆形蓝色徽章，上面有文字 {argument name="headline text" default="kcal"} 和一片与下边缘重叠的绿叶， 5) 一个青蓝色图标，上面有一个白色碗和两个闪光，上面有文字 {argument name="brand text" default="Ai"}，6) 一个有光泽的绿色苹果，带有电路迹线和节点，暗示食品科技人工智能，7) 一个切成两半的牛油果，位于发光扫描框架的中心，8) 一个带有蓝色闪电符号和弯曲跟踪线的金属勺子，9) 围绕鲑鱼和西兰花的绿色、橙色和红色圆形分段营养计， 10) 一个分开的盘子，里面有烤鸡、西兰花、米饭、蓝莓和一个小的升序分析条形图，11) 白色瓷砖上的相机镜头，附有绿叶，12) 扫描支架内有一个闪闪发光的绿色苹果，13) 深色瓷砖上有蓝色、绿色、黄色和橙色的发光圆形活动环，14) 中心有白色叉子的蓝色防护罩，15) 酸奶或扫描支架内放有草莓、蓝莓和格兰诺拉麦片的燕麦碗，16) 深蓝色卡路里图标，带有文字 {argument name="calorie text" default="kcal"}、弧形发光、一个闪光和一个小条形图，17) 带有白色电路树或分支芯片图案的薄荷绿方块，18) 扫描中包含烤鸡、鳄梨、西红柿和蔬菜的盘装健康餐支架，19) 一碗深色蓝莓和白色酸奶或奶油，上面覆盖着明亮的电闪电，20) 一个柔和的水绿色 3D 立方体图标，一面有叉子和盘子符号，另一面有绿叶。使整体风格高度精致，略带未来感，对 App Store 品牌具有商业可行性，所有 20 个图标具有一致的视觉语言，除了可见的短标签之外没有额外的文本，以及由人工智能生成的优质产品设计美学。

items.title: Fantasy Anime Witch Movie Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic vertical fantasy anime movie poster for {argument name="franchise title" default="LEGENDS OF URIA"}, with a clean white background, bold royal-purple graphic accents, and premium cinematic key art styling. The central figure is {argument name="character name" default="LORANA"}, a tall elegant dark witch shown from mid-thigh up in a heroic three-quarter pose, facing slightly right, with her face partially obscured by flowing long black hair. She has extremely long windblown hair streaming leftward across the composition, pale skin, a confident mysterious presence, and a dark sorceress design. Her outfit is a fitted black mini dress with structured gold trim, a sweetheart bustier, long black gloves, thigh-high black stockings, a heavy gold chain belt draped around the hips, and a large crimson cape lined in deep purple. She wears ornate red metallic shoulder armor with gold edging and matching red bracers. In her raised right hand, she levitates an old brown spellbook with gold corner details and an eight-pointed star emblem, surrounded by vivid blue magical flames and glowing energy. Behind her, place a diagonal purple panel on the right side with silhouettes of gothic spires and castles fading into the background, plus a faint circular magic sigil behind her hair and shoulders. Add small red flower petals drifting through the scene, thin black decorative lines, tiny diamond icons, dotted texture clusters, and angular red-and-purple motion graphics for a modern fantasy poster layout. At the top left, include the large stylized title text {argument name="series logo text" default="URIA"} in ornate serif fantasy lettering, with smaller text above reading "LEGENDS OF" and small Japanese subtitle text below reading "レジェンド オブ ウリア". Add 1 vertical Japanese tagline on the left side: "千年の時を超え、魔女が帰還する" with the single word "魔女" highlighted in red. At the top right, include 1 compass-like emblem and stacked small text reading "MAGIC DESTINY LEGEND". At the bottom center, add layered Spanish and English release typography: 1 red line reading "EL REGRESO DE LA BRUJA", 1 huge white number reading {argument name="year count text" default="1000"}, 1 smaller white word "AÑOS", and 1 massive purple character name reading {argument name="main name text" default="LORANA"}, with 1 small red katakana label "ローラーナ" beneath it. At the bottom left, include 1 release block with "ESTRENO 2026" and smaller text "SOLO EN CINES Y PLATAFORMAS", plus 3 small fantasy faction-style emblems. At the bottom right, include 1 stacked tagline block with five lines: "UNA LEYENDA", "PERDIDA.", "UN PODER", "PROHIBIDO.", "UN DESTINO", "INEVITABLE." At the very bottom center, add the line "DESTINY WILL BE WRITTEN IN BLOOD AND MAGIC." Use high-detail anime illustration, glossy shading, elegant fantasy poster composition, strong contrast, luxurious crimson, black, gold, and violet palette, with a polished theatrical coming-soon feel.

items.promptZh: 一张戏剧性的奇幻动漫海报，采用干净的垂直单页布局，适用于名为《乌利亚传奇》的虚构系列。采用优雅的高对比度海报设计，羊皮纸白色背景，深靛蓝色标题字体，温暖的铜色和铁锈红色口音，以及英雄的中央全身人物。在左上角，放置大型风格化徽标文本“LEGENDS OF URIA”，其中有一把剑集成到排版中，其下方是一个小的日语字幕行。主角是一位年轻的男性奇幻文士，面朝中央站立，脸被一块扁平的方形模糊块故意遮挡，橙色短发凌乱，皮肤白皙，姿势坚毅。他穿着胸前带有黑色世界树徽章的奶油色外衣，黑色长袖，深色裤子，棕色宽袖靴子，棕色长方形带扣腰带，一件巨大的铁锈红色连帽斗篷披在双肩上，飘逸在身体周围。他右手拿着一本厚厚的深棕色书，书角有金色细节，封面上有金色的树徽。在他身后，左边是一座浅灰色的奇幻城市，左边是大教堂般的塔楼，右边是发光的哥特式彩色玻璃拱门内部。添加小的浮动余烬颗粒和散布在页面周围的金色、铁锈色和靛蓝色的最小几何图形装饰。在左侧，包含一个衬线字体的西班牙大标题：“EL ESCRIBA QUE LA DEPERTÓ”，后面是较小文本的简短西班牙简介。还包括一个带有树符号的圆形魔法印记、一个写着“DIVISIÓN ESCRIBA DE LA ORDEN”的师徽章块、一个圆形树冠、左下角附近的 3 个小图标标志以及一个简短的西班牙传说句子。在右侧边缘添加一个高大的垂直红色横幅，上面有白色树符号和西班牙语文本“LA HISTORIA NECESITA ALGUIEN QUE LA ESCRIBA”。在其旁边添加一个白色的竖排日语句子。在底部中心，将角色名称放在巨大的金属衬线字母中：“{argument name =“character name”default =“MATTHEW”}”，下面有一个小的日语渲染。在右下角添加发布文本“ESTRENO {argument name="releaseyear"default="2026"}”。沿着底部边缘添加英文标语“DESTINY WILL BE WRITTEN IN BLOOD AND MAGIC”。整体风格应该像精美的电影动画宣传海报、奇幻出版社品牌、华丽的排版、象征性的世界树图像、温暖的魔法灯光和优质的关键艺术。

items.title: Nostalgic Watercolor Anime Adventure Poster
items.titleZh: A nostalgic watercolor anime poster on textured off-white paper, composed as a vertical double-exposure illustration inspired by late-1990s adventure anime. The main silhouette is the left-side profile of a young boy wearing large swim goggles pushed up on his head, his face turned to the right, with the silhouette filled by a dreamlike montage of memories and fantasy scenes. Inside the upper center of the silhouette, show 8 children from behind standing together on a ridge and looking toward a glowing, distant crystalline tower beneath a circular celestial portal in a cloudy blue-violet sky; include 7 small creature companions among them. On the upper right inside the silhouette, place a large dragon-like monster emerging from the clouds. Near the center, add a glowing round handheld digital device with a small screen, radiating light. In the middle-lower area, depict 2 iconic small dinosaur-like creatures sitting above an old shrine approach, one purple horned creature and one small yellow reptilian creature. In the lower area, show a mossy torii gate, overgrown stone steps, utility poles, and a small rural train on the right, all wrapped in mist and foliage. At the very bottom, include the 8 children again as tiny silhouettes walking away together along a path, reinforcing the theme of friendship and remembrance. Use soft ink-and-watercolor washes, muted blues, indigo, lavender, sepia, and warm golden highlights, with splattered pigment edges and painterly cloud textures. Keep the composition airy and elegant, with a refined modern poster-design sensibility and almost no generic AI gloss. Add vertical Japanese text on the right side reading あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。 and place a Japanese title logo at the lower left reading デジモンアドベンチャー, with a small English subtitle “DIGIMON ADVENTURE” and the date line “1999 - 永遠の冒険”.

items.title: NASA Spacecraft Hull in Orbit
items.titleZh: A cinematic ultra-detailed close-up of a NASA spacecraft in low Earth orbit, viewed from very near the hull at a dramatic diagonal angle so the curved metallic body fills most of the frame from left foreground to right midground. The spacecraft exterior is brushed silver-gray metal with visible seams, access panels, latches, rivets, light scuffing, and realistic weathered texture. Prominently display the classic NASA meatball logo near the upper left area of the hull and large black stenciled mission text reading {argument name="mission code" default="ASTRA-99"} across the side. Show the craft tapering toward a cylindrical engine or docking section on the far right. In the background, include the blue limb of Earth with white cloud patterns and a thin glowing atmospheric edge against deep black space. Lighting is hard sunlight from the upper right, creating crisp highlights, soft reflections on the metal, and deep shadow falloff along the lower hull. Photorealistic aerospace engineering, sharp focus on the spacecraft surface, high contrast, epic realism, premium sci-fi documentary style.
items.promptZh: 近地轨道上的 NASA 航天器的电影超详细特写镜头，从非常靠近船体的位置以戏剧性的对角角度观看，因此弯曲的金属主体填充了从左前景到右中景的大部分画面。航天器外部采用拉丝银灰色金属制成，具有可见的接缝、检修板、闩锁、铆钉、轻微磨损和逼真的风化纹理。在船体左上区域附近突出显示经典的 NASA 肉丸标志，并在侧面显示大型黑色模板任务文本{argument name="mission code" default="ASTRA-99"}。显示飞船向最右侧的圆柱形发动机或对接部分逐渐变细。在背景中，包括地球的蓝色边缘和白色云图案以及深黑色空间中薄薄的发光大气边缘。照明是来自右上方的强烈阳光，产生清晰的高光、金属上的柔和反射以及沿着下部船体的深度阴影衰减。逼真的航空航天工程，对航天器表面的清晰聚焦，高对比度，史诗般的现实主义，优质的科幻纪录片风格。

items.titleZh: A dramatic fast-food poster advertisement for Burger King, vertical composition, photorealistic studio food photography mixed with bold Korean promotional graphic design. Place the official Burger King logo centered at the very top. Below it, add huge distressed block Korean headline text in a stacked layout reading "신제품 와퍼 출시!" with "와퍼" in vivid deep red and the other words in textured off-white, all on a dark smoky black background. In the center, show one massive hero burger shot from a slightly low front angle, perfectly centered and filling most of the frame. The burger has 8 clearly visible layers and elements: a glossy sesame seed top bun, curly green leaf lettuce, thick red tomato slices, thick white onion rings, sliced pickles, streaks of ketchup, melted American cheese, a flame-grilled beef patty with heavy char marks, and a soft bottom bun. Add a tiny golden crown icon floating just above the top bun. The burger sits on a dark rustic wooden stump pedestal. Surround the lower half and side edges with dramatic orange flames, glowing embers, heat sparks, and smoky atmosphere to emphasize flame grilling. Near the bottom, place a secondary Korean slogan in bold text, centered, reading "불맛의 정점을 경험하라" with "불맛" in red and the remaining words in warm beige-gold, separated above by a small flame icon. At the very bottom, add a red badge-shaped label with a dark border containing the Korean text "한정 판매" in bold black. Use a high-contrast black, red, orange, and toasted brown color palette, intense cinematic lighting, glossy food highlights, crisp ingredient texture, premium commercial advertising finish, and a fiery indulgent mood.
items.promptZh: 汉堡王的戏剧性快餐海报广告，垂直构图，逼真的工作室食品摄影与大胆的韩国促销图形设计相结合。将汉堡王官方徽标置于顶部中央。在其下方，以堆叠布局添加巨大的仿旧韩文标题文本，内容为“신제품 와퍼 출시!” “와퍼”为鲜艳的深红色，其他文字为纹理灰白色，全部位于深烟熏黑色背景上。在中间，展示了一个巨大的英雄汉堡，从稍低的前角拍摄，完美居中并填充了大部分画面。汉堡有8个清晰可见的层次和元素：光滑的芝麻面包、卷曲的绿叶生菜、厚厚的红色番茄片、厚厚的白洋葱圈、切片泡菜、番茄酱条、融化的美国奶酪、带有严重焦痕的火焰烤牛肉饼和软底面包。添加一个漂浮在顶部发髻上方的小金色皇冠图标。汉堡放在一个深色质朴的木树桩基座上。用戏剧性的橙色火焰、炽热的余烬、热火花和烟熏气氛围绕下半部和侧边缘，以强调火焰烧烤。在底部附近，以粗体文字居中放置第二条韩语标语，内容为“불맛의 정점을 경험하라”，“불맛”为红色，其余文字为暖米色金色，上方由一个小火焰图标分隔。在最底部添加一个带有深色边框的红色徽章形状标签，其中包含粗体黑色的韩文文本“한정 판매”。使用高对比度的黑色、红色、橙色和烤棕色调色板、强烈的电影灯光、光泽的食物亮点、清爽的成分质地、优质的商业广告效果和火热的放纵情绪。

items.title: Photoreal librarian presenting AI book
items.titleZh: A photorealistic vertical promotional portrait in a cozy modern library or bookstore interior, showing a young East Asian woman standing behind a wooden counter and presenting a large book toward the camera. She has long straight dark brown hair parted near the center, small delicate earrings, and a neat, friendly, professional appearance. She wears a white button-up shirt, a muted green striped necktie, and a beige apron tied at the waist with a stitched name patch reading “Librarian Ai-chan” and a small open-book icon. Her left hand holds the book upright at chest height, angled slightly toward the viewer, while her right hand is open beneath it in a classic product-introduction gesture. The book is the clear focal point: a glossy dark cover with dramatic orange title text reading “Pollo AI” twice, one large at the top and one glowing near the center over a cinematic landscape image, plus smaller Japanese subtitle and feature text and a circular P-style logo near the lower left. Place a transparent acrylic desk sign on the left side of the counter with Japanese text above and the large name “Ai-chan” below. On the right side of the counter, stack exactly 3 hardcover books horizontally, each with numbered spine labels and Japanese titles. In the softly blurred background, include a tall wooden bookshelf on the left with books, small potted plants, and a warm lamp; a framed wall poster on the upper right with Japanese writing; and a leafy indoor plant on the far right. Add a small white “Pollo.ai” watermark in the top-right corner. Use warm ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, soft beige and wood tones, realistic skin and fabric texture, clean commercial composition, and the polished look of a professional lifestyle advertisement for a book or AI-related publication. Keep the framing from mid-thigh to above the head in a portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
items.promptZh: 在舒适的现代图书馆或书店内部拍摄的逼真的垂直促销肖像，显示一位年轻的东亚女性站在木制柜台后面，向镜头展示一本大书。她有一头中分的深棕色长直发，戴着精致的小耳环，外表整洁、友好、专业。她穿着一件白色的纽扣衬衫，一条柔和的绿色条纹领带，腰间系着一条米色围裙，围裙上缝着一个写着“图书管理员爱酱”的名字贴片和一个打开的小书图标。她的左手将书直立在胸部高度，稍微向观众倾斜，而她的右手则在书下方张开，以经典的产品介绍姿势。这本书是明显的焦点：光滑的深色封面上有戏剧性的橙色标题文字，上面写着两次“Pollo AI”，一个大的在顶部，一个在电影风景图像的中心附近发光，加上较小的日文字幕和特色文本，以及左下角附近的圆形 P 型徽标。在柜台左侧放置一个透明的亚克力台牌，上面写着日文，下面写着大名字“Ai-chan”。在柜台右侧，水平堆放 3 本精装书，每本都带有编号的书脊标签和日文书名。柔和模糊的背景中，左侧有一个高高的木质书架，上面放着书籍、小盆栽和温暖的台灯；右上角有一张带框的海报，上面有日语文字；最右边还有一株绿叶室内植物。在右上角添加一个小的白色“Pollo.ai”水印。使用温暖的环境照明、浅景深、柔和的米色和木质色调、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理、干净的商业构图以及书籍或人工智能相关出版物的专业生活方式广告的精美外观。保持从大腿中部到头顶的构图，人像的长宽比为 3:4。

items.title: Demon AI Intern Office Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic Chinese social-media poster in a warm amber office setting, featuring a stylish demon-themed female assistant character seated at a desk. The composition is a single vertical poster with dense graphic design, cinematic lighting, and a premium glossy illustration style mixing anime realism and commercial advertising. At the top, place a huge bold red Chinese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="龙虾夏夏"}, with an elegant handwritten script overlay reading {argument name="signature text" default="Xia Xia"}. Under it, add a strong black Chinese slogan: {argument name="subtitle text" default="嘴欠，但能交付"}. The character is centered, upper body visible behind a desk, with messy vivid red hair in a loose bun and many flyaway strands, small dark red devil horns, pale skin, black layered clothing, a lanyard ID badge, long red metallic claw gloves, and a tired but dangerous office-worker aura. Her face is intentionally obscured by a square censor block in the center. She props her cheek with one clawed hand and holds a branded black takeaway coffee cup in the other hand. Add subtle lobster-inspired details in the outfit and props, including segmented glossy red shell-like forms behind and around her chair. The desk contains exactly 7 visible items: 1 open laptop with a red lobster logo and the words "XIA XIA", 1 closed dark book stack beneath the laptop, 1 open notebook with handwritten sketches and Chinese notes, 1 black fountain pen, 1 rectangular black desk nameplate with Chinese text, 1 takeaway coffee cup with matching lobster logo, and 1 hanging employee badge card. In the left background, show a computer or presentation screen displaying a Feishu-style document interface with the Chinese title "内容创作流程" and a simple 3-step flowchart labeled exactly "场景", "流程", "资产", plus the sentence "Agent 是放大器，不是方向盘。" Add a sticky note near that screen reading "扣瑞芋". In the upper left, include a yellow annotation box with the Chinese text "黄叔雇来的毒舌但能干的AI实习生" and a playful doodled face beside it. In the right background, pin up 3 office notes: 1 clipboard-style intern profile card titled "实习生档案" with multiple bullet lines of Chinese profile text and a handwritten sign-off, 1 checklist board titled "今日待办" with 5 checkbox items and a red star on the final line, and 1 yellow sticky note reading "老板别演". Make all Chinese typography feel intentionally designed, as if for a meme ad campaign and character branding poster. At the bottom, add a bold centered Chinese footer slogan reading {argument name="footer slogan" default="不演龙虾，我就是龙虾。"}. Use orange sunset backlight, warm shadows, glossy reflections on the claws, a cluttered but stylish startup office atmosphere, black and burnt-orange color grading, and a humorous yet competent "sharp-tongued AI intern" vibe. Include visible branding text "XIA XIA" on the cup and laptop, and make the whole image feel like a high-end character promo poster for an assistant persona used in workplace AI marketing.

items.titleZh: A luxury cosmetics advertisement poster featuring a single upright {argument name="product type" default="lipstick"} centered on a glossy black cube pedestal against a rich monochrome {argument name="background color" default="deep crimson red"} studio background. The product is a bold satin-finish {argument name="product shade" default="true red"} lipstick with the bullet fully extended, dramatic sculpted tip, and a two-tone tube: vivid red upper casing and matte black lower casing. On the front of the black base, vertical white brand text reads {argument name="brand name" default="BOBBI BROWN"}. Place elegant editorial copy on the left side in a refined high-fashion serif layout, split across multiple lines, reading {argument name="headline text" default="It’s not just a lipstick, it’s an attitude."}, with the final word styled in italic and a slightly brighter coral-red tone than the rest of the text. Add 1 small white logo watermark in the top-right corner reading {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}. Use cinematic product lighting with soft but high-contrast highlights, subtle reflections on the pedestal, crisp edges, premium beauty-campaign styling, minimalist composition, square format, clean negative space, and a polished ecommerce-ready luxury ad aesthetic.

items.title: Luxury Perfume Ad on Marble Vanity
items.titleZh: A luxury e-commerce advertising photo of a premium perfume bottle on a polished gray-and-white marble vanity, shot in a warm cinematic studio style with soft golden lighting, shallow depth of field, and elegant reflections. The composition is square and high-end, with the perfume bottle centered slightly right of frame and promotional text on the left. The bottle is a tall sculpted hourglass-shaped glass flacon with smoky transparent gray glass fading darker at the base, a glossy gold spherical cap, a gold collar engraved with fine branding, and a large metallic gold interlocking monogram on the front. Keep the branding-inspired feel but do not add extra products. In the foreground left, include 1 cut-crystal bowl with a gold rim, partially cropped. In the background right, include 1 brushed gold cylindrical vase holding 1 bouquet of soft white flowers, blurred. Behind the bottle, add 1 black marble rectangular box with subtle white veining and gold trim. In the lower right foreground, include 1 draped piece of champagne-colored satin fabric, softly out of focus. The background should be dark, luxurious, and softly blurred, with rich brown-black tones and a vertical shadowed panel on the left to support typography. Add elegant serif headline text on the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="Premium Perfume,"} in large warm beige letters, with a smaller serif subheading beneath reading {argument name="tagline" default="Subtlety and Elegance"}, plus a thin short gold horizontal line below the subheading. The hoodie has two yellow athletic stripes running down each sleeve, a loose hood, and a partially open zipper over a fitted white tank top with thin black straps visible underneath. She wears a black choker and a single dark dangling earring. Her hair is a short platinum-silver bob with long side-swept bangs and a smooth, airy texture. items.promptZh: 精美的动漫风格国际电影海报，具有电影般的略带绘画风格的外观和柔和的自然光线。构图以一位从大腿中部以上的年轻女子为中心，她以轻松的姿势站立，一只手插在一件超大海军蓝拉链连帽衫的口袋里。这款连帽衫的每个袖子上都有两条黄色运动条纹，宽松的兜帽，合身的白色背心上有半开的拉链，下面可见细细的黑色带子。她戴着一条黑色项圈和一只黑色垂坠耳环。她的头发是白金银色的短发，刘海长长的侧扫，质地光滑、轻盈。她的脸被一个柔和的米色色调的扁平矩形检查块故意遮挡。保持整体造型优雅和克制，而不是过度细节，比浮华的超渲染动漫艺术更自然、可信的完成效果。将背景构建为由对角面板切片制成的旅行电影拼贴画：其中一个面板显示了一个位于悬崖上的地中海风格的沿海小镇，旁边是平静的蓝色海水和远处的鸟儿；另一个面板显示了一个地中海风格的小镇。一幅图画展示了一条乡村铁路线，左侧有一列火车，铁轨旁有电线杆；一幅图画展示了白雪覆盖的山脉和安静山谷中蜿蜒的道路；一个面板显示了昏暗的城市天际线和发光的灯光；一幅图画展示了日落时沿着海岸蜿蜒的海滨道路。使用柔和的奶油色、蓝色和石板色调色板，营造怀旧的春季旅行氛围。在左上角添加优雅的节日奖桂冠，正好 3 个堆叠的桂冠，并带有西班牙文字，指示主要动画节奖项。在底部附近添加大的居中标题排版，阅读{argument name =“headline text”default =“VIAJES DE PRIMAVERA”}，并使用淡象牙色的精致衬线字体。在其下方，添加一个较小的西班牙语斜体标语：{argument name="tagline" default="Cada destino cambia su corazón."}。在该行下方添加一条发布行，内容为 {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}。在最底部包括微小的制作信用文本和一个小的工作室徽标。该图像应该感觉像艺术动画电影海报，宣传春天的旅程戏剧，具有平衡的负空间、优质的布局设计和逼真的印刷海报排版。

items.title: Okinawa Summer Travel Banner
items.titleZh:
Create a polished Japanese travel agency summer banner ad for Okinawa in a bright, inviting commercial style. Use a wide horizontal layout with a vivid tropical beach scene as the full background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand shoreline, small green island in the mid distance, deep blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, and palm leaves hanging in from the upper right corner. On the right foreground, place 1 traditional Okinawan shisa lion-dog statue sitting on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus flowers and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, include 1 small glass-bottom sightseeing boat floating close to shore. Add 2 small simple fish doodle icons over the sea.

Make the typography the hero element. Across the left-center to center, place very large Japanese calligraphic headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="夏の沖縄"}, with a blue gradient and white glow or soft outline, highly legible and elegant. Above it, add a handwritten-style Japanese catchphrase in blue reading {argument name="catchphrase" default="青い海、青い空、心ほどける島時間。"} with a loose underline flourish. Under the main headline, add a smaller Japanese subheading reading {argument name="subheading" default="感動の景色と、あたたかいおもてなしに出会う旅へ。"}.

In the upper left, add a circular summer badge with a sunburst feel, soft cream background, tiny wave lines, a small hibiscus accent, and Japanese text reading "この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!". Decorate the headline area with 1 pink hibiscus flower on the left and subtle ocean-wave graphic strokes.

Along the lower middle, place 3 rounded white feature cards in a row, partially overlapping the beach scene. Count and depict all 3 cards clearly: the first card shows a sea turtle swimming underwater in a circular photo, with Japanese heading "美しい自然を満喫" and smaller body text about transparent waters and scenic spots; the second card shows a bowl of Okinawa soba in a circular photo, with heading "沖縄グルメを堪能" and smaller body text mentioning 沖縄そば and ゴーヤチャンプルー; the third card shows Shuri Castle in a circular photo, with heading "観光スポットも充実" and smaller body text mentioning 美ら海水族館 and 首里城. Add small coral, shell, hibiscus, and starfish decorations around these cards.

On the right lower-middle, overlap the beach with 1 tilted circular promotional sticker in pale blue and cream, with a small yellow tab on top. The yellow tab says "早めの予約がおトク!" and the main circle says "夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!". Add a white plumeria flower accent near the sticker.

Create a full-width dark blue footer bar across the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place a white travel company logo icon and company name text {argument name="company name" default="〇〇旅行株式会社"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline below. Across the center of the footer, place exactly 3 circular line-icons with short Japanese captions: 1 calendar icon for tour plans, 1 support staff icon for travel assistance, and 1 suitcase icon for comfortable travel help. On the right side of the footer, add a boxed CTA area with Japanese text "詳しくはこちらから" and a mock search field containing {argument name="search text" default="〇〇旅行　沖縄"} plus a search icon. Overall design should feel premium, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable, like a professional Japanese web banner or travel campaign visual.

items.title: Dramatic Cricket Signing Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic sports poster featuring a waist-up portrait of a male cricket player in a royal blue Delhi Capitals jersey, facing slightly left in a strong three-quarter pose. His face is obscured by a large soft-edged vertical rectangular blur centered over the face, creating an anonymized reveal effect. Behind his head is a bright glowing white circular halo, centered like a spotlight or moon. The background is dark navy and black with electric blue flame-like textures rising on both sides, overlaid with rough chalk-style scribbles, arrows, circles, and large hand-drawn letters for a gritty urban sports aesthetic. The jersey has red-orange collar and placket accents, a white Puma logo on the right chest and sleeve, a Delhi Capitals crest on the left chest, a red circular Jio patch on the sleeve, a rectangular ALL SEASONS sponsor patch on the chest, and large Hero branding across the torso. Add realistic fabric texture, sweat sheen, grain, dust, scratches, and distressed poster wear. At the bottom, place elegant white handwritten script reading Welcome to Dilli above very large bold cracked white block letters reading {argument name="player name" default="REHAN AHMED"}. Use high contrast lighting, moody shadows, centered composition, and a premium IPL team announcement poster style.
items.promptZh: 一张戏剧性的体育海报，上面是一位身穿宝蓝色德里首都队球衣的男性板球运动员的腰部肖像，面朝左，摆出强有力的四分之三姿势。他的脸被以脸部为中心的大型软边垂直矩形模糊所遮挡，产生了匿名的暴露效果。他的头后面有一个明亮的白色圆形光环，中心像聚光灯或月亮。背景是深海军蓝和黑色，两侧有电蓝色火焰般的纹理，上面覆盖着粗糙的粉笔式涂鸦、箭头、圆圈和大号手绘字母，营造出坚韧的城市运动美感。球衣衣领和门襟饰有橙红色装饰，右胸和袖子上有白色 Puma 标志，左胸上有德里首都队队徽，袖子上有红色圆形 Jio 贴片，胸前有矩形 ALL SEASONS 赞助商贴片，躯干上有大型英雄品牌标志。添加逼真的织物纹理、汗水光泽、颗粒、灰尘、划痕和仿旧海报磨损。在底部，放置优雅的白色手写脚本“欢迎来到迪利”，上面有非常大的粗体裂纹白色大写字母“{argument name =“player name”default =“REHAN AHMED”}。使用高对比度照明、喜怒无常的阴影、居中构图和优质 IPL 团队公告海报风格。

items.titleZh: Create a dramatic vertical poster-style sports tribute for {argument name="athlete name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}, designed like a cinematic legacy montage with a dark, high-contrast, gold-and-black color grade, gritty smoke, sparks, stadium haze, and celebratory lighting. At the top, place a huge metallic distressed headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LEWIS HAMILTON"}, with a bold gold subheadline beneath it reading “BEYOND SPEED. BEYOND LIMITS.” and a smaller white line below saying “A LEGEND IN MOTION.” The composition centers on a large, close-up hero portrait of the athlete in a modern black racing suit, shown from the chest up, facing slightly to the side with intense expression, detailed skin texture, braided hair, dramatic rim lighting, and visible sponsor-style logos across the suit. Build a collage around the central portrait using exactly 8 supporting elements: on the upper left, a childhood go-kart scene labeled “1995” with the caption “THE DREAM BEGINS”; below it, a single-seater junior formula car scene labeled “2003” with the caption “F1 IS CALLING”; below that, a victory celebration scene labeled “2008” with the caption “A STAR IS BORN” and a second line “FIRST WIN CANADIAN GP”; lower left, a racing portrait labeled “2013” with the caption “WORLD CHAMPION” and a second line “A NEW ERA”; center torso text block labeled “2014 – 2020” with the title “DOMINANCE” and three stat lines “7 WORLD TITLES”, “6 CONSTRUCTORS’ TITLES”, and “82 RACE WINS”; bottom center, a front-facing black Formula 1 car with number 44 emerging from shadows; upper right, a triumphant full-body figure raising a trophy overhead amid confetti; mid-right, a vertical achievements column titled “ACHIEVEMENTS” with exactly 5 laurel-wreathed stats reading “7× F1 WORLD CHAMPION”, “103 RACE WINS”, “104 POLE POSITIONS”, “197 PODIUM FINISHES”, and “7 BRITISH GP WINS”, followed by a final text callout “SIR” and the line “KNIGHTED FOR SERVICES TO MOTORSPORT”; lower right, a modern portrait of the athlete with hand over chest beside the caption “2021 & BEYOND” and the stacked text “STILL PUSHING. STILL INSPIRING. STILL WINNING.” Add 2 additional cars at the bottom edge: a red Formula 1 car on the lower left streaking diagonally with motion blur, and a smaller black Formula 1 car on the lower right. Place a centered quote near the bottom in white italic caps: {argument name="quote" default="I DON’T RACE TO BE SECOND. I RACE TO BE ONE OF A KIND."}, followed by a gold handwritten signature-style script reading {argument name="signature name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}. Finish with a footer slogan in spaced-out white capitals: “TALENT. DISCIPLINE. PASSION. PURPOSE.” and a final line beneath it: “LEWIS HAMILTON – MORE THAN A DRIVER. A MOVEMENT.” Use layered depth, sharp typography, premium magazine-poster layout, subtle British flag accents, realistic cars, photoreal faces, and an inspirational champion-documentary aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="athlete name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}创建一个引人注目的垂直海报风格的体育致敬，设计类似于电影传统蒙太奇，具有黑暗、高对比度、金黑颜色等级、砂砾烟雾、火花、体育场烟雾和庆祝灯光。在顶部放置一个巨大的金属仿旧标题，上面写着 {argument name="headline text" default="LEWIS HAMILTON"}，其下方有一个粗体的金色副标题，上面写着“BEYOND SPEED. BEYOND LIMITS”。下面有一条较小的白线，上面写着“A LEGEND IN MOTION”。构图以这位身穿现代黑色赛车服的运动员的大型特写英雄肖像为中心，从胸部向上展示，略微面向侧面，表情强烈，皮肤纹理细致，头发编成辫子，边缘灯光引人注目，整个套装上可见赞助商风格的标志。使用 8 个支撑元素围绕中央肖像构建拼贴画：左上角是童年卡丁车场景，标记为“1995”，标题为“梦想开始”；下面是一个单座青少年方程式赛车场景，标有“2003”，标题为“F1 IS CALLING”；下面是胜利庆祝场景，标有“2008”，标题为“一颗明星诞生”，第二行为“FIRST WIN CANADIAN GP”；左下角，一幅赛车肖像，标有“2013”​​，标题为“WORLD CHAMPION”，第二行为“A NEW ERA”；中心躯干文本块标记为“2014 – 2020”，标题为“DOMINANCE”和三个统计行“7 WORLD TITLES”、“6 CONSTRUCTORS’ TITLES”和“82 RACE WINS”；底部中央，一辆正面黑色一级方程式赛车，编号为 44，从阴影中显现出来；右上方，一个胜利的全身人物在五彩纸屑中高举奖杯；中右，垂直成就栏标题为“成就”，正好有 5 个桂冠统计数据，分别为“7× F1 世界冠军”、“103 场比赛获胜”、“104 杆位置”、“197 次登上领奖台”和“7 次英国大奖赛获胜”，后面是最后的文字标注“SIR”和“KNIGHTED FOR SERVICES TO”行赛车运动”；右下角是这位运动员的现代肖像，手放在胸前，旁边写着“2021 年及以后”标题和堆叠文字“仍在推动。仍在鼓舞人心。仍在获胜。”在底部边缘添加 2 辆额外的汽车：一辆红色一级方程式赛车在左下角以运动模糊对角线疾驰，一辆较小的黑色一级方程式赛车在右下角。在底部附近放置一个白色斜体大写居中的引号：{argument name="quote" default="I DON’T RACE TO BE SECOND. I RACE TO BE ONE OF A KIND."}，后面是金色手写签名式脚本，内容为 {argument name="signature name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}。最后以白色大写字母间隔的页脚口号结尾：“才华、纪律、激情、目的。”其下方还有最后一行：“刘易斯·汉密尔顿——不仅仅是一名车手。一场运动。”使用分层的深度、清晰的版式、优质的杂志海报布局、微妙的英国国旗口音、逼真的汽车、照片般真实的面孔以及鼓舞人心的冠军纪录片美学。

items.title: Anime AI Studio Girls at Sunset
items.titleZh: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a cozy creative studio at golden hour, showing 5 young women gathered around a cluttered wooden worktable, lit by warm sunset light through large windows, hanging pendant lamps, and string lights. The mood is stylish, intelligent, playful, and slightly chaotic, like a startup loft mixed with an artist workspace. In the left foreground, a tall woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy auburn"} hair wears a white daisy flower crown and a sleeveless rust-red dress with a belt; she stands closest to camera and holds up a handwritten paper sign that reads exactly: {argument name="sign text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}, with a small heart doodle. Behind and to the right of her stands a second woman with platinum-blonde twin ponytails, a black gothic mini dress, black thigh-high stockings, and large headphones around her neck; she poses confidently with one hand on her hip near an open laptop covered in stickers, prominently featuring a large X logo. In the center background stands a petite girl with very long straight black hair and a dark navy dress, reserved and quiet, positioned in front of a wide monitor displaying a glowing Gemini star logo on a dark screen. To the right of center, a glamorous woman with a short black bob and earrings leans over the desk in a fitted red floral cheongsam-style dress, looking toward the papers and laptops. On the far right, a fifth woman with messy light-brown hair in a loose bun wears an oversized open shirt over a cropped white T-shirt with the OpenAI knot logo and casual pants, leaning over the table with one hand braced on the surface and the other near a drawing tablet. The room should contain 2 laptops visible on the desk, 1 central monitor, 3 mugs, 2 sticky notes, 1 paper sign, 1 notebook page titled "Plans", and many scattered creative objects like pens, cables, books, papers, and cans. The first laptop is covered with stickers including a large X logo; the second laptop has an OpenAI logo. The desk includes a black mug with a moon-and-text design, a white mug that says "Good answer takes time.", a white cup with an orange sunburst logo, an energy-drink can, a clear plastic drink cup, a closed notebook, loose handwritten notes, and a tablet on the far right. One sticky note says "You got this" with a heart, and another says "One step at a time" with a tiny flower. The notebook page on the desk reads "Plans" and lists 3 items: "1. World peace", "2. More coffee", "3. Nap", with a small cat doodle. The environment should include bookshelves, framed prints, potted plants, warm wood textures, and wall decor with visible posters and signs, including "Anthropic", "Kindness intelligence", "DO GOOD BUILD COOL SHIT", and a neon-style sign that says "focus fuel". Use cinematic composition, rich amber and sepia tones, intricate linework, soft painterly shading, detailed fabrics and hair, subtle glow on screens, and a polished modern anime illustration aesthetic. No blur, no distortion, no extra people, and no duplicated objects.

items.title: Sunset Futuristic Megacity Panorama
items.titleZh: A vast cinematic sci-fi megacity at sunset, viewed from a high observation platform between dark futuristic superstructures, with an immense glowing orange-and-gold sky filled with dramatic clouds and haze. The scene shows a sprawling vertical city extending far into the distance, packed with countless ultra-tall needle-like skyscrapers and luminous architectural spires rising through layers of clouds. A colossal hovering platform-city dominates the upper right-middle area, dark metallic and heavily detailed, suspended above the skyline with smaller towers and structures attached beneath it. In the lower left foreground, a sleek futuristic spacecraft is launching away from a terrace, angled diagonally outward toward the center, with bright blue engine exhaust trails and reflective metallic panels. Tiny human silhouettes stand along the terrace edge for scale. Multiple small flying vehicles and hovercraft are scattered across the sky at different distances, creating dense air traffic. Far below, the city grid glitters with warm lights through atmospheric mist. Use a grand panoramic composition, high contrast between dark architectural framing and radiant sunset light, intricate techno-industrial detail, atmospheric perspective, volumetric clouds, reflective surfaces, and a richly colored palette of amber, peach, violet, deep navy, and electric blue accents. Ultra-detailed, epic futuristic concept art, photoreal matte-painting feel, sharp focus, dramatic scale, vertical 4:3 composition, no text or logos.

In the foreground stands a cheerful high school girl traveler in a dynamic welcoming pose, one arm stretched toward the viewer as if inviting them to come along. She has long blonde twin-tail hair with soft waves and pink-dyed tips, windblown dramatically, and her face is simplified and unobstructed for a clean commercial illustration. She wears a black school blazer with gold trim, a white dress shirt, a red-and-black ribbon bow, a pleated black skirt with gold hem, thigh-high black socks, and carries a black shoulder bag with a cute round animal charm. Beside her is 1 silver rolling suitcase covered with multiple colorful travel stickers, including a prominent airline-themed sticker. The overall mood is youthful, aspirational, energetic, and travel-forward, blending school life and air travel. Include exactly 2 handwritten-style English phrases in the sky area: "Let's go!" near a doodled white airplane trail at upper right, and no other English handwritten phrase besides the brand text. Recreate the poster layout with exactly 1 airline brand block at top left reading "JAPAN AIRLINES" with a red crane logo, 1 large Japanese headline in brush-style lettering across the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="羽ばたけ、未来の私へ！"}, and 1 smaller Japanese subheadline beneath it reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="旅は、きみをもっと強く、もっと自由にする。"}. In the mid-left area, place a large white promotional panel with pink accents for a student discount campaign. Place 1 circular red JAL logo at the bottom right corner. Show 5 young women standing around a large wooden worktable, framed as a wide group portrait. The mood is whimsical, slightly satirical, and aspirational-but-chaotic. On the far left, place a tall woman with very long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="auburn"} hair wearing a crown of white daisies and a sleeveless rust-brown dress with a white sunburst emblem on the chest and a dark belt at the waist; she holds a small handwritten note toward the viewer that reads exactly {argument name="note text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}. items.promptZh: 温暖、高度详细的动漫风格插图，背景是一个舒适、杂乱的独立工作空间，感觉就像一家书吧咖啡馆和一家初创工作室混合在一起，金色的午后阳光透过右侧高大的窗户照射进来，天花板上悬挂着 4 盏黑色工业吊灯，灯串、满溢的书架、植物和覆盖背景的手写励志标语。展示 5 名年轻女性站在一个大型木制工作台周围，框架为一幅宽幅集体肖像。气氛异想天开，略带讽刺，充满抱负但混乱。最左边是一位高个子的女人，留着很长的波浪发，头戴白色雏菊王冠，穿着无袖铁锈棕色连衣裙，胸前有白色太阳纹徽章，腰间系着深色腰带；她向观看者拿着一张手写的小便条，上面写着{argument name="note text" default="Claude is requests your permission"}。她面前的边桌上放着一杯茶、一叠书和一盆小盆栽。在她旁边，放着一位朋克金发女郎，扎着双马尾辫，系着黑色蝴蝶结，脖子上挂着大号黑色耳机，身穿露肩黑色连衣裙，躯干上标有醒目的白色“X”；她自信地站在一台打开的笔记本电脑旁边，笔记本电脑上贴着贴纸，上面还有一个大 X 标志。在中央后方，一个神秘的苗条女孩，有着极长的深藏青色头发，苍白的皮肤，穿着哥特式的深色连衣裙，安静地站在桌面显示器前，在黑暗的屏幕上显示出蓝色发光的星星或闪闪发光。在中间的右侧，一位优雅的女士穿着一件合身的红色旗袍风格连衣裙，带有花卉刺绣和侧开衩，一只手靠在木桌上，靠近一本打开的笔记本，笔记本上写满了草图或文字。最右边是一位穿着休闲、头发凌乱的黑发女郎，头发凌乱，扎着发髻，穿着一件带有黑色结状 AI 标志的白色 T 恤，里面穿着一件开放的米色外套，站在一台带有相同标志的开放式银色笔记本电脑后面。主桌上散布着许多舒适的办公桌物品：2 个杯子、1 个打开的笔记本、1 支钢笔、1 个黑色小雕像、1 个闭合的书架和笔记本电脑。在整个房间里添加可读的手写墙注和标志：左上角的“FOCUS SHIPS DREAMS”，左墙上的“SHIPPING IS MY CARDIO”，靠近顶部中心的“将咖啡因变成代码”，靠近窗户的“善待未来的自己”，左下角书脊上的“The Art of Asking Nicely”，靠近中左的黑色杯子上的“WORLD’S OKAYEST MODEL”，“MOONSHOT”右下角附近的书架上写着“日记”，右下角的杯子上写着“只有好提示”，右下角有一张便利贴，上面写着“AGI 已经为我们做好了准备”，上面有一个小涂鸦。使用绘画般的线条、错综复杂的纹理、富有表现力的时尚造型、温暖的棕色和琥珀色分级、柔和的电影深度以及精致的社交媒体病毒插图美学。

items.title: Anime Concert Interview Magazine Spread
items.titleZh: A high-impact anime promotional interview poster designed as a glossy two-page magazine spread for a futuristic live music event. The scene shows a packed nighttime concert arena filled with a crowd holding glowing light sticks in neon yellow, blue, and purple, with a huge illuminated stage in the background, laser beams, bokeh lights, haze, and a giant triangular play-icon screen reading "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026". In the center foreground are 2 anime-style female presenters seen from a dramatic side and back angle, both looking toward the stage. The left character is {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"}, wearing a dark oversized hooded jacket with black and acid-lime accents, large lime-green headphones marked "06", and raising a bright yellow glow stick overhead; her face is partially obscured by a rectangular privacy block. The right character is {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"}, with a short silver-white bob haircut and fair skin, wearing a pale oversized hooded coat, softly lit by stage lights, holding a white-blue glowing baton near her chest, with an emotional profile expression as she watches the show. Use cinematic rim lighting, richly saturated purple-blue concert colors, reflective fabric highlights, and detailed anime rendering with a polished editorial-advertising finish. Compose the layout like a Japanese special interview feature with dense text overlays, translucent dark panels, thin neon-yellow borders, and bold sans-serif typography. Include 8 distinct text blocks: 1 small header tag at top left reading "/ SPECIAL INTERVIEW /"; 1 large Japanese headline at upper left reading "この夏、AIと音楽の未来がステージで輝く！"; 1 event logo block at upper right reading "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026" and "2026.7.18 SAT @ FUTURE ARENA ODAIBA"; 3 question-and-answer panels stacked on the left with yellow-framed headers beginning with "Q."; 3 question-and-answer panels stacked on the right with yellow-framed headers beginning with "Q."; plus 2 character intro name boxes near the figures labeled "ソラ" and "ナギ". Add a bold closing Japanese tagline across the bottom left and center reading "AIと音楽が響き合う、新しい夏がはじまる。 一緒に、未来を体験しよう！". At the bottom right, include a footer block repeating the event name and date, plus a visible QR code and a small caption indicating the official website. The overall style should feel like a premium Japanese event flyer, interview article, and key visual combined, energetic, futuristic, emotional, and festival-like.

items.title: Juventus Yamal Transfer Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic vertical football poster for {argument name="player name" default="Yamal"} in a Juventus transfer-announcement style, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, black-and-white with metallic gold accents, gritty premium sports graphic design. The composition has 2 visible portraits of the same young male footballer with dark brown skin and short tight curly hair: one large upper-body rear three-quarter portrait dominating the top half, wearing a glossy white Juventus jersey with the name {argument name="jersey name" default="YAMAL"} printed large across the back, head turned slightly left so one ear and partial cheek are visible; and one full-body action pose in the lower center, arms spread wide while running or celebrating, wearing the modern Juventus home kit with black-and-white vertical stripes, white shorts with the number {argument name="squad number" default="19"}, white socks, and light-colored boots with a subtle pink accent on the sole. Keep the face areas softly obscured and non-detailed. Use a dark moody background with layered architectural imagery of Turin, including 3 landmark elements: a faint domed historic building on the left mid-background, a tall tower resembling Mole Antonelliana on the lower right, and a shadowy stadium structure across the lower middle. Add 3 Juventus logos: one small white logo at the top left, one large translucent logo integrated into the upper right background, and one medium white logo at the bottom right. Add bold typography and editorial layout elements: the word {argument name="main vertical text" default="YAMAL"} set vertically in huge white condensed sans-serif letters along the left side, small vertical gold text reading "JUVENTUS FOOTBALL CLUB" beside it, gold text on the right reading {argument name="side name text" default="YAMAL"} above the large gold number "19", a gold signature scribble below, the slogan "FINO ALLA FINE" stacked in gold on the lower left, "JUVENTUS" in small white text beneath it, and small coordinate text at the bottom left reading "45.0703° N, 7.6869° E" and "TORINO, ITALIA". The jersey on the action figure should include visible sponsor and badge details: Juventus crest with 3 stars, Adidas logo, Jeep sponsor, a circular tricolor badge on the chest, and a black sleeve patch reading "azimut". Add energetic white paint streaks and brush slashes in 3 main areas: upper right, lower center near the kicking leg, and subtle scratches on the left edge. Include marble-like black texture panels, gold star accents, faint chevrons, and smoky atmosphere. Lighting should be cinematic with rim light on the player, glossy fabric highlights, sharp contrast, and a premium transfer-poster aesthetic suitable for a social media football announcement.
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="player name" default="Yamal"}制作一张引人注目的垂直足球海报，采用尤文图斯转会公告风格、超详细、高对比度、带有金属金色点缀的黑白、坚韧的优质运动图形设计。该构图中有两张可见的肖像，都是同一位年轻的男足球运动员，有着深棕色的皮肤和短而紧的卷发：一张大的上半身后四分之三的肖像占据了上半部分，穿着一件光滑的白色尤文图斯球衣，名字{argument name =“jersey name”default =“YAMAL”}印在背面，头稍微向左转，因此一只耳朵和部分脸颊可见；下半身是一个全身动作姿势，在跑步或庆祝时张开双臂，穿着带有黑白垂直条纹的现代尤文图斯主场球衣、印有号码{argument name="squad number" default="19"}的白色短裤、白色袜子和浅色靴子，鞋底带有微妙的粉红色调。保持脸部区域柔和地被遮盖并且没有细节。使用深色喜怒无常的背景和都灵分层的建筑意象，包括 3 个标志性元素：左中背景上一座淡淡的圆顶历史建筑，右下角一座类似安托内利尖塔的高塔，以及中下部分的阴影体育场结构。添加 3 个尤文图斯徽标：1 个白色小徽标位于左上角，1 个大半透明徽标集成在右上角背景中，1 个中等白色徽标位于右下角。添加粗体排版和编辑布局元素：单词{argument name =“main Vertical text”default =“YAMAL”}在左侧垂直设置为巨大的白色压缩无衬线字母，旁边有小的垂直金色文本，上面写着“JUVENTUS FOOTBALL CLUB”，右侧的金色文本在大金色数字“19”上方写着{argument name =“side name text”default =“YAMAL”}，下面是金色签名涂鸦，左下方有金色标语“FINO ALLA FINE”，下方有白色小文字“JUVENTUS”，左下方有小坐标文字“45.0703° N, 7.6869° E”和“TORINO, ITALIA”。人偶上的球衣应包含可见的赞助商和徽章细节：带有 3 颗星的尤文图斯队徽、阿迪达斯徽标、吉普车赞助商、胸前的圆形三色徽章以及写有“azimut”的黑色袖标。在 3 个主要区域添加充满活力的白色油漆条纹和笔刷斜线：右上、踢腿附近的中下以及左边缘的微妙划痕。包括大理石般的黑色纹理面板、金色星星装饰、淡淡的 V 形图案和烟熏氛围。灯光应该是电影般的，边缘光照射在球员身上，有光泽的织物亮点，鲜明的对比度，以及适合社交媒体足球公告的优质转会海报美学。

items.titleZh: A cinematic rear three-quarter tracking shot of a futuristic white Audi supercar racing through a dense neon-lit city at night on a wet street, viewed from a very low angle close to the rear wheel. The car has a sleek widebody coupe silhouette, glossy pearl white body panels, a black rear fascia, and a continuous thin LED taillight strip with segmented red and white light elements stretching across the tail. The glowing Audi four-ring logo is illuminated in white at the center rear, with a stylized glowing model badge beneath it that reads "tron" in a futuristic font. The rear bodywork is partially removed or transparently open to reveal exposed high-performance mechanical components: 1 large rectangular metallic battery or power unit mounted low at the back, 3 visible thick exhaust or cooling pipes spanning across the rear, 1 visible gearbox or motor assembly near the center-right, and a deep black rear diffuser with 2 large fins. The car rides on oversized deep-dish black wheels with ultra-wide rear tires, and the tire sidewalls feature bright white Japanese-style lettering around the circumference. Use strong motion blur in the background and along the road surface to imply high speed, with sharp focus on the car body and exposed machinery. Surround the scene with abstract urban bokeh, streaking neon signage, reflections of red, blue, and white city lights across the wet pavement and glossy bodywork. High contrast, cyberpunk atmosphere, realistic automotive photography, dramatic nighttime lighting, ultra-detailed metal textures, cinematic lens, dynamic composition, speed, power, futuristic engineering.

items.titleZh: Create a polished square advertising image for Colgate Sensation White, split vertically into two equal halves with a glowing divider line in the center, showing a side-by-side contrast between tradition and modern science. On the left half, place an elderly African woman seated behind a pale marble tabletop in a warm, earthy interior with carved wooden wall panels and a clay pot in the background. She wears a richly patterned traditional rust-orange and gold wrap dress with layered bead necklaces and bracelets, and has short gray natural hair. She holds a natural chewing stick near her mouth in a calm, dignified pose. Curve the French headline text above her head in large warm golden-yellow letters: "Depuis toujours." On the right half, place a young African child seated behind the same tabletop in a sleek modern blue interior with soft glowing lights and vertical gold accents. The child wears a vivid traditional-modern outfit: a copper-brown tunic with bright blue patterned front panel and gold trim, with neat braided hair, and holds a Colgate toothbrush near the mouth. Curve the French headline text above the child in large bright blue letters: "Pour toujours." At the bottom center, spanning both halves and placed prominently on the marble table, show exactly 2 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste boxes stacked slightly offset, with one matching toothbrush resting on top. The packaging must be highly legible and realistic, featuring the red Colgate logo and blue-white Sensation White branding. items.promptZh: 为高露洁 Sensation White 制作一个抛光的方形广告图像，垂直分成相等的两半，中间有一条发光的分隔线，展示传统与现代科学之间的并排对比。在左半部分，一位年长的非洲妇女坐在浅色大理石桌面后面，室内环境温暖朴实，背景是雕刻的木墙板和陶罐。她穿着一件图案丰富的传统铁锈橙色和金色裹身裙，戴着分层的珠项链和手镯，留着自然的灰色短发。她把一根天然的咀嚼棒放在嘴边，摆出平静而庄严的姿势。在她头顶上用温暖的金黄色大字弯曲法文标题文字：“Depuis toujours”。在右半部分，将一名年轻的非洲儿童坐在同一个桌面后面，桌面采用时尚现代的蓝色内饰，配有柔和的灯光和垂直的金色装饰。孩子穿着生动的传统现代服装：铜棕色束腰外衣，前面有亮蓝色图案，镶有金色饰边，头发编成整齐的辫子，嘴边拿着一把高露洁牙刷。将法语标题文字以大而亮的蓝色字母弯曲在孩子上方：“Pour toujours”。在底部中心，跨越两半并放置在大理石桌子上的显着位置，恰好展示了 2 个高露洁 Sensation White 牙膏盒，它们稍微偏移地堆叠在一起，顶部放置着一支配套的牙刷。包装必须高度清晰和逼真，具有红色高露洁标志和蓝白色的 Sensation White 品牌。在底部边缘居中添加醒目的白色法式标语：“Le meilleur de la Tradition, la Force de la science”。使用电影级商业照明、优质产品摄影真实感、丰富的肤色、平衡的对称性以及传统与创新相遇的视觉故事。
items.prompt: Create a polished square advertising image for Colgate Sensation White, split vertically into two equal halves with a glowing divider line in the center, showing a side-by-side contrast between tradition and modern science. items.title: Professional Brand Packaging System
items.titleZh:
Please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "Brand Packaging System Display Image" for the brand {argument name="brand name" default="Brand Name"} in the category {argument name="category" default="Product Category"}. This is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. The image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[Aspect Ratio Requirements] The overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. Horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. The layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. The weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[Core Requirements] Automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [Category] and build a unified visual system around the [Brand Name]. Choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. Prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. You can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[Category Adaptation] Adapt packaging forms to the [Category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for Bakery; cups and sleeves for Coffee/Tea; jars and tubes for Beauty/Skincare; candles and cards for Fragrance/Lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for Fashion/Collectibles. The result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[Quantity Control] Control the number of items; do not overcrowd. The scene should be "less is more." Suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. Total visible elements should be between 6-10. Ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[Visual System] All packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [Brand Name] as the core element. Maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. The style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[Color Mechanism] Avoid fixed combinations. Generate different schemes like Cream White/Caramel Brown, Mist Blue/Warm White, Olive Green/Linen Beige, Chocolate Brown/Ivory, etc. Avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. Maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[Composition] Use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. Arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. At least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). Create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[Visual Style] High-end commercial photography feel. Clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). Emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). Modern and clean visual language.

[Lighting] Commercial grade lighting. Soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. Use clear but restrained shadows for depth. The light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[Final Effect] The final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality.
items.prompt:
请为品牌【{argument name="品牌名称" default="品牌名称"}】、类目为【{argument name="品牌类目" default="品牌类目"}】创作一张高审美、高完成度的「品牌包装系统展示图」。这不是普通电商白底图，也不是单一产品图，而是一张具有品牌提案感、视觉识别系统感和商业摄影质感的包装家族陈列效果图。画面需要体现“同一品牌在多个包装载体上的统一落地”，呈现一个成熟消费品牌的完整包装系统。

【画幅要求】整体必须为固定 4:5 的竖版海报构图，画面方向明确为纵向，禁止生成横版构图、宽幅桌面陈列或过于分散的横向展示。整体构图需符合海报阅读逻辑：上方保留呼吸感，中部为品牌包装系统的主要视觉焦点，下方安排辅助包装、标签和产品本体，整体重心集中，适合直接作为品牌展示海报发布。

【核心要求】根据【类目】自动匹配最合理、最自然的包装组合与产品形态，并围绕【品牌名字】建立统一的品牌视觉系统。画面中应选择少量但有代表性的包装形式，组成一组完整而精炼的品牌包装系统，不追求堆砌数量，而强调主次层级、品牌统一性与陈列美感。可根据类目合理选择以下包装类型中的一部分：手提袋 / 购物袋、纸盒 / 礼盒 / 外包装盒、长条盒 / 单品盒 / 套装盒、包装袋 / 封套 / 小样袋 / 软袋、杯子 / 瓶子 / 罐子 / 管状容器 / 喷雾瓶 / 泵头瓶、标签 / 贴纸 / 封签 / 吊牌 / 小卡片，以及与类目对应的真实产品本体。

【类目适配逻辑】包装形式与产品形态需要根据【类目】自动匹配，但不局限于单一方向。可参考以下适配逻辑自由发散：若类目为食品 / 烘焙 / 零食 / 饮品，则以纸袋、纸盒、包装袋、杯子、食品容器、贴纸、封签及真实产品本体为主；若类目为茶饮 / 咖啡 / 饮料，则以杯子、瓶子、罐装包装、提袋、杯套、封口贴、礼盒等为主；若类目为美妆 / 护肤 / 彩妆 / 香水，则以瓶、罐、管、盒、礼盒、手提袋、小样包装等为主；若类目为香氛 / 家居 / 生活方式，则以香薰瓶、蜡烛杯、包装盒、礼盒、提袋、吊卡、标签卡等为主；若类目为服饰 / 饰品 / 潮玩 / 文创，则以包装盒、抽屉盒、防尘袋、手提袋、贴纸、吊牌、配件包装等为主；若类目为数码配件 / 工具 / 小型消费品，则以硬盒、外包装盒、收纳袋、说明卡、贴纸、封套、标签等为主。整体必须体现“类目合理、品牌统一、包装成体系”的效果。

【数量与密度控制】请控制画面中的物件数量，不要过多堆砌，也不要把所有可能包装形式全部展示出来。整体应呈现“少而精、完整但不拥挤”的品牌包装系统效果。建议选择最具代表性的包装载体进行展示：大件包装 1～2 个，中型包装 2～3 个，小型包装或辅助物件 2～4 个，真实产品本体 1～3 个，总可见元素建议控制在 6～10 个之间。包装种类应体现层次变化与系统感，但不宜重复过多同类物件。画面需要有足够留白与呼吸感，确保每个包装都清晰可见、主次明确、摆放舒展，宁可少而精，也不要为了“完整”而过度塞满。

【品牌视觉系统要求】所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，统一使用【品牌名字】作为核心品牌识别元素。整体应具备一致的 logo / 标志呈现、字体风格、图形语言、插画语言或纹样系统、排版逻辑、配色体系、材质与印刷质感。品牌调性、色彩方向、图案元素、辅助图形和视觉氛围，请根据【类目】自动匹配并合理发散，不局限于任何固定风格。整体风格应统一、协调、具有品牌识别度，可以是简约高级、自然有机、时尚现代、轻奢精致、年轻清新、艺术感、潮流个性或经典优雅，但必须符合【类目】特征，并呈现成熟品牌的设计完成度。

【配色机制要求】整体配色不要固化为某一种固定组合，也不要连续多次出现高度相似的主色系统。每次生成时应根据【类目】与品牌气质，主动形成不同的主色方案与配色关系，采用“受控发散”的方式进行色彩演绎。色彩可以是低饱和自然色、现代中性色、轻复古色、明快清新色、轻奢深色系或艺术感综合色系，但必须保持高级、统一、克制、有品牌感。允许每次生成时呈现不同的视觉气质，例如奶油白与焦糖棕、雾灰蓝与暖白、橄榄绿与亚麻米、酒红与奶霜白、可可棕与象牙白、炭灰与麦秆金、雾粉灰与米白、海军蓝与暖灰等，仅作为参考方向而非固定模板。不要荧光色，不要廉价高饱和，不要杂乱失控的多色拼贴。

【画面构图与陈列要求】画面采用品牌包装家族陈列逻辑，而不是杂乱堆放。整体为商业摄影棚场景，使用 3/4 轻俯视角或略带透视的正面陈列角度，形成有层次、有秩序、有主次的包装展示画面。构图参考以下逻辑：后景摆放 1～2 个较大的包装作为视觉支撑，如手提袋、大礼盒、大外盒；中景安排品牌核心包装或主力单品包装，作为主要视觉焦点；前景摆放较小包装、辅助包装、标签、贴纸及真实产品本体；至少有一个真实产品与包装产生自然互动，如产品半露出、摆放在包装前方、与包装组合展示；整体形成平衡而有设计感的三角式或错落式构图。画面干净、有留白、不拥挤，内容丰富但克制，以有限而精准的包装组合体现完整的品牌包装生态。

【视觉风格要求】整体呈现高端商业摄影质感与品牌提案感，背景为干净的摄影棚环境，可为白色、暖白色、浅灰色，或根据品牌调性自动匹配的极简背景。画面应强调真实的包装材质表现、清晰的纸张折痕、盒型结构、瓶罐轮廓、标签细节、印刷质感、压纹 / 烫金 / 哑光 / 棉纸纹理 / 牛皮纸纹理等材质细节，以及统一而高级的配色搭配、精致现代干净的品牌视觉语言和强烈的“这是一整套品牌包装系统”的完整感。

【光影要求】采用真实商业摄影级光影，可为柔和棚拍光，也可带有轻微方向性的自然侧光。需要有清晰但克制的阴影，以增强立体感、空间感与高级感。整体光线通透、明亮、干净，不要阴暗，不要廉价感，不要杂乱背景。

【最终效果要求】最终画面应像一个成熟品牌的包装系统展示海报、包装家族提案图或品牌视觉落地效果图，而不是零散商品拼图。重点突出：固定 4:5 竖版海报感、品牌统一性、包装家族完整性、商业摄影感、设计提案感、类目适配性，以及高级审美与视觉完成度。
