items.title: Japanese Video Production Poster
items.titleZh: Create a clean, premium Japanese corporate poster for a {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} video production company, in a minimalist editorial layout on an off-white background with lots of negative space. Portrait orientation, A4-like poster proportions. At the very top left, place an oversized bold black sans-serif logotype reading {argument name="company name" default="Arks"}, spanning nearly the full width of the page. In the upper right, add a small stacked brand mark in thin uppercase letters: "VIDEO" on one line, "PRODUCTION" on the next, "COMPANY" on the third, with a small burnt-orange geometric accent nearby. Below the logo, add a vertical burnt-orange bar on the left and a large elegant Japanese headline in black Mincho-style serif: {argument name="headline text" default="4つの領域で、映像を磨く。"}. Directly underneath, add a smaller service line in Japanese with slash separators: "SNS運用 / ショートドラマ / MV制作 / AI映像". The main body is a 2 by 2 grid of exactly 4 service panels with thin light-gray divider lines. Each panel has a large black editorial number and a Japanese label. Panel 1 label: "SNS運用" with the number "01"; image shows a close-up hand holding a smartphone displaying social media analytics, on a desk with charts, a calendar sheet, a pen, and a coffee mug, in warm natural office lighting; caption below in Japanese: "企画・分析・運用を一つの流れで。" Panel 2 label: "ショートドラマ" with the number "02"; image shows exactly 2 Japanese high-school-age students in white shirts standing outdoors on a rooftop or balcony, one female and one male, side-profile composition, muted overcast daylight, cinematic shallow depth of field; caption below: "共感が残る、短編の物語設計。" Panel 3 label: "MV制作" with the number "03"; image shows a moody musician playing electric guitar in a dim studio, backlit by soft haze, with a camera monitor in the foreground showing the same performer; caption below: "アーティストの世界観を、映像で可視化。" Panel 4 label: "AI映像" with the number "04"; image shows a dark professional AI video-generation or image-editing software interface on a monitor, with a cinematic scene of a lone figure standing on rocks under dramatic clouds, plus thumbnail timeline images and side control panels; caption below: "技術を表現へ変える、次世代の映像制作。" At the bottom left, place a small three-line English slogan in uppercase: {argument name="tagline text" default="CREATE.\nCONNECT.\nLEAVE A MARK."} with a small burnt-orange line accent above it. At the bottom right, place the website {argument name="website" default="arks-vp.com"} in small serif text with a short black horizontal line beside it. Use a refined mix of bold modern sans-serif for the large logo and numbers, and elegant Japanese serif for headlines and labels. Color palette: black, charcoal, warm off-white, light gray rules, and restrained burnt-orange accents. The overall feel should be realistic, polished, contemporary, Japanese editorial advertising design, with accurate Japanese typography and natural image tones.

items.title: Tennis Hydration Ad Poster
items.titleZh: Create a hyper-realistic sports advertising poster shot from an extreme wide-angle, low courtside perspective on a bright sunny day at an outdoor tennis court. In the extreme foreground, a male tennis player lunges dramatically toward the camera while thrusting a large matte cobalt-blue insulated water bottle toward the viewer, making the bottle the dominant object in the frame. The bottle is covered with visible condensation droplets and has a brushed metallic gold cap, with the white logo text {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} printed near the bottom. The athlete wears a clean white athletic t-shirt, bright blue tennis shorts, white wristbands, white socks, and white tennis shoes. His other arm stretches back holding a black tennis racket, with 1 bright yellow-green tennis ball visible near the racket on the right side of the image. The pose should feel dynamic and athletic, with one leg bent deeply and the other extended in a wide lunge across the blue hard court. Use strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, vivid saturated blues, and a clear cloudless sky, with green trees and a dark fence line in the distant background. Compose it like a premium hydration brand campaign, with sharp focus on the bottle and athlete, dramatic foreshortening, commercial polish, and energetic motion. Add clean white ad typography integrated onto the court surface in the lower half: a smaller line reading {argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}, a very large bold line reading {argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}, and a smaller subheading reading {argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keeps up with every move."}. Place the {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} logo again in white at the top right, and a small website URL in white at the bottom right reading {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}.
items.promptZh: 在阳光明媚的日子，在室外网球场从超广角、低场边视角拍摄的超现实体育广告海报。在最远的前景中，一名男子网球运动员戏剧性地冲向镜头，同时将一个大的哑光钴蓝色绝缘水瓶推向观众，使瓶子成为画面中的主要物体。瓶子上覆盖着可见的冷凝水滴，并配有拉丝金属金色瓶盖，底部附近印有白色徽标文字{argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"}。运动员穿着干净的白色运动 T 恤、亮蓝色网球短裤、白色腕带、白色袜子和白色网球鞋。他的另一只手臂向后伸展，拿着一个黑色网球拍，在图像右侧的球拍附近可以看到一个明亮的黄绿色网球。这个姿势应该给人一种充满活力和运动感的感觉，一条腿深深弯曲，另一条腿在蓝色硬地球场上呈弓步伸展。使用强烈的正午阳光、清晰的阴影、生动饱和的蓝色和清澈无云的天空，远处的背景中有绿色的树木和深色的栅栏线。将其设计为优质水袋品牌广告活动，重点关注瓶子和运动员、戏剧性的透视、商业润色和充满活力的动作。在下半部分的球场表面上添加干净的白色广告排版：一条较小的行显示为{argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}，一条非常大的粗行显示为{argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}，还有一个较小的副标题显示为{argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keep up with every move."}。再次将白色的 {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} 徽标放在右上角，并在右下角放置一个白色的小网站网址，内容为 {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}。

items.title: Futuristic Brand Visual Manual
items.titleZh: Create a sophisticated multi-page brand visual manual for a company named "{argument name="brand name" default="Any Brand Name"}". The overall brand persona should be playful, futuristic, vibrant, and highly designed, striking a balance between "toy-like energy" and the "sophistication of a high-end creative tech brand." The visual style should use bold and experimental brand language, including: high-saturation bright colors, simple geometric shapes, modern typography, dynamic visual rhythm, and slightly surreal image expression. The overall atmosphere should convey: creativity, youthfulness, rhythm, tactile experience, and conceptual avant-garde. The expression needs to integrate the fun of consumer products, the presentation of fashion brands, and the language of contemporary digital design. The brand manual should reflect: extreme focus on product details, diverse visual experimentation, packaging design exploration, editorial style photography, immersive retail experience, and cross-platform brand application. The final presentation should construct a confident, contemporary, unified, and complete brand worldview—both easy to understand and approachable, yet possessing a strong sense of art direction, maintaining high visual consistency while showcasing aesthetic standards at a high-end creative studio level.
items.prompt:
为一家名为「{argument name="品牌名称" default="任何品牌名称"}」的公司打造一套精致的多页品牌视觉手册(多张图片形式)。品牌整体气质应当充满趣味、具有未来感、色彩鲜明，并且设计感强烈，在“玩具般的活力”与“高端创意科技品牌的精致感”之间取得平衡。视觉风格需采用大胆且具有实验性的品牌语言，包括:高饱和亮色、简洁几何图形、现代字体设计、富有动感的视觉节奏，以及略带超 surreal 感的图像表达。
整体氛围应传递出:创造力、年轻感、节奏感、触感体验以及概念前卫性。在表达上，需要融合消费级产品的趣味性、时尚品牌的呈现方式，以及当代数字设计的语言体系。品牌手册中应体现:
对产品细节的极致关注(product obsession)多样化的视觉实验(visual experimentation)包装设计探索(packaging exploration)编辑风格摄影(editorial photography)沉浸式零售体验(immersive retail)跨平台品牌应用 (cross-platform brand application)最终呈现应构建一个自信、当代、统一且完整的品牌世界观一既易于理解与接近，又具备强烈的艺术指导感(artdirection)在视觉上保持高度一致性，同时展现出高端创意工作室级别的美学标准。

items.title: Luxury Hair Dryer Beauty Ad
items.titleZh: Create a premium minimalist beauty advertisement on a clean light gray studio background. Show a glamorous female model from chest up on the left side, with {argument name="hair color" default="deep brunette"} hair blown dramatically to the left in a smooth, glossy wave, emphasizing shine and movement. She wears an elegant white halter dress with a twisted neckline. Her face is de-emphasized and not the focal point. On the right side, place a sleek modern cylindrical hair dryer in a metallic silver finish with a rose-gold circular rim around a black hollow center, shown upright with visible handle buttons, lower air vent perforations, and attached cord. Use luxury commercial product-photography lighting, soft shadows, ultra-clean retouching, and high-end cosmetic ad styling. Add bold modern sans-serif headline text in the upper right: {argument name="headline text" default="Effortless shine."} on the first line and {argument name="subheadline text" default="Everyday perfection."} below it in a lighter weight. In the lower left, include exactly 4 vertically stacked feature callouts with thin outlined circular icons and small sans-serif text: 1) sparkle icon with title "Fast drying." and body "Powerful digital motor for quick, efficient results." 2) thermometer icon with title "Heat intelligent." and body "Measures air temperature 40 times per second." 3) wavy heat lines icon with title "Designed for hair health." and body "Helps protect natural shine and smoothness." 4) muted speaker icon with title "Engineered for balance." and body "Lightweight, quiet, and comfortable to use." In the bottom right corner, add the luxury brand logo text {argument name="brand name" default="LUXÉO"} with small uppercase "PROFESSIONAL" beneath it. Vertical poster layout, polished mobile ad aesthetic, aspirational beauty-tech branding, realistic hair texture, realistic skin, crisp typography, and premium editorial composition.

items.title: OpenAI Merch Poster Grid
items.titleZh: A clean, minimalist promotional poster on an off-white background in a modern tech-brand style. At the top left, a very large bold sans-serif headline in deep cobalt blue reads {argument name="headline text" default="Thinking Mode Searches"} split across two lines. Beneath it, a smaller gray explanatory sentence says that with thinking mode, the model can automatically browse the internet and find relevant contents for reference. At the top right, place a small blue OpenAI knot logo. Below the intro text, add a thin horizontal blue divider line ending with a tiny sparkle icon on the right. Under that, include a prompt line in small text with the word “Prompt:” in blue followed by the sentence {argument name="prompt text" default="Make a poster about OpenAI merch available on the official website right now."}. The main body is a centered 3-by-2 product grid with 8 total merchandise items shown as clean catalog cutouts with soft shadows inside rounded pale cards. Top row has 3 larger products: 1) a white long-sleeve striped rugby-style jersey with black collar and cuffs, small blue patches, and blue chest text “Research & Deployment Co.”, labeled “10 Year Jersey”; 2) a dark brown pullover hoodie with front pocket, small centered chest text “Research Deployment Co.” and sleeve print, labeled “Diagram Hoodie”; 3) a black T-shirt viewed from the back with a metallic knot graphic and pale pink text “Research & Deployment Co.”, labeled “Chrome Blossom Tee”. Bottom row has 5 smaller products: 4) a blue folding chair keychain shaped like a chair, labeled “Blue Chair Keychain”; 5) a black baseball cap with white flame graphics and “GPT-5” on the front, labeled “GPT-5 Flame Cap”; 6) a white notebook with a bold blue lower band and minimal OpenAI branding, labeled “OpenAI Notebook”; 7) a glossy black mug with “OpenAI” in white, labeled “OpenAI Office Mug”; 8) a dark green baseball cap with small white text “Thinking deeply”, labeled “Thinking Deeply Cap”. Keep all item labels centered below each product in small blue sans-serif text. items.title: Apple-Style CEO Announcement Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic, ultra-polished Chinese corporate announcement poster in a premium Apple-style keynote aesthetic, vertical 4:5 composition, featuring a confident middle-aged East Asian man from the waist up standing outdoors in front of a futuristic glass-ring campus building at dusk, with a huge glowing white Apple logo behind him on the right side. He wears a minimalist black button-up shirt over a dark undershirt, with a calm, authoritative posture and luxury-brand presentation lighting. The sky is a deep blue-to-gray gradient, and the overall color palette is dark navy, charcoal, silver, and warm soft white. At the very top center, place a small white Apple logo, with a thin horizontal divider line on each side and the Chinese text “Apple 新篇章 由此开启” beneath it in elegant sans-serif. In the top right corner, add large bold red Chinese text: “AI生成”. Across the upper-middle area, add a huge bold white Chinese headline: “{argument name="headline text" default="罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO"}”. Directly below it, add smaller spaced-out white Chinese subheadline text: “用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”. On the left side of the subject’s chest area, place a quotation block with a large opening quotation mark and 2 lines of Chinese body text in dark navy: “{argument name="quote" default="我不是来改变 Apple，而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。"}”, followed by a handwritten-style signature line and the name “罗永浩”. In the lower-middle area, overlay a dark translucent horizontal feature bar containing exactly 4 icon-and-text items, evenly spaced from left to right: 1) a hammer icon with the title “工匠精神” and subtitle “极致产品主义”, 2) a speech bubble icon with the title “用户至上” and subtitle “体验超越期待”, 3) a light bulb icon with the title “创新驱动” and subtitle “重新定义未来”, 4) a heart outline icon with the title “真诚沟通” and subtitle “打造人心的科技”. At the bottom center, add large white English text: “Think Different. Think Again.”, then below it smaller white Chinese text: “现在，交给罗永浩。” and a handwritten signature beneath. The subject should resemble {argument name="character name" default="罗永浩"}, with {argument name="hair style" default="short black hair, neatly combed"} and {argument name="outfit" default="minimalist black button-up shirt"}. Make the image photorealistic but slightly idealized like a premium launch campaign, with cinematic contrast, soft edge glow around the Apple logo, subtle reflections on the glass architecture, elegant typography hierarchy, and a highly believable luxury-tech advertisement finish.

items.title: Cinematic Beyblade Rooftop Launch
items.titleZh: A hyper-realistic cinematic action photo of a young man mid-jump above a rooftop at golden-hour sunset, captured from a dramatic low angle against a glowing orange sky filled with scattered clouds. He is centered in the frame, airborne with both knees bent, wearing a woven straw hat, an open {argument name="jacket color" default="bright red"} overshirt flaring in the wind, a white tank top, dark loose cargo-style pants, rugged dark boots, layered necklaces, fingerless gloves, and a belt with a launcher holster clipped at his waist. His right arm is thrust toward the camera, launching a spinning top toy on a visible ripcord, with the toy in the extreme foreground on the right side rendered large and motion-blurred for depth and speed. Place a transparent plastic Beyblade battle stadium at the bottom foreground, catching warm reflections from the sunset, with the clearly visible printed logo text {argument name="brand text" default="BEYBLADE X"}. The city skyline stretches across the lower background with several high-rise buildings silhouetted by the setting sun near the horizon. Lighting is intensely warm and backlit, with strong rim light, cinematic contrast, subtle lens flare, and dynamic fabric movement. The composition should feel like a live-action promotional poster for {argument name="toy franchise" default="Beyblade X"}, emphasizing energy, youth, speed, and urban rooftop competition, in vertical poster format.

items.title: Samurai Mecha Girl Figure Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a premium Japanese figure advertisement poster on a clean off-white background with subtle pale gray brushstroke textures and tiny scattered gold flecks. The layout should look like a luxury hobby product introduction page for an original anime/mecha statue. The main centerpiece is a highly detailed 1/7 scale-style figure of {argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, a slim teenage anime girl in a dramatic crouching attack pose, turned three-quarters to the viewer, with one knee bent under her body and the other mechanical leg planted forward. She raises a katana overhead with both hands as if about to strike. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur block. She has long brown hair with loose strands flying outward, a white headband with a small mechanical side ornament, and a navy Japanese sailor school uniform with a cropped long-sleeve top, red neckerchief, short pleated skirt, and exposed midriff. Her arms and legs are mostly robotic: metallic silver-gray mechanical arms with articulated fingers and visible joints, bulky armored mech thighs and calves with realistic pistons, seams, weathering, and small orange caution markings. The sword is a polished katana with a white-and-black wrapped handle and a metallic guard. Render the statue as a realistic painted collectible figure with studio lighting, glossy and matte material contrast, precise shadows, and showroom-grade product photography.

Design the page like a commercial figure brochure with exactly 5 numbered detail callout sections. On the left side, stack 4 rectangular close-up panels vertically, each with a number and Japanese label plus short descriptive body text in Japanese: panel 1 shows a close-up of the face and hair, labeled "01 表情"; panel 2 shows the upper torso and uniform, labeled "02 上半身"; panel 3 shows the raised mechanical arms and sword grip, labeled "03 メカアーム&ソード"; panel 4 shows the mechanical legs, labeled "04 メカレッグ". At the bottom right, add a wider rectangular panel labeled "05 武装・ディテール" showing exactly 2 katana close-up views arranged horizontally, one above the other. Keep all panel images bordered lightly and integrated into the poster layout.

At the upper left, place a large expressive brush-calligraphy title reading {argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, with an ink-brush circle motif behind the first word. At the upper right, add a gold minimalist logo and the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}, with small Japanese tagline text beneath it. Along the right side, place a vertical Japanese promotional slogan in elegant dark text. In the lower left area, include small product specification text in Japanese with exactly these lines of product info styling: scale, product name, sculptor credit, paint credit, brand, and a release date line. Use {argument name="release date" default="2025年12月"} in the schedule area. Along the bottom, add a dark horizontal footer bar with the gold brand logo on the left, the brand name repeated, a short Japanese brand statement in small text across the center, and tiny legal/disclaimer text at the far right. Overall style: high-end Japanese figure marketing sheet, refined editorial composition, realistic collectible statue photography, elegant white-and-gold packaging aesthetic, anime girl fused with hard-surface mecha design, polished and premium.

items.title: Chibi Catgirl at Yokohama Stadium
items.titleZh: A cute anime chibi girl walking toward the camera on the tree-lined pedestrian approach outside {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"}, shown in a realistic modern Japanese city photo background under bright midday sunlight with a blue sky peeking through the trees. The stadium fills the upper background with its large white structural beams and a dark blue sign reading {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"}. On the right side, there are 2 tall blue vertical banners on lampposts with a stylized B logo and welcome text for Yokohama Stadium, plus 2 smaller matching blue banners farther down the walkway. The paved plaza is wide and open, with 2 short black bollards visible in the foreground-left area, green hedges and mature trees along both sides, and small pedestrians scattered in the distance for scale. In the center foreground, place 1 super-deformed catgirl character composited naturally into the scene: petite chibi proportions, oversized head, soft anime shading, pale skin, long slightly tousled dark hair with bangs, fluffy cat ears, and a small black cat tail. She wears an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="forest green"} hoodie that falls like a short dress, black low-cut shoes, and 1 small black crossbody bag with a flap and tiny charm hanging from it. She is holding 1 wrapped burger or sandwich with both hands near her mouth as if eating while walking. Her pose is slightly pigeon-toed and casual, one leg crossing in front of the other, giving a shy adorable feeling. Use a whimsical contrast between highly realistic street photography and a polished anime sticker-like character with clean outlines and subtle shadowing on the pavement. Keep the face centered but obscured by a large square mosaic blur censor block.
items.promptZh: 一个可爱的动漫《赤壁》女孩在 {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"} 外的绿树成荫的人行道上走向镜头，在明亮的正午阳光下，在逼真的现代日本城市照片背景中，蓝天透过树林窥视。体育场的上部背景充满了白色的大结构梁和一个深蓝色的标志，上面写着{argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"}。在右侧，灯柱上有 2 个高大的蓝色垂直横幅，上面有风格化的 B 标志和横滨体育场的欢迎文字，另外在走道的远处还有 2 个较小的匹配蓝色横幅。铺砌的广场宽阔而开阔，前景左侧可见两根黑色短柱，两侧有绿色的树篱和成熟的树木，远处散布着小行人以形成规模。在中央前景中，放置1个自然合成的超级变形猫女角色：娇小的赤壁比例，超大的头部，柔和的动漫阴影，苍白的皮肤，带有刘海的略乱的黑长发，毛茸茸的猫耳朵和黑色的小猫尾巴。她穿着一件像短裙一样垂下来的超大{argument name="hoodie color" default="forest green"}连帽衫，黑色低帮鞋，还有 1 个带有翻盖和小饰物的黑色小斜挎包。她双手拿着一个包好的汉堡或三明治，放在嘴边，就像边走边吃一样。她的姿势略显内八字，随意，一腿交叉在前，给人一种害羞可爱的感觉。在高度逼真的街头摄影和抛光的动漫贴纸般的角色之间使用异想天开的对比，该角色具有清晰的轮廓和人行道上的微妙阴影。保持脸部居中，但被大方形马赛克模糊检查块遮挡。

items.title: Dark Fantasy Wizard Podcast Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic dark fantasy studio poster of two wizard-like figures posed like a parody heavy-metal album cover. In the foreground, a stocky older wizard sits or leans toward the camera, wearing a glossy black hooded robe, large over-ear studio headphones, and a long thick white beard spilling over his chest. He grips a tall black staff in his left hand; the staff has an elongated spearhead-shaped ornate top with open lattice details. A large black podcast microphone on a boom or stand is positioned directly in front of him at mouth level, with a visible sticker that reads "CARAJO" on the microphone body. Behind him stands a second older wizard in a luminous white robe with gold trim and a rope belt, also with long white hair and a long white beard. He holds a tall white staff with a matching ornate spearhead top in his right hand and extends his left hand toward the viewer in a commanding spell-casting gesture, fingers spread. Behind the standing wizard’s head is a bright electric-blue glowing circular halo made of runes, creating a magical summoning-ring effect. The background is pure black, with high-contrast cinematic lighting: cool blue rim light from behind and warm highlights on the hands, robes, and staffs. The composition is vertical, tightly framed, with the black-robed wizard occupying the lower center and the white-robed wizard towering behind him. items.title: Mirassol FC Signing Announcement Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic Brazilian football club signing announcement poster in a vertical 2:3 layout, with a gritty high-contrast sports-marketing aesthetic in yellow, dark green, black, and gold. The main subject is a muscular tattooed male footballer wearing a bright yellow Mirassol FC home jersey, shown as a large centered half-body portrait from chest up, facing forward with a serious intimidating expression. He has a shaved head, visible neck and arm tattoos, and a broad athletic build. The jersey has dark green trim on the collar and sleeves, the Mirassol crest with two stars on the chest, the ATHLETA logo on the opposite chest, a large green sponsor wordmark reading “Poty” across the torso, shoulder brand marks, and a circular sleeve sponsor patch. Behind him, place a dramatic waving Mirassol flag in dark green and yellow on the upper right with a large club crest and two stars, glowing stadium lights, smoky golden particles, and a night stadium crowd background. On the left side, stack large bold condensed text in Portuguese: “BEM-VINDO AO” above an oversized yellow “MIRASOL”, then the player name split across 2 lines as “ALEX” and “POATAN” in huge white letters, with a handwritten yellow signature-style “Poatan” beneath. Below that, add a 4-line motivational block in uppercase white text with the final line highlighted in yellow: “DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA.” On the right side, add a vertical info panel with 3 icon-and-word traits, each in yellow with matching symbols: target icon with “FOCO”, fist icon with “DISCIPLINA”, and helmet icon with “GARRA”, then below them a bold yellow callout: “AGORA É PELO LEÃO!”. Include 2 smaller secondary player images at the bottom: 1 on the lower left, a cropped front three-quarter pose kissing the club badge on the jersey; and 1 on the lower center-right, a back view with both arms raised and index fingers pointing upward. On the back-view jersey, show the sponsor text “DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA” across the upper back, the name “POATAN”, and the number “10” in large green numerals. Add a black-and-gold bottom strip containing 4 values separated evenly with icons: lion head and “MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO”, shield and “FORÇA E HONRA”, star and “HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”, soccer ball and “PAIXÃO PELO JOGO”. Beneath that, place a yellow banner with the slogan “NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO.” and at the very bottom a handwritten white phrase “FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!” followed by the hashtag “#POATANÉLEÃO”. Use cinematic rim lighting, intense contrast, metallic golden glow, textured smoke, and premium club-announcement poster design.

items.titleZh: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic action movie poster at golden-hour sunset, showing a rugged adult male action hero standing on the shattered glass edge of a skyscraper rooftop high above a futuristic megacity. He is positioned on the left side of the frame in a powerful full-body pose, wearing a dark fitted T-shirt, black jeans, and a dark open jacket, with windswept short brown hair. His face is intentionally obscured with a smooth rectangular blur block, as if censored. In one hand he holds a glowing blue holographic device projecting a transparent sci-fi interface with maps, targeting graphics, and a digital countdown timer reading 00:18:43. The background features a dramatic skyline of tall modern towers stretching to the horizon, with the sun low in the center-right casting warm orange light across the city. Fill the sky with explosive blockbuster action: 1 large helicopter in the upper right exploding midair with fire, smoke, debris, and spinning rotor fragments; 1 damaged passenger aircraft on the lower right banking downward trailing flames and black smoke; and 2 fast military jets streaking across the upper left sky leaving bright missile trails. Add flying embers, sparks, drifting debris, and intense volumetric smoke clouds for a high-stakes disaster atmosphere. Place a huge metallic 3D movie title across the upper-middle right reading {argument name="title text" default="TIMEFALL"}, angled slightly with bold steel texture and cinematic shadowing. Beneath it, add the tagline in clean bold capitals: {argument name="tagline" default="ONE MAN. ONE CHANCE. NO LIMITS."}. Add a small white brand mark in the top-right corner reading {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}. Use ultra-detailed photorealism, dramatic contrast, blockbuster poster composition, anamorphic flare, sharp character detail, epic scale, and polished Hollywood key art styling.

Freeze motion with multiple splashes and droplets of orange sauce exploding upward and around the burger, plus floating crumbs and seasoning particles in the air. items.titleZh: Create a hyper-detailed cinematic parody movie poster featuring an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu as an extreme bodybuilding powerlifting hero, centered in a full frontal deep squat while holding a massively overloaded barbell across his shoulders. The dog has a realistic Shiba Inu head with a calm, confident expression, warm orange-and-cream fur, upright ears, and direct eye contact. The body is exaggeratedly muscular and humanlike, with huge deltoids, chest, arms, abs, quads, and calves, rendered with glossy dramatic highlights and dense texture in the fur and skin. He wears only tight black lifting shorts and a dark lifting belt. The squat stance is low and powerful, knees bent wide, feet planted on a wet reflective rooftop or industrial platform at night. Put a modern city skyline in the background with illuminated skyscrapers, bluish haze, smoke, and two bright stadium floodlights in the upper left and upper right creating strong rim light and a heroic sports-arena mood. The composition should be perfectly centered and symmetrical, with the barbell extending horizontally across the frame and stacked with many large black weight plates on both sides. Use a high-contrast teal, amber, black, and gold color palette with intense cinematic grading, sharp focus on the character, and atmospheric glow around the lights. Add stylized poster typography: at the very top, a gold all-caps tagline reading {argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."}. Add 2 blocks of small white Japanese copy, 1 on the left of the character and 1 on the right, each set in 2 lines. At the bottom, place a gigantic cracked stone-textured gold title in all caps reading {argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"}. Beneath it, add a red all-caps subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."}. Add a small red stamp-like Japanese label near the lower right of the title. Include dense tiny mock film-poster credits in white across the lower center, a ratings box in the lower left, 3 tiny studio or audio logos in the lower right, and a centered release line near the bottom reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"}. Make it look like a polished blockbuster action-comedy sports film poster with absurdly epic intensity, photoreal rendering, dramatic shadows, volumetric smoke, reflective ground, and premium theatrical poster design.

items.title: Latin American Tech Festival Poster
items.titleZh: Create a highly detailed, colorful isometric festival poster illustration of a bustling Latin American technology fair in an open urban plaza, packed with dozens of people networking, coding, presenting, eating, recording media, and attending talks. The overall style should feel like a premium editorial cityscape poster: vibrant, dense, optimistic, playful, and full of readable signage, with crisp linework, painterly textures, warm sunlight, and a celebratory startup-community atmosphere. The main headline on the large stage at upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}, with a subheading in Spanish reading "Aprender para transformar". On the stage, show a live conference with blue lighting, a presenter, and a seated audience; include 4 vertical icon panels on the stage area labeled "Educación", "Tecnología", "Innovación", and "Futuro", plus 3 glowing topic icons on the back wall labeled "Código", "Comunidad", and "Impacto". Build the plaza as a dense multi-zone event map with exactly 24 clearly labeled signs or booths distributed across the scene: "Keep Coding Keep Growing", "YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA", "Remote Work Zone", "ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE", "STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE", "DESIGN THINKING", "HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS", "Café con código", "AREPAS CON TODO", "Hechas con código y ♥", "Inspiración", "Networking", "Aprendizaje", "Café", "Baños", "SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA", "AI LAB", "DATA PEOPLE", "DEVS QUE IMPACTAN", "MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY", "PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS", "FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO", "FOUNDER MODE", and "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE". In the center of the plaza, place a circular fountain with a large green geometric logo sculpture as the visual anchor. Surround it with tables, laptops, whiteboards, crowds, planters, and benches. Include a colorful hillside neighborhood in the background with mountains, palm trees, power lines, and exactly 2 red cable cars crossing the sky; also add exactly 1 small drone flying overhead. On the upper right building, place a large brand sign reading {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} and a green billboard that says "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER". Populate the lower and middle foreground with many micro-scenes: a podcast booth labeled "PODCAST ON AIR", a neon "LIVE STREAM" corner, a startup workspace with people using laptops, a hackathon judging table, a founder pitch area, a fintech board with charts, and a coffee stand with espresso equipment and menu boards. Add 6 animal or mascot details across the scene: 1 orange cat lounging near the left worktables, 1 capybara at the lower left, 1 multicolor llama piñata in the lower center-left, 1 yellow rubber duck near the center-bottom, 1 small green robot near the bottom center-right, and 1 tiny turtle near the bottom beside a coin. Also place exactly 4 vehicle elements: 2 green scooters at the lower left, 1 decorated taco truck at the lower right with the sign "TACOS AL PASTOR", and 1 wheelchair user moving through the crowd. Include extra props that reinforce tech culture: whiteboards with sticky notes, a board titled "Traction" with an upward graph and bullet points "Users", "Revenue", "Retention", "Love", a board titled "CAP TABLE" with percentage rows, a Bitcoin-style coin on the ground, microphones, cameras, cables, monitors, smartphones, and branded green merchandise. Clothing should be modern casual startup attire with hoodies, jackets, backpacks, jeans, sneakers, and conference badges, featuring a diverse mix of ages and Latin American identities. Use rich greens, teals, oranges, purples, and warm neutrals, with lush plants and vines integrated into architecture. Make every corner busy and discoverable, like a Where's-Waldo-style tech ecosystem celebration, but keep the composition readable and inviting.

items.title: Juventus Cinematic Player Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic luxury sports poster for {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} as a Juventus football star, in a dark cinematic black-and-gold editorial style. Vertical composition, high contrast, moody stadium atmosphere, premium poster design with layered photomontage. The background is a massive waving Juventus flag filling the upper half of the image, black fabric with broad white stripes and a large metallic gold Juventus "J" crest on the right side, topped by exactly 3 gold stars. In front of the flag, place an oversized close-up half-body portrait of the player wearing a classic Juventus home kit, facing slightly left, with wet textured hair, visible neck tattoos, dramatic rim lighting, and the face partially obscured by shadow for a mysterious heroic look. In the foreground, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with a soccer ball at his feet on a floodlit pitch, centered near the bottom, wearing the black-and-white striped Juventus jersey with white shorts, white socks, black boots, gold number 20 on the shorts, gold Adidas details, and the Jeep sponsor logo clearly visible. The stadium should wrap across the lower half with bright white floodlights, dark packed stands, light fog, and subtle smoke near the ground. Use elegant magazine-poster typography integrated into the composition: top left small gold text "JUVENTUS" and "FOUNDED 1897", with exactly 3 gold stars beneath; along the upper left a vertical list of 4 words in white caps: "CLASS", "VISION", "INTELLIGENCE", "WORK RATE"; beneath that a gold handwritten signature and the year split across two lines as "20" and "26"; center-left large serif player name text with the first name smaller and the last name huge, reading "BERNARDO" and "SILVA" in white; below that smaller gold text "JUVENTUS"; lower right exactly 3 gold stars above 3 stacked white words: "TRADITION", "PASSION", "GLORY"; bottom center exactly 3 gold stars above the phrase "THE OLD LADY" and smaller text "SINCE 1897". Color palette limited to black, white, charcoal, and metallic gold. Add subtle rain haze, fabric texture, vignette, glowing highlights on the crest and text, and a polished Champions League poster aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 为尤文图斯足球明星 {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} 创建一张引人注目的豪华体育海报，采用黑暗电影般的黑金编辑风格。垂直构图，高对比度，喜怒无常的体育场氛围，优质海报设计与分层蒙太奇。背景是一面巨大的飘扬的尤文图斯旗帜，占据了图像的上半部分，黑色织物上有宽阔的白色条纹，右侧有一个巨大的金属金色尤文图斯“J”徽章，顶部正好有 3 颗金色星星。在旗帜前面放置一幅超大的球员半身特写肖像，身穿经典的尤文图斯主场球衣，面朝左侧，头发湿漉漉的，有纹理，颈部纹身清晰可见，边缘灯光引人注目，脸部部分被阴影遮住，营造出神秘的英雄形象。在前景中，展示了同一名球员的全身动作姿势，他脚下有一个足球，在泛光灯照明的球场上向前奔跑，中心位置靠近底部，他穿着黑白条纹尤文图斯球衣，白色短裤、白色袜子、黑色靴子，短裤上有金色的数字 20，金色的阿迪达斯细节和吉普车赞助商标志清晰可见。体育场的下半部应该被明亮的白色泛光灯、黑暗的看台、浅雾和地面附近的微妙烟雾所包围。使用优雅的杂志海报排版融入构图：左上角小金色文字“JUVENTUS”和“FOUNDED 1897”，下面正好有 3 个金色星星；左上角有 4 个白色大写字母的垂直列表：“CLASS”、“VISION”、“INTELLIGENCE”、“WORK RATE”；下面有一个金色手写签名，年份分为两行：“20”和“26”；中左大衬线球员姓名文本，名字较小，姓氏较大，白色为“BERNARDO”和“SILVA”；下面是较小的金色文字“JUVENTUS”；右下角正好有 3 个金色星星，上面有 3 个堆叠的白色单词：“TRADITION”、“PASSION”、“GLORY”；底部中心正好有 3 颗金星，位于短语“THE OLD LADY”和较小的文字“SINCE 1897”上方。调色板仅限于黑色、白色、木炭色和金属金色。添加微妙的雨雾、织物纹理、小插图、徽章和文字上的发光亮点以及抛光的冠军联赛海报美感。

items.title: Boca Juniors Welcome Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster in Boca Juniors colors, designed like a polished social media graphic. Show a half-body portrait of {argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"} wearing the modern Boca Juniors home jersey, dark royal blue with a wide gold chest band, gold shoulder stripes, Adidas logo on the right chest, CABJ crest on the left chest, and “betsson” sponsor across the yellow band. The player is centered slightly to the right, cropped from upper torso to top of head, with short dark hair and athletic build, turning his head slightly to his left while pointing with his right index finger directly at the club crest on his chest. Do not show facial details clearly; keep the face obscured or out of focus. Use a deep blue textured stadium-themed background with glowing highlights and subtle grunge overlays. In the lower left background, include La Bombonera stadium facade with visible signage reading “LA BOMBONERA” and “CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS.” Add small floating gold confetti particles throughout the scene for celebratory energy. Place a large CABJ shield logo in the upper right. Typography must be bold and poster-like: at the top left in small gold uppercase text, “BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”; below it a small gold star; then a huge stacked headline on the left with “BIENVENIDO” in tall white condensed uppercase and “DYBALA” in oversized gold condensed uppercase. Below the name, add smaller white uppercase text reading “PAULO DYBALA,” flanked by thin gold lines and a small gold star. At the bottom, place a thin gold horizontal line across the width and centered gold uppercase text reading “| JUGADOR DE BOCA |” with a gold star beneath it. Use high contrast, glossy sports-poster lighting, rich navy and gold color grading, sharp fabric detail, and an elite club announcement aesthetic.

items.titleZh: Create a cinematic sports advertising poster featuring a giant close-up running shoe in motion splashing through shallow water on a wet city street at sunset. The composition is a low-angle, ultra-dynamic action shot with 1 primary shoe dominating the right half of the frame and 1 secondary blurred shoe visible behind it, implying a runner mid-stride. The hero sneaker is a white and gray knit performance shoe with a black side swoosh-style logo, gray laces, small red lace-loop accents, a thick translucent cushioned sole, and a bright orange-red outsole glow along the bottom edge. Show the shoe covered in realistic water droplets and sharp texture detail, with explosive splash particles frozen around the sole. The runner wears dark athletic leggings, visible only from the lower legs down. Use intense contrast between cool blue-gray shadows and fiery orange highlights, with glossy reflections on the rain-soaked pavement. items.titleZh:
{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. 
Act as a high-end sports graphic designer creating a conceptual tribute poster. The style is a complex "dual exposure photo-grid composite" with mixed-media textures.
CENTRAL STRUCTURE (THE VESSEL):
The central focus is a large-scale, high-contrast black and white portrait silhouette of {argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. This main portrait acts as the container.
THE GRID FILL & TEXTURES (MIXED MEDIA):

items.title: Anime Heroine Promo Poster
items.titleZh:
A polished anime-style vertical key visual poster for a futuristic fantasy action series. Center the composition on a full-body young heroine in a confident three-quarter back pose, looking over her shoulder, with her face partially obscured by angle and hair. She has long flowing silver-white hair blowing dramatically in the wind, pale skin, and cool violet accents. Her outfit is a sleek black, white, and purple combat uniform: black cropped jacket with white hood and cape-like layered back panels, fitted bodice, short pleated skirt, utility belt and straps, black gloves, thigh strap on one leg, and subtle star-emblem details. In her right hand she holds a large angular sci-fi sword with glowing purple energy lines. The background is a bright blue daytime sky with soft clouds, several white birds, and an elegant white city of tall cathedral-like spires and bridges, creating a grand utopian futuristic kingdom atmosphere. Use strong wind effects in the hair, ribbons, coat tails, and fabric. Add smooth linework and smooth coloring, clean anime rendering, high-detail cel shading, crisp lighting, glossy highlights, and a premium game-promo illustration finish.

Design it as a complete Japanese promotional poster layout. On the upper left, place a large bold vertical headline in Japanese reading "未来を、自分の手で。" with the middle phrase in purple and the rest in black, over a pale decorative emblem. Beneath it, add a short Japanese blurb in smaller text. On the right side, place a tall dark vertical sidebar with white Japanese text reading "信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。". On the lower left, include 3 tilted rectangular inset images stacked diagonally: 1 close-up portrait of the heroine's face, 1 action shot of her fighting with the glowing sword, and 1 wide cityscape view. Below those in a dark character info panel, show the character name "ルシア" with the romanized name "Lucia" and a small emblem, followed by 7 profile lines in Japanese: "CV：悠木 碧", "年齢：17歳", "所属：黎明騎士団（不屈の翼）", "武器：双刃剣（レプリカント）", "誕生日：4月12日", "身長：165cm", "好きなもの：静かな場所、星空", and a final dislike line. At the bottom center, place the large series logo text "黎明のリベリオン" with the English subtitle "REIMEI NO REBELLION" beneath it, and below that the release line "2025年、始動。". Color palette: white, black, deep indigo, electric violet, and sky blue. Overall mood: heroic, elegant, aspirational, premium anime game or light novel promotional poster.

items.title: Split-Screen Athleisure Couch Ad
items.titleZh: Create a clean, square split-screen commercial image for athleisure clothing with polished ad photography and realistic typography. At the top across the full width, place a large bold all-caps white headline in a heavy sans-serif font: {argument name="headline text" default="BOUGHT FOR THE GYM. USED FOR THE COUCH."} The layout is divided vertically into 2 equal panels. In the left panel, show a neatly arranged flat lay of 5 apparel items on a smooth light gray studio background with soft directional lighting and subtle shadows: 1 black hoodie with drawstrings and a small white swoosh-style chest logo, 1 pair of black athletic shorts with a small white logo near the hem, 1 pair of white crew socks with black swoosh-style logos, and 1 pair of black running shoes with white midsoles and white swoosh-style side logos. The clothing should look premium, minimal, and carefully styled like an e-commerce campaign. In the right panel, show a young man wearing the same black hoodie, black shorts, white crew socks, and black running shoes, slouched lazily on a dark charcoal fabric couch in a dim cozy living room, holding a smartphone and looking relaxed and unmotivated. In front of him on a dark coffee table are 6 visible lounge items: 1 open pizza box with a pizza, 1 red soda can, 1 large red bag of nacho cheese tortilla chips, 1 TV remote, 1 blue bowl of chips, and 1 pink-frosted sprinkled donut partly visible at the bottom edge. Add a draped gray blanket on the couch and keep the mood humorous and relatable. At the bottom center, overlay a smaller white caption in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline text" default="Still worth it."} High-end product advertising aesthetic, crisp text rendering, brand-aware lifestyle marketing, realistic materials, balanced composition, subtle contrast between aspirational fitness purchase and actual couch use.

items.title: Bold KFC Food Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A bold square fast-food advertisement poster in a clean studio setup, designed like a premium KFC campaign. The composition is perfectly centered with a white background panel in the middle and solid bright red vertical side panels on both the left and right. At the very top, place 3 short red vertical stripes spaced evenly across the upper margin, referencing the KFC brand motif. Under them, add a large stacked headline in heavy bold sans-serif uppercase text: “THIS IS NOT A FILTER.” in black, followed directly below by “IT’S JUST KFC.” in bright red. In the center foreground, show a young man with short dark curly hair wearing a dark red crew-neck shirt, leaning forward behind a large bucket of fried chicken as if smelling the food; only his hair, ears, shoulders, and upper torso are visible, and his face is obscured by a rectangular blur block. The bucket is oversized and centered on a white tabletop, filled with 6 visible pieces of golden crispy fried chicken with textured crunchy breading, with light steam rising from the chicken. The bucket is white with red side panels and a black KFC-style logo on the front, with the face area obscured by a metallic gray blur block. On the left side of the table, place 1 red-and-white striped fries carton filled with golden French fries, with a few extra fries scattered on the tabletop in front; the carton also has the KFC-style logo with its face area obscured. On the right side, place 1 tall transparent glass of dark cola packed with ice, condensation visible on the outside, branded with the KFC-style logo with the face area obscured. In front of the drink, place 1 small white dipping bowl filled with glossy red ketchup. At the bottom center, add the tagline in bold black sans-serif: “Crispy. Juicy. Irresistible.” and beneath it a small cursive signature-style line reading “Col. Harland Sanders.” with a small rectangular red accent below. items.title: Censored Studio Portrait
items.titleZh: A centered studio portrait photo of a single adult man from upper chest to top of head, facing straight toward the camera against a smooth deep navy-blue backdrop. He has a very closely shaved buzz cut, visible ears on both sides, medium tan skin, and short dark facial hair concentrated along the chin and jawline with a faint mustache. Dress him in a plain off-white or cream crewneck sweatshirt with no logo. Use soft professional studio lighting with gentle highlights on the scalp, ears, neck, and sweatshirt, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, and a clean photographic look. Compose it symmetrically with the head near the top of frame and broad shoulders filling the lower half, in a vertical portrait orientation. Overlay 1 large opaque rectangular censor block centered over the face, covering from forehead to below the nose area and spanning most of the facial width; make the block a flat muted brown tone with slightly soft edges so the facial features are completely hidden.

items.title: Retro Fast-Food Brand Board
items.titleZh: Using REFERENCE_0 as the hero food photo, transform it into a polished one-page restaurant branding board for a fried chicken and waffle-fries concept named {argument name="brand name" default="Can Dende"}. Keep the yellow-table food photography as the visual anchor, but redesign the output as a clean square brand guideline sheet on a warm off-white background with a cheerful, retro, hand-drawn fast-casual identity. Add a large logo area in the upper left with bold vintage red lettering, a small illustrated fried-food mascot above it, and the tagline “FRIED CHICKEN & RUFFLES”. Build the page as a structured multi-panel layout with 9 sections: 1) logo/hero area, 2) brand story text block, 3) top-right hero photo crop from the reference, 4) color palette showing exactly 5 swatches with hex labels, 5) typography section with a large display sample of the brand name plus 3 text styles labeled header, subhead, and body, 6) patterns and textures section with exactly 4 playful assets: a yellow wavy stripe pattern, a red checker pattern, a handwritten phrase, and a small doodle heart, 7) iconography section with exactly 5 simple icons: chicken, bottle, fries, smiley face, and heart, 8) photography style section with a 2x2 grid of exactly 4 food-photo crops derived from the reference and matching close-up shots, plus a short bullet list of photography guidelines, and 9) brand applications section with exactly 5 mockups labeled signage, takeout packaging, menu design, social media, and staff apparel. Include a circular badge near the hero photo that says {argument name="badge text" default="CRISPY GOOD MOOD"}. Use the palette {argument name="primary palette" default="yellow, tomato red, deep navy, leaf green, soft pink"}. items.title: Spicy Nacho Tornado Ad
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic square commercial poster for a spicy snack brand, with a fiery red storm atmosphere and high-energy food advertising style. The background is a dark crimson sky filled with glowing clouds, scattered sparks, and visible lightning bolts. In the center, a giant tornado made of swirling transparent wind rings, glossy whole red chili peppers, square corn chips, crumbs, and seasoning particles rises upward from an opened snack bag, forming a powerful vortex. The tornado should feel dynamic and explosive, with chips and chili peppers flying outward in different sizes and depths for a cinematic 3D look. At the bottom center, place a glossy red snack packet standing upright, labeled with the brand logo and product name {argument name="product name" default="Crispy Nachos Chips"}, with a spicy flavor badge reading {argument name="flavor text" default="Spicy Masala"}, a small chili illustration, a corn note near the bottom, and a printed image of square nacho chips on the front. Put a stylized playful logo at the top left reading {argument name="brand name" default="SnaX"} in bold yellow and white script with a red outline, and a clean white platform watermark at the top right reading {argument name="platform text" default="Pollo.ai"}. On the left side, add a huge stacked distressed headline in bold condensed uppercase, with the first word in golden yellow and the remaining three lines in white, reading exactly: {argument name="headline text" default="WARNING! CRUNCH STORM INCOMING"}. Use intense rim lighting, glossy highlights, deep shadows, rich red-orange color grading, and a premium snack advertisement composition that feels spicy, crunchy, chaotic, and irresistible.
items.promptZh: 为某麻辣零食品牌打造戏剧性的方形商业海报，火红风暴氛围，高能食品广告风格。背景是深红色的天空，充满了发光的云彩、分散的火花和可见的闪电。中心，一个由旋转的透明风环、光滑的整颗红辣椒、方形玉米片、面包屑和调味料颗粒组成的巨大龙卷风从打开的零食袋中向上升起，形成强大的漩涡。龙卷风应该给人一种动态和爆炸性的感觉，碎片和辣椒以不同的大小和深度向外飞舞，营造出电影般的 3D 外观。在底部中心，直立放置一个光滑的红色零食包，贴上品牌徽标和产品名称 {argument name="product name" default="Crispy Nachos Chips"} 的标签，并贴上辛辣口味徽章，上面写着 {argument name="flavor text" default="Spicy Masala"}、一个小辣椒插图、靠近底部的玉米音符以及正面印有方形玉米片的图像。在左上角放置一个风格化的俏皮徽标，内容为{argument name="brand name" default="SnaX"}，采用粗体黄色和白色脚本，带有红色轮廓，并在右上角放置一个干净的白色平台水印，内容为{argument name="platform text" default="Pollo.ai"}。在左侧，添加一个巨大的堆叠式粗体大写标题，第一个单词为金黄色，其余三行为白色，准确阅读：{argument name =“headline text”default =“WARNING！CRUNCH STORM INCOMING”}。使用强烈的边缘照明、光泽高光、深阴影、丰富的红橙色渐变以及令人感觉辛辣、松脆、混乱和不可抗拒的优质零食广告构图。

items.title: UFC-Style Women's Fight Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic UFC fight-poster style sports promotion for {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"}, designed as a high-contrast vertical matchup graphic with two female MMA fighters facing inward in orthodox guard poses. The left fighter is a fit blonde woman with shoulder-length messy beach-wave hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly right. The right fighter is a fit dark-haired woman with long straight black hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly left, with a large detailed black-and-gray tattoo sleeve on her right arm and script tattoo text on the inner upper arm. Both fighters are sweaty, intensely lit, and centered close together with fists raised near chest height. Use a split background: fiery orange sparks and smoke on the left, icy blue-white sparks and haze on the right, with a dark black center seam. At the top center, place a black rectangular logo box with gold trim containing the gold text {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}. Beneath it, in stacked condensed white uppercase type, add the tagline: "TWO ICONS. ONE OCTAGON." Along the far left edge, place the surname "SWEENEY" vertically in large distressed gold letters; along the far right edge, place the surname "FOXX" vertically in large distressed silver-gray letters. In the center, overlay huge distressed white condensed sans-serif typography with the matchup names stacked exactly as {argument name="left fighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} above a small gold "VS" and {argument name="right fighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"}. Below that, add a small gold subtitle reading "BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT". At the bottom center, show a small realistic UFC octagon cage seen from a slightly elevated front angle, embedded into the poster. In front of the cage, place a black date card with gold trim containing stacked gold text: "JUNE 14", "SATURDAY", "10PM ET / 7PM PT". Below the card, add white text "LIVE ON" and the ESPN+ logo. Bottom left, add small gold and white ticket text reading "TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25" with the Ticketmaster logo beneath. Bottom right, add the Rogers Arena logo and white text "ROGERS ARENA" with gold text "VANCOUVER, BC" below. Use a glossy premium combat-sports poster finish, cinematic rim lighting, gritty texture overlays, metallic typography, and intense face-off composition.
items.promptZh: 针对 {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"} 的引人注目的 UFC 格斗海报风格体育宣传，设计为高对比度垂直对决图形，其中两名女性 MMA 选手面朝内，摆出正统的后卫姿势。左边的拳击手是一位身材健美的金发女性，留着齐肩凌乱的海滩波浪发，棕褐色的皮肤，黑色运动胸罩，黑色 UFC 手套，穿着黑色拳击短裤，从大腿上部到头部，稍微向右转。右边的战士是一位身材匀称的黑发女性，黑色长直发，棕褐色皮肤，黑色运动胸罩，黑色UFC手套，黑色战斗短裤，从大腿上部到头部，稍微向左转，右臂上有一个大而细致的黑灰色纹身袖，上臂内侧有文字纹身文字。两名拳手都大汗淋漓，光线强烈，并紧靠在一起，拳头举到接近胸部的高度。使用分割背景：左边是火热的橙色火花和烟雾，右边是冰冷的蓝白色火花和薄雾，中间有深黑色接缝。在顶部中心，放置一个带有金色镶边的黑色矩形徽标框，其中包含金色文本 {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}。在其下方，以堆叠的浓缩白色大写字体添加标语：“两个图标。一个八角形。”沿着最左边缘，垂直放置姓氏“SWEENEY”，以大号仿旧金色字母书写；沿着最右边缘，用大号仿旧银灰色字母垂直放置姓氏“FOXX”。在中心，覆盖巨大的仿旧白色压缩无衬线字体，其中对战名称完全按照 {argument name="leftfighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} 堆叠在小金色“VS”和 {argument name="rightfighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"} 上方。在其下方添加一个金色小标题，上面写着“BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT”。在底部中心，展示了一个小型的现实 UFC 八角形笼子，从稍微升高的前角看到，嵌入到海报中。在笼子前面放置一张带有金色镶边的黑色日期卡，其中包含堆叠的金色文字：“6 月 14 日”、“星期六”、“东部时间晚上 10 点/太平洋时间晚上 7 点”。在卡片下方添加白色文字“LIVE ON”和 ESPN+ 徽标。左下角添加金色和白色的小票文字，上面写着“TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25”，下方带有 Ticketmaster 徽标。右下角添加罗杰斯竞技场徽标和白色文字“ROGERS ARENA”，下方添加金色文字“VANCOUVER, BC”。使用光滑的优质格斗运动海报表面、电影边缘照明、坚韧的纹理覆盖、金属版式和激烈的对峙构图。

items.title: Chaotic Shonen Manga Cover
items.titleZh: A hyper-energetic Japanese shonen manga magazine cover illustration, packed edge to edge with explosive pop-art chaos and bright candy colors, in the style of a weekly comic anthology cover. The main focus is a trendy gyaru teenage girl at the center, leaning toward the viewer in a dynamic foreshortened pose, grinning widely with her mouth open and pointing directly at the camera with one hand while holding a pink toy hammer over her shoulder with the other. items.title: Summer McCafé Mountain Road Ad
items.titleZh: Create a premium vertical fast-food lifestyle advertisement in a polished commercial photography style, designed like a summer campaign poster for McDonald's and McCafé. Show a glamorous young woman with softly blurred, unidentifiable facial features sitting confidently on the hood of a sleek red sports car parked on a winding mountain road at golden hour. She has long wavy auburn hair glowing in warm sunset backlight, wears a dark green satin bomber jacket with gold detailing, a white camisole, high-waisted burgundy pants, and black ankle boots with heels. Her pose is relaxed and stylish, one leg bent and one extended forward, while she holds out a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw and visible McDonald's golden arches branding toward the camera. Scatter red roses across the car hood around her, and place 1 McDonald's paper takeout bag on the right side of the hood. Use a dramatic canyon or hillside background with warm sunlight, soft haze, cinematic depth of field, and a luxurious aspirational road-trip mood. Include floating red flower petals in the air. Compose the layout as a high-end ad with the model centered slightly right and large promotional typography on the left. Add exactly 3 large headline lines in the upper left: "SIP.", "SAVOR.", and "{argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER."}" with the first 2 in bold white and the third in bold golden yellow. Below that, add the subheadline: "Refresh your drive with McCafé." with "McCafé" highlighted in yellow. Add exactly 3 circular feature icons stacked vertically on the left with short captions: "PREMIUM McCAFÉ ICED COFFEE", "WORLD FAMOUS FRIES", and "QUALITY YOU CAN TASTE". Place the McDonald's golden arches logo with the text "i'm lovin' it" in the top right. Add a small lower-left tagline reading "Good days start here." with "start here." in yellow. Create a bold yellow bottom banner spanning the width, divided into 3 content areas: left area reads "SUMMER SAVINGS" and "ENJOY EXCLUSIVE OFFERS"; center area includes a McDonald's app icon and the text "DOWNLOAD THE APP FOR DEALS NEAR YOU"; right area reads "FOLLOW US @MCDONALDS" with social icons. Use brand-accurate red and yellow accents, glossy product styling, realistic lighting, sharp editorial retouching, shallow depth of field, luxury commercial ad composition, and mobile-first poster proportions.
items.promptZh: 以精美的商业摄影风格制作优质垂直快餐生活方式广告，设计类似于麦当劳和麦咖啡的夏季活动海报。展示一位迷人的年轻女子，她的面部特征柔和模糊，无法辨认，她自信地坐在一辆时尚红色跑车​​的引擎盖上，停在黄金时段的蜿蜒山路上。她有一头长长的赤褐色波浪发，在温暖的夕阳背光下闪闪发光，穿着带有金色细节的深绿色缎面飞行员夹克、白色吊带背心、高腰酒红色裤子和黑色高跟踝靴。她的姿势轻松而时尚，一条腿弯曲，一条腿向前伸展，她拿着一杯透明的塑料冰咖啡，里面插着一根吸管，在镜头前可以看到麦当劳的金色拱门。将红玫瑰撒在她周围的汽车引擎盖上，并将 1 个麦当劳纸质外卖袋放在引擎盖右侧。使用引人注目的峡谷或山坡背景，搭配温暖的阳光、柔和的薄雾、电影般的景深和奢华的公路旅行氛围。包括漂浮在空中的红色花瓣。将布局构建为高端广告，模型稍微居中于右侧，大型促销字体位于左侧。在左上角添加 3 个大标题行：“SIP.”、“SAVOR.”和“{argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER."}”，前 2 行为粗体白色，第三行为粗体金黄色。在其下方添加副标题：“用 McCafé 刷新您的驾驶体验。” “McCafé”以黄色突出显示。添加正好 3 个圆形功能图标，垂直堆叠在左侧，并带有简短标题：“优质麦咖啡冰咖啡”、“世界著名薯条”和“您可以品尝的品质”。将麦当劳的金色拱门标志与文字“i'm lovin' it”放在右上角。在左下角添加一个小标语：“美好的日子从这里开始”。与“从这里开始”。黄色。创建一个横跨宽度的大胆黄色底部横幅，分为 3 个内容区域：左侧区域写着“SUMMER SAVINGS”和“ENJOY EXCLUSIVE OFFERS”；中心区域包括麦当劳应用程序图标和文字“下载应用程序以获取您附近的优惠”；右侧区域写着“关注我们@MCDONALDS”和社交图标。使用品牌准确的红色和黄色口音、光泽的产品造型、逼真的灯光、锐利的编辑修饰、浅景深、豪华的商业广告构图和移动优先的海报比例。

items.title: JoJo-Style OpenAI Stand Poster
items.titleZh: A highly detailed anime illustration in the style of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, presented as a dramatic vintage manga character sheet poster for {argument name="character name" default="OpenAI"} personified as a glamorous female stand master. The layout is a single page with 6 distinct sections framed by ornate art nouveau borders and manga panel lines. Main section on the left: a full-body fashion portrait of the character in a confident contrapposto pose, wearing a tailored white suit with emerald green and black accents, gold trim, a long cape lined in teal, fitted vest, corset-like torso panel, high-waisted pants, heeled shoes, gloves, chain accessories, circular hair ornaments, earrings, and multiple OpenAI logo emblems integrated into the outfit. The belt buckle reads GPT, the pant leg has vertical text reading “SAFETY ★ ALIGNMENT ★ BENEFIT,” and the jacket sleeve shows the OpenAI name and logo. Her hair is silver-white, styled in elaborate curled twin buns and long ringlets, with glossy emerald accessories and JoJo-inspired luxury fashion detailing. Top left section: a cream parchment title panel with the OpenAI logo and the large text “OpenAI”, plus 3 text blocks reading “STAND NAME: GPT-∞”, “[dʒi: pi: ti: mu: geni ti]”, and “STAND MASTER: OPENAI”, followed by an italic Spanish quote: “La curiosidad es el prompt, el conocimiento es la respuesta, y la humanidad… es el contexto.” Top right section: a close-up portrait panel of the same woman from the shoulders up, turned partly away with one hand raised elegantly, against a dark purple manga background with 4 large stylized purple sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with smaller English translation beneath it: “Mi propósito es extender el potencial de la humanidad.” and “(My purpose is to extend humanity’s potential.)” Center-right section: a stand ability information box titled “STAND ABILITY: [INFINITE CONTEXT]” with Spanish descriptive text beneath: “Permite analizar, conectar y generar conocimiento ilimitado a partir de cualquier información existente.” Lower center-right section: a humanoid robotic stand in a dynamic reaching pose, feminine and sleek, with a glossy black faceplate displaying the OpenAI knot logo, white biomechanical armor, emerald glowing seams, gold accents, and several floating holographic rings and data panels orbiting around it. The rings contain readable words including “DATA”, “CREATIVITY”, “REASONING”, and a distorted futuristic label similar to “RETRIEVAL/AGENT”. The background is cosmic and starry with dramatic energy effects. Bottom right section: a smaller rear three-quarter portrait panel of the woman looking over her shoulder with a confident smile and one finger near her chin, again over a purple manga background with 3 large stylized sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with two lines: “¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES?” and “MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN.” Bottom left section: a circular JoJo-style stat chart with 6 labeled attributes in Spanish, showing “POTENCIAL ∞”, “VELOCIDAD A”, “ALCANCE ∞”, “DURABILIDAD B”, “PRECISIÓN A”, and “POTENCIA A”. UU.)” and “Misión: Asegurar que la inteligencia artificial general beneficie a toda la humanidad.” Use a richly inked manga print aesthetic, detailed crosshatching, cel shading, aged paper texture, elegant cream margins, deep emerald, ivory, black, and gold palette, exaggerated JoJo fashion anatomy, sharp linework, dramatic comic-book composition, and luxurious supernatural sci-fi energy.
items.promptZh: 《JoJo 的奇妙冒险》风格的高度详细的动画插图，以戏剧性的复古漫画角色表海报的形式呈现，为{argument name="character name" default="OpenAI"} 拟人化为迷人的女性站长。布局是一个单页，有 6 个不同的部分，由华丽的新艺术风格边框和漫画面板线条构成。左侧主要部分：角色的全身时尚肖像，摆出自信的逆姿势，穿着定制的白色西装，带有翠绿和黑色的口音，金色镶边，青色衬里的长斗篷，合身的背心，紧身胸衣般的躯干面板，高腰裤，高跟鞋，手套，链条配件，圆形发饰，耳环，以及融入服装的多个 OpenAI 标志徽章。皮带扣上写着 GPT，裤腿上有竖排文字“SAFETY ★ ALIGNMENT ★ BENEFIT”，夹克袖子上有 OpenAI 名称和徽标。她的头发是银白色的，梳着精致的卷发双发髻和长卷发，搭配闪亮的祖母绿配饰和 JoJo 风格的奢华时尚细节。左上部分：奶油色羊皮纸标题面板，带有 OpenAI 徽标和大文本“OpenAI”，外加 3 个文本块，内容为“STAND NAME: GPT-∞”、“[dʒi: pi: ti: mu: geni ti]”和“STAND MASTER: OPENAI”，后面是斜体西班牙语引言：“La curiosidad es el prompt, el conocimiento es la respuesta, y la Humanidad……es el contexto。”右上部分：同一个女人从肩膀以上的特写肖像面板，优雅地举起一只手，部分转身，背景是深紫色漫画背景，有 4 个大型风格化紫色音效符号。添加一个西班牙语气泡，其下方带有较小的英文翻译：“Mi propósito es Extender el potencial de la humanidad”。和“（我的目的是扩展人类的潜力。）”中右部分：一个标题为“站立能力：[无限上下文]”的站立能力信息框，下方有西班牙语描述性文字：“Permite analizar，conectar y generico ilimitado apartir de cualquier informaciónexistente。”下中右部分：一个人形机器人支架，摆出动态的伸展姿势，女性化且时尚，有光泽的黑色面板，显示 OpenAI 结标志，白色生物机械装甲，祖母绿发光接缝，金色装饰，以及几个围绕其旋转的浮动全息环和数据面板。这些环包含可读的单词，包括“数据”、“创造力”、“推理”，以及一个类似于“检索/代理”的扭曲的未来标签。背景是宇宙和星空，具有戏剧性的能量效果。右下部分：一个较小的后四分之三肖像面板，女人回头看去，脸上带着自信的微笑，一根手指靠近下巴，同样是在紫色漫画背景上，有 3 个大型风格化音效字形。添加包含两行的西班牙语气泡：“¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES？”和“MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN”。左下部分：圆形 JoJo 风格统计图表，带有 6 个西班牙语标记属性，显示“POTENCIAL ∞”、“VELOCIDAD A”、“ALCANCE ∞”、“DURABILIDAD B”、“PRECISIÓN A”和“POTENCIA A”。在它下面，包括一个名为“OPENAI”的小奶油传记框，上面写着西班牙语：“Fundada：2015（旧金山，EE.UU。）”和“Misión：Aseguar que la inteligencia Artificial General beneficie a toda la humanidad”。使用丰富的墨迹漫画印刷美学、细致的交叉影线、卡通渲染、做旧的纸张纹理、优雅的奶油色边缘、深翠绿、象牙色、黑色和金色调色板、夸张的 JoJo 时尚解剖结构、锐利的线条、戏剧性的漫画书构图和奢华的超自然科幻能量。

items.title: Luxury Leather Fashion Collage Ad
items.titleZh: A high-fashion luxury editorial advertisement in a vertical format, featuring a mysterious female model from mid-torso up, centered and slightly turned to the side, wearing an oversized dark olive leather jacket with a high collar and prominent buckle strap detail near the neck. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur, while her dark wavy shoulder-length hair remains visible and voluminous. She carries a slouchy black leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap and a small gold logo near the bottom corner. Place the large serif brand name {argument name="brand text" default="LOEWE"} across the center in elegant white uppercase letters, overlaying the figure. Build the entire composition as a tactile collage made of torn and layered fabric and leather swatches: exactly 8 visible material fragments surrounding and partially overlapping the subject, including beige linen at the top left, olive stitched leather panels on the left, soft beige fabric at the lower left edge, dark brown embossed leather with a monogram motif at the upper right, rocky coastline photography at the right and lower right, a textured taupe stitched textile across the lower center, a dark denim-like fragment at the lower left, and a deep brown leather panel at the bottom right. In the background, reveal a dramatic coastal landscape with rocks, ocean waves, and a moody cloudy sky lit like late afternoon or sunset. Use rich earthy tones, muted olive, dark brown, taupe, black, and warm highlights. The overall look should feel premium, cinematic, moody, artisanal, and minimalist, like a luxury fashion campaign combining leather craftsmanship, collage art direction, and editorial photography.

items.titleZh: A bright, cheerful summer co-branded beverage poster in a clean Chinese commercial advertising style, showing a collaboration between {argument name="brand one" default="蜜雪冰城"} and {argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"}. Vertical poster layout with a soft blue sky background, sunlit greenery, and an outdoor cafe atmosphere. At the top, place both brand logos side by side with a large bold Chinese headline in playful hand-drawn display lettering: {argument name="headline text" default="雪王遇见星朋友"}. Beneath it, add a green ribbon banner with Chinese subheadline text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="米雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}, and a smaller line reading "甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍". Include 2 circular stamp-style graphics: one on the left reading "联名限定", and one on the upper right like a postmark with Chinese text around a small drink icon. In the center foreground on a wooden outdoor table, display 2 iced drinks: on the left, a tall clear cup of vivid green matcha slush topped with a tall swirl of vanilla soft serve and green matcha drizzle, with visible ice texture and a cute snowman mascot logo on the cup; on the right, a tall clear Starbucks-style iced latte with milk and green matcha swirls at the bottom, topped with whipped cream and dark cookie crumbs, with the green siren logo on the cup. In front of the drinks, place 1 cute white snowman mascot figurine with a tiny crown, round body, rosy cheeks, red cape, and a happy wink, sitting and holding a small takeaway coffee cup. Add 2 vertical product name tags beside the drinks: left tag "雪顶抹茶星冰乐", right tag "抹茶雪王奥利奥". On the right midground, place 1 small black chalkboard sign on a wooden easel reading "ICE CREAM & COFFEE" with chalk drawings of an ice cream cone and a takeaway cup. In the lower left, create a torn-paper price block showing a combo offer with large red numbers "¥19.9", green supporting text, and a small green badge reading "立省 ¥6". In the lower center-right, add a "联名周边" area displaying exactly 4 merchandise items: 1 cup sleeve, 1 character keychain or acrylic charm, 1 round badge, and 1 small sticker or token, all using the snowman mascot and coffee collaboration theme. Use warm sunlight, glossy drink photography, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh trees, high contrast product retouching, crisp packaging details, and an upbeat youthful retail-promo aesthetic. Include scattered doodle hearts and playful decorative accents around the typography. Keep all visible text in Chinese except the Starbucks wordmark and the chalkboard text.

Beneath it, add a green ribbon banner with Chinese subheadline text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="米雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}, and a smaller line reading "甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍". In the center foreground on a wooden outdoor table, display 2 iced drinks: on the left, a tall clear cup of vivid green matcha slush topped with a tall swirl of vanilla soft serve and green matcha drizzle, with visible ice texture and a cute snowman mascot logo on the cup; on the right, a tall clear Starbucks-style iced latte with milk and green matcha swirls at the bottom, topped with whipped cream and dark cookie crumbs, with the green siren logo on the cup. items.title: Futuristic Secure-IP Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A futuristic luxury skincare-style advertising poster in a pale icy blue monochrome palette, designed like a high-end tech-beauty campaign. The composition is vertical and airy with soft glowing light, misty gradients, translucent particle effects, and a clean editorial layout. On the left side, a young woman in a flowing white sleeveless dress is shown from the shoulders up in side profile, head tilted back as if inhaling fresh air, with dark windswept hair streaming outward. Her face is obscured by a plain square censor block. Fine luminous network lines and sparkling dots flow from her neck and chest toward the right, suggesting digital cleansing and connectivity. On the right side, a tall matte-white spray bottle floats upright, labeled "SECURE-IP" and "IP ADDRESS CLEANSER," with smaller product copy beneath and a subtle premium cosmetic finish. Behind and around the bottle, branching translucent stems rise like biotech coral or neural fibers, each ending in clear glowing bubbles; several bubbles contain faint tech text such as "DATA PACKET," while nearby micro labels identify features including "OXYGEN FLOW," "DATA PACKETS," "SECURE ROUTING," "RISK FILTER," "PRIVATE CLEAN," and "CONNECTION PURE." In the upper left, small brand text reads "IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY." A large bold uppercase headline dominates the left-center: "{argument name="headline text" default="BREATHE SECURE. GLOW FREE."}" with a smaller subheading below reading "for risk-free connections." Along the bottom is a row of 4 minimalist icon-and-text feature blocks, evenly spaced: 1) shield icon with the heading "CLEANSE YOUR IP" and short supporting copy, 2) wifi icon with the heading "SECURE CONNECTIONS" and short supporting copy, 3) leaf icon with the heading "BREATHE FREELY" and short supporting copy, 4) share/network icon with the heading "GLOW CONFIDENTLY" and short supporting copy. At the lower right, add a paragraph of marketing copy about constant connection and digital cleansing, ending with the tagline "BREATHE. CONNECT. GLOW." At the lower left, include a circular IP logo and the brand line "SECURE-IP" with a small subtitle like "OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE." Overall style: surreal product advertising, premium editorial poster, clean sans-serif typography, soft bloom, translucent glass spheres, elegant sci-fi wellness branding, ultra-detailed, polished, magazine-quality layout.
items.promptZh: 未来派奢华护肤风格广告海报，采用淡冰蓝色单色调色板，设计得像一场高端科技美容活动。该构图是垂直且通风的，具有柔和的发光光线、朦胧的渐变、半透明的粒子效果和干净的编辑布局。左侧，一位身着飘逸白色无袖连衣裙的年轻女子从肩部向上侧视，头向后仰，仿佛在呼吸新鲜空气，深色的头发随风飘逸。她的脸被一个普通的方形检查块遮住了。精细的发光网络线和闪闪发光的点从她的颈部和胸部向右流动，暗示着数字清洁和连接。在右侧，一个高大的哑光白色喷雾瓶直立漂浮，标有“SECURE-IP”和“IP ADDRESS CLEANSER”，下面有较小的产品副本和微妙的高级化妆品表面。在瓶子的后面和周围，分枝的半透明茎像生物技术珊瑚或神经纤维一样升起，每根茎的末端都是透明的发光气泡；几个气泡包含微弱的技术文本，例如“数据包”，而附近的微型标签标识包括“氧气流”、“数据包”、“安全路由”、“风险过滤器”、“私人清洁”和“纯粹连接”等功能。在左上角，小品牌文字写着“IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY”。一个大的粗体大写标题占据了左中心：“{argument name =“headline text”default =“BREATHE SECURE”。 GLOW FREE。"}"，下面有一个较小的副标题，内容为“无风险连接”。底部是一排 4 个简约的图标和文本功能块，均匀分布：1) 盾牌图​​标，标题为“清理您的 IP”和简短的支持副本；2) wifi 图标，标题为“安全连接”和简短的支持副本；3) 叶子图标，标题为“自由呼吸”和简短的支持副本；4) 共享/网络图标，标题为“自信地发光”和简短的支持副本。在右下角，添加一段关于持续连接和数字清理的营销文案，以口号“呼吸。连接。发光”结尾。在左下角，包括一个圆形 IP 徽标和品牌线“SECURE-IP”，以及一个小副标题，例如“OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE”。整体风格：超现实的产品广告、优质的社论海报、干净的无衬线字体、柔和的花朵、半透明的玻璃球、优雅的科幻健康品牌、超详细、抛光、杂志品质的布局。

items.title: Helicopter Selfie Over Moscow
items.titleZh: A realistic smartphone-style travel photo taken inside a helicopter cabin, showing a seated passenger on the left side of the frame and a sweeping aerial view of Moscow through a large window on the right. The person is wearing a black zip-up athletic jacket with a small white swoosh logo, a seatbelt across the chest, a metallic wristwatch, and large black aviation headphones with a microphone boom. Their face is obscured by a rectangular blur block, and they are giving a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera. The helicopter interior is dark, with black leather seating and beige cabin trim framing the window. Outside the window, capture an overcast daytime panorama of central Moscow from above, with the Kremlin walls and towers clearly visible, the colorful onion domes of Saint Basil's Cathedral in the lower right, a broad cityscape stretching into the distance, and a cluster of modern skyscrapers on the far right horizon. Use natural diffused light, realistic urban detail, mild atmospheric haze, and the candid composition of a tourist selfie shot from a helicopter ride, wide-angle but not distorted.

items.title: Luxury Handbag Sunset Ad
items.titleZh: Luxury fashion advertisement, vertical editorial product ad shot at golden hour on a high-rise balcony overlooking a modern city skyline at sunset. A stylish woman stands in a confident three-quarter pose, framed from mid-thigh up, with her face obscured by a simple rectangular block matching warm brown-orange tones. She has long, softly wavy brunette hair lit by warm backlight from the setting sun. She wears a black tailored blazer over a fitted white scoop-neck ribbed top and high-waisted light beige trousers, with one hand in her pocket and the other holding a structured taupe leather handbag with a top handle, flap closure, polished gold clasp hardware, and a hanging leather tag. The bag is the visual hero and should look premium, elegant, and sharply detailed. Use cinematic warm lighting, soft rim light on the hair, subtle luxury color grading, shallow depth of field, and blurred skyscrapers in the background. Compose the layout like a premium brand campaign with large text and icons on the left side. At top left, place a refined serif monogram logo: {argument name="brand monogram" default="L"}. Below it, large white serif headline text stacked in uppercase: {argument name="headline text" default="CARRY CONFIDENCE. EVERYDAY."}. items.title: Cute Winter Anime Channel Poster
items.titleZh:
A cute pastel anime promotional poster in a dreamy idol-fanclub style, landscape orientation, featuring a single horse-girl character from the waist up on the right side of the composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark chestnut brown"} long fluffy hair with side-swept bangs covering one eye, one large visible sparkling purple-pink eye, fair skin, soft blush, and upright horse ears with a large cream bow tied between them. Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream cable-knit sweater, and a navy sailor-style inner collar with a small red ribbon at the chest. The overall color palette is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown with soft winter lighting.

Design the image as a Japanese fan-content announcement graphic with layered sticker-like typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, sparkles, and snowflake motifs. The background should be a softly blurred cozy winter café or warmly lit indoor scene with glowing bokeh and pale decorative textures. Add exactly 5 major text areas: a pink ribbon banner at the top with the Japanese text "ライスと一緒に"; a very large central-left headline in rounded pop lettering reading "ほのぼの 育成" with "ほのぼの" in pink and white and "育成" in bold brown with white stitched edging; a small dark ribbon under it reading "しよっ♪"; a circular brown badge on the right reading "初見さん歓迎"; and a logo-like label at bottom right reading "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" with a small horseshoe icon. Add exactly 1 memo pad in the bottom-left corner with 3 checklist lines, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー", "チャンミ", and "まったり雑談". Include small decorative pink hearts around the character, tiny accent lines near her head, white snowflakes, lace-like trim, paper-cut corner decorations, and a soft scrapbook aesthetic. Make the whole piece look like an adorable fictional stream or channel thumbnail welcoming new viewers, highly polished, clean anime line art, soft shading, glossy eyes, and charming commercial poster composition.
