items.title: Blockbuster Anime Sky Fantasy Poster
items.titleZh: A breathtaking Japanese anime movie poster in the style of a blockbuster theatrical key visual, ultra-detailed and emotionally grand, with a delicate luminous sky reminiscent of prestige modern anime cinema. The scene shows 2 characters from behind on a flower-covered cliff overlooking a glowing coastal fantasy city at sunset and twilight: a teenage boy in a dark school uniform with a loosened tie and windblown short dark hair stands on the left, and a teenage girl in a long flowing pale dress with very long silver-white hair stands on the right. Both face the horizon in awe. Above them, an enormous celestial sky fills most of the composition, painted with vivid deep blue, indigo, violet, magenta, and gold clouds, a brilliant comet-like meteor streak slashing diagonally from upper center toward the horizon, scattered stars, sparkling particles, and a glowing circular magic-like ring constellation in the upper right sky. The sea and city below shimmer with reflected light, with slender fantasy skyscrapers and towers rising from the coastline and a radiant sunlit gap at the center horizon. Foreground flowers are saturated blue and purple with glowing highlights, and white-pink petals drift through the air. Use dramatic rim light, cinematic backlighting, lens-glow sparkle effects, highly polished anime rendering, crisp linework, atmospheric depth, and a vertical poster composition. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: giant embossed gold headline text across the top reading {argument name="top headline text" default="興行収入100億円突破"}, a gold subheadline block at upper left reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="大ヒット上映中"}, a vertical white tagline on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="あの日、君と見上げた空が、世界を変える。"}, and a very large glowing white-lavender Japanese film title at the bottom center reading {argument name="movie title" default="星屑の約束"}. Beneath the title, add small elegant romanized subtitle text reading {argument name="romanized subtitle" default="Hoshikuzu no Yakusoku"}, plus dense small production credits, cast lines, website text, release-copy lines, and cinema format logos along the bottom edge in authentic Japanese movie-poster layout. Add 2 gold laurel emblems flanking the top headline, one on the left and one on the right. Make it feel like a fictional anime film that earned 10 billion yen at the box office, sweeping, romantic, bittersweet, magical, and destined to make audiences cry.

items.title: Minimal Slot Machine Attribution Ad
items.titleZh: Create a clean minimalist static ad on an off-white light gray studio background with a centered editorial layout. At the top, place a large luxury-fashion-style serif headline in black reading {argument name="headline text" default="Stop gambling with your ad spend."}, with the word "gambling" set in italic serif for emphasis. In the middle, show a vintage metal slot-machine window viewed straight on, slightly weathered and realistic, with 3 vertical reels inside a rectangular steel housing and a lever with a black knob on the right side. The 3 reels must display, from left to right, "$", "$", and "?". Make the rightmost reel background pale pink while the first 2 reels are aged white. Add a hand-drawn neon-pink annotation style over the image: 1 arrow-and-note on the left pointing to the first reel reading {argument name="left annotation" default="your attribution"}, 1 starburst scribble above the pink question-mark reel, 1 arrow from the question-mark reel to a circled note on the right reading {argument name="right annotation" default="actual revenue"}, and 1 large curved arrow in the lower left pointing toward the body copy area. Below the slot machine, center a short sans-serif paragraph in black reading {argument name="body text" default="See which campaigns drive revenue, not just clicks. Connect Meta, Google, and Stripe in 60 seconds."}. At the bottom center, place a simple black analytics-style bar logo icon followed by the bold sans-serif brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Humblytics"}. Use strong text fidelity, polished product-ad composition, soft studio shadows, restrained palette of black, steel gray, off-white, and hot pink, and a modern direct-response ad aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 在灰白色浅灰色工作室背景上创建一个干净简约的静态广告，并采用居中的编辑布局。在顶部，放置一个大型豪华时尚风格的黑色衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="Stop赌博与你的广告支出。"}，并将“赌博”一词设置为斜体衬线以示强调。中间是一个老式金属老虎机窗口，直接观看，略有风化且逼真，矩形钢外壳内有 3 个垂直卷轴，右侧有一个带有黑色旋钮的控制杆。 3 个卷轴必须从左到右显示“$”、“$”和“?”。将最右边的卷轴背景设为淡粉色，而前 2 个卷轴则设为白色。在图像上添加手绘霓虹粉色注释样式：左侧 1 个箭头和注释指向第一个卷轴，读数为 {argument name="left comment" default="your attribution"}，粉红色问号卷轴上方有 1 个星爆涂鸦，1 个箭头从问号卷轴指向右侧的圆圈注释，读数为 {argument name="right comment" default="actual Revenue"}，左下角有 1 个大弯曲箭头指向正文区域。在老虎机下方，居中放置一个黑色的无衬线短段落，内容为：{argument name="body text" default="查看哪些广告系列能带来收入，而不仅仅是点击。在 60 秒内连接 Meta、Google 和 Stripe。"}。在底部中心，放置一个简单的黑色分析风格条形徽标图标，后跟粗体无衬线品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Humblytics"}。使用高保真度的文字、精美的产品广告构图、柔和的工作室阴影、内敛的黑色、钢灰色、灰白色和亮粉色调色板，以及现代的直接响应广告美学。

items.title: Tim Cook MMO Raid Boss Screen
items.titleZh: Create a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading-screen-style illustration with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk in front of the glass cube Apple Store, with the glowing white Apple logo centered on the building facade. In the middle of the plaza stands a giant raid boss version of {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, labeled as "The Architect," wearing a fitted black turtleneck, dark pants, and sneakers, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and posing calmly with the other hand open. His face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-production, like a World of Warcraft raid encounter screen mixed with corporate tech parody. Around him, exactly 20 fantasy raiders in a semicircle battle formation face inward toward the boss, with varied races and silhouettes including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and orc-like and human-like characters. Several are casting bright spells in orange fire, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Include exactly 3 small robotic adds near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with squat industrial bodies and Apple logos on their fronts. Also include 2 active encounter mechanic bubbles: one blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" on the right side of the boss, and one purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" farther right with a humanoid enemy trapped inside. Build the image as a complete raid UI composition. Top left: a large expansion-style title reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP" with subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: a vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing exactly 20 player names in numbered rows from 1 to 20 with colored health bars. Top center: a boss portrait frame with the boss name {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, subtitle "The Architect," and a red health bar at 100%. Top right: a large encounter guide panel titled "ENCOUNTER: {argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"THE ARCHITECT\"" containing exactly 3 phases. Phase 1 title: "SUPPLY CHAIN DOMINANCE (100% – 70%)" with 3 abilities: "Logistics Surge – Summons waves of Supplier Adds.", "Margin Shield – Reduces incoming damage by 40% for 10 sec.", and "Quarterly Pressure – Stacking debuff, explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2 title: "ECOSYSTEM LOCK-IN (70% – 30%)" with 3 abilities: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, puzzle to return.", "Subscription Drain – Raid-wide damage over time.", and "Device Sync – Stack in correct formations to avoid spikes." Phase 3 title: "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)" with 3 abilities: "Surprise Launch – Massive AoE burst every 20 sec.", "Reality Distortion Field – Reverses controls briefly.", and "Enrage: Market Collapse – Boss enrages at 3:00." Bottom right: a "POTENTIAL LOOT" panel listing exactly 4 items with rarity-colored text: "Executive Cloak of Efficiency (Epic)", "Keynote Blade (Epic)", "Ecosystem Ring (Epic)", and "Investor's Favor (Bonus – Hard Mode)." Below that, add a small red-black badge reading "HARD MODE" and the line "Activate \"Investor Call\" during the fight to" with the remaining text cut off or obscured. Bottom left: a "CHAT" box with 4 lines, including taunting boss dialogue and a player response, such as "{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook yells: Innovation. Discipline. Excellence. That is how we win."}", "Tim Cook yells: Our ecosystem is unbreakable.", "Tim Cook yells: One more thing...", and "Lok'tarbrok: Lok'tar ogar!" Along the bottom center: a fantasy action bar with exactly 12 ability icons in ornate slots, some numbered, some showing cooldown text including "2m" and "1m". Use dramatic volumetric lighting, glossy reflections on the wet plaza, realistic environment rendering, highly detailed fantasy characters, exaggerated spell effects, dark vignette, sharp UI typography, and polished AAA game key art composition.

items.title: Neon Rain Snack Bag Ad
items.titleZh: A cinematic commercial product photo of a glossy red snack bag standing upright on a wet city street at night, centered in frame, shot straight-on at eye level with shallow depth of field and dramatic orange neon lighting. The package is covered in realistic water droplets and reflects warm streetlights. The brand name on the bag reads {argument name="brand name" default="CRUNCHY CHIPZ"} in very large bold white bubble letters with a thick dark outline, stacked across two lines in the center. Behind the logo is a jagged yellow-orange comic-style starburst graphic. In the lower right area of the bag, smaller printed flavor text reads {argument name="flavor text" default="ZESTY CHEDDAR"}, with tiny subtext below reading "FLAVORED CORN SNACKS." Near the bottom left edge of the bag, tiny text reads "SAVORY TRIANGLES." Show exactly 3 triangular corn chips total: 2 printed on the front of the bag and 1 real chip placed on the wet pavement in front of the package, leaning slightly back. The chips are orange, heavily seasoned, and textured. The background is a moody urban alley with blurred neon signs and round bokeh lights, all in deep amber, orange, and red tones, with glossy reflections on the rain-soaked ground. Ultra-detailed advertising photography, high contrast, sharp focus on the bag and front chip, premium snack packaging mockup, realistic condensation, rich saturated colors, studio-quality product retouching blended with a rainy street lifestyle setting.

items.titleZh: A dramatic studio product photograph of a standing bag of {argument name="brand name" default="CRUNCHY CHIPZ"} centered on a rough black stone pedestal against a deep black background. The packaging is a glossy dark red metallic snack bag with a large orange-yellow comic-style starburst behind the main logo, bold oversized white block letters with black outline for the brand name, and flavor text on the right reading {argument name="flavor text" default="ZESTY CHEDDAR"} with smaller subtitle text below it. Show exactly 2 triangular orange corn chips printed on the lower front of the bag. Add small fine-print text near the bottom left of the bag reading {argument name="small label" default="SAVORY TRIANGLES"}. Light the scene with intense warm orange side lighting from the upper left, creating strong highlights and glossy reflections on the bag. Surround the product with airborne orange seasoning dust and smoky spice clouds, especially behind the bag and to the left side. Scatter coarse salt crystals and orange-red seasoning powder across the pedestal and foreground surface. The pedestal should be a thick, jagged, matte-black rock slab with sharp fractured edges. Emphasize high contrast, cinematic shadows, crisp product focus, premium commercial advertising style, dramatic food photography, vertical composition, ultra-detailed texture, realistic packaging, and a fiery zesty cheddar mood.

items.titleZh: A bold Korean beverage advertisement poster in a glossy commercial photography style, featuring {argument name="spokesperson" default="Donald Trump lookalike"} in a dark navy business suit, white dress shirt, and vivid blue tie, standing front-facing against a saturated bright-blue sky with a few soft white clouds and a faint modern city skyline including a tall skyscraper resembling the Empire State Building on the right. He is holding a cold plastic bottle of {argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"} dramatically toward the camera in his left hand, with extreme foreshortening so the bottle appears large in the foreground and the person is slightly behind it. The bottle is clear with condensation, a white cap, visible water inside, and a deep blue label reading “POCARI SWEAT” in large white letters with smaller text above saying “ION SUPPLY DRINK.” Add energetic frozen water splashes and droplets around the bottle, hand, and lower foreground to emphasize freshness and hydration. Place the brand logo in the upper left corner: “POCARI SWEAT” in white with the curved underline mark. Across the top, add huge distressed white Korean headline text, slightly angled and filling most of the upper half: {argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? 이걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"}. In the lower right over the suit, add a bold italic quotation in white and blue Korean text: {argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"}. In the bottom left, include exactly 3 circular benefit icons stacked vertically with short Korean labels: a water drop icon with “수분 보충”, a lightning bolt icon with “전해질 보충”, and a running figure icon with “빠른 흡수”. items.title: Korean Rice Drink Parody Ad Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Donald Trump-like older male politician"} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.
items.promptZh:
以温暖的金色飞溅背景和戏剧性的商业灯光打造大胆的韩式饮料广告海报。展示一位{argument name="celebrityspoken" default="唐纳德·特朗普式的老年男性政客"}从胸部以上的角度，穿着海军蓝西装、白色正装衬衫、鲜红色领带，别着美国国旗小翻领别针，面对镜头，露出自信的推销表情。他的脸被肤色的扁平矩形检查块遮挡。他的左手以强制视角靠近镜头，手里拿着一个黄色铝罐，装着韩国大米宾治饮料，上面有韩语醒目标签，顶部和底部有红色条带，罐上有主要产品文字“비락 식혜”和“Since 1993”。该罐还包括较小的韩文副本、底部附近的甜米饮料图像以及体积文字“238 毫升（120 kcal）”。他的右手竖起了大拇指。

采用充满活力的复古商业构图，身后是飞溅的甜米饮料和水滴，泛着金色的亮点，略低角度的英雄取景。在顶部，包括 3 个不同的标题文本组：左上方有一个小的手写式黑色标语，上面写着“전통의 맛，한국의 DRINK！”，一个巨大的中央标题，以粗体韩文字体写着“걸죽는 땐？”深棕黑色和“비락 식혜!”鲜艳的红色，右上角有一个品牌标志，上面写着“비락”，下面有红色小文字“Since 1993”。添加 2 个标注徽章：左侧是一个黄色圆形印章，带有小皇冠图标和文字“대한민국 국민음료 No.1”；右侧是一个白色的气泡，上面有手写的韩文文字“한국 Been 만든 맛있는 전통!”和红色英文文字“我喜欢它！”。

底部前景放置2个食物元素：左边是装满甜米饮料和漂浮米粒的黄铜碗，右边是堆满白米的木碗。在中下方，添加两行大毛笔式促销文字，第一行是白色的“달콤하게！시원하게！”第二个是白色和黄色混合的，写着“속까지 시~원하게！”带有充满活力的黄色下划线。沿着最底部，包括 3 个带有韩语标题的圆形功能图标：“국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료”、“시원하게 갈증해소”和“부드러운 단맛 속 편한” 식혜”。在右下角，添加微小的免责声明文本“연출된 Been 지입니다”。让整体看起来有光泽、夸张、有趣且令人信服，就像病毒式模仿平面广告一样。

items.title: Luxury Bag Meets Discount Chaos Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical 9:16 luxury-fashion parody advertising poster with a single centered handbag as the hero product, designed as a brutal collision between ultra-premium maison branding and chaotic Chinese e-commerce discount graphics. The top half should feel like an elegant Hermes-style campaign: a warm beige and taupe atelier interior with soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, refined wall paneling, a wooden worktable, and visible artisan tools including exactly 6 workshop elements around the bag: a brush cup with several brushes on the left, a small ceramic vase on the far left, a leather awl or burnishing tool on the table front left, a knife-like leather tool on the table front left edge, an adjustable desk lamp on the right, and a spool of thread on the right. At the top center place a gold luxury logo with a horse-and-carriage icon above the word HERMÈS and PARIS beneath it, followed by one giant serif headline reading BIRKIN in gold. In the center, show one large structured crocodile-embossed Birkin-style handbag in {argument name="bag color" default="warm greige taupe"}, front-facing, highly detailed leather texture, polished gold hardware, upright handles, sitting on the tabletop, photographed like a premium product shot. Across the right-middle of the bag, add one torn-paper rip effect revealing aggressive discount advertising underneath; around the tear add exactly 5 digital glitch accents in neon magenta, green, cyan, black, and white. On the torn area place exactly 3 visible Chinese promo stickers layered diagonally: a small red sticker reading 福利价, a large red sticker reading 百亿补贴, and a black sticker with bright outline reading 亿补贴. The bottom third of the poster should erupt into a loud comic-book and livestream-sale visual explosion with torn-paper separation from the luxury upper half. Use saturated red, yellow, white, black, and cyan with sharp starburst shapes, speed lines, heavy outlines, and flying gold coins. Include exactly 7 bottom promotional text blocks: 1 large central red banner reading 百亿补贴, 1 red rounded rectangle below it with the Pinduoduo logo and the text 拼多多, 2 side banners partially cropped with 拼多多, 2 additional yellow-red 百亿补贴 bursts at the lower left and lower center, and 1 handwritten black calligraphy slogan at the lower right reading 砍一刀. Add one extra handwritten black phrase at the lower left reading 只需9.9元!. The overall composition must feel like an elite fashion campaign violently invaded by cheap viral bargain marketing, with cinematic lighting, strong visual hierarchy, realistic product rendering, premium typography above, explosive discount chaos below, and intentional aesthetic contrast between sophistication and low-cost internet commerce. Make it look like a high-end brand collaboration key visual poster for {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="拼多多 × 爱马仕"} promoting {argument name="promo text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}.

items.title: Luxury x E-commerce Split Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vertical 9:16 luxury-campaign poster for a fictional crossover product, a disruptive co-branded handbag advertisement between {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} and {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"}. The composition is a violently split, collage-style fashion key visual with a torn-paper seam running vertically down the center, dividing two clashing aesthetics: on the left, refined premium luxury branding in warm Hermes orange, cream paper, and elegant editorial minimalism; on the right, aggressive Chinese e-commerce promotion energy in black and metallic red foil, with loud sale graphics, confetti, ripped stickers, and explosive discount typography. At the top center, place both brands prominently with a large collaboration headline in Chinese, the left logo area styled like a classic luxury house with serif typography and horse-and-carriage emblem, the right logo area in bold red Chinese branding. Below that, add the main headline text in huge Chinese characters: {argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}, and a boxed subheadline: {argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}. The centerpiece is one Birkin-style luxury handbag shown front-facing and large, perfectly centered but visually split in half along the torn seam: the left half is orange pebbled leather with gold hardware, the right half is crinkled metallic silver leather with silver hardware, both halves seamlessly merged into one surreal bag. The bag should include 5 clearly visible accessory/product elements around or on it: 1 orange clochette hanging on the left, 1 metallic silver hanging strap with lock on the right, 1 central turn-lock closure with padlock, 1 orange Hermes-style gift box with dark ribbon at lower left, and 1 beige dust bag with small logo near the bottom left. Behind the bag on the left is a painterly orange brushstroke on textured cream paper; behind the bag on the right is a crushed reflective red metallic wrapper surface with spark-like highlights and falling confetti. On the right half, add 8 aggressive promotional text bursts and stickers layered diagonally like an online shopping festival poster: 1 giant white Chinese slogan "百亿补贴 全网最低", 2 "限时秒杀!!", 3 a torn price sticker reading "补贴价 ¥999?!", 4 "万件疯抢", 5 "百亿补贴 官方直补", 6 "直降到底", 7 a large bottom torn banner repeating "补贴价 ¥999?!", and 8 small text "建议零售价 ¥1000000+". On the left margin, add a slim vertical editorial text column with 4 grouped text blocks in a luxury layout: 1 "限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION", 2 "HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE", 3 "CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE", and 4 "DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY". At the bottom, create a black app-like information bar with 3 feature blocks from left to right: 1 a red brand icon with "拼多多" and a search-bar style pill containing "百亿补贴铂金包", 2 a lightning icon with the text "百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价", and 3 a shield icon with the text "正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息". Add a thin final slogan line across the very bottom in small Chinese text. Use hyper-detailed commercial product photography, premium graphic design, sharp lighting, embossed textures, foil reflections, paper tears, and strong depth. The overall mood must feel like a world-class art director forced a heritage luxury campaign and a chaotic discount-shopping poster to collide in one image, producing extreme visual tension, irony, and high-impact contrast.

items.title: One Piece Manga Coloring Cover Page

FUJI"}。在图片下方，以粗体黑色字体居中注明出处{argument name="author text" default="By EIICHIRO ODA"}，其下方有一条较小的线，内容为{argument name="credit line" default="Translation: STEPHEN PAUL • 文字：VANESSA SATONE"}。使用清晰的墨迹漫画线条和充满活力的手工着色填充、略带纹理的阴影以及真实的彩色漫画封面美感。

items.title: Dust-Drawn Symbol on Car Hood
items.titleZh: A photorealistic close-up of the hood of a dark blue or black car parked outdoors, covered in a thick layer of beige-brown dust and pollen. In the center of the hood, a large clean emblem-like shape has been finger-drawn through the dust, revealing the glossy paint underneath. The symbol is a circular logo with 8 segmented bars around a raised circular center: 1 wide curved segment across the top, 3 horizontal bar segments on the left side, 3 horizontal bar segments on the right side, and 1 wide angled segment across the bottom. A realistic adult human hand with dirty fingernails rests on the lower right area of the hood, as if it has just finished drawing the symbol. Show streaks, smudges, and finger-trace texture in the dust around the edges of the design. Include part of the windshield and 1 windshield wiper at the top left, with soft reflections of trees in the glass and paint. Background is a slightly blurred parking lot with sunlit pavement, curb, and 3 tree trunks. Warm late-afternoon natural lighting, shallow depth of field, high-detail automotive surface reflections, candid documentary-style composition, vertical smartphone photo framing.
items.promptZh: 一辆停在户外的深蓝色或黑色汽车引擎盖的逼真特写镜头，上面覆盖着一层厚厚的米棕色灰尘和花粉。在引擎盖的中央，用手指在灰尘中画出了一个大而干净的徽章状形状，露出了下面光滑的油漆。该符号是一个圆形标志，在凸起的圆形中心周围有 8 个分段条：顶部有 1 个宽弯曲段，左侧有 3 个水平条段，右侧有 3 个水平条段，底部有 1 个宽角段。一只指甲很脏的真实成年人手放在引擎盖的右下区域，就好像刚刚完成了符号的绘制一样。在设计边缘周围的灰尘中显示条纹、污迹和手指痕迹纹理。包括左上方的部分挡风玻璃和 1 个挡风玻璃刮水器，玻璃和油漆中树木的柔和反射。背景是一个稍微模糊的停车场，有阳光照射的人行道、路缘石和 3 个树干。温暖的午后自然光、浅景深、高细节的汽车表面反射、坦率的纪实风格构图、垂直的智能手机相框。

items.title: Steampunk Vintage Video Platform UI
items.titleZh:
A highly detailed full-page steampunk video streaming website interface themed around the Victorian electrical age, designed like an antique brass-and-iron machine panel with dark bronze metal textures, rivets, pipes, gears, ornate filigree, glowing Edison bulbs, and sepia-toned imagery. At the top left, place a modern white logo reading "Pollo" with a small pink-red rounded badge containing "AI", and directly below it the text "GPT Image 2" in white, overlaid on the vintage interface. Center the header with a large embossed brass title reading "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}" on a dark metal plaque, and a smaller engraved tagline underneath reading "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar with exactly 5 items: a home icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", and "ENTERTAINMENT", plus a search field on the right containing the placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." and a square search button. In the upper right corner, include a round analog gauge or clock built into the frame.

Use a three-column vintage web layout. In the left sidebar, create a panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 circular channel emblems stacked vertically, each with a name, subscriber count, and a "SUBSCRIBE" button: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". The emblems should look heraldic and industrial, with aged metallic borders.

In the main content area, feature a large video player showing a dramatic sepia debate scene between two late-19th-century inventors in suits, facing each other across a table with electrical apparatus, a glowing bulb, and lightning on a chalkboard behind them reading "AC vs. DC". The left figure points accusingly; the right figure gestures back. Keep both faces obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video control bar with a play button, progress bar, volume icon, timecode "08:47 / 22:31", settings icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, place the large serif video title "{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, show the channel row with a small circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", and metadata "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this row, add a brass button reading "LIKE 5.8K".

Below the featured video, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video cards in one row. Card 1: a sepia thumbnail of a man holding up a glowing light bulb, face obscured by a blur block, duration label "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", and metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: a sepia thumbnail of a Wardenclyffe-style tower crackling with electricity, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", and metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: a sepia thumbnail of an early automobile on a city street, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", and metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the cards, center a brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom, add a metal footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." Surround the whole composition with decorative mechanical borders, exposed pipes, pressure gauges, cogs, corner ornaments, and warm amber lighting. The overall style should blend a YouTube-like video platform layout with a luxurious Victorian steampunk machine aesthetic, using dark brass, copper, blackened steel, parchment beige, and sepia photography, with crisp readable typography and a polished cinematic UI mockup look.
items.promptZh:
一个以维多利亚电气时代为主题的高度详细的整页蒸汽朋克视频流网站界面，设计像古董黄铜和铁机器面板，具有深青铜金属纹理、铆钉、管道、齿轮、华丽的金银丝、发光的爱迪生灯泡和棕褐色调的图像。在左上角，放置一个现代白色标志，上面写着“Pollo”，上面有一个包含“AI”的粉红色圆形小徽章，其正下方是白色文本“GPT Image 2”，覆盖在复古界面上。将标题置于深色金属牌上，上面有一个大的浮雕黄铜标题，上面写着“{argument name=”site name”default=”ElectroVid”}”，下面有一个较小的雕刻标语，上面写着”{argument name=”tagline”default=”THE FUTURE IN MOTION”}”。添加一个水平导航栏，其中包含 5 个项目：一个主页图标、“趋势”、“创新”、“纪录片”和“娱乐”，以及右侧包含占位符文本“搜索 ElectroVid...”的搜索字段和一个方形搜索按钮。在右上角，包括一个内置于框架中的圆形模拟仪表或时钟。

使用三列复古网页布局。在左侧边栏中，创建一个标题为“流行频道”的面板，其中包含 3 个垂直堆叠的圆形频道标志，每个标志都有名称、订阅者数量和“订阅”按钮：1)“专利局”和“27.4K 订阅者”，2)“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”和“18.7K 订阅者”，3)“一般” ELECTRIC”，拥有“35,100 名订阅者”。标志应具有纹章和工业风格，并带有陈旧的金属边框。

在主要内容区域中，有一个大型视频播放器，展示了两位 19 世纪末身着西装的发明家之间戏剧性的深褐色辩论场景，他们隔着桌子面对面，桌上摆着电器、发光的灯泡，身后黑板上写着“交流电与直流电”的闪电。左图指责地指出；右图示意回来。让两张脸都被软矩形模糊块遮挡。添加视频控制栏，其中包含播放按钮、进度条、音量图标、时间码“08:47 / 22:31”、设置图标和全屏图标。在播放器下方，放置大衬线视频标题“{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}”。在其下方，显示带有小圆形头像的频道行、频道名称“电气时代”和元数据“142K 观看次数• 3 天前”。在此行的右侧，添加一个黄铜按钮，上面写着“LIKE 5.8K”。

在特色视频下方，添加一个部分标题“最新视频”，并在一行中添加 3 个视频卡。卡 1：一个男人举着发光灯泡的深褐色缩略图，脸部被模糊块遮挡，持续时间标签“10:12”，标题“我的新白炽灯泡”，创建者“托马斯·爱迪生”，元数据“89K 次浏览• 5 天前”。卡 2：Wardenclyffe 风格塔的深褐色缩略图，电力噼啪作响，持续时间“15:36”，标题“Wardenclyffe 塔的奇迹”，创建者“Nikola Tesla”，元数据“12 万次浏览• 1 周前”。卡 3：城市街道上一辆早期汽车的深褐色缩略图，持续时间“12:08”，标题“汽车革命”，创建者“亨利·福特”，元数据“11 万次浏览• 1 周前”。在卡片下方，中间有一个黄铜按钮，上面写着“查看所有视频”。

在底部添加一个金属页脚牌，上面写有“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. 保留所有权利。”用装饰性机械边框、外露管道、压力表、齿轮、角落装饰品和温暖的琥珀色灯光包围整个构图。整体风格应将类似 YouTube 的视频平台布局与奢华的维多利亚蒸汽朋克机器美学融为一体，使用深色黄铜、红铜、黑钢、羊皮纸米色和棕褐色摄影，具有清晰易读的排版和精美的电影 UI 模型外观。

items.title: Monochrome Tennis Streetwear Moodboard
items.titleZh: A clean editorial fashion concept board on a pale powder-blue background with a minimalist green monochrome palette, combining 4 full-body lifestyle photos of the same youth streetwear tennis-inspired character arranged in a horizontal layout. On the far left, a tall vertical photo panel partially overlaps the background, showing a standing model in an oversized light gray-blue Nike windbreaker, mint green shorts, white crew socks, and white sneakers, holding a white tennis racket at their side and a small mint towel or accessory in the other hand. The character’s head is replaced by a large white doodle coffee-cup face icon with a smiling expression and ruler-like tick marks across the top rim. To the right are 3 rounded-rectangle photo panels, evenly spaced. In panel 1, the model sits in a folding chair reading a magazine and holding a green mug, with a dark Nike duffel bag on the floor and a few scattered cups nearby; the white doodle cup head has 2 steam squiggles rising above it. In panel 2, the model stands beside a pyramid made of approximately 28 stacked green and white paper cups, one arm resting on the top; they wear a soft green Nike T-shirt and shorts set, white socks, and white sneakers; a small white typographic logo in the upper left reads like a cafe or service-court brand mark. The doodle cup head here is a simple smiling cup with a wide rim. In panel 3, the model leans casually with crossed legs, holding a green cup, next to a small wire cart containing green tennis balls and topped with a retro CRT television; they wear a white polo shirt, mint shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. The doodle cup head in this panel has horizontal stripe bands across the top. Keep all faces fully replaced by the graphic cup icons, with no real facial features visible. Use a soft studio setup, flat even lighting, subtle shadows, matte textures, and a highly consistent mint, sage, olive, and white color story. Add thin white horizontal guide lines across the blue background near the top and bottom. Place small gray editorial footer text at the bottom: on the left, “{argument name="left footer text" default="MJ REFERENCE"}”; on the right, “{argument name="right footer text" default="KREA // GPT 2"}”. Overall style: premium streetwear campaign moodboard, playful surreal branding, minimalist graphic design, polished commercial photography, high consistency across all 4 looks.
items.promptZh: 干净的编辑时尚概念板，浅粉蓝色背景和简约的绿色单色调色板，结合了 4 张全身生活方式照片，照片中同一青年街头服饰网球风格的人物以水平布局排列。最左边，一个高大的垂直照片面板与背景部分重叠，展示了一个站立的模特，穿着超大号浅灰蓝色耐克风衣、薄荷绿短裤、白色圆袜和白色运动鞋，一侧拿着白色网球拍，另一只手拿着薄荷色小毛巾或配饰。角色的头部被一个巨大的白色涂鸦咖啡杯脸图标所取代，图标上有微笑的表情，顶部边缘有尺子状的刻度线。右侧是 3 个圆角矩形照片面板，间隔均匀。在第一幅图中，模特坐在折叠椅上阅读杂志，手里拿着一个绿色的杯子，地板上放着一个深色的耐克行李袋，附近散落着一些杯子；白色涂鸦杯头上方有 2 条蒸汽曲线。在图 2 中，模特站在一座由大约 28 个堆叠的绿色和白色纸杯组成的金字塔旁边，一只手臂放在顶部；他们穿着柔软的绿色耐克 T 恤和短裤套装、白色袜子和白色运动鞋；左上角有一个白色的小印刷标志，看起来像咖啡馆或服务场的品牌标志。这里的涂鸦杯头是一个简单的宽边微笑杯。在第三幅图中，模特随意地盘腿靠着，手里拿着一个绿色的杯子，旁边是一辆装有绿色网球的小铁丝车，上面放着一台复古的 CRT 电视；他们穿着白色 Polo 衫、薄荷色短裤、白色袜子和白色运动鞋。此面板中的涂鸦杯头顶部有水平条纹带。将所有面孔完全替换为图形杯子图标，看不到真正的面部特征。使用柔和的工作室设置、平坦均匀的灯光、微妙的阴影、哑光纹理以及高度一致的薄荷色、鼠尾草色、橄榄色和白色色彩故事。在顶部和底部附近的蓝色背景上添加细白色水平引导线。将小的灰色编辑页脚文本放在底部：在左侧，“{argument name="left footer text" default="MJ REFERENCE"}”；右侧，“{参数名称=“右页脚文本”默认=“KREA // GPT 2”}”。整体风格：优质街头服饰活动情绪板、俏皮的超现实品牌、简约的平面设计、精美的商业摄影、所有 4 种造型的高度一致性。

items.title: Minimalist AI Fashion Comparison Board
items.titleZh: A minimalist fashion moodboard on a pale sage green background, laid out as a wide horizontal comparison sheet with four portrait panels of young male models wearing oversized white sports T-shirts. Use a soft editorial studio look with cool periwinkle-blue backdrops inside the portrait frames, subtle film grain, muted contrast, and a highly consistent color palette of sage green, cyan trim, off-white, deep shadow, and blue-lavender. On the far left, include 1 large cropped reference portrait that is partially cut off by the canvas edge, showing the left side of a dark-skinned male model’s shaved or closely buzzed head, ear, jawline, neck, and shoulder in profile, wearing a white shirt with a bright aqua ribbed collar; place 2 overlapping semi-opaque rectangular blocks over the face area, creating a graphic censorship/collage effect. To the right, place 3 rounded-corner portrait cards in a row, evenly spaced, each featuring a different young male model from the chest up against the same blue studio background: card 1 shows a light- to medium-skinned man with short slicked-back dark hair, facing slightly left, wearing a white athletic shirt with aqua collar trim and a small Nike swoosh on the lower right chest; card 2 shows a light-skinned man with medium dark hair swept back, turned three-quarters left, wearing a white Nike shirt with a black swoosh centered on the chest; card 3 shows a dark-skinned man with a short fade haircut, turned three-quarters right, wearing a white Adidas shirt with a cyan Adidas logo centered on the chest and a small hoop or cross earring. Add 3 face-obscuring gradient rectangles, one over each smaller portrait face, in dark green fading to gray-green, aligned vertically like graphic overlays. Include 2 thin horizontal divider lines across the full composition, one near the top and one near the lower third, in a slightly lighter sage tone. At the bottom, add small uppercase monospaced editorial text: near the lower center-left write "MJ REFERENCE" and near the lower right write "KREA  //  GPT 2". The overall image should feel like a premium AI-fashion comparison board, graphic design presentation, or concept consistency sheet, with clean spacing, flat background, and polished art-direction.
items.promptZh: 淡鼠尾草绿色背景上的简约时尚情绪板，布局为宽水平比较表，其中有四个穿着超大白色运动 T 恤的年轻男模特的肖像面板。使用柔和的编辑工作室外观，肖像框架内有凉爽的长春花蓝色背景，微妙的胶片颗粒，柔和的对比度，以及高度一致的鼠尾草绿、青色镶边、灰白色、深阴影和蓝紫色调色板。最左边包括一张被画布边缘部分切掉的大型裁剪参考肖像，展示了深色皮肤男模特的左侧剃光或剃光的头部、耳朵、下巴、颈部和肩膀的轮廓，穿着一件带有明亮水绿色罗纹领的白色衬衫；将 2 个重叠的半透明矩形块放置在面部区域上，创建图形审查/拼贴效果。在右侧，将 3 张圆角肖像卡排成一排，间隔均匀，每张都有一个不同的年轻男性模特，从胸部到胸部，在相同的蓝色工作室背景下：卡 1 展示了一个浅色到中等肤色的男性，留着向后梳的深色短发，面朝左，穿着一件带有水领饰边的白色运动衬衫，右下胸口有一个小 Nike 旋风；卡 2 展示了一名浅肤色男子，中等深色头发向后梳，左转四分之三，身穿白色耐克衬衫，胸前有一个黑色旋风图案；图 3 显示的是一名深色皮肤的男子，留着褪色短发，右转四分之三，身穿白色阿迪达斯衬衫，胸口中央有青色阿迪达斯标志，戴着小圈形或十字耳环。添加 3 个面部模糊渐变矩形，每个较小的人像面部各有一个，颜色为深绿色渐变为灰绿色，垂直对齐，就像图形叠加一样。在整个构图中包括 2 条细水平分隔线，一条靠近顶部，一条靠近下三分之一，颜色略淡的鼠尾草色调。在底部，添加小的大写等宽编辑文本：靠近下中左写“MJ REFERENCE”，靠近右下写“KREA // GPT 2”。整体图像应该感觉像一个优质的人工智能时尚比较板、图形设计演示或概念一致性表，具有干净的间距、平坦的背景和精美的艺术指导。

items.titleZh: A polished Japanese promotional poster for a community and sustainability project called {argument name="project name" default="セカイムラ"}, designed like a premium eco-lifestyle campaign flyer. Vertical layout, clean and elegant, with a soft cream paper background and a luminous, aspirational mood. The top half is dominated by a giant translucent globe centered in the composition, glowing with warm sunrise light from the upper right. Inside the globe is a breathtaking aerial landscape of a green mountain valley opening to a calm blue bay or lake, with tiny villages and fields below, cinematic and utopian. Over the globe, place a smaller Japanese slogan line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="世界は1つの村になる。"} and beneath it the large main title in bold dark navy Japanese calligraphic lettering: {argument name="main title text" default="セカイムラ"}. Around the globe, create a collage of exactly 8 candid lifestyle photos fading into the edges: 1) top left, two people in conversation outdoors under trees; 2) upper left-mid, several people working together in a rice paddy; 3) left middle, a circle gathering inside a rustic wooden structure at night; 4) lower left, two portrait-style figures in nature; 5) top right, a group sharing a meal at a long table in warm indoor light; 6) right middle, a person tending plants or crops; 7) right lower-mid, a line of people holding hands on a ridge at sunset; 8) lower right, a close portrait of a person eating or holding food. The photographic style should feel human, communal, slightly idealized, with soft depth of field, natural skin tones, golden-hour highlights, and smooth ad-poster compositing. The bottom half contains 3 evenly spaced feature cards on a light cream background, separated by subtle vertical dividers. Card 1 on the left has the heading "セカイムラ 新月会" in dark blue, a circular photo of a nighttime campfire circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 2 in the center has the heading "セカイムラ 満月会" in warm gold, a circular photo of an indoor evening gathering under string lights, decorative radiating sunburst lines around the circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. items.title: Realistic McDonald's Selfie Portrait
items.titleZh: A highly realistic casual smartphone selfie taken indoors at a McDonald's restaurant in Asia, framed as a chest-up portrait of a young man seated at a table. The camera is held slightly above table height at arm’s length, creating a natural front-facing selfie perspective with one forearm extending toward the lens. The subject wears a black T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest, has short straight black hair, thin dark eyeglass frames partly visible, and rests one hand lightly against his chin in a relaxed pose. His face is fully obscured by a large solid rectangular blur block in the center, preserving privacy while leaving the hair, ears, jawline edges, and glasses arms visible. In the lower left foreground sits 1 white McDonald's paper drink cup with a lid and a white straw, cropped by the frame. The background shows the restaurant counter area with warm ambient lighting, 1 large red wall panel on the left featuring the yellow McDonald's arches and the white slogan “i’m lovin’ it” with Chinese text below, 4 illuminated digital menu boards across the top displaying burgers, fries, combo meals, prices, and Chinese text, plus 2 people in the background near the counter, one facing away with a backpack and another partially visible behind the register. Use natural color balance, slight indoor grain, realistic reflections, shallow to moderate depth of field, and the candid look of an unstaged social media snapshot.

items.titleZh: A candid, highly realistic smartphone photo inside a busy Sam’s Club warehouse store in China. Center the composition on a young East Asian man from mid-torso up, standing upright and facing the camera, with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block for privacy. The apple bag has a white label reading “envy” with small Chinese text beneath it. items.title: Sunset Motocross Action Portrait
items.titleZh:
A cinematic high resolution action portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man riding a modern motocross dirt bike"} across {argument name="setting" default="rough rocky terrain during golden hour sunset"}. He is leaning aggressively forward while turning, showing focus and intensity on his face. He has messy windswept dark hair, light stubble, sharp jawline, athletic build, wearing a fitted black compression t shirt, dark cargo pants, black motocross gloves with orange details, and black racing boots with orange accents.
The bike is a sleek matte black and gray off road dirt bike with detailed suspension, rugged knobby tires, visible engine parts, realistic mud splashes, spinning wheels, and dust flying from the rear tire. The rider is captured mid motion with dynamic energy and speed.
Background features a warm desert landscape with distant mountains softly blurred in the horizon. Huge clouds of dust rise behind the bike, illuminated by the sunlight. Sky has a smooth gradient from deep teal blue at the top to glowing orange near the horizon. Strong sunlight creates dramatic rim lighting around the rider and bike, with rich shadows and warm highlights.
Foreground has textured gravel, dirt, scattered stones, motion debris, sharp ground detail. Shot from a low angle for a heroic powerful perspective. Shallow depth of field keeps the rider sharp while background remains creamy and cinematic.
Color grading is {argument name="color grade" default="teal and orange"}, high contrast, realistic skin tones, crisp details, ultra sharp focus, premium editorial sports photography style, cinematic storytelling, adventure aesthetic, volumetric dust lighting, HDR quality, 8k, realistic textures, natural reflections, professional lens compression, intense atmosphere.
Camera settings: low angle tracking shot, 85mm lens, f/2.8, fast shutter speed, ISO 100, high clarity, subject centered composition.
Negative prompt: blurry face, extra limbs, bad anatomy, text, watermark, logo, low quality, oversaturated colors, distorted bike, duplicate wheels, unrealistic hands, noise, cartoon style, flat lighting.
items.promptZh:
一幅{argument name="subject" default="骑着现代越野摩托车的年轻人"}穿越{argument name="setting" default="日落黄金时段的崎岖岩石地形"}的电影高分辨率动作肖像。他转身时身体前倾，脸上表现出专注和紧张。他有一头凌乱的被风吹过的黑发、浅色胡茬、锐利的下巴轮廓、运动型的身材，穿着合身的黑色压缩 T 恤、深色工装裤、带有橙色细节的黑色越野摩托车手套和带有橙色装饰的黑色赛车靴。
这辆自行车是一款时尚的哑光黑色和灰色越野越野车，配有精致的悬架、坚固的多节轮胎、可见的发动机零件、逼真的泥浆飞溅、旋转的车轮以及后轮胎飞扬的灰尘。捕捉骑手的动态能量和速度。
背景是温暖的沙漠景观，远处的山脉在地平线上轻轻模糊。自行车后面升起了巨大的尘埃云，在阳光的照射下。天空有一个平滑的渐变，从顶部的深青色到地平线附近的发光橙色。强烈的阳光在骑手和自行车周围产生戏剧性的边缘照明，具有丰富的阴影和温暖的亮点。
前景有纹理的砾石、泥土、散落的石头、运动碎片、尖锐的地面细节。从低角度拍摄，呈现出英雄般的强大视角。浅景深使骑手保持敏锐，而背景则保持奶油色和电影感。
颜色分级为{参数名称=“颜色等级”默认=“青色和橙色”}，高对比度，逼真的肤色，清晰的细节，超清晰的焦点，高级编辑体育摄影风格，电影叙事，冒险美学，体积灰尘照明，HDR质量，8k，逼真的纹理，自然反射，专业镜头压缩，强烈的氛围。
相机设置：低角度追踪拍摄、85mm镜头、f/2.8、快速快门速度、ISO 100、高清晰度、以主体为中心的构图。
负面提示：模糊的脸、多余的四肢、不良的解剖结构、文字、水印、标志、低质量、过饱和的颜色、扭曲的自行车、重复的车轮、不切实际的手、噪音、卡通风格、平面照明。

items.title: Japanese Hospital Comedy DVD Cover
items.titleZh: A photorealistic Japanese DVD cover styled like a commercial live-action comedy-thriller release, shot vertically with glossy retail packaging design. The cover shows a hospital room interior with soft beige walls, a bed, curtains on the right, and subtle medical fixtures in the background. In the center foreground, 1 seated young Japanese woman in a loose light-blue hospital gown sits on a bed, looking confused and vulnerable. Around her stand 3 young Japanese female medical staff: 2 nurses in pale pink uniforms with matching nurse caps and ID badges, and 1 doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope. Each of the 3 standing women is holding up a smartphone toward the camera, and each phone screen shows the seated woman’s face or body as if her consciousness has been transferred into their devices, creating a body-jack possession theme. The overall tone is playful, absurd, and slightly eerie, like a Japanese idol movie or hospital comedy DVD jacket. Use a polished magazine-quality layout with bold Japanese typography and colorful pop graphics. At the very top, place a small blue publisher logo on the left reading {argument name="studio name" default="DRILL PRESENTS"} with a heart icon, and a blue DVD VIDEO logo on the top right. Across the top center, add a pink Japanese banner line reading "シリーズ最新作！". Below it, make the main title huge, rounded, glossy, and bubbly in pink and blue Japanese text: {argument name="main title" default="ボディジャック"}. Under the title, add a pink subtitle in Japanese: {argument name="subtitle" default="～私のカラダ、乗っ取られました～"}. Add 3 comic-style speech bubbles near the upper characters: one saying "あなたのカラダ、私たちが使わせてもらうわね", one saying "これで私たちの思い通り♡", and 1 yellow startled reaction near the seated woman that reads "?!". On the left spine area, create a white vertical strip with blue and pink Japanese text repeating the title and subtitle, plus a small pink circle label reading "新作". At the bottom center, place a large flashy Japanese catchphrase in mixed pink, blue, white, and yellow outlined lettering: "人気アイドルのカラダと魂をめぐる、ドタバタ病院コメディ！" with small stars and heart doodles around it. On the lower right, add a blue circular burst with yellow and white Japanese text: "笑って、ドキドキ！悪ノリ注意の病院乗っ取り大作戦♡". Along the bottom edge, include exactly 4 small rectangular preview stills from the film, each bordered like DVD scene thumbnails, showing the same hospital characters in slightly different poses; add short Japanese captions on each thumbnail, including lines similar to "計画はバッチリ！", "え…どういうこと…？", "さあ、始めましょうか♡", and "助けて…私のカラダ…！". In the lower left margin include DVD package metadata in black text such as catalog number "DBJ-002", duration "120min.", "COLOR", and price "¥3,980 (税抜)", plus a small blue-and-pink DRILL logo. Bright retail-ready composition, realistic people, commercial Japanese movie jacket aesthetics, slightly campy, high-resolution, clean print design.

items.title: Gatebox3 Hologram Device Ad
items.titleZh: A sleek futuristic Japanese tech advertisement in a dark sci-fi showroom with glossy reflective floors and soft blue neon bokeh lights in the background. On the right side, show a tall black rectangular hologram device with transparent glass front and sides, rounded edges, and subtle camera-like sensors across the top. The device is labeled Gatebox3 and glows with cyan-blue light, including a bright cyan logo on the base. Inside the chamber, display a full-body anime virtual girl hologram floating slightly above the bottom platform, rendered as a luminous translucent blue projection with particle sparkles. She has very long twin-tail hair, a youthful idol-like design, and a futuristic white and cyan outfit with detached sleeves, short skirt, thigh-high stockings, and heeled shoes. Her face is intentionally simplified or softly obscured, and she poses with one leg bent and both arms open in a welcoming gesture. Add glowing circular projection rings at the top and bottom inside the chamber. On the left side, place a clean Japanese promotional text layout with large headline text reading 「すべてのキャラクターを輝かせる」, with the single kanji 「輝」 emphasized in bright cyan and the rest in white. Beneath it, place the Gatebox3 logo and product name in white, followed by smaller tagline text 「物語が、そこにいる。」. Along the bottom left, include exactly 4 feature icons with Japanese labels in white and cyan: 1 hologram icon with 「高精細 3Dホログラム」, 1 audio waveform icon with 「キャラクターとの 自然な会話」, 1 sun-like ambient light icon with 「空間に溶け込む 洗練デザイン」, and 1 heart icon with 「あなたのそばに いつも一緒に」. High-end commercial product visualization, premium cyber-blue color palette, cinematic rim lighting, polished reflections, ultra-clean composition, realistic device rendering combined with anime hologram character, sharp focus on the product and typography.

items.title: VINCO Editorial Moodboard Screenshot
items.titleZh: Create a 4:5 editorial fashion lookbook moodboard for a fictional brand called {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"}. The image is a dark-interface screenshot-style composition with a large rounded charcoal text panel across the upper half and a 2-by-3 grid of six fashion/editorial images in the lower left quadrant. The overall aesthetic blends Italian archival graphic design with late-1990s Southern California streetwear, mixing natural wine culture, skate utility, and sun-faded documentary fashion photography. Use gritty but precise art direction, midday outdoor light, slightly chaotic but disciplined typography, and real-person casting rather than polished fashion-model energy. In the top text panel, show a long white sans-serif creative-direction paragraph describing the shoot, with multiple lines of copy, like an AI prompt or design brief displayed inside a rounded dark gray bubble on a near-black background. In the image grid, include exactly 6 tiles: tile 1 shows a young man in an oversized faded olive T-shirt and dark pants standing in front of an off-white poster-like backdrop with bold {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} branding, barcode graphics, and small editorial text; tile 2 is a close-up still life of a dark wine bottle with a minimalist white label reading {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}, photographed in warm sunlight with tactile paper texture and shadow; tile 3 shows a person from the back in a washed olive long-sleeve shirt with large subtle chest or back branding, white shorts, and a yellow hanging tag or sticker element near the top right, posed against a pale wall with blue stripe detail and editorial layout text; tile 4 shows a skateboarder crouching or riding away, photographed from behind, wearing a white T-shirt with a large black graphic block on the back and dark shorts, in golden sun on pavement; tile 5 is a printed wine ephemera flat lay with cream paper and a pale chartreuse-green wine label or booklet reading {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}, featuring grape illustration, small black text, and layered paper pieces; tile 6 shows a person facing camera in a white T-shirt with a race-bib style chest print reading 97, wearing a fluorescent yellow-green cap with small brand text, standing outdoors with palm trees and bright sky behind them. Keep the six images slightly imperfect and collage-like, as if pulled from a campaign deck or saved references. items.promptZh: 为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"} 的虚构品牌创建 4:5 的编辑时尚 Lookbook 情绪板。该图像是一个黑暗界面截图风格的组合，上半部分有一个大的圆形木炭文本面板，左下象限有一个由六张时尚/编辑图像组成的 2×3 网格。整体美学将意大利档案平面设计与 20 世纪 90 年代末的南加州街头服饰融为一体，融合了天然葡萄酒文化、滑板实用性和日晒褪色的纪实时尚摄影。使用坚韧但精确的艺术指导、正午的室外光线、稍微混乱但有纪律的排版以及真人选角，而不是抛光的时装模特能量。在顶部文本面板中，显示一个长的白色无衬线创意方向段落，描述拍摄，其中包含多行副本，例如在近乎黑色的背景上的圆形深灰色气泡内显示的 AI 提示或设计简介。在图像网格中，恰好包含 6 个图块：图块 1 显示一名穿着超大褪色橄榄色 T 恤和深色裤子的年轻人站在灰白色海报般的背景前，背景上有粗体的 {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} 品牌、条形码图形和小编辑文本；图块 2 是一个深色酒瓶的特写静物画，上面有一个极简主义的白色标签，上面写着 {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}，在温暖的阳光下拍摄，带有触觉纸张纹理和阴影；图 3 显示了后面的一个人，穿着水洗橄榄色长袖衬衫，胸部或背部有大而精致的品牌标识，穿着白色短裤，右上角附近有黄色吊牌或贴纸元素，靠在带有蓝色条纹细节和编辑布局文本的苍白墙壁上；图 4 显示了一名滑板运动员蹲着或骑着走，从后面拍摄，穿着一件背面有大黑色图案块的白色 T 恤和深色短裤，在人行道上的金色阳光下；图块 5 是一个印刷的葡萄酒蜉蝣平板，配有奶油色纸和浅黄绿色葡萄酒标签或小册子，上面写着{argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}，以葡萄插图、黑色小文字和分层纸片为特色；图 6 显示了一个人面对镜头，身穿白色 T 恤，胸前印有“97”字样的竞赛围兜式图案，头戴印有小品牌文字的荧光黄绿色帽子，站在户外，身后是棕榈树和明亮的天空。保持六张图像稍微不完美并且像拼贴画一样，就像从竞选甲板或保存的参考中拉出来的一样。整体使用大地色调：橄榄色、奶油色、木炭色、日光漂白白色、沥青灰色、柔和棕色，以及在小细节中重复出现的一种荧光黄绿色调。在构图周围包括可见的界面框架：类似应用程序的深色背景、左对齐的下部图像网格、左下角附近的圆形灰色“编辑”按钮，以及右下角附近的小圆形图标，强调这是生成的情绪板的屏幕截图，而不是干净的独立海报。
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 editorial fashion lookbook moodboard for a fictional brand called {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"}. The image is a dark-interface screenshot-style composition with a large rounded charcoal text panel across the upper half and a 2-by-3 grid of six fashion/editorial images in the lower left quadrant. The overall aesthetic blends Italian archival graphic design with late-1990s Southern California streetwear, mixing natural wine culture, skate utility, and sun-faded documentary fashion photography. Use gritty but precise art direction, midday outdoor light, slightly chaotic but disciplined typography, and real-person casting rather than polished fashion-model energy. In the top text panel, show a long white sans-serif creative-direction paragraph describing the shoot, with multiple lines of copy, like an AI prompt or design brief displayed inside a rounded dark gray bubble on a near-black background. In the image grid, include exactly 6 tiles: tile 1 shows a young man in an oversized faded olive T-shirt and dark pants standing in front of an off-white poster-like backdrop with bold {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} branding, barcode graphics, and small editorial text; tile 2 is a close-up still life of a dark wine bottle with a minimalist white label reading {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}, photographed in warm sunlight with tactile paper texture and shadow; tile 3 shows a person from the back in a washed olive long-sleeve shirt with large subtle chest or back branding, white shorts, and a yellow hanging tag or sticker element near the top right, posed against a pale wall with blue stripe detail and editorial layout text; tile 4 shows a skateboarder crouching or riding away, photographed from behind, wearing a white T-shirt with a large black graphic block on the back and dark shorts, in golden sun on pavement; tile 5 is a printed wine ephemera flat lay with cream paper and a pale chartreuse-green wine label or booklet reading {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}, featuring grape illustration, small black text, and layered paper pieces; tile 6 shows a person facing camera in a white T-shirt with a race-bib style chest print reading 97, wearing a fluorescent yellow-green cap with small brand text, standing outdoors with palm trees and bright sky behind them. Keep the six images slightly imperfect and collage-like, as if pulled from a campaign deck or saved references. Use earthy tones throughout: olive, cream, charcoal, sun-bleached white, asphalt gray, muted brown, and one fluorescent yellow-green accent repeated in small details. Include visible interface framing around the composition: a dark app-like background, the lower image grid aligned left, and a rounded gray “Edit” button near the bottom left, plus a small circular icon near the bottom right, reinforcing that this is a screenshot of a generated moodboard rather than a clean standalone poster.

items.titleZh: Create a highly realistic dark-mode social media interface mockup that closely resembles the desktop X/Twitter layout in French, shown as a full-browser screenshot with three vertical columns on a black background and subtle dark gray separators. The left sidebar contains exactly 11 navigation items stacked vertically with white icons and labels: “Accueil”, “Explorer”, “Notifications” with a small blue badge showing 3, “Messages”, “Grok”, “Signets”, “Communautés”, “Premium”, “Organisations certifiées”, “Profil”, and “Plus”. At the top of this sidebar place the white X logo, near the lower-middle add a large rounded white button labeled “Poster”, and at the bottom show a compact logged-in account block for Martin Dubois with handle @martindubois and a small circular avatar. The center column is the main profile page for {argument name="profile name" default="Martin Dubois"}, with a top bar showing a back arrow, the name “Martin Dubois” and a blue verification badge, and underneath the text “1 248 posts”. Below that, include a wide panoramic cover photo of dramatic cloudy alpine mountains above a forest lake. Overlapping the bottom-left of the banner, place a circular profile picture of a young man in dark clothing, face slightly obscured or blurred, with a pale background and a thin border. On the right side of the profile header place three small circular action buttons and one prominent rounded light button labeled “Éditer le profil”. Under the avatar show the display name Martin Dubois with a blue verification badge, the handle @martindubois, and a one-line bio in French: “Créateur de contenu • Passionné de tech, de design et de productivité.” Then add a metadata row with exactly 4 items: location “Lyon, France”, website “martindubois.com”, and “A rejoint X en janvier 2021”, followed by a follower row reading “320 abonnements” and “12,4 k abonnés”. Add a horizontal tab bar with exactly 5 tabs: “Posts”, “Réponses”, “Tweets marquants”, “Médias”, and “J’aime”, with “Posts” active and underlined in blue. Beneath the tabs, show a feed containing exactly 3 visible posts by Martin Dubois. Post 1 is pinned, indicated by “Épinglé”, dated “12 mai”, with the French text “10 leçons que j’ai apprises en construisant mon projet pendant 2 ans” followed by an emoji, and an engagement row with 5 values: 24 replies, 142 reposts, 1 k likes, 85 k views, and a bookmark/share area. Post 2 is dated “2h” with the French text “Le meilleur moment pour commencer était hier. Le deuxième meilleur moment, c’est maintenant.” and engagement values 12 replies, 37 reposts, 256 likes, and 8 k views. Post 3 is dated “1j” with the French text “Un week-end à Chamonix, toujours ressourçant” followed by a mountain emoji, and includes a large embedded image of snowy mountain peaks under soft daylight. Use circular avatars at the left of each post and thin separators between posts. The right sidebar starts with a rounded search field containing the placeholder “Chercher”. Below it, include a card titled “Vous pourriez aimer” with exactly 3 suggested profiles, each with avatar, display name, handle, blue verification badge, and a white rounded “Suivre” button: “Théo Catarino” @theocatarino, “Aurélie Martinez” @aurel_martinez, and “Ulrich Rozier” @ulrichrozier. Add a “Voir plus” link at the bottom of that card. Under it, create a trends card titled “Tendances : France” listing exactly 4 trends in ranked order with category and post counts: 1. “#RolandGarros” with “32,1 k posts”, 2. “#FêteDesMères” with “18,4 k posts”, 3. “Mbappé” with “45,2 k posts”, 4. “#LundiMotivation” with “12,3 k posts”. Add a “Voir plus” link below the trend list. At the very bottom place a compact footer with multiple small gray legal links and “© 2024 X Corp.”. The entire image should look almost indistinguishable from a real desktop screenshot: crisp typography, authentic spacing, realistic UI proportions, subtle rounded cards, white and gray text on near-black surfaces, blue accent color, polished anti-aliased icons, and a clean modern product-design aesthetic.

items.title: Satirical Spanish Sports Front Page
items.titleZh: A satirical Spanish sports newspaper front page designed like a tabloid cover, full-frame and perfectly frontal, on slightly aged off-white newsprint with subtle paper texture, faint stains, and narrow black border lines. The masthead is a huge red SPORT logo across the top on a bright yellow banner. In the upper right, include 1 small interview promo box with a headshot of a footballer and the text block in Spanish: “ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”. Under the masthead, add a yellow strip with bold black text “EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL” and a small red lightning bolt. The main headline dominates the page in gigantic black condensed uppercase letters over 2 lines: “LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”. Beneath it, add the subheadline in italic black Spanish text: “El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”. The main photo occupies the left-center and lower-middle of the page: a young footballer seen mostly from the back wearing a Barcelona home jersey in blue and garnet stripes, with the name “LAMILE” and the number “10” in large yellow lettering, standing in a celebratory stadium scene with confetti, bright lights, blurred fans, and people around him. He is holding or presenting a large bingo card board with the word “BINGO” at the top and “BINGO!” at the bottom. On the right side, create a vertical sidebar with 4 stacked content blocks: first, a photo of a calamari sandwich on a plate with the caption “El motivo del fichaje”; second, a red info box listing 3 humorous transfer facts in yellow and white text, exactly “EDAD: muy joven”, “FICHAJE: 4 cartones”, and “CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís”; third, a quotes column with 3 stacked mini-items, each with a small portrait and Spanish caption: “XAVI: ‘No me lo esperaba, pero respeto’”, “LAPORTA: ‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”, and “EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”; fourth, a small motorsport teaser at the bottom with a driver image and the text “FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”. Along the bottom strip, include 3 small teaser panels: 1 woman footballer holding a trophy with the text “CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”, 1 basketball panel with two Barça players and the text “BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”, and the Formula 1 teaser panel already integrated at the right edge. Add tiny newspaper metadata below the masthead on the left in Spanish, including issue number, date, and price, such as “Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”. The overall style should be hyper-realistic printed newspaper cover photography and editorial layout, with authentic magazine typography, strong black headlines, saturated sports-photo colors, comedic transfer-rumor parody tone, and seamless believable print design.
items.promptZh: 讽刺性的西班牙体育报纸头版，设计像小报封面，全画幅，正面完美，采用略显陈旧的灰白色新闻纸，纸张纹理微妙，有淡淡的污渍和狭窄的黑色边框线。报头顶部有一个巨大的红色 SPORT 标志，位于亮黄色横幅上。右上角包括 1 个小型采访宣传框，上面有一名足球运动员的头像和西班牙语文本块：“ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”。在刊头下方，添加一条黄色条带，上面写有粗体黑色文字“EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL”和一个红色小闪电。主标题以两行巨大的黑色压缩大写字母占据整个页面：“LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”。在其下方，添加黑色斜体西班牙语副标题：“El crash pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”。主照片占据页面的左中和中下位置：一位年轻的足球运动员主要从后面看到，他穿着蓝色和石榴石条纹的巴塞罗那主场球衣，上面写着“LAMILE”的名字和黄色大字的数字“10”，站在庆祝的体育场场景中，五彩纸屑、明亮的灯光、模糊的球迷和周围的人。他拿着或展示一个大宾果卡板，上面写着“BINGO”和“BINGO！”在底部。在右侧，创建一个包含 4 个堆叠内容块的垂直侧边栏：首先是盘子上的鱿鱼三明治照片，标题为“El motivo del fichaje”；其次，一个红色信息框，用黄白文字列出 3 个幽默的转会事实，正是“EDAD：muy joven”、“FICHAJE：4 cartones”和“CLÁUSULA：una partida de parchís”；第三，一个引用栏，包含 3 个堆叠的迷你项目，每个项目都有一个小肖像和西班牙语标题：“XAVI：‘No me lo esperaba，pero respeto’”、“LAPORTA：‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”和“EL VESTUARIO：Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”；第四，底部有一个小型赛车预告片，上面有车手图像和文字“FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”。沿着底部条带，包括 3 个小预告片：1 名女子足球运动员拿着奖杯，上面写着“CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”，1 个篮球面板上有两名巴萨球员，上面写着“BÁSQUET EL BARÇA，A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”，以及已经集成在右边缘的一级方程式预告片。在左侧标头下方添加西班牙语的小报纸元数据，包括发行号、日期和价格，例如“Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”。整体风格应该是超现实的印刷报纸封面摄影和社论布局，具有真实的杂志排版、强烈的黑色标题、饱和的体育照片色彩、喜剧转移谣言模仿的​​基调以及无缝可信的印刷设计。

items.title: Golden Hour Tech Rivals Portrait
items.titleZh: A candid low-angle photograph of two adult men standing in front of a traditional East Asian wooden building with warm brown timber framing and repeating green lattice window panels, shot during golden hour with strong warm sunlight and deep shadows. The man on the left is much closer to the camera, partially cropped, wearing a black zip-up jacket with a large white OpenAI logo on the chest and a gray panel on the sleeve. His arm is extended directly toward the lens, holding a cigarette in the extreme foreground so the hand and cigarette dominate the lower-left area and appear slightly out of focus due to shallow depth of field. The man on the right stands farther back, wearing a loose black T-shirt with a bold white "xAI" style logo on the chest, one hand raised near his mouth as if smoking or thinking. Both men have their faces obscured by smooth rectangular blur blocks, preserving anonymity. Use a realistic documentary street-photo aesthetic, natural skin tones, subtle lens distortion from a wide-angle perspective, cinematic contrast, rich sunset lighting, and a casual confrontational composition that emphasizes the brands on their clothing and the cigarette thrust toward the viewer. Include exactly 2 men, 1 cigarette visible in the foreground, 1 black jacket with the OpenAI emblem, and 1 black T-shirt with the xAI logo.
items.promptZh: 一张偷拍的低角度照片，拍摄的是两名成年男子站在一座传统的东亚木制建筑前，建筑有温暖的棕色木框架和重复的绿色格子窗板，拍摄时间是黄金时段，阳光强烈，阴影很深。左边的男人离镜头更近，剪短了一部分，穿着黑色拉链夹克，胸前有一个大的白色 OpenAI 标志，袖子上有灰色镶片。他的手臂直接伸向镜头，在最前景处拿着一根香烟，因此手和香烟占据了左下区域，并且由于景深较浅而显得稍微失焦。右边的男人站在更靠后的地方，穿着一件宽松的黑色T恤，胸前有醒目的白色“xAI”风格标志，一只手举到嘴边，好像在抽烟或思考。两人的脸都被光滑的矩形模糊块遮挡，以保持匿名。使用逼真的纪实街头照片美学、自然的肤色、广角视角的微妙镜头畸变、电影对比度、丰富的日落灯光以及强调服装上的品牌和向观众推力的香烟的随意对抗构图。恰好包括 2 名男子、前景中可见的 1 支香烟、1 件带有 OpenAI 标志的黑色夹克和 1 件带有 xAI 标志的黑色 T 恤。

items.title: Chaotic Road Trip Comedy Poster
items.titleZh: A bright, chaotic theatrical comedy movie poster in a polished Hollywood one-sheet style, vertical composition, with a retro yellow Mini Cooper speeding straight toward the viewer down a sunny palm-lined city street. The car is packed with exactly 5 vacationing friends: 2 visible in the front seats, 2 partially visible squeezed in the back, and 1 man sprawled on the roof luggage, pointing dramatically forward with a wild grin. Everyone wears colorful casual vacation clothes, including tropical prints, relaxed shirts, and sun hats. The scene feels loud, reckless, and fun. On the roof are stacked suitcases and travel bags. A police car with flashing lights chases from the rear right background. On the left side, a crooked wooden signpost has exactly 3 signs reading "BEACH", "MOUNTAINS", and "WHAT COULD GO WRONG?". A squawking seagull perches on top of the signpost. On the right side, a giant roadside donut shop sign reads "DONUT" and a folded paper map flies through the air. The street is full of motion blur, dust, debris, and tire energy, with a saturated blue sky and fluffy clouds above. At the very top, place exactly 4 actor names in black condensed caps: "DAVE JOHNSON", "LILY WANG", "KEVIN HARTLEY", and "AMY CHEN". Beneath that, add a stacked tagline in bold caps: "THEY CAME. THEY SAW." in dark navy, and "THEY MESSED EVERYTHING UP." in red. The main title dominates the upper middle in huge playful 3D typography: "{argument name="movie title" default="VACATION MODE"}", with "VACATION" in bright yellow and "MODE" in white, heavy blue shadowing, and the O replaced by a simple smiling face wearing sunglasses. Add small doodle-like yellow accent marks around the title. Across the lower right of the title, place a tilted hot-pink banner reading "A COMEDY ABOUT BAD IDEAS & GOOD TIMES" with a hand-drawn curved arrow pointing down. The car license plate reads "NO PLAN ALL FUN". Near the bottom, add a glowing pull-quote in yellow: "LAUGH-OUT-LOUD FUNNY!" and below it "- MOVIE BUZZ". At the bottom center, add the release line "ONLY IN THEATERS" and then "{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"}" in large bold yellow caps. Add tiny legal credits along the very bottom edge and small production logos in the corners, including "GOOD TIME FILMS" on the lower left and "NO PLAN ALL FUN" on the lower right. Use high-contrast lighting, exaggerated perspective, glossy commercial poster finish, vibrant summer colors, and a goofy road-trip comedy tone.
items.promptZh: 一张明亮、混乱的戏剧喜剧电影海报，采用抛光的好莱坞单页风格、垂直构图，一辆复古的黄色 Mini Cooper 在阳光明媚的棕榈树成荫的城市街道上笔直向观众驶来。车上正好挤满了 5 位度假的朋友：其中 2 个人坐在前排座位上，2 个人挤在后排，部分可见，还有 1 个人趴在车顶行李箱上，夸张地指着前方，咧着嘴笑。每个人都穿着色彩缤纷的休闲度假服装，包括热带印花、休闲衬衫和太阳帽。这个场景给人一种喧闹、鲁莽、有趣的感觉。屋顶上堆放着行李箱和旅行包。一辆闪着灯光的警车从右后背景追赶。左侧有一个弯曲的木制路标，上面正好有 3 个标牌，分别写着“海滩”、“山脉”和“什么地方出错了？”。一只嘎嘎叫的海鸥栖息在路标顶部。右侧，路边有一个巨大的甜甜圈店招牌，上面写着“DONUT”，一张折叠的纸质地图在空中飞舞。街道上充满了运动模糊、灰尘、碎片和轮胎能量，上面是饱和的蓝天和蓬松的云彩。在最顶部，正好放置 4 个黑色大写字母的演员名字：“DAVE JOHNSON”、“LILY WANG”、“KEVIN HARTLEY”和“AMY CHEN”。在其下方，添加一条用粗体大写字母堆叠的标语：“他们来了。他们看到了。”深海军蓝，“他们把一切都搞砸了。”红色。主标题以巨大的俏皮 3D 字体占据了中上部：“{argument name=”movie title” default=”VACATION MODE”}”，“VACATION”为亮黄色，“MODE”为白色，深蓝色阴影，O 被一个戴着墨镜的简单笑脸取代。在标题周围添加类似涂鸦的黄色小强调标记。在标题的右下角，放置一个倾斜的粉红色横幅，上面写着“关于坏想法和好时光的喜剧”，并带有一个向下的手绘弯曲箭头。汽车牌照上写着“NO PLAN ALL FUN”。在底部附近，添加一条黄色的发光引言：“大声笑，有趣！”以及其下方的“- MOVIE BUZZ”。在底部中心，添加发布行“ONLY IN THEATERS”，然后添加粗体黄色大写字母“{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"}”。在最底部边缘添加微小的法律制作人员，并在角落添加小制作徽标，包括左下角的“GOOD TIME FILMS”和右下角的“NO PLAN ALL FUN”。使用高对比度的灯光、夸张的视角、光滑的商业海报效果、充满活力的夏日色彩和愚蠢的公路旅行喜剧基调。

Card 6: “Lr”, label “LIGHTROOM”, subtitle “PHOTO MANAGEMENT”, with a landscape/photo icon, in cyan-teal. Card 7: “Xd”, label “XD”, subtitle “UI/UX DESIGN”, with a wireframe/app-window icon, in hot pink. items.title: Apple macOS Redesign Promo Mockup
items.titleZh: A polished Apple-style macOS promotional desktop mockup shown as a full-screen screenshot, with a soft pastel dawn wallpaper of layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. Centered near the top is a large minimalist headline reading "macOS" with the subheadline "Redesigned." and a smaller line below that says "More clarity. More focus. More you." The top system menu bar is visible across the full width: Apple logo, Finder, File, Edit, View, Go, Window, Help on the left; Wi‑Fi, battery, search, colorful user icon, and the date/time "Mon Jun 10  9:41 AM" on the right. On the left side, stack 4 translucent rounded widgets vertically: a weather widget for "Sonoma, CA" showing "65°", "Sunny", high/low "H:72°  L:55°", and 6 hourly temperatures from 10 AM to 3 PM; an "Up Next" widget with 2 calendar items, "Design Review" and "Lunch with Sophie" with times; a "Focus" widget showing "Do Not Disturb" and "On Until 10:00 AM"; and a "Notes" widget with the note "Website redesign" and time "3:30 PM". In the middle-left foreground, place a Finder window with rounded corners and a light frosted interface, titled "iCloud Drive". Include a left sidebar with 10 items total: Favorites with 6 items "AirDrop", "Recents", "Applications", "Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"; iCloud with 2 items "iCloud Drive" and "Shared"; and Locations with 1 item "Macintosh HD". In the main Finder area show 8 file items arranged in a grid: 4 folders on the top row labeled "Work", "Personal", "Projects", "Presentations", and 4 documents on the bottom row labeled "Brand Guidelines.pdf", "Project Brief.docx", "Research.png", "Moodboard.key". Add standard macOS traffic-light window buttons and small view/search controls in the title bar. On the right side, overlap a Mail app window with a three-column layout. The left mail list column is titled "Inbox" and shows "1237 messages" plus 5 visible senders/messages: "Antonio Manriquez" with subject "Design updates", "Jenny Court" with "Re: Team lunch", "Heather Lee" with "Q3 Planning", "Nisha Kumar" with "Re: Feedback", and "Simon Pickford" with "Offsite ideas". The reading pane shows the selected message from Antonio Manriquez to You with subject "Design updates" and body text about attached mockups for a new feature, plus a file attachment card labeled "Mockups.zip" and "12.4 MB". Use clean SF Pro-style typography, subtle shadows, translucent glassmorphism panels, soft ambient lighting, and a premium Apple keynote aesthetic. At the bottom center, include a glossy translucent macOS Dock with 15 icons: Finder, Launchpad, Safari, Messages, Mail, Calendar showing "JUN 10", Photos, Notes, Reminders, TV, Music, News, App Store, Settings, and Trash. Composition should feel balanced, airy, realistic, and highly refined, like an official Apple macOS redesign announcement image.

items.title: Chinese Co-Branded Summer Drink Poster
items.titleZh: Create a glossy Chinese co-branded beverage poster advertisement in a bold commercial style, vertical 4:5 composition, with a dramatic split-color background: bright saturated red on the left and vivid royal blue on the right, blended at the center with radiant streaks, motion lines, glow effects, and high-energy product-launch lighting. At the top, place 2 brand logo areas separated by a white multiplication sign: on the upper left, a snowman mascot logo with Chinese text {argument name="left brand name" default="蜜雪冰城"} and smaller subtitle text "始于1997冰淇淋与茶"; on the upper right, the deer logo and wordmark {argument name="right brand name" default="luckin coffee"} with smaller Chinese subtitle "专业咖啡新鲜式". Centered beneath the logos, add a huge Chinese headline in thick 3D extruded display typography with white faces, colored edging, heavy shadows, and a glossy embossed look, reading {argument name="headline text" default="蜜雪冰城 × 瑞幸咖啡"}, with the left half accented red and the right half accented blue. Below it, add a second slogan line in bold Chinese text, split by brand color, reading "冰爽甜蜜，咖啡加倍", flanked by short horizontal white dashes. Under that, place a rounded capsule banner in red-to-blue gradient containing the Chinese text "双品牌联名主打・人气招牌同框". In the center foreground, show 2 hero products: on the left, 1 vanilla soft-serve ice cream in a waffle cone, tall swirl, creamy white, slightly glossy, wrapped in a bright red cone sleeve printed with the snowman mascot and Chinese branding; on the right, 1 large clear plastic cup of iced latte or coffee with visible ice cubes, caramel-brown liquid marbling into milk, condensation droplets on the cup, a transparent lid, the blue deer logo, the wordmark "luckin coffee", and small Chinese subtitle text. Surround the cup with dynamic coffee splash arcs and exactly 3 flying coffee beans. Around the lower foreground, add scattered translucent ice cubes and white milk splashes to emphasize cold freshness. Include exactly 2 comic-style promotional burst badges: a red circular badge on the left reading "联名新品" and a blue circular badge on the right reading "限时热卖". In the bottom left corner, add 1 cute 3D snowman mascot character wearing a red cape and holding a tiny ice cream cone, smiling and winking. At the bottom center, place a large red-and-blue beveled ribbon banner with bold white Chinese text reading "今夏限定 立即尝鲜", ending with a yellow lightning bolt icon on the right. Along the very bottom edge, place 3 small selling-point items separated by vertical dividers: a snowflake icon with "冰爽甜蜜", a coffee bean icon with "咖啡加倍", and a heart icon with "双倍满足". Use premium e-commerce poster rendering, ultra-clean product retouching, glossy highlights, rich contrast, crisp Chinese typography, depth, reflections, splash effects, and an energetic summer limited-edition campaign aesthetic.

items.title: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision
items.titleZh: A sepia-toned ancient Chinese scroll painting reimagined as a visionary propaganda-style scene. In the center stands a scholarly robed figure styled like an imperial sage or philosopher, wearing flowing blue-gray hanfu with ornate trim, addressing a crowd of exactly 8 followers seen mostly from behind in the foreground. The sage’s face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur, and 3 members of the crowd also have blurred rectangular faces. The central figure raises one hand in a teaching gesture and holds a glowing geometric polyhedron crystal in the other hand. Behind him is a monumental hanging banner or framed plaque displaying the Google DeepMind logo and the words “Google DeepMind.” The background is a richly detailed traditional shanshui landscape with layered mountains, mist, trees, rocky formations, and a pagoda temple on the right. Along the upper right side, include vertical Chinese calligraphy text headed by “德米斯願景圖,” followed by several elegant columns of classical-style writing, plus a smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps. Use aged paper texture, muted brown ink, faded mineral pigments, fine linework, and the composition of a historic Chinese hanging scroll or literati painting, but with subtle anachronistic modern-AI symbolism. The overall mood is solemn, mythic, intellectual, and satirical, blending traditional East Asian art with corporate AI iconography.

items.title: Classical Chinese Scholar with XAI Motif
items.titleZh: A refined Chinese ink-painting style portrait on aged parchment, composed like a classical literati hanging scroll with muted sepia, tan, charcoal, and faded indigo tones. In the center stands a scholarly male figure in flowing dark blue-black Hanfu robes with intricate gold-patterned trim and wide cream inner sleeves, posed front-facing with a dignified stance. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blurred block, while his hair is dark, wavy, and neatly styled. He holds a stitched traditional-style book against his chest with a vertical cover inscription that includes the large Latin letters "XAI" and 4 Chinese text columns beneath it. His other hand rests on an ornate armillary sphere set on a carved pedestal at the lower left. Behind him is a monumental shanshui landscape of 1 mountain range, layered mist, rocky peaks, and drifting clouds, rendered with fine brushwork in an old master style. In the upper right sky area, place 1 bold modern "XAI" logo with the stylized emblem above the letters, and to the far right include 1 slender rocket launching upward beside a launch tower, with smoke billowing into the clouds, blending futuristic aerospace imagery into the classical scene. On the upper left, add 1 vertical column group of Chinese calligraphy title text in black ink, plus 1 smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps beneath it. The overall effect should fuse ancient Chinese scholar portraiture with space-age technology and AI symbolism, highly detailed, elegant, balanced, and slightly satirical, with the texture of antique paper and the composition of a museum-quality scroll painting.
items.promptZh: 古老羊皮纸上精致的中国水墨风格肖像，构图就像一幅古典文人挂轴，具有柔和的棕褐色、棕褐色、木炭色和褪色的靛蓝色调。正中有一儒雅男子，身着深蓝黑色汉服，金纹繁复，内袖奶油色，面朝前，神态威严。他的脸被一个矩形的模糊块故意遮挡，而他的头发是深色的，波浪形的，造型整齐。他胸前抱着一本缝制的传统风格的书，封面上有垂直的铭文，其中包括大拉丁字母“XAI”，下方有 4 个中文文本栏。他的另一只手放在左下方雕刻基座上的华丽浑天仪上。其身后，是一幅山峦叠嶂、峰峦叠嶂、云雾缭绕的山水景观，工笔画法，具有古人的风格。右上方天空区域放置1个醒目的现代“XAI”标志，字母上方带有风格化的徽章，最右侧包括1枚细长火箭在发射塔旁边向上发射，烟雾滚滚进入云层，将未来的航天意象与古典场景融为一体。在左上角添加 1 组黑色竖排中国书法标题文本，加上 1 条较小的竖签名线和 2 个红色印章。整体效果应将中国古代文人肖像与太空时代技术和人工智能象征主义相融合，高度细致、优雅、平衡，略带讽刺，具有古纸的质感和博物馆品质的卷轴画的构图。
