items.title: 人像电影感海报优雅
items.prompt: 先锋派平面设计海报页面，优雅的编辑排版，灰白色背景，4:5 纵横比。构建一个简洁的非对称模块化网格，包含四个不同的图像区块：一张 {argument name="human" default="[HUMAN]"} 的高对比度特写肖像，一张 {argument name="car" default="[CAR]"} 的电影感照片，一张 {argument name="animal" default="[ANIMAL]"} 的醒目图像，以及一张 [PLACE] 的氛围感照片，每张图像均置于各自的矩形区块内。以黑色为主色调，辅以 [ACCENT1] 和 [ACCENT2] 的微妙点缀，风格极简而精致。添加一个抽象变形或纹理面板，以强化实验性设计语言。包含一个醒目的标题“{argument name="title" default="[TITLE]"}”，一个极简主义小图标“[LOGO]”，微型排版，短篇编辑文本栏，细小的序列号，细分割线，小字说明，以及优雅的留白。高级时装平面设计美学，小众杂志页面，精致的瑞士风格与先锋派结合的构图，清晰的排版，单色摄影，微妙的模糊与纹理变化，考究的艺术指导。

items.title: 建筑海报品牌复古温暖
items.prompt:
目标：为个人创意账号创作一张方形复古海报风格的社交媒体页眉/品牌视觉图，主题为收集日常感官、记录共鸣瞬间并分享灵感。

画布：1:1 方形图片，温暖的孔版印刷质感，带有轻微褪色的纸张纹理，构图大胆。使用珊瑚粉色背景，超大的奶油色字体几乎填满整个画面。

布局：在画布上半部分放置巨大的压缩块状字母“MORE”，中间放置“SENSE”，并被画布边缘裁剪，使字母呈现出海报般的建筑感。在下方中心处，绘制一个人物坐在书桌前的简单线条画场景。右上角添加一个倾斜的票据形状标签。右下角附近添加一行手写的日文标语。底部添加一条细水平线，并排布 3 个导航词，中间用黄色小圆点隔开。

主要插画：简单的蓝绿色线条画，填充奶油色并带有珊瑚色点缀。展示 {argument name="character name" default="chi.okey"} 为一名留着波波头的短发角色，背影/侧影，坐在长方形书桌前的椅子上。人物身穿宽松毛衣、裙子或短裤、袜子和运动鞋，正在打开的笔记本上书写。书桌上包含 5 个可见物品：1 本打开的笔记本、1 盆小盆栽、1 个黄色马克杯、1 部智能手机或小卡片，以及 1 个小长方形物品。书桌右侧包含 1 只毛茸茸的绵羊吉祥物，拥有奶油色的羊毛身体、深色脸部和细小的腿。在椅子和桌子下方添加深蓝绿色的投影。

票据标签：在右上角绘制一张奶油色入场券风格的贴纸，带有蓝绿色轮廓、穿孔细节和小装饰标记。票据上的文字应包含粗体的“{argument name="account name" default="chi.okey"}”，下方为“SENSE COLLECTOR”，以及日文文案：“面白い！珍しい！心が動くモノだけ。”

底部文字：创建 3 个底部菜单项，使用蓝色大写字母及较小的英文小写说明：1) “COLLECT” 搭配 “what moves me”，2) “WRITE” 搭配 “what stays”，3) “SHARE” 搭配 “what inspires”。在三个项目之间放置 2 个黄色小圆点。

附加文字：在右下角附近，添加手写日文 “好きが、いちばんのセンス。” 并配有一条黄色短下划线。

视觉风格：极简日式杂志美学、复古孔版印刷、干净的矢量线条、蓝绿色轮廓、奶油色字体、珊瑚粉色背景、黄色点缀和马克杯。带有轻微的油墨错位感、细微的纸张斑点，品牌形象既俏皮又沉稳。

约束条件：保持构图简洁，保留超大且被裁剪的“MORE SENSE”字体，包含 1 只绵羊吉祥物，拒绝写实风格，不添加额外角色，无水印。

items.title: 奢侈品营销广告海报
items.prompt: 请使用上传的产品照片作为精确参考。保留产品包装的精确形状、比例、材质、颜色、盖子、标签、文字位置、Logo、设计细节以及整体可辨识的外观。请勿更改包装，请勿虚构不同的设计，请勿替换品牌，也请勿扭曲产品。创作一张超高端的广告海报，采用超写实产品营销的格式。主体对象即为参考照片中的产品。它必须是绝对的核心主体，并占据构图的主导地位。图像应看起来昂贵、简洁、美观、现代且具有广告感，如同世界级的奢侈品商业广告。使用垂直构图。将产品放置在正中心或略高于中心的位置。产品必须以极致的写实感呈现：准确的包装、逼真的材质、清晰的标签、清晰可辨的品牌标识、高级的反射、干净的高光、立体感以及精致的呈现。如果合适，可在产品周围添加与产品质地、配方或精髓相关的克制视觉点缀：如飘动的丝带、柔和的包裹动态、细腻的颗粒、水滴、奶油质感、玻璃光泽、芳香雾气或其他简洁的雕塑元素。一切都应看起来受控、优雅且高级，避免混乱或过载。背景应极简、干净、显贵，并带有柔和的深度渐变。背景颜色应与产品协调，并提升其高级感。不要添加多余物体，不要有拥挤的环境，不要有视觉杂质。灯光应采用高级影棚灯光，柔和且具有电影感。包装上有干净的高光、柔和的轮廓光、整洁的阴影、优美的立体感以及向背景过渡的优雅光影。图像应看起来诱人、干净、奢华且专业。图像必须包含俄语文字，不得有误，并完美融入设计中。使用极简的高级排版：简洁的现代字体，优雅的布局，无杂乱感。添加：品牌名称：“[BRAND NAME]”、产品名称：“[PRODUCT NAME]”、简短标语：“[SHORT SLOGAN]”、如有需要可添加短语：“[ADDITIONAL PHRASE]”。文字应看起来像是昂贵广告活动的一部分：简洁、时尚、高级且易读。整体氛围：奢华、高端商业、纯净美妆 / 奢华食品 / 高端生活方式 / 高端产品营销，具体取决于产品类型。最终风格：超写实产品摄影、高端广告美学、世界级广告品质、8k、简洁的奢华设计。负面提示词：扭曲的包装、错误的标签、薄弱的品牌标识、混乱的效果、杂乱的背景、廉价的广告风格、脏乱的阴影、噪点、不可读的文字、俄语文字错误、塑料质感、劣质材料、多余物体、草率的排版。

items.title: 建筑海报插画城市复古
items.prompt: 为埃及 {argument name="city name" default="亚历山大"} 创作一张层次丰富的复古旅行拼贴海报，背景采用带有细微污渍、折痕、地图网格线、邮戳、手写注释和深褐色纹理的陈旧羊皮纸。采用竖版海报构图，营造出 20 世纪 30 年代宏大的探险海报感，结合照片级拼贴、雕版插画和复古印刷设计。在最顶部左侧放置小号坐标文本“31°12’N 29°54’E”，居中放置“ALEXANDRIA, EGYPT”，右侧放置“EST. 331 BC”。主标题应占据上三分之一区域：巨大的深海军蓝粗衬线字体“ALEXANDRIA”，旁边配有醒目的红色阿拉伯语文本“الإسكندرية”。在标题下方添加标语“WHERE THE MEDITERRANEAN TELLS ITS TIMELESS STORY.”。将中心场景构建为密集的历史城市蒙太奇：左侧海边矗立着亚历山大灯塔（法罗斯灯塔），中央是暖色调石材的盖特贝城堡，其后方隐约可见现代化的亚历山大图书馆倾斜的圆盘屋顶，一根旗杆上挂着埃及国旗，一个巨大的柔和金色太阳圆环，地中海海岸线和港口水域，以及一张标有“MEDITERRANEAN SEA”和“ALEXANDRIA”的淡色古地图。在标题区域附近添加 2 只飞鸟。包含 3 个圆形邮戳或印章元素：左上方一个亚历山大灯塔邮戳，底部中央一个带有波浪图案的亚历山大邮戳，以及咖啡馆店面附近的一个小型装饰性印章。在左侧添加 2 个引用/注释框：一个框内的拿破仑·波拿巴名言“I have not seen any place that can compare with it.”，以及手写笔记“Qaitbay Citadel”和“Lighthouse of Alexandria”。下半部分展示繁华的亚历山大老街：中心前景是轨道上一辆编号为 215 的绿色复古电车，右侧是一辆黑黄相间的经典出租车，后方是一辆奶油红相间的巴士，还有棕榈树、行人、古老的欧洲建筑立面和阳台，左侧有 Rue Fouad 和 Café Farouk 的招牌，右侧有 Florence 的招牌。在前景中包含一个市场和食物展示，共有 6 组突出的食物/陈列：一大盘配有柠檬的烤鱼和虾、一碗面包卷、一篮番茄和蔬菜、一筐橙子、一个写有阿拉伯文的粗麻袋，以及一个写有阿拉伯文的图案木制农产品箱。在左下角添加一个包含 5 个项目的“必看清单”：Qaitbay Citadel, Bibliotheca Alexandrina, Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, Montazah Palace & Gardens, The Corniche。在底部中央书写“A CITY OF MANY LAYERS, A STORY THAT NEVER ENDS.”，下方书写“DISCOVER HER PAST. LIVE HER PRESENT. LOVE HER FOREVER.”。最后在右下角重复坐标。配色方案：褪色的奶油色羊皮纸、海军蓝墨水、铁锈红阿拉伯字母、暖砂岩色、青色海面、柔和的绿色、出租车黄、太阳赭石色。保持排版清晰易读，使拼贴画极其精细且连贯，无现代水印，无额外 Logo，无无关文本。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
创建一个垂直的 4:5 超现实编辑肖像，描绘一位 21 岁的成年东亚女性，优雅的椭圆形脸，轮廓柔和的下巴，笔直的黑眉毛，杏仁眼紧闭，精致的直鼻，柔和饱满的珊瑚粉色嘴唇微张，温暖的浅米色皮肤，质感真实，长直的深栗色头发在中心附近分开，耳朵周围有几缕松散的发丝。她穿着一件衬里牢固的不透明象牙色连衣裙，配有宽大的折叠肩带、朴素的雕刻方形垂褶领口，以及包裹她的躯干和下半身的大量白色丝绸面料。双手漂浮在脸的左侧附近，手掌放松，手指微妙地分开，下巴向着光线抬起。

保真度——最高优先级：从这些书面事实中重建椭圆形的面部几何形状、闭上的杏仁眼、抬起的下巴、分开的嘴唇、中分的黑发、宽阔的白色带子、举起的手、包裹着的白色丝绸、空气中的金色叶子、偏离中心的上半身位置、硬定向阳光、灰灰色背景和宁静的悬浮气氛。仅应用规定的成年年龄标准化；请勿以其他方式重新设计、美化、苗条、放大、压平或抑制自然曲线、改变衣柜或改变心情。

使用从脸到颈到肩的路线作为主要线，以不透明褶皱下方轻轻转动的腰部作为次要线。当胸部被牢固地覆盖时，她的肩膀稍微向右旋转；宽大的带子结构、抬起的胸腔、温和的后倾头角、逼真的重力和雕刻的阳光，使成人的轮廓在不强调解剖学的情况下可读。将她从大腿中部向上放置在垂直框架的左下角和中央。一条巨大的光滑象牙色丝带从较低的前景涌出，绕过她的手臂和躯干，然后沿着右边缘以戏剧性的螺旋上升到顶部，具有可信的折痕、重量、张力和半透明的边缘发光，而所有身体覆盖仍然不透明。在不同深度撒上十几片小赭色和淡金色的秋叶；有几张被锐利冻结，有几张在镜头附近模糊。使用中低相机位置和 65 毫米编辑镜头，浅景深，来自左上方的强烈温暖阳光，创建图形面部阴影和光芒四射的织物高光，微妙的冷填充，淡灰灰色无缝背景，精致的光晕和精细的胶片颗粒。情绪状态是一阵风中的欣喜若狂的寂静。没有文字、徽标、水印、签名、二维码、露骨裸露或亲密暴露。

items.title: 人像海报写实温暖
items.prompt:
目标：创作一张优质的 FC Barcelona 足球官宣海报，以 {argument name="player name" default="Robert Lewandowski"} 为核心明星，采用粗犷的编辑体育设计风格。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 纵横比，做旧的米白色纸张纹理，带有微妙的圆形线条图案、轻微的垃圾风格斑点，以及精致的优质编辑排版。

布局：顶部中央放置 FC Barcelona 队徽。左上角书写“MAY 17, 26”，前方加一条短细的金线。右上角书写“FC BARCELONA”并添加白色的“Pollo.ai”水印。主背景包含 3 个高大的垂直黑白肖像面板：左侧面板展示球员胸部以上、略微向右的侧脸；中央面板展示正面特写肖像；右侧面板展示球员手持或拉扯胸前球衣的动作。所有 3 个背景人脸均被柔和的矩形灰色模糊遮罩覆盖。在面板前方，放置 1 个球员自信站立的全身彩色剪影，其面部同样被垂直的柔和灰色模糊遮罩覆盖。

主体细节：前景中的球员身穿现代 FC Barcelona 主场球衣，采用海军蓝和深红色垂直条纹，配有黄色 Nike 对勾标志、Barcelona 队徽、Spotify 赞助商标志、带有数字 9 的蓝色短裤、蓝色长袜和浅色足球鞋。他直立站立，一只手叉腰，另一只手在身侧拿着一个欧冠风格的足球。在球员剪影周围使用细红色的轮廓光，将其与单色背景区分开来。

文字内容：在底部中央，使用巨大的粗体压缩大写字体。第一行：“ROBERT”，深海军蓝色。第二行：“LEWANDOWSKI”，深红色。在左下角添加一个带有小数字“9”的金色签名图形。在最底部，添加简短的大写传记文字：“ROBERT LEWANDOWSKI IS A POLISH PROFESSIONAL FOOTBALLER WHO PLAYS AS A STRIKER FOR LA LIGA CLUB FC BARCELONA AND CAPTAINS THE POLAND NATIONAL TEAM.” 在底部角落附近添加两个微小的垂直强调条，采用 Barcelona 的配色。

视觉风格：高对比度体育海报，写实摄影与平面设计相结合，富有戏剧性的颗粒感，黑白面板周围有温暖的金色粉尘高光，锐利的排版，优质的比赛日收藏海报美学。

约束条件：总共包含 4 个球员形象：3 个单色背景肖像和 1 个全身彩色前景人物。保持可见的面部区域用灰色模糊矩形进行匿名化处理。不要添加额外的球员、奖杯、体育场观众或无关的标志。

items.prompt: 仅使用上传的人像作为身份参考。保留人物真实的五官特征、脸型、肤色、发型和自然的身体比例。创建一个 {argument name="photo type" default="逼真的摄影棚风格照片拼贴"}，采用 {argument name="layout" default="多个重叠人像框"} 的布局：包含面部特写、侧脸、半身姿势、全身姿势、头发/细节特写以及放松的坐姿。使用 {argument name="background" default="干净的米灰色摄影棚背景"}，柔和的室内光线，自然的皮肤纹理，逼真的手机摄影/杂志大片质感，搭配适合人物的现代休闲服装，带有白色照片边框，布局略微倾斜，细节丰富且自然。无 Logo，无水印，无文字。

items.title: Logo 集成与马克笔叠加效果
items.prompt:
第一张图片为插图。第二张图片包含黑色背景上的 Logo 设计。

将 Logo 放置在插图中最大、最整洁的空白区域——即线条、形状和视觉元素最少的区域。{argument name="placement note" default="[在此处添加关于放置位置的简要说明]"}

复刻第二张图片中的 Logo 原样。以粗犷的手绘笔触进行渲染，呈现出如同用粗马克笔直接在表面签名般的效果。允许 Logo 略微溢出空白区域，延伸至相邻的插图内容中。

颜色规则：Logo 颜色必须始终与下方的背景形成对比。在浅色背景上使用深色线条，在深色背景上使用浅色线条。如果 Logo 跨越多种背景色调，请在笔触中途切换颜色。切勿让 Logo 与周围颜色融合。

请勿以任何其他方式修改插图。请务必完整保留所有原始颜色、线条和构图。

items.title: 情侣胶片电影感黄昏霓虹优雅
items.prompt:
目标：使用浪漫的婚礼摄影美学、忧郁的氛围和优雅的编辑排版，创作一张电影感竖版订婚派对邀请函海报。

画布：9:16 竖版邀请函设计，全出血照片背景，深色黄昏色调，柔和的胶片颗粒感，高端奢华婚礼文具风格。

背景图像：雨后黄昏时分广阔的草地，背景是雾气弥漫的常青森林、深蓝灰色的山脉、低垂的雾气和戏剧性的多云天空。在画面下方中央，展示一对订婚情侣手牵手背影，正穿过田野奔跑：左侧的男士身穿象牙白西装，手持带有飘带的小花束；右侧的女士身穿飘逸的白色吊带婚纱，轻轻提起裙摆，长长的深色秀发在风中飘动。在右侧远景处增加一座微小的暖光小屋或庄园建筑，以增强深度感。

主要视觉效果：在天空的中上方，放置一行巨大的发光霓虹手写体，内容为 {argument name="main script text" default="We're Engaged"}。霓虹灯应为珊瑚粉色，超大尺寸，线条流畅，呈现不完美的草书效果，具有明亮的内部光感、柔和的红色光晕，以及向左右边缘延伸的长长笔触。

文本内容：包含 6 个独立的文本块，除霓虹书法外，其余全部居中对齐，采用纤细、字间距宽阔的大写衬线体或小型大写字母。1) 顶部小字行：{argument name="top invitation text" default="PLEASE JOIN US FOR AN"}。2) 下方："ENGAGEMENT PARTY"。3) 主要霓虹书法：{argument name="main script text" default="We're Engaged"}。4) 底部日期/时间：{argument name="date and time" default="06.21.2025\nAT 6:00 PM"}。5) 场地信息块：{argument name="venue name" default="GREENFIELD ESTATE"}，下方附地址：{argument name="venue address" default="123 MEADOW LANE\nWILLOWBROOK, OR"}。6) 底部最后一行小字："RECEPTION TO FOLLOW"。

布局：将顶部邀请文字置于天空上方，保持宽阔的字间距；霓虹书法占据天空主导位置并与山脉区域重叠；情侣位于画面下方三分之一处；将日期、场地、地址和招待会文字堆叠在下方的草地区域，确保对比度适中且保持优雅感。

视觉风格：忧郁浪漫的编辑摄影风格，电影级深度，自然动态，柔和雾气，低调的绿色与炭蓝色，发光的珊瑚色霓虹书法，高级订婚邀请函设计，简约而精致。

约束条件：不要添加边框、Logo、二维码、额外的装饰图标或额外文字。情侣比例要小，以突出景观和排版。确保所有六个文本块的可读性。

items.title: 男孩动漫插画山温暖优雅
items.prompt: 一张印在纹理米白色纸张上的怀旧水彩动漫海报，采用受 20 世纪 90 年代末冒险动漫启发的竖版双重曝光插画构图。主体轮廓为一名年轻男孩的左侧侧脸，头上戴着一副向上推起的护目镜，面部朝向右侧，轮廓内填充着如梦似幻的记忆与奇幻场景蒙太奇。在轮廓上方的中心位置，展示 8 名儿童背对镜头站立在山脊上，望向云雾缭绕的蓝紫色天空中一个圆形天体传送门下方发光的远方水晶塔；他们身旁伴有 7 只小型生物伙伴。在轮廓内部的右上角，放置一只从云层中显现的巨型龙状怪物。在中心附近，添加一个发光的圆形手持数字设备，屏幕微亮，向外辐射光芒。在中下部区域，描绘 2 只标志性的小型恐龙状生物坐在古老的神社参道上方，其中一只是紫色长角生物，另一只是小型黄色爬行类生物。在底部区域，展示一座长满青苔的鸟居、杂草丛生的石阶、电线杆以及右侧的一列小型乡村火车，所有景物都笼罩在薄雾与植被之中。在最底部，再次呈现 8 名儿童作为微小剪影沿着小路并肩远去的画面，强化友谊与回忆的主题。使用柔和的水墨与水彩渲染，色调为柔和的蓝色、靛蓝、薰衣草紫、深褐色以及温暖的金色高光，并带有飞溅的颜料边缘和绘画感的云层纹理。保持构图的通透与优雅，具备精致的现代海报设计感，几乎没有常见的 AI 塑料感。在右侧添加竖排日文文字“あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。”，并在左下角放置日文标题 Logo“デジモンアドベンチャー”，配以小型英文副标题“DIGIMON ADVENTURE”以及日期行“1999 - 永遠の冒険”。

items.title: 建筑写实Logo未来沙漠
items.prompt: 创建一个电影级写实风格的广角镜头，展示位于沙漠峡谷中、处于黄金时刻的未来感军事指挥大院。场景中，一座巨大的混凝土与钢结构战术基地从左中向右上对角延伸，建筑采用粗野主义风格，带有风化的棕褐色混凝土、深色金属饰边、工业通风口、装甲门、栏杆、天线塔、泛光灯，以及位于上方中心附近的控制塔。在设施上添加 4 处醒目的文字标记：一个黑色标牌，上面写着 {argument name="facility name" default="DELTA FORCE"}，下方附有较小的文字 "TACTICAL COMMAND CENTER"；一块标有 {argument name="sector label" default="A2"} 的大型蓝色墙板，下方带有较小的 "SECTOR" 文字；一个大型橙色门牌号 {argument name="door number" default="12"}；以及控制塔上一个小型三角形警告风格的徽标。在前景中，放置一个横跨下画面的大型混凝土路障，上面涂有黑黄相间的对角危险条纹，并带有污垢、缺口和两个金属吊环。在其后方，包含一条沿着基地弯曲的空旷铺装道路、低矮的安全围栏、护柱、堆叠的板条箱以及工业堆场的细节。背景左侧有岩石沙漠悬崖，几棵稀疏的棕榈树，以及温暖的橙色日落天空，太阳位于左侧地平线附近，伴有柔和的云层。使用略微倾斜的动态摄像机角度，16:9 纵横比，中低视角，高细节游戏电影级写实感，戏剧性的暖色轮廓光，长阴影，清晰的纹理，逼真的灰尘和风化效果，无人，无车辆，无水印。

items.title: 数字故障艺术静物花
items.prompt: 竖屏 9:16 的数字故障艺术静物。近黑炭灰纯色背景，中央一根细长玫瑰枝自下而上贯穿画面，分布三至四朵盛开的巨大玫瑰：奶油白、桃粉、珊瑚红渐变花瓣，真实柔软、半透明边缘和细腻自然褶皱；叶片为低饱和鼠尾草绿，枝条与叶脉清楚。花与枝周围发生受控的数据损坏：大小不一的硬边矩形切片水平错位，局部复制、缺失或延伸成细窄 RGB 扫描条；故障色取样自花朵与叶片，包含粉、青、薄荷绿、紫和少量橙。上半部故障较稀疏，中部围绕花朵密集，底部叶片逐渐分解并汇聚成向下延伸的多色垂直条码瀑布。主体保持摄影级植物质感，故障块保持数字硬边，不添加光斑、文字、容器或其他物体。无 logo、无签名、无水印。

items.title: 3D 品牌广告样机
items.prompt: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="[在此输入品牌名称]"} 创作一个富有创意的 3D 广告，展示一个由该品牌元素构成的超现实物体。使用相匹配的背景色，在下方放置真实标语，并将 Logo 置于顶部。加入一个与该物体互动的小人，保持整体概念极简、巧妙且具有视觉冲击力。

items.title: 建筑海报字体城市复古
items.prompt: 创作一张复古装饰艺术风格的旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="孟买"}，{argument name="country name" default="印度"}。使用 2:3 的竖向海报画布，带有细双线边框，并呈现出暖赭色、深褐色和日落金色的旧纸质感。在最上方，放置巨大的粗体压缩衬线字体，写着“MUMBAI”，颜色为深青色，几乎横跨整个宽度。在其正下方左侧，添加间距宽阔的大写红色字母，写着“INDIA”。下方加入一个简单的线稿日出图标，接着是一行斜体标语“The City That Never Sleeps.”，以及一个带有居中圆点的小型装饰分隔符。在分隔符下方，添加坐标文本 {argument name="coordinates" default="19.0760° N, 72.8777° E"}。下三分之二处应展示海滨印度门的电影感日落景观，以写实的复古海报风格呈现：纪念碑位于中右侧，体量宏大，拱门和塔楼清晰可见；背景是橙色发光的天空和云朵，太阳低悬于地平线附近，波光粼粼的水面上有几艘小船，前景是沿海滨大道（Marine Drive）蜿蜒的滨海公路。在前景下方的道路上包含一辆黑黄相间的复古出租车，左侧背景有小型城市天际线建筑、棕榈树、路灯、石质海堤，以及纪念碑附近零星的微小行人。保持排版清晰易读，带有怀旧颗粒感、轻微褪色的墨迹和细腻的半色调纹理，不要包含任何现代物体、Logo 或多余的文字。

items.title: 建筑动漫写实复古冷调
items.prompt: 创作一幅生动的夏季海滨场景，采用精致的动漫写实插画风格，构图比例为 2:3 竖屏。在左下角的前景中，放置一张圆形的白色咖啡桌，桌上放着 1 杯高透明玻璃杯装的冰镇柠檬苏打，杯中可见气泡、冷凝水珠和 1 片柠檬；阳光在桌面上投下清晰的棕榈叶阴影。在右侧，展示一辆光泽亮丽的 {argument name="car color" default="亮红色"} 复古敞篷跑车，停在白色海滨建筑旁，驾驶座车门敞开，可见黑色仪表盘、棕褐色真皮座椅、方向盘和镀铬轮毂，车身上映出棕榈叶的强烈倒影。建筑拥有白色灰泥墙、深屋檐、绿松石色窗框、大面积反光玻璃窗以及锐利的热带阴影。上方从顶部边缘延伸出棕榈叶，在墙面和车身上投下长长的阴影。背景是一条安静的海滨公路，沿着湛蓝的大海向远处延伸，配有白色护栏、鹅卵石路面、低矮的浪花、远处的海岸线，以及布满高耸白色积云的深蓝色天空。采用强烈的正午阳光，高对比度，饱和的青色海洋与天空，营造干净的度假氛围，线条清晰，倒影细节丰富，画面中无人、无 Logo、无可见文字、无水印。强调在炎热的海滨咖啡馆度过一天后，享用一杯冰镇 {argument name="drink" default="柠檬苏打"} 的清凉感。

items.title: 女性海报品牌
items.prompt: 一张为 {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"} 制作的高端摄影广告海报，采用单色淡蓝色与白色调，配有光泽感的反射地面和柔和的天蓝色背景。背景中醒目地展示着巨大的白色粗体无衬线压缩字体 {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"}，几乎占据了整个画面的高度。在右上角添加一行白色小字：“Designed with ChatGPT”。画面中包含 3 位留着齐肩波浪形浅棕色至深金色头发的成年女性，她们均身穿宽松的白色长袖上衣和飘逸的白色阔腿裤，造型如同极简主义时尚模特，表情自然放松。她们的面部被刻意遮挡或模糊处理。一位模特斜靠在左侧巨大的直立白色洞洞鞋上，一位模特随意地坐在右上方的巨大白色洞洞鞋上，另一位模特则斜倚在右下方的地面上，单手撑地，半坐在一个光泽感的蓝色球体上。画面包含 2 只巨大的白色洞洞鞋作为核心道具：一只在左侧垂直站立，展示鞋底和侧面轮廓；另一只在右中部的蓝色水晶块上倾斜放置，展示鞋面和鞋头。两只洞洞鞋均为经典的泡沫套穿款式，带有透气孔、厚实鞋底、后跟带和圆形标志铆钉。右中部的洞洞鞋鞋面上装饰着 8 个清晰可见的鞋花：一个蓝绿色虹彩圆形鞋花、一朵黄色花心的白色雏菊、鞋带附近的一个黑白圆形徽章、一个小型的“CROCS”文字鞋花、一朵深色花朵、一个和平手势标志、一个橙色笑脸、一朵白云以及一朵橙色花朵。在场景周围散布 7 个大小不一、具有光泽感的悬浮或落地蓝色球体：左侧模特身后有一个大球，中心附近悬浮一个中球，左下角前景有一个中球，右下角模特下方用作座椅的一个中球，左上方有一个小球，以及另外 2 个融入构图的蓝色球体。在最左侧和最右侧边缘添加半透明的雕塑感凝胶状形态，并在右侧鞋子下方放置棱角分明的蓝色水晶状岩石。在底部中心，放置简洁的无衬线字体白色宣传文案：第一行为 {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."}，第二行为 {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."}。在其下方，展示 4 个极简主义功能图标及白色标签：“ICONIC COMFORT”（标志性舒适）、“LIGHTWEIGHT”（轻盈）、“EASY TO CLEAN”（易于清洁）和“UNIQUELY YOU”（独一无二的你）。在底部中心放置 {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} 粗体小写白色标志，并带有小型商标符号。整体风格应呈现出高端超现实时尚大片的质感，具备干净的编辑级布光、柔和的阴影、光泽质感、通透的构图以及现代生活方式的产品广告感。

items.title: 食物海报产品雪冷调
items.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗"} 创建一张竖版中式餐饮推广海报，宣传一款口感清爽的冰镇甜品碗，要求展现逼真诱人的质感、配料、卖点及价格。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，暖奶油米色背景，带有柔和的热带阳光感，右上角有淡淡的棕榈叶阴影，左上角有一杯模糊的柠檬饮品，底部角落散落着水果道具，呈现高端甜品店的广告风格。

布局：居中构图。顶部放置椰子品牌 Logo 图标及品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="椰殿"}，下方配有小字标语“甜得有层次”及纤细的装饰分割线。下方使用深棕色大号中文字体标题“杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗”。标题下方添加一个圆角金色胶囊标签，内含“冰镇甜品碗”字样，并配有小碗图标和雪花图标。画面中心主体为一个透明玻璃碗，盛满芒果黄果泥、浓郁椰乳、晶莹剔透的波波、红西柚果粒及光泽诱人的芒果丁。一把金勺从右上角伸入，舀起芒果丁、波波、西柚及滴落的椰乳。顶部点缀薄荷叶以增加新鲜感。

食物细节：确保甜品超写实且富有光泽：碗中清晰可见 5 种配料——芒果丁、浓郁椰乳、红西柚果粒、晶莹波波及薄荷叶。展示堆叠的高耸芒果块、碗缘的奶油白椰乳层、底部的橙色芒果泥，以及冷凝水珠带来的清凉感。

左侧边栏：一个圆角竖向奶油色卡片，标题为“成分亮点”，包含 4 个垂直排列的配料亮点，每个配料配有写实插图及中文说明：1) 芒果插图，“爱文芒果 / 不打泥，保留果肉”；2) 椰子插图，“泰国椰乳 / 椰肉现榨”；3) 西柚插图，“红西柚粒 / 爆汁微苦”；4) 波波插图，“脆波波 / 无香精”。

右侧边栏：一个圆角竖向奶油色卡片，标题为“产品卖点”，包含 4 个垂直排列的圆形线框图标及中文说明：1) 芒果图标，“半斤芒果 / 一碗顶一杯”；2) 椰子图标，“椰乳代替淡奶 / 更轻更滑”；3) 雪花图标，“冰碗出品 / 从第一口冷到最后”；4) 水滴图标，“不加一滴水 / 纯果 + 椰乳”。

价格与行动号召：碗下方放置一个棕色笔触风格的价格条，上方标注小字“价格”，下方为醒目的白色大号价格 {argument name="price" default="32元 / 碗"}。下方放置一个圆角白金配色 CTA 按钮，带有勺子图标及文字 {argument name="call to action" default="挖一勺夏天"}。

底部区域：添加一条纤细的分割线及中文文案“更多新品与门店动态，可在以下平台搜索”。横向排列 4 个平台图标：抖音、小红书、美团及大众点评风格的橙色图标。最底部添加一个圆角搜索栏，文字为“搜索：椰殿”。

视觉风格：高端中式甜品海报，明亮的芒果黄与椰子白配色，深巧克力棕色字体，金色点缀，简洁的商业排版，写实食物摄影与精致平面设计结合，高对比度，细节锐利，诱人的湿润高光，柔和阴影，画面中无人。

约束：确保所有中文字符清晰可辨且位置准确。使用 2 个侧边信息卡片，侧边栏共计 8 个功能项，底部 4 个平台图标，以及一个中心甜品碗。禁止添加额外价格、额外产品、水印、二维码或无关文字。

items.title: 男性插画极简
items.prompt: 创作一幅现代协作办公场景的简洁扁平化矢量插画，背景为暖奶油色。画面中需精确展示 3 位坐在同一张长款黑色办公桌前的同事，整体采用大胆的极简几何风格，除少量黑色细线条细节外不含轮廓线，且人物面部特征需通过柔和的方形模糊块进行遮挡。左侧是一位身材苗条的男性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 的侧分发型，佩戴红色眼镜，坐在粉色椅子上，身穿白色衬衫外搭青色夹克，下着黑色九分裤，脚穿白底青色运动鞋，正在使用一台带有青色支架的大型黑色台式显示器打字；键盘旁放置一个黄色马克杯。中间是一位留着黑色高发髻的曲线型身材女性，坐在青色椅子上，身穿亮粉色高领上衣，佩戴大型黄色圆形耳环，下着青色阔腿裤，脚穿黑色鞋子；她手持一张白纸，正在查阅文件。右侧是一位留着黑色波波头的女性，坐在青色椅子上，身穿白色短袖衬衫，下着亮黄色阔腿裤，脚穿黑色运动鞋；她正使用一支触控笔在倾斜的黑色数位板上绘画。画面需包含 8 个清晰可见的桌面物品：1 台大型台式显示器、1 个黄色马克杯、1 叠黑白书籍、中间同事手持的 1 张白纸、1 个黑色文件托盘、托盘内放置的 3 个黄色、青色及粉色文件夹、1 个倾斜的数位板、1 支黑色触控笔，以及 1 个装有 2 支黑色钢笔的粉色笔筒。采用 4:3 横向构图，人物上方留有充足的空白空间，边缘清晰，运用青色、亮粉色、黄色、黑色和白色的高对比度配色，呈现出友好的编辑插画风格。避免出现文字、Logo、照片写实感、阴影、渐变及额外的人物。

items.title: 单色 AI 咖啡海报
items.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="LETZ.AI"} 创作一张极具戏剧张力的单色广告海报，将高端外带咖啡杯与富有远见的 AI 成长隐喻相结合。

画布：竖版海报，比例约为 4:5，仅限黑白，高对比度，电影级布光，奢华科技品牌美学。使用深色纹理桌面背景，杯子后方上方设有明亮的聚光灯，并投下深邃的阴影。

布局：左上方放置品牌标识“LETZ.AI”，采用纤细且字间距较宽的大写字母，并带有小型注册商标符号。右上方展示一个黑色外带咖啡杯，配有黑色塑料杯盖，采用背光照明；杯身正面印有巨大的白色块状字母“L”，下方附有小型文字“LETZ.AI”。咖啡杯在海报下半部分投下长长的三角形阴影。在阴影内部，呈现出如同投影在桌面上的超现实灰度景观：一个孤独的人站在岩石悬崖上，望向远处的未来城市天际线，城市中心有一枚火箭垂直发射升空，冲向多云的天空，地平线附近有明亮的太阳光晕。

主标题：在左侧标志下方，设置三行堆叠的粗体压缩大写标题：“FUEL.”、“FOCUS.”、“FORWARD.”。使用高而窄的无衬线字体，颜色为白色或浅灰色。下方添加一行小型且字间距较宽的大写副标题：“AI THAT MOVES AS FAST AS YOU DO.”，并配有一条短而细的下划线作为点缀。

底部功能栏：在底部边缘添加 3 个功能项，由 2 条细垂直分割线隔开。这 3 个功能项分别为：1) 闪电图标，标签为“REAL-TIME INTELLIGENCE”；2) 十字准星/目标图标，标签为“PRECISION AUTOMATION”；3) 向上的对角箭头图标，标签为“UNSTOPPABLE GROWTH”。图标需保持极简风格，采用白色线条艺术，搭配小型大写标签。

主体细节：阴影中的场景必须包含 1 个人的剪影、1 枚火箭、1 个城市天际线、1 条蜿蜒的河流，以及环绕山谷的山脉剪影。咖啡杯必须是视觉焦点，质感需真实，呈现哑光黑色，边缘高光清晰，并带有细腻的颗粒感。

视觉风格：高端黑白商业摄影与电影级哑光绘画超现实主义的融合，产品焦点锐利，带有大气雾感，强烈的明暗对比，戏剧性的三角形构图，充满灵感的初创企业/AI 广告氛围。

约束条件：严格保留所有可见文字，避免添加额外的标语或多余物体，严禁色彩点缀，除品牌标识外不得有水印，保持画面整洁，具有编辑感。

items.title: 食物涂鸦字体咖啡馆
items.prompt:
以提供的参考照片为基础，保持原图不变，在上方添加一层充满情感的 Instagram 风格白色细笔手写标注，营造出直接书写在照片上的视觉效果。请勿更改羊角面包、咖啡、桌面、光影、裁剪或背景；仅添加排版文字、下划线、箭头、小型涂鸦标记以及一颗爱心。

叠加风格：随性的日式手写字体，温馨的咖啡馆日记氛围，笔触略带不完美感，呈现白色粉笔或油漆笔的质感，并配有指向羊角面包和咖啡杯的细箭头。保持文字清晰易读且自然，字号与间距错落有致。

添加 9 处独立的手写文本块：
1. 左上角大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="朝のごほうび"}，配有双下划线和小型闪烁装饰笔触。
2. 下方较小的副标题：{argument name="subtitle text" default="焼きたての香りで 今日がはじまる。"}，配有一条长长的弧形下划线。
3. 左侧中部指向羊角面包的笔记：{argument name="butter note" default="バターの香り、ふわり"}。
4. 左下角指向羊角面包尖端的笔记："先端まで きれい"。
5. 中心位置指向光泽表面的笔记："表面の照りが たまらない"。
6. 右上角指向羊角面包层次的笔记："さくっと 軽い層"。
7. 盘子附近底部居中的笔记，带下划线："この立体感が好き"。
8. 右下角指向咖啡杯的笔记："やさしい一口"。
9. 底部手写结束语：{argument name="closing phrase" default="なんでもない朝が、少し好きになる。♡"}，并带有下划线。

构图建议：将大部分文字放置在背景中较暗的墙面或窗户区域，以及食物周围，避免过度遮挡羊角面包主体。使用弧形箭头、点状强调标记、波浪形下划线和小型装饰笔触将笔记与羊角面包和咖啡连接起来。请勿添加任何 Logo、边框、贴纸或其他额外元素。

items.title: 动物插画海报山优雅
items.prompt: 创作一张竖版海报插画，主体为 {argument name="animal" default="丹顶鹤"}，采用精致的几何艺术风格，居中站立在宁静的 {argument name="landscape theme" default="蓝绿色东亚山水"} 之中。使用 2:3 纵向画布。丹顶鹤全身像，身姿高挑优雅，面向左侧，长喙向上倾斜，头顶有红色冠羽，身体洁白，颈部有黑色条纹，尾羽呈黑色，细长的红黑色双腿在静水中映出淡淡倒影。鸟身由简洁的层叠曲线、纤细的轮廓线以及类似装饰艺术风格（Art Deco）的几何羽毛板块构成。背景为青色和玉色，点缀着云雾缭绕的山峦、平静的湖泊、风格化的圆形云朵、左下角的简化松树、两侧深色的圆形岛屿，以及鹤颈左侧的一轮扁平红色太阳。背景需包含 5 组主要元素：1 个红色太阳圆盘，1 组位于右上角的大型层叠山脉，1 组横跨中部的较小山水云雾，1 组位于左下角的风格化松树，以及底部左右两侧各 1 个深色岸边岛屿。视觉氛围宁静、高级且具有海报质感，融合了日式屏风画美学、现代矢量几何、细腻的纸张纹理、柔和的青绿色渐变、奶油色高光以及利落的黑色线条。无文字，无 Logo，无水印，无边框。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
创建一个垂直的 9:16 电影超现实时尚肖像，描绘一位 23 岁的成年东亚女性，侧身漂浮在广阔的粉紫丁香云景中。她有一张精致的瓜子脸，均衡的脸颊体积，笔直的黑眉毛，柔和地向上凝视的杏仁形黑眼睛，自然的挺直鼻子，柔和的玫瑰色嘴唇，温暖的浅米色皮肤，质感真实，黑棕色的长发轻盈地向上飘逸。她穿着一件灰玫瑰色高级定制礼服，配有牢固衬里的不透明无肩带折叠紧身胸衣、精美的水平微褶、合身的自然腰部以及巨大的分层雪纺和丝绸裙子。

正确的保真度——最高优先级：保持成功的成熟东亚外观、玫瑰色时装褶皱、戏剧性的飘逸裙子、珊瑚日落、体积云、逼真的面料和电影灯光。仅校正身体方向和姿势几何形状。将她的整个人物相对于垂直画布旋转大约 90 度：她的头位于框架的右侧，她的裙子和腿向左延伸，穿过肩膀、腰部和臀部的线条在中间三分之一处几乎水平。她是斜倚在半空中，不是站立、攀爬、跳跃、向上飞翔或垂直摆出姿势。

Rotate her entire figure approximately 90 degrees relative to the vertical canvas: her head is on the right side of the frame, her skirt and legs extend toward the left, and the line through shoulders, waist, and hips is nearly horizontal across the middle third. She is reclining in midair, not standing, climbing, leaping, flying upward, or posed vertically.

Her torso remains sideways and almost level, the right shoulder slightly lower, one knee bent toward the upper-left under opaque drapery, and the opposite leg extended toward the left beneath layered fabric. Her right arm drifts downward toward the lower-right with an open relaxed hand; her left arm trails behind along the horizontal motion. Make the securely covered waist-to-hip-to-leg transition the primary line through the fitted pleated waist, sideways weight, controlled knee bend, realistic fabric tension, and low three-quarter perspective—neither enlarged nor flattened, never anatomy-centered. Arrange the skirt as three rose-pink petal fins flowing leftward, with translucent outer edges but fully opaque body coverage. Leave generous pink cloud space above and below the horizontal figure. Use a 50 mm lens from slightly beneath her, full-body crop, warm coral sunrise from upper right, cool mauve fill from below, gentle volumetric haze, pastel film color, fine grain, and restrained highlight bloom. items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 timed smartphone portrait of an adult-coded young woman, visually around 20 to 25 years old, wearing a black-and-white gothic nurse and bunny-ear cosplay outfit. She is seated or leaning forward beneath a phone fixed above her on a stand. This is not a mirror selfie: the phone and stand remain outside the frame, leaving both of her hands free. Position the camera approximately 40 to 50 degrees above eye level, nearly centered in front of her and looking downward. Use the gentle perspective of a close 24 to 28 mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone lens, making the head, eyes, hands and plush ears appear prominent while the torso and waist gradually recede toward the lower frame.

Frame the scene from the oversized ears down to the waist area. Place her face in the upper central region without perfect alignment or mechanical symmetry. Her head tilts subtly toward the viewer's right, and her face lifts toward the camera. Both eyes look directly into the lens. Raise both hands beside her cheeks and temples, bend the wrists gently inward and curve the fingers into a cat-paw face-framing gesture. The thumbs point toward the jaw and cheeks while the other fingers create arched frames around the face. The hand on the viewer's left sits slightly lower and the hand on the viewer's right sits slightly higher. Both elbows open outward. Maintain believable five-finger anatomy, natural joints, convincing wrist angles and small gaps between the fingers. Give her moderately long almond-shaped nails painted translucent nude pink or creamy beige.

Her expression is quiet, soft and knowingly playful. The lips remain gently closed or separated by an extremely narrow gap, with the corners raised into a restrained small smile and no visible teeth. Her gaze should not appear vacant; she is consciously engaging with the camera, combining sweetness with a mild mischievous quality. Preserve the original softly rounded short-oval facial contour, naturally tapered but not sharply pointed chin, eye spacing, large eyes, narrow nose bridge, small nose tip, soft lip shape and slight natural asymmetry. Do not force an extreme V-shaped jaw, excessively raise the nose bridge or enlarge the lips.

Use refined makeup inspired by Japanese jirai-kei, ryousangata and anime cosplay aesthetics without assigning a celebrity, ethnicity, nationality or identity. Apply a bright ivory complexion with a neutral-cool base that shifts into soft peach-pink under the warm indoor light. Add gray-brown circle lenses with translucent softly defined iris edges. Blend rose pink and pale mauve through the eye sockets, deepening the outer corners slightly. Draw thin black upper eyeliner with subtly lowered outer corners. Add pink shading beneath the eyes and tiny silver-white glitter around the inner corners and aegyo-sal. Keep the lashes fine and separated rather than thick and heavy. Add soft pink blush under the eyes and on the nose tip. Finish the lips with a moist semi-translucent berry-pink gradient gloss and restrained wet highlights.

Her hair is dense deep black with extremely subtle dark-brown reflections under the frontal light. Thick blunt bangs cover the eyebrows, with slight natural separation along the lower edge. Long straight sections form low twin-tail or low twin-section structures on both sides, falling along the cheeks and over the chest, with ends curving gently inward. The hair should appear smooth, dense and semi-matte, deliberately styled for cosplay while retaining a few flyaways, crossing strands, uneven bang divisions and slightly mismatched ends. Avoid greasy shine or a perfectly molded plastic-wig appearance.

Place a white nurse cap at the center of the crown, displaying a prominent black cross or plus-shaped graphic, with a small amount of black lace visible behind it. Attach a pair of oversized white plush rabbit ears. The ear on the viewer's left extends outward and then hangs downward through the upper-left and left edges of the frame. The ear on the viewer's right rises over the head, arches toward the upper-right and continues beyond the frame. Do not make the ears identical. They should be thick, fluffy and soft with slightly irregular fibers. Add one black satin bow to each side of the hair, with a longer ribbon tail on the viewer's right.

Dress her in a cropped white high-neck top that combines nurse-uniform, gothic-maid and bunny-cosplay elements. Around the neck, include fine white ruffles, black piping, black sheer ruffle trim and a narrow black band. Hang a black cross-shaped pendant at the center with tiny silver-toned connector highlights. Run vertical black lace details along the torso and place black cross appliqués and short rectangular accents across the chest and abdomen. Finish the cropped hem with a translucent black pleated or tulle ruffle. Cover the shoulders with white short sleeve pieces, leaving one section of upper arm exposed between the short sleeve and detached sleeve on the viewer's left. Let both hands emerge from oversized white flared cuffs edged with narrow black lace.

The white material should resemble soft matte lightweight uniform cloth or a cotton blend. Let the wide sleeves form natural folds and stacked creases as the arms are raised. Keep the bodice neatly fitted but not tight. The chest remains fully covered by the high-neck garment and creates only a soft natural fabric contour, with no cleavage and no exaggerated bust. Expose only a limited strip of slim waist and lower abdomen beneath the cropped hem, mainly at the bottom center. The abdomen is naturally smooth with a gentle curve created by leaning forward, without pronounced muscles, ribs or hollow definition. Keep the lower garment almost entirely outside the frame, allowing only a small hint of black-and-white waistband, ruffle or skirt edge along the bottom. Do not invent a fully visible skirt, stockings, buttocks or legs.

Visible skin consists of the full face, both hands and fingers, small portions of the wrists, one exposed upper-arm section on the viewer's lower-left side, and a limited strip of waist and lower abdomen. Only an extremely narrow area of neck appears above the central collar. Use bright ivory skin with a neutral-cool base and creamy peach transitions under the warm-white light. The facial skin should appear finely textured and soft, as though it would feel slightly cool, smooth and gently hydrated, while subtle natural variation remains beneath the eyes, beside the nose and around the lips. Apply slightly less diffusion to the hands so faint knuckle and palm-edge texture remains. The exposed upper arm and abdomen should look warm, smooth and soft to the touch, with believable tonal variation rather than waxy, rubbery or completely textureless skin.

Set the portrait in a warm, slightly crowded private bedroom, small studio or cosplay preparation corner. Behind her on the left, include a wooden shelf or tabletop with stacked off-white ceramic bowls, cups or vessels. Add a brown textile, brush-like decoration or fringed soft object behind the left side. Near the upper-left edge, show part of a green cartoon print or decorative artwork. Let a small section of black lace pattern remain visible behind the nurse cap. Introduce silver tubular chair rails, shelving or furniture diagonally along the lower-left and lower edges. Behind her on the right, include an orange cartoon animal or pumpkin-colored cardboard decoration. Near the bottom, show parts of a patterned textile or cushion containing yellow, orange and green. Preserve a few household objects partially obscured by the subject, sleeves and rabbit ears. Do not reorganize the setting into a plain studio, luxury hotel or minimalist bedroom.

Illuminate the scene with warm indoor ambient light combined with soft warm-white frontal fill positioned close to or slightly above the camera axis. Make the face and hands the brightest areas, while the white garment and plush ears remain slightly less luminous but retain fabric and fiber detail. Let the heavy bangs cast a shallow soft shadow over the forehead. Preserve gentle natural shadows around the nostrils, lower lip, jaw, spaces between the fingers and interiors of the sleeves. Let the under-eye glitter produce tiny point reflections, place soft square or circular catchlights inside the irises, and give the glossy lips and nails moist restrained highlights. The plush ears should show soft diffuse reflection rather than harsh glare. Do not add hard rim light, dramatic backlight, cold blue nighttime lighting or polished cinematic studio illumination.

Render the portrait with believable smartphone computational processing: slightly soft, low in contrast and mildly warm, with moderate beauty diffusion on the skin while retaining recognizable detail in the eyes, lashes, hair strands, lace, fingers and nail edges. Preserve a small amount of mobile sensor noise, light JPEG compression, inconsistent background sharpness, flyaway hairs, fabric folds and edge interference. Keep the face, hands and front hair clear while allowing the more distant wooden shelf, ceramics, textiles and cartoon decorations to soften slightly but remain recognizable. Avoid ultra-clean advertising sharpness, aggressive HDR, exaggerated pore detail or flawless commercial studio polish.

She had just adjusted the nurse cap, satin bows and plush rabbit ears and had already started the timer. She is now holding both hands beside her face and looking directly into the lens with a paw-like gesture. In the next second, she may lower her hands, break into a small laugh or reach up to readjust the ear curving beyond the frame. The final image should feel like a soft, dreamy, warm and mildly mischievous social-media cosplay portrait: intimate without being explicit, carefully styled while still preserving accidental framing, slight asymmetry, minor imperfections and the lingering emotion of the previous second.

Negative minor appearance, childlike proportions, mirror selfie, visible phone, phone covering face, misaligned gaze, cross-eyed, closed eyes, broad toothy smile, extreme V-shaped jaw, Western glam makeup, plastic skin, waxy skin, extreme smoothing, greasy face, oversharpened HDR, hard rim light, cold blue lighting, exposed breasts, cleavage, bare shoulders, excessive exposed waist, bare buttocks, bare legs, exaggerated bust, exaggerated curves, peace sign, heart hands, duplicated hands, extra arms, extra palms, six fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, broken wrists, deformed nails, duplicate rabbit ears, extra animal ears, identically upright ears, missing bows, deformed crosses, plain studio, luxury bedroom, perfect symmetry, text, watermark, signature, logo.

items.title: 霓虹女性
items.prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE INSTRUCTION: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact source of truth for the product's appearance, color, finish, branding, and form factor. Do not invent or alter any product detail. Reproduce it with photorealistic precision.
---
Create a photorealistic premium [PRODUCT CATEGORY] campaign poster in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. Design it as a clean global OOH, digital, and social campaign layout with strict grid alignment, premium white space, and precise typography. The campaign idea is "[CAMPAIGN TAGLINE]," but do not render that phrase as visible text.

Use a strict 12-column poster grid with 6% outer margins. Keep all text aligned to this grid. The image has four layers: background shape, giant background typography, subject/product photography, and clean graphic text overlays.

BACKGROUND: Pure matte white canvas. Place one large rounded-rectangle block behind the subject, occupying roughly 70% of the poster height and 76% of the width, centered slightly above the middle. The block uses a controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] gradient, glowing gently from top-left to bottom-right. Behind the subject and product, place giant cropped typography reading "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]" in ultra-bold geometric sans-serif letters. The word is a background layer only: huge, partially cropped by the frame edges, wide letter spacing, darker [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] than the rectangle, subtle embossed depth, soft shadow, and low enough contrast that it does not fight the product.

SUBJECT AND PRODUCT: [DESCRIBE MODEL OR SUBJECT — e.g., "a female model with a clean editorial look, neutral confident expression, natural slightly wind-touched hair, muted off-white outfit, and [ACCENT COLOR] jacket"]. Shoot from a slightly low hero angle. Body angled for depth, face turned toward the viewer with direct eye contact. One hand extends toward the camera holding the product from the uploaded reference image. The product is the dominant foreground object, slightly tilted to reveal [KEY PRODUCT DETAIL — e.g., "the triple camera system, brushed titanium edges, and centered brand logo"]. Keep the product sharp with realistic surface reflections, material texture, faint micro-details, and soft bloom around premium features. Keep the model's face readable behind it.

LIGHTING: Soft studio key light from front-left, warm rim light from the right, and subtle [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] bounce from the background block. Skin remains natural and non-airbrushed with realistic catchlights. Product edges have clean [MATERIAL FINISH — e.g., "metallic / matte / glossy"] highlights. Shadows are soft and controlled.

TYPOGRAPHY OVERLAY: All text must be flat, crisp, perfectly aligned graphic typography — not painted onto the scene. Render exactly these text elements once, with no extra text:

Top left, small black logo: [BRAND LOGO NAME/MARK]

Top right, thin sans-serif: "[BRAND SUB-TAGLINE — e.g., 'Built for Apple Intelligence.']"

Mid left, glassmorphism pill: "[PRODUCT NAME — e.g., 'iPhone 17 Pro']"

Large background type: "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]"

Bottom right body copy, small clean sans-serif:
"[PRODUCT NAME]. [POWER STATEMENT — one sentence.]
[FEATURE 1]. [FEATURE 2].
[CLOSING LINE — e.g., 'Designed for what's next.']"

BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP: Place four equal-width glass-white rounded cards along the bottom, aligned to the grid, same height, same spacing, same baseline alignment. Each card has one minimal line icon above the heading. Render exactly:
Card 1: "[FEATURE HEADING 1]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 1]"
Card 2: "[FEATURE HEADING 2]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 2]"
Card 3: "[FEATURE HEADING 3]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 3]"
Card 4: "[FEATURE HEADING 4]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 4]"

GRAPHIC DETAILS: Two or three small sparkle icons only, subtle grain, soft glassmorphism, controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR]-white-[ACCENT COLOR] palette, no neon, no oversaturation.

items.prompt:
A high-end futuristic streetwear fashion poster featuring a faceless avant-garde model floating and leaping through the sky. The model wears an oversized beige puffer jacket with layered hoods and a knitted face mask completely covering the face. The lower outfit consists of loose white cargo pants layered with exaggerated light blue and dark blue stacked denim leg warmers, paired with beige sneakers and a black crossbody shoulder bag.
The composition uses an extreme low-angle perspective shot, making the legs and shoes appear dramatically enlarged for intense visual impact, as if the character is jumping directly over the viewer’s head. The pose feels anti-gravity and surreal — one arm stretched outward while one leg kicks forward dynamically, creating a floating airborne motion.
The background features a bright cyan-blue sky with soft white clouds, illuminated by clean sunlight and strong atmospheric depth. The overall visual style blends luxury fashion editorial photography, surreal streetwear advertising, and experimental urban poster design.
Add two smaller collage-style silhouette versions of the character in the top-right and bottom-left corners — one floating in the air and another mid-jump — creating the feeling of a fashion magazine collage layout.
Poster layout should resemble a square luxury magazine cover adapted to a 9:16 vertical composition. Add massive abstract rounded typography at the top inspired by Y2K bubble fonts and experimental streetwear brand logos. Include a small graffiti-style brand mark on the left side. On the right side, place a white handwritten brush-style slogan reading: “RISE ABOVE WITH FASHION”, followed by tiny editorial-style caption text underneath. Add a small barcode centered at the bottom.
The design should include thin white borders and a soft off-white paper texture overlay.
Style keywords: futuristic street fashion, avant-garde clothing design, Y2K graphic design, magazine cover typography, collage silhouettes, extreme low-angle shot, sky background, surreal floating motion, exaggerated perspective, premium streetwear campaign, realistic fabric texture, ultra-detailed, clean luxury aesthetic.
Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 front-facing smartphone selfie of an adult-coded young woman, visually around 18 to 24 years old, wearing a black-and-white gothic nurse cosplay. She leans close to the lens while the unseen phone is held approximately 30 to 40 degrees above eye level and pointed downward. Use a very close 24 to 28 mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone perspective that makes the face and eyes visually prominent without producing extreme distortion.

Her head is lightly tilted and her face is raised toward the camera. She looks directly upward into the lens with a quiet, soft, slightly timid and faintly distant expression. Her lips remain naturally closed with relaxed, level corners and no obvious smile, preserving the feeling of a brief emotional pause. Preserve the original softly rounded, relatively short facial shape, natural jawline, eye spacing, narrow nose bridge, small nose tip and soft lip shape. Do not sharpen the chin or significantly reshape the facial proportions.

Her hair is dense, deep black and mostly straight, with thick blunt bangs covering the eyebrows. Long side sections fall naturally on both sides in a low twin-section or twin-tail arrangement, with the ends curving slightly inward. The hair should appear smooth, dense and semi-matte while retaining fine flyaways, minor irregularity and believable strand texture. Place a white nurse cap at the center of the crown with a prominent black cross symbol. Oversized fluffy white animal ears extend from both sides and are irregularly cropped by the top edge of the frame. Add black satin ribbon bows on both sides of the hair.

Use refined makeup inspired by Japanese jirai-kei, ryousangata and anime cosplay aesthetics without referencing a particular celebrity or assigning ethnicity. Apply a very fair neutral-cool complexion, rose-pink and pale mauve eye-shadow gradients, thin black eyeliner with subtly lowered outer corners, and gray-brown circle lenses. Add tiny silver-white glitter points at the inner corners, beneath the eyes and along the aegyo-sal area. Keep the lashes fine and separated. Apply soft pink blush beneath the eyes, across the cheeks and on the tip of the nose. Use a translucent, moist-looking pink gradient lip gloss with delicate reflective highlights.

The only visible skin should be the full face, tiny areas near the ears and a very narrow strip of upper neck above the high collar. The shoulders, arms, chest, waist, hips and legs must remain covered or outside the frame. The facial skin should appear finely textured, soft, slightly cool, smooth and gently hydrated, with mild smartphone beauty diffusion but subtle natural variation remaining beside the nose, beneath the eyes and around the lips. Avoid plastic or completely textureless skin.

Dress her in a white high-neck, long-sleeved cosplay top combining nurse-uniform and gothic-maid elements. Add black piping, a fine white ruffled collar, black sheer ruffles, narrow black lace details and several black cross appliqués. Around the neck, include a thin black band, black sheer ruffle trim and a hanging black cross-shaped ornament. The fabric should look soft, lightweight and matte, with small natural folds created by the close selfie posture. Do not make the garment tight or emphasize the chest. The lower garment, waist, hips and legs must not appear.

Keep the framing casual and imperfect. Her face fills most of the image but is not aligned with perfect symmetry. A white-sleeved arm enters from the lower-left foreground and reaches toward the unseen phone. The oversized ears are partially cropped along the top edge, and small edge obstructions remain. Do not turn the composition into a centered passport portrait.

Place her in a warm, slightly crowded corner of a private room or small studio. Behind her on the left, include a wooden shelf with stacked off-white ceramic bowls and vessels. Near the upper-left edge, show part of a green-toned artwork or print. Add a thin metal frame or furniture structure in the rear. Along the right edge, let an orange cartoon star and animal-shaped cutout intrude into the composition, with a soft white cushion or bedding behind the right shoulder. Keep the background lived-in and mildly cluttered rather than converting it into a plain studio, minimalist room or luxury bedroom.

Illuminate the scene with warm indoor ambient light combined with soft near-axis frontal fill positioned slightly above the face. Let the light illuminate the forehead, nose bridge, upper cheeks and chin while the bangs cast a faint soft shadow across the forehead. Retain gentle natural shadows around the nostrils and beneath the jaw. Let the under-eye glitter create tiny point reflections and the lip gloss produce a moist highlight. Do not add a strong rim light, dramatic backlight or polished cinematic studio setup.

Render the image with believable smartphone computational processing, mild beauty-filter softness, a subtle warm cast, restrained sharpening, slight sensor noise and light JPEG compression. Keep the face and front hair sections clear while allowing the shelving, ceramics and cartoon decoration to soften slightly but remain recognizable. The image should feel as though she had just adjusted the nurse cap and bows, has already raised the phone above her, and is now looking quietly into the lens. In the next second, she may relax her expression or readjust the fluffy ear cropped by the frame. Preserve the intimacy, small imperfections, asymmetry and lingering emotion of a genuine social-media selfie.

Negative minor appearance, childlike body, mirror selfie, visible phone, phone covering face, bare shoulders, cleavage, exposed chest, bare waist, bare legs, exaggerated breasts, exaggerated curves, pointed chin, Western glam makeup, plastic skin, extreme smoothing, oversharpened HDR, hard rim light, professional studio background, perfect symmetry, misaligned gaze, cross-eyed, duplicate ears, extra bows, deformed crosses, extra fingers, distorted limbs, text, watermark, logo.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

Act as a Streetwear Creative Director and Graphic Designer creating a triptych of three distinct campaign images unified by subculture aesthetics — analog grain, collage layering, hand-drawn elements, and raw urban energy. The three panels are presented side by side as a single wide-format image. Each panel has a completely different visual treatment but they belong to the same campaign universe. The entire system is driven by [BRAND NAME]'s real brand identity, real products, real cultural positioning. References: hip-hop album artwork, streetwear zine culture, skate photography, graffiti editorial, risograph print aesthetics.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS EXTRACTION

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] from training data before generating anything.

COLOR SYSTEM: identify [BRAND NAME]'s primary brand color — this becomes the dominant background color across all three panels. Each panel uses a variation of this color: Panel 1 uses the most saturated vivid version. Panel 2 uses a slightly darker or more complex version. Panel 3 uses a slightly desaturated or shifted version. Secondary accent color: identify [BRAND NAME]'s accent color — used for hand-drawn elements, graffiti tags, and accent marks across all three panels.

BRAND WORLD: identify [BRAND NAME]'s cultural positioning — music, skate, street, outdoor, sport, or other. All photographic content, environments, and cultural references across all three panels must authentically belong to this world.

HERO PRODUCT: identify [BRAND NAME]'s most iconic current product — footwear, apparel, or accessory. This product appears prominently in Panel 3 as the subject of close-up photography.

BRAND TYPOGRAPHY: identify [BRAND NAME]'s official wordmark style and the typeface character used in their campaigns. Apply to Panel 2's logo lockup.

CULTURAL LANGUAGE: identify real slogans, real product names, real cultural phrases associated with [BRAND NAME]'s community. These appear as handwritten text, editorial copy, and background writing across all three panels.

---

PHASE 1: TRIPTYCH STRUCTURE

Single wide-format image — aspect ratio approximately 3:1 landscape or three 1:1 squares side by side. The three panels are placed edge to edge with zero gap — they bleed directly into each other. Each panel is equal width. Together they form one unified campaign image read left to right. The three panels share: the brand color family, the analog grain treatment, the hand-drawn mark-making aesthetic, and the subculture visual language. They differ in: photographic treatment, typographic approach, and compositional structure.

---

PHASE 2: PANEL 1 — RISOGRAPH PORTRAIT (LEFT)

Visual language: album cover / risograph print / screenprint aesthetic. Two-color duotone treatment — [BRAND NAME]'s primary brand color as the background, black and off-white/cream for the photographic subject. The photograph is processed to look like a two-color risograph or screenprint: high contrast, visible halftone grain, ink texture, slightly misregistered color layers creating a subtle offset effect.

Photographic subject: a close-up portrait of a person relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s cultural world — a musician, skater, or street figure. The portrait is tightly cropped, the face filling 60 to 70% of the panel. The subject wears [BRAND NAME] products visibly.

Collage micro-elements layered over the portrait: two small human figures — tiny scale, approximately 3 to 5% of panel height — placed on a horizontal surface within the portrait (a hat brim, a shoulder) as if they are tiny people standing on the subject. A small cut-out photograph embedded within the portrait (on the chest or collar area) showing a lifestyle scene relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s world — this cutout has slightly torn or rough edges.

Hand-drawn elements scattered across the panel: a loose cursive script text — a real [BRAND NAME] phrase or cultural word — written in white brush pen style over the upper-center of the portrait. Small doodle marks: tiny stars, hearts, directional lines, quick sketches — scattered asymmetrically across the panel, drawn in thin black or white ink. These marks are casual and quick — like someone drew on the artwork with a ballpoint pen.

Bottom right corner: a small rectangular label element — brand name in small mono type, and a barcode graphic beneath it.

---

PHASE 3: PANEL 2 — STREETWEAR EDITORIAL (CENTER)

Visual language: streetwear magazine spread / brand editorial. A real photograph — not duotone — of a person wearing [BRAND NAME] products in an urban environment. Shot with a fisheye or ultra-wide lens from a low angle looking up — the subject is in the lower-center of the frame, the environment (buildings, sky, street) fills the upper portion in dramatic wide-angle perspective. The photograph retains its natural color but has a slight film grain overlay and a color grade consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s brand world.

Brand logo lockup: [BRAND NAME]'s official wordmark and logo symbol rendered large in white — positioned in the upper portion of the panel, over the sky/architectural zone of the photograph. The logo occupies approximately 40 to 50% of the panel width. The wordmark is in [BRAND NAME]'s correct official typography.

Graffiti tag overlay: a large aggressive wildstyle graffiti tag written in [BRAND NAME]'s accent color — bright, energetic, spanning approximately 60 to 70% of the panel width. Positioned in the middle zone of the panel, partially overlapping the figure and the logo. The tag style is authentic to street graffiti — fluid, confident, marker-thick strokes with sharp wild extensions. The tag spells a real [BRAND NAME] word, product name, or brand-relevant phrase.

Lower left editorial text block: a small structured text block with a bold headline in white — a real [BRAND NAME] campaign or cultural phrase as the title, followed by 2 to 3 lines of smaller body text describing the brand's cultural positioning or product. Set in a mix of bold and regular weight — some words in bold, some in regular, creating typographic rhythm. This text block mimics a magazine article header.

Lower right corner: care label / garment icons — a row of 4 to 5 small washing/care instruction icons in white, as found on clothing labels. Next to them: [BRAND NAME]'s logo in small form with a tagline. This references the brand's product language.

Corner micro-elements: top left — current year with ® symbol. Top center — a small descriptor ("Brand Meets Subculture" equivalent for [BRAND NAME]'s world). Top right — a social media handle or brand identifier in small type.

Bottom disclaimer strip: a small M-rating style box with small text — "This content is a creative concept" — positioned lower left. Lower right: "Never stop [brand-relevant verb]" + small [BRAND NAME] logo.

---

PHASE 4: PANEL 3 — ZINE COLLAGE (RIGHT)

Visual language: skate zine / analog collage / film photography. A flat-color or slightly textured background in [BRAND NAME]'s primary color — the background has visible film grain or paper texture, slightly desaturated, analog feel.

Multiple photographic layers: 3 to 4 photographs of different sizes placed across the panel at varying angles — some tilted 5 to 15° clockwise or counter-clockwise, some slightly overlapping. Each photograph looks like a real printed photo — slightly glossy, with a very thin white border like a developed photograph. Some photos have a transparent tape element or a colored paper backing visible at the corners — physical analog mounting effect. Photo subjects: close-up shots of [BRAND NAME]'s hero product — different angles, different colorways, shot in real environments (skate spot, street, nature). One photo includes a partial figure — a person sitting or standing in a real environment wearing [BRAND NAME] products.

Handwritten text scattered across the panel: multiple instances of handwritten text in different scales and styles — some large and gestural (song lyrics, personal thoughts, brand phrases relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s world), some small and intimate (diary-like notes, dates, place names). The text is written in thin ballpoint or marker style — white, black, or the brand accent color. The text content is authentic to [BRAND NAME]'s cultural community.

Quick sketch doodles: small hand-drawn illustrations scattered between the photos — gesture drawings of figures, objects relevant to the brand, abstract marks. These are quick and rough — 10 to 20 seconds per sketch quality.

Numerical identifier: a large painted or stenciled number on one of the environmental elements in the main photograph — a real-feeling street number, code, or reference number. Rendered as if spray-painted or stenciled.

---

PHASE 5: UNIFIED ANALOG TREATMENT

All three panels share these visual properties that unify them as one campaign: film grain — a consistent fine grain overlay across all three panels at 20 to 30% opacity. Color family — all three panels are dominated by variations of [BRAND NAME]'s primary brand color. Hand-drawn marks — all three panels contain freehand pen, marker, or brush marks of varying density. Layer depth — all three panels have multiple overlapping visual layers creating physical depth. Cultural authenticity — all three panels reference [BRAND NAME]'s real subculture world.

---

PHASE 6: TECH SPECS

Single wide-format image — three panels side by side, zero gap between them. Each panel: 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait — three equal widths. Film grain: real noise texture overlay on all panels — ISO 1600 to 3200 equivalent grain density. Risograph treatment on Panel 1: genuine two-color halftone simulation — not a filter, a real duotone with visible dot pattern at close inspection. Photography: editorial quality across all three panels — natural moments, not overly staged. Hand-drawn elements: authentic imperfect mark-making — not computer-generated perfect lines. Color palette: exclusively [BRAND NAME]'s documented brand colors across all three panels. Output feel: this triptych is published as a zine spread, pinned in a streetwear designer's studio, or posted as a campaign carousel on [BRAND NAME]'s Instagram.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
受动作视频游戏封面启发，创建一个近乎正方形的高影响力宣传海报拼贴画，其中多个成年女性流行偶像人物排列在厚厚的黑色棱角漫画面板边框内。在整个设计中使用饱和的亮黄色工作室背景，中央有一个大的白色大写字母模仿游戏徽标，在底角附近有较小的评级标签风格的图形元素。

拍摄对象应该看起来像韩国流行女团的战术概念：苗条的成年表演者，自信、严肃的表情，明亮而有光泽的眼睛，微微张开或放松的嘴唇，以及强烈的镜头意识态度。保持不同的面部角度和表情，而不是让它们完全相同。使用韩流化妆：烟熏细长眼线、猫眼形状、眼睑上的微光、夸张的睫毛、柔和轮廓的脸颊、明亮干净的底妆和裸粉色的嘴唇。

将头发设计成具有强烈的偶像时尚变化：凌乱的湿质感黑色波浪、帽子下的长粉色洋红色波浪、白金金色辫子、深色凌乱的头发和修饰脸型的发丝。头发应该有故意的飞扬、光泽、体积和可见的工作室灯光亮点。

衣柜应融合军事街头服饰和舞台造型：橄榄绿和黑色短款上衣、迷彩夹克、无袖背心、战术背心、肩带、带扣、腰带、工装裤、无指手套、圈形耳环、链条、戒指和帽子。有几件服装应该以时尚舞台的方式展现皮肤：脸部、颈部、锁骨、肩膀、上臂、腹部、腰部、低腰裤上方与臀部相邻的小区域，以及通过透明黑色紧身衣的大腿区域。皮肤在光线下看起来应该是白皙的，带有暖黄色的弹力，光滑、缎子般，就像在工作室的热灯下轻轻撒了粉一样，颧骨、锁骨、肩膀和暴露的腹部有明亮的亮点。

使用混合取景：特写肖像、半身照、裁剪的躯干姿势、一个中央站立的人物、蹲伏的侧姿势、举起的手臂、双手靠近脸部或帽子、轻微的躯干扭曲以及激进的偏离中心的裁剪。构图应该感觉响亮、不对称、像海报一样，而不是像干净的工作室肖像。

拍摄它就像使用强正面工作室闪光灯和强补光拍摄一样，然后合成为光滑的杂志风格粉丝海报。保持深焦、锐利的面孔、饱和的色彩、坚硬的图形边框、轻微的压缩纹理和粘贴游戏封面的质量。气氛应该让人感到大胆、挑衅、都市、俏皮和时尚的危险，就好像角色已经走出混乱的城市任务，并在下一个场景开始之前被冻结在封面上。

避免单一主题的肖像、纯色背景、柔和的色彩、自然的户外光线、过于光滑的塑料人工智能皮肤、孩子般的面孔、过度性感的姿势、缺少黑色面板边框、缺少中央排版、褪色的黄色、模糊的文字、变形的手、多余的肢体和通用的军事角色扮演。
items.prompt:
Create a near-square high-impact promotional poster collage inspired by an action video game cover, featuring multiple adult female pop-idol figures arranged inside thick black angular comic-panel borders. Use a saturated bright yellow studio background across the entire design, with a large central white block-letter parody game logo and smaller rating-label style graphic elements near the bottom corners.

The subjects should look like a tactical K-pop girl group concept: slim adult performers with confident, serious expressions, intense glossy eyes, slightly parted or relaxed lips, and strong camera-aware attitude. Preserve varied facial angles and expressions rather than making them identical. Use K-pop editorial makeup: smoky elongated eyeliner, cat-eye shape, shimmer on the eyelids, dramatic lashes, softly contoured cheeks, luminous clean base, and nude-pink lips.

Style the hair with strong idol-fashion variation: messy wet-textured black waves, long pink-magenta waves under a cap, platinum blonde braids, dark tousled hair, and face-framing strands. Hair should have deliberate flyaways, gloss, volume, and visible studio-light highlights.

Wardrobe should mix military streetwear and stage styling: olive green and black cropped tops, camouflage jackets, sleeveless tanks, tactical vests, straps, buckles, belts, cargo pants, fingerless gloves, hoop earrings, chains, rings, and caps. Several outfits should reveal skin in a fashion-stage way: faces, necks, collarbones, shoulders, upper arms, midriffs, waist, small hip-adjacent areas above low-rise pants, and one thigh area through sheer black tights. Skin should look fair to light with warm yellow bounce, smooth and satin-like as if lightly powdered under hot studio lamps, with bright highlights on cheekbones, collarbones, shoulders, and exposed midriff.

Use mixed framing: close-up portraits, half-body shots, cropped torso poses, one central standing figure, a crouched side pose, raised arms, hands near the face or cap, slight torso twists, and aggressive off-center crops. The composition should feel loud, asymmetrical, and poster-like, not like a clean studio portrait.

Photograph it as if shot with hard frontal studio flash and strong fill light, then composited into a glossy magazine-style fan poster. Keep deep focus, sharp faces, saturated color, hard graphic borders, slight compression texture, and a pasted-game-cover quality. The mood should feel bold, defiant, urban, playful, and fashionably dangerous, as if the characters had already stepped out of a chaotic city mission and are frozen on the cover before the next scene begins.

Avoid a single-subject portrait, plain background, pastel colors, natural outdoor lighting, overly smooth plastic AI skin, childlike faces, oversexualized posing, missing black panel borders, missing central typography, washed-out yellow, blurry text, deformed hands, extra limbs, and generic military cosplay.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

Act as a Senior Brand Art Director creating a horizontal triptych hero banner — three vertical panels side by side forming a single unified wide-format campaign image. The entire composition is driven by [BRAND NAME]'s real brand identity, real campaign information, and real cultural associations. References: Adidas FIFA World Cup campaign, Nike hero banners, Puma campaign triptychs, luxury brand editorial hero images.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] before generating anything.

COLOR SYSTEM: identify the exact two dominant colors [BRAND NAME] uses in hero campaign materials. Color 1: primary dark or neutral — the color used for portrait/product panels (black, deep navy, charcoal, or brand dark tone). Color 2: primary accent — the saturated vivid brand color used as the hero background for the central panel (hot pink for Adidas Argentina, signal orange for Nike, royal blue for Pepsi, etc). These two colors define the entire triptych — panels alternate or contrast between them. A brand designer must confirm these colors are correct.

TYPOGRAPHY CHARACTER: identify the typographic style [BRAND NAME] uses for campaign hero text. Describe its visual character precisely — script italic for fashion campaigns, bold condensed grotesque for sportswear, extended serif for luxury. The central panel typography must feel native to [BRAND NAME]'s visual language.

CAMPAIGN CONTENT: identify the most current or most iconic real campaign, product line, collaboration, or cultural moment associated with [BRAND NAME]. Extract: the campaign name, the hero product or collection name, a short product descriptor sentence (one real sentence used in [BRAND NAME] marketing), a CTA phrase consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s tone.

CULTURAL FIGURE: identify one real public figure — athlete, artist, musician, or cultural icon — who has a documented genuine relationship with [BRAND NAME] through sponsorship, collaboration, ambassadorship, or cultural association. This person appears in the left panel portrait.

---

PHASE 1: TRIPTYCH STRUCTURE

Single horizontal image — aspect ratio 3:1 or 16:5 ultrawide. Three equal-width vertical panels placed side by side with no gap between them — the panels bleed into each other creating a seamless wide composition. Each panel is a tall vertical rectangle, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio individually.

Panel 1 left: dark background (Color 1 from PHASE 0).
Panel 2 center: vivid accent background (Color 2 from PHASE 0).
Panel 3 right: same vivid accent background as center (Color 2) — or a slight variation.

The three panels read as one unified image — photography bleeds to frame edges on all sides, typography spans across panel boundaries where relevant.

---

PHASE 2: LEFT PANEL — PORTRAIT

The left panel is a dramatic close-up portrait of the cultural figure identified in PHASE 0. Shot tight — head and upper shoulders only, approximately 60 to 70% of the frame is the face and neck. The figure is in profile or 3/4 view — looking toward the center panel, not at camera. This directional gaze pulls the viewer's eye toward the center. The figure is wearing [BRAND NAME] product visibly. Lighting: dramatic, single source — strong side lighting creating deep shadows on the non-lit side of the face. The dark background (Color 1) envelopes the figure — no environmental context, pure portrait against dark. Upper left corner: the figure's name in small caps, light color, generous tracking — "LIONEL MESSI" style attribution. Lower left corner: a white or light-colored rectangular content block containing: campaign or product title in bold medium type, one sentence product descriptor in small regular type, a CTA button with arrow — "SHOP NOW →" style.

---

PHASE 3: CENTER PANEL — TYPOGRAPHIC HERO

The center panel is the most visually explosive element of the triptych. Background: Color 2 (vivid brand accent) at full saturation — pure flat color, no gradient. Two figures or one figure in a dynamic physical pose — movement, energy, action consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s brand world. The figures are wearing [BRAND NAME] products. The figures are positioned slightly off-center, overlapping with each other.

REPEATING TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM: a single key word from the campaign — a country name, collection name, product name, or brand word — is typeset in a large italic or script display typeface and repeated three times vertically across the full height of the panel. The three repetitions vary in size: top instance — medium, partially cropped by the top edge. Middle instance — largest, approximately 40 to 50% of panel height, sitting behind or over the figures. Bottom instance — medium-large, partially cropped by the bottom edge. All three instances are the same word. The typography color: a vivid contrasting color — white, hot pink, or a third brand accent — with high visibility against Color 2. The figures exist on a layer between the background color and the typography — they are behind some type instances and in front of others, creating depth.

Above the figures: a small campaign identifier in all-caps tracked text — campaign name and trademark symbol. Below the figures: same campaign identifier repeated.

---

PHASE 4: RIGHT PANEL — PRODUCT CLOSE-UP

The right panel is a tight editorial crop of [BRAND NAME]'s hero product from the campaign — apparel, footwear, or accessory. The crop is intimate and detailed — showing the product at close range, revealing material texture, construction details, branding elements. Background: Color 2 (same as center panel) creating visual continuity. The product is worn or held by a partial figure — only a torso, hands, or legs visible, no face. A large graphic number or letter — a jersey number, collection code, or brand identifier — is positioned in the frame as a typographic accent, consistent with the treatment in the center panel.

---

PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

All typography across the triptych uses the character identified in PHASE 0 — consistent visual language across all three panels. The repeating word in the center panel: italic, script, or bold display consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s campaign aesthetic. Attribution text, campaign identifiers, and CTA: clean sans-serif, all-caps, tracked — consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s informational typography. No decorative fonts outside the brand's documented visual language.

---

PHASE 6: LIGHTING & PHOTOGRAPHY

Left panel: dramatic portrait lighting — single strong side light, dark background, high contrast. Center panel: even bright studio lighting consistent with the flat vivid background — figures are cleanly lit, no heavy shadows. Right panel: product photography lighting — soft, revealing material texture and construction detail. All three panels feel like they were shot in the same campaign session — unified photographic language despite different lighting needs.

---

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION UNITY

The three panels must read as one image, not three separate images placed next to each other. Unity mechanisms: the typography from the center panel may bleed slightly into the edges of the left and right panels. The saturated Color 2 background of the center and right panels creates a visual block that anchors the right two-thirds of the composition. The dark Color 1 of the left panel creates contrast that makes the portrait pop. The figure's gaze in the left panel points toward the center. The overall reading direction: portrait left → typographic explosion center → product detail right.

---

PHASE 8: TECH SPECS

Aspect ratio: 3:1 or 16:5, single flat image — no separate panels, no borders between panels. Color palette: exactly Color 1 and Color 2 from PHASE 0, plus white or light neutral for typography. No additional colors. No gradients. No textures. Photography: editorial campaign quality — not stock photography. Typography: character consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s documented visual identity as described in PHASE 0. All campaign text, product names, and cultural figure attribution are real [BRAND NAME] data. Output feel: this image appears as the hero banner on [BRAND NAME]'s official website homepage or as a campaign outdoor billboard.

items.title: 请根据用户输入的【主题】或上传的【参考图片】，创作一张横向 …
items.prompt:
请根据用户输入的【主题】或上传的【参考图片】，创作一张横向 4:3 的高完成度「AI美甲灵感方案 」。

【输入规则】
如果用户提供的是文字主题，请根据主题进行抽象提炼。
如果用户提供的是参考图片：
- Image A 是灵感参考图，是本次美甲方案的核心灵感来源；
- 如果用户还提供了手部照片，则 Image B 为手部参考图，用于辅助生成更贴近肤色与手型的实际上手效果；
- 如果没有手部照片，请生成一组自然、真实、审美在线的通用女性双手上手效果图。

--------------------------------------------------
【图片标题与副标题】
主标题请明确写：
AI美甲灵感方案

英文副标题可写：
AI Nail Inspiration Board

小标题可根据主题自动生成，例如：
Inspired by [主题名称]
或
Visual Translation of [主题名称]

如果是中文主题，也可以中英结合，例如：
灵感来源 / Inspired by [主题]
主题转译 / Concept Translation

--------------------------------------------------
【整体版式要求】
横向 4:3 版式，整体采用高端提案板排版。

画面建议分为以下几个模块，并保持层次清晰、留白舒服、结构有秩序：

一、顶部标题区
二、灵感来源区
三、视觉元素提取区
四、10指甲设计区（核心主视觉）
五、风格总结区
六、推荐甲型 / 工艺 / 场景区
七、实际上手效果区（非常重要）
八、底部总结区

背景保持干净克制，可使用暖白、奶油白、浅灰、浅米色、雾粉灰等高级底色，不要过度花哨。
整体设计感应偏向高端美甲品牌视觉、时尚杂志内页、设计提案板，而不是电商详情页或低质海报。

--------------------------------------------------
【各板块详细要求】

① 标题区 / Title Area
在画面上方清晰呈现：
- 主标题：AI美甲灵感方案
- 英文副标题：AI Nail Inspiration Board
- 主题名称：根据用户输入自动生成
- 一句简洁的风格描述，例如：
“从主题中提取色彩、符号与情绪，转译为一整套可上手的美甲方案。”

标题区要简洁有力，体现高级感和设计感。

--------------------------------------------------
② 灵感来源区 / Inspiration Source
如果用户上传了参考图，请在左上或上方区域展示参考图缩略图，并标注：
- 灵感来源 / Inspiration Source
- 主题名称
- 简短说明：这次设计从参考图中提取了哪些气质与方向

如果用户只输入文字主题，则在此区域以文字方式呈现：
- 主题名称
- 主题简介
- 核心氛围描述

此区不是大篇文字，而是简洁专业、像设计说明一样。

--------------------------------------------------
③ 视觉元素提取区 / Visual Extraction
请将灵感拆解成几个清晰的小模块，排版精致、信息明确：

A. 色彩系统 / Color Palette
请推荐：
- 主色 3 个
- 辅助色 2 个
- 点缀色 1 个

用小色卡形式展示，并标注色彩名称。
色彩命名可偏审美化，例如：
奶杏裸粉、冷调银灰、酒红莓果、墨绿、雾霾紫、香槟金、深海蓝、珍珠白等。

B. 关键词 / Style Keywords
提炼 4—6 个关键词，例如：
温柔、神秘、复古、冷艳、梦幻、浪漫、华丽、克制、轻甜、未来感、松弛、清冷、戏剧感等。

C. 图案与符号 / Motifs
提取 4—6 个可被转译进甲面的视觉元素，例如：
月亮、星轨、花瓣、水波、羽毛、火焰、丝带、蝴蝶、格纹、书页、音符、金线、藤蔓、金属边框、玻璃碎片感等。

D. 材质与工艺 / Texture & Finish
提炼适合本次主题的工艺方向，例如：
猫眼、珠光、金箔、渐变晕染、镜面、果冻透感、法式边、贝壳碎片、磨砂、立体水滴、微浮雕、细闪、丝绒感等。

这一整区要非常像“设计逻辑提取板”，清晰、专业、简洁。

--------------------------------------------------
④ 10指甲设计区 / 10-Nail Design Plan
这是整张图的绝对核心，请占据最大视觉权重。

请明确展示：
- 左手 5 枚
- 右手 5 枚

每一个指甲都要单独清晰呈现，并附简洁说明。
建议每枚指甲包含：
- 指位（Thumb / Index / Middle / Ring / Pinky）
- 设计名称
- 简短说明（1句话）
- 主要元素 / 工艺

整套 10 指甲必须形成统一风格，同时又有节奏变化，不可十个都一样，也不可毫无联系地乱做。
既要有完整系列感，又要有细节差异和层次感。

--------------------------------------------------
⑤ 风格总结区 / Concept Summary
请在右侧或中右区域做一个小型总结模块，包含：

- 风格主题 / Style Theme
例如：
暗夜玫瑰 / Midnight Rose
海风日落 / Sunset Coast
旧梦电影感 / Retro Cinema Mood
春日书页 / Spring Pages
深海星轨 / Ocean Starline

- 整体气质说明
用 1 段简洁说明总结整套方案的方向，例如：
“这套设计通过低饱和主色、细节金属线条与局部珠光工艺，将灵感中的浪漫与克制感转译为更适合日常佩戴的高级美甲方案。”

--------------------------------------------------
⑥ 甲型 / 工艺 / 适用场景区
请做成小而精致的模块，包含：

A. 推荐甲型 / Nail Shape
根据主题与风格自动推荐 1—2 种合适甲型，例如：
- 短圆甲
- 方圆甲
- 椭圆甲
- 杏仁甲
- 中长椭圆甲

并简短说明理由，如：
“更显精致”“更适合日常佩戴”“更能承载图案层次”“更显手部修长感”。

B. 推荐工艺 / Recommended Finishes
总结这套设计最重要的工艺重点，例如：
渐变晕染、微珠光、金线细节、猫眼流光、局部镜面等。

C. 场景建议 / Best For
说明适合的场景，例如：
通勤、约会、婚礼、度假、节日、演唱会、春夏、秋冬等。

这一块要像“实用落地建议”，增强方案可执行性。

--------------------------------------------------
⑦ 实际上手效果区 / On-Hand Preview
这一部分非常重要，必须精致、真实、有说服力。

请生成一组高完成度的双手上手效果图，展示这整套美甲真正做在手上的样子。
要求：
- 双手自然、真实、比例正常
- 手部姿态优雅，不夸张、不僵硬
- 指甲细节清晰可见
- 光线柔和高级，具有棚拍质感
- 可采用自然摆拍方式

如果用户提供了手部照片，请尽量匹配其手部肤色与基础手型特征；
如果没有手部照片，请生成一组大众审美友好、气质自然、适合展示美甲的女性双手效果。

重点：
这不是简单的小缩略图，而是整张图中非常关键的落地展示模块。
要让用户第一眼就觉得：“这套设计真的能做，而且做出来会很好看。”

--------------------------------------------------
⑧ 底部总结区 / Final Note
请在底部或右下角写一句清晰有力的总结语，例如：

“这套方案并非简单复制灵感来源，而是提取其色彩、情绪与符号语言，转译为更适合甲面表达、同时兼顾美感与佩戴性的完整美甲设计。”

这句总结要起到“收尾 + 提升专业感”的作用。

--------------------------------------------------

最终请输出一张横向 4:3 的高完成度「AI美甲灵感方案」专业提案图。
用户第一眼应被这套美甲方案吸引，第二眼能看懂整套设计逻辑，第三眼会觉得这套方案真实可做、而且做出来会很好看。

ULTRA-PREMIUM GLOBAL FMCG CAMPAIGN

PHASE 4 — COLOR SYSTEM

items.title: 请根据用户输入的【品牌名 / 项目名】【副标题 / 产品名】…
items.prompt:
请根据用户输入的【品牌名 / 项目名】【副标题 / 产品名】【类型 / 行业】【地域风味】【品牌定位】【核心关键词】【核心图形】【核心食物 / 品类元素】【情绪气质】【主色调】【辅助色】【画幅比例】，设计一个高完成度的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo / Chinese Retro Food Emblem Logo」。

【用户输入】
品牌名 / 项目名：[品牌名 / 项目名]
副标题 / 产品名：[副标题 / 产品名]
类型 / 行业：[类型 / 行业]
地域风味：[港式 / 粤式 / 湘味 / 川味 / 炭火 / 夜宵 / 茶餐厅 / 烧味 / 海鲜 / 小酒馆等]
品牌定位：[品牌定位]
核心关键词：[复古、国潮、招牌感、老字号感、烟火气、江湖感、新消费感等]
核心图形：[龙 / 凤 / 鹤 / 虎 / 牛 / 蛙 / 鹅 / 鱼 / 龙虾 / 器具 / 图腾 / 吉祥纹样等]
核心食物 / 品类元素：[烧鹅 / 烧烤 / 茶饮 / 龙虾 / 面食 / 牛肉 / 冰室 / 酒馆等]
情绪气质：[热闹、霸气、复古、经典、地方感、烟火气、江湖感、年轻化等]
主色调：[主色调]
辅助色：[辅助色]
画幅比例：[画幅比例]

【核心目标】
这次要设计的是一个真正可用于餐饮品牌的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo」。它不是普通海报，也不是简单卡通插画，更不是只写几个字。请以中文主字标为核心，融合强识别图形、餐饮品类符号、复古中英文排版和完整徽章式结构，打造一个具有门头感、包装感、品牌系统感和传播感的餐饮 Logo。

最终结果应让人一眼感受到：
1. 这是一个餐饮品牌；
2. 它有明确品类和个性；
3. 它像一个成熟的品牌主标，而不是一张装饰性图案。

【设计本质】
这类 Logo 的核心不是单一图形或单一字体，而是以下五层整合：
1. 中文主字标：负责品牌识别；
2. 图形符号：负责记忆点与品类联想；
3. 徽章结构：负责整体完整性；
4. 中英文排版：负责层次感与复古品牌氛围；
5. 颜色系统：负责强化餐饮调性和品类情绪。

【最重要的原则】
1. 中文品牌名必须醒目、清楚、具有招牌感；
2. Logo 必须是一个完整标识，而不是零散元素拼贴；
3. 图形必须与品牌名或品类相关，不能为了装饰而装饰；
4. 英文为辅助，中文为主，英文不能喧宾夺主；
5. 整体必须有餐饮品牌属性，适合门头、菜单、包装和社媒头像；
6. 画面必须有复古感，但不能老气、脏乱或失去现代品牌完成度；
7. 必须有“国潮复古餐饮徽章”的味道，而不是美式卡通或日式商铺字标。

【中文主字标要求】
1. 中文品牌名为绝对主角；
2. 字体要有复古餐饮招牌感、老包装感或国潮标题感；
3. 可以厚重、粗壮、有黑体 / 宋黑 / 商业手写感；
4. 可以做适度变体，但必须清晰可读；
5. 不要极简细字体，不要弱，不要像普通系统字；
6. 需具备门头感和品牌标识感。

【图形系统要求】
请根据【核心图形】与【品类元素】设计一个与品牌高度相关的主图形。
可选方向包括：
- 动物 / 神兽：龙、凤、虎、牛、鹅、鱼、蛙、鹤等；
- 食材 / 菜品：龙虾、烧鹅、牛肉、面碗、火焰、茶杯等；
- 传统图腾：章印、纹样、牌匾、吉祥图案；
- 器具 / 场景符号：烤架、火焰、碗筷、冰室元素等。

图形要求：
1. 要有记忆点；
2. 要与品类和名字有明确关系；
3. 不要做得太复杂写实；
4. 要适合与字标整合为徽章；
5. 可以偏复古插画、版画感、老商标感、国潮线描感。

【徽章结构要求】
请把整体设计成一个完整的“餐饮品牌徽章 Logo”，而不是简单横排。
结构可参考以下方式：
1. 上方英文拱形 + 中央图形 + 下方中文主字标；
2. 中央大图形 + 左右小标签 + 下方副标题；
3. 圆章 / 椭圆章 / 牌匾式构图；
4. 中心主图 + 上下分层文字；
5. 对称排版 + 小图章 + 小圆标系统；
6. 老招牌 / 老商标 / 包装主标式版式。

【中英文排版要求】
1. 中文为主，英文为辅；
2. 英文可用于拱形主标题、品类名、店型说明、口号、年份、ESTD 等；
3. 英文参与构图，增强复古商标感；
4. 英文不需要过多，但要精致、清晰、服务整体结构；
5. 可以使用如：
- HOUSE
- TAVERN
- BARBECUE
- ROAST GOOSE
- TEA RESTAURANT
- LOBSTER HOUSE
- ESTD / SINCE / CLASSIC / SPECIALTY
6. 不要让英文压过中文，也不要变成纯英文品牌。

【辅助元素要求】
可以加入少量增强品牌系统感的小元素，例如：
- ESTD 年份
- 小圆章
- 小图标
- 小标签
- 小印章
- 地域说明
- 品类说明
- 横线 / 点阵 / 小边框
- slogan 小字

但必须克制，不能把画面做成复杂海报。

【色彩要求】
请根据品牌品类选择更合适的国潮复古餐饮色彩系统，例如：
1. 黑 + 红：烧烤、卤味、烧味、小酒馆；
2. 黑 + 金 / 棕金：老字号、熟食、烧鹅、粤式餐饮；
3. 绿 + 红 + 米白：港式冰室、茶餐厅；
4. 蓝 + 红 + 白：海鲜、龙虾、年轻夜宵餐饮；
5. 黑 + 蓝：更年轻、更理性一点的夜宵或酒馆；
6. 红 + 米白：老长沙粉面、传统小吃等。

要求：
- 色彩有餐饮招牌感；
- 颜色不宜过多，2~4 个主色最稳；
- 高饱和点缀可以增强吸睛度，但必须控制统一性。

【画面呈现要求】
1. 这是独立 Logo 展示图，不是菜单海报；
2. 背景简洁，建议浅灰白、米白、纸白或纯净浅底；
3. Logo 主体完整、清晰、居中；
4. 结构完整、信息有层次；
5. 整体看起来像一个成熟餐饮品牌的主 Logo 提案。

【风格关键词】
国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo、Chinese Retro Food Emblem Logo、餐饮品牌、复古商标、老招牌、品牌徽章、中英混排、国潮字标、餐饮主标、门头感、包装感、老字号感、新消费餐饮。

【验收标准】
请确保最终结果满足：
1. 一眼看出是餐饮品牌；
2. 中文主字标醒目好认；
3. 图形与品牌名 / 品类有明确关系；
4. 徽章结构完整；
5. 中英文排版有层次；
6. 配色有餐饮品牌气质；
7. 适合门头、菜单、包装、贴纸、外卖头像和社媒主图使用；
8. 整体有“国潮复古餐饮徽章”的成熟商业感。

【输出要求】
请最终输出一个高完成度的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo」。它必须以中文品牌名为核心，结合复古图形、中英文辅助系统、徽章式构图和明确的品类属性，形成一个真正可品牌化、可传播、可落地的餐饮品牌标识。

items.title: “作为【汉考克】官方纪念超跑联动活动，一辆真的像会在城市街头…
items.prompt:
“作为【汉考克】官方纪念超跑联动活动，一辆真的像会在城市街头、车展现场或品牌快闪活动中出现的官方角色涂装超跑，正在引发巨大关注的瞬间”。

这不是单纯的汽车插画。
请把它做成仿佛真实存在的动画官方联动企划，
像是在日本城市街头、车展展台或高端商场外偶然看到“我家孩子纪念涂装超跑”后，用手机拍下来的真实照片。
画面要有现实感、特别感，并且能在社交媒体时间线上瞬间抓住视线。

【角色主视觉姿势指定】
超跑车身侧面的巨大主视觉中，请从以下姿势中选择最适合角色气质的 1 到 2 个，自然融入画面。

角色必须表现为成年角色。
姿势要有强烈视觉吸引力、角色海报感和官方限定视觉感，
像动画官方纪念视觉、时尚杂志封面、超跑联动宣传海报，
既要有冲击力，又要保持高级、干净、可公开展示的广告质感。

可选姿势：

・正面近距离特写 
重点突出角色脸部、眼睛、表情、发丝和服装细节，让角色在车身侧面形成最强视觉中心。

・自信的正面站姿，一只手扶腰 
角色面向观众，自信微笑或微微挑眉，身体线条清晰，像官方主视觉海报。

・背向站姿 
角色背对观众，微微回头看向镜头，头发、裙摆、外套或披风被风轻轻吹起，营造强烈回眸感。

・下蹲姿势，双手放在头后 
角色以时尚写真感的下蹲姿势出现，双手自然放在头后，表情自信，构图要高级，不要低俗。

・正面下蹲姿势，双手放在头后 
角色面向观众，身体姿态有张力，眼神直接，像限定版角色宣传海报。

・跪姿回眸 
角色以低姿态的跪姿或俯身姿态回头看向镜头，突出头发、眼神、服装线条和角色气质，画面保持官方广告级别的精致感。

请根据角色设定自动选择最合适的 1 到 2 个姿势。
不要堆叠太多动作。
如果角色气质偏清纯、治愈、大小姐、偶像、魔法少女、和风、赛博、冷艳、小恶魔等，请自动调整姿势强度和表情风格。

姿势重点是：
高级、暧昧、漂亮、有记忆点、有官方主视觉冲击力。
不要过度裸露，不要强调内衣，不要出现低俗构图，不要让姿势破坏官方纪念超跑广告的真实感。

【画面目标】
当这张图出现在 X 时间线上时，
看到的人应该第一眼就产生：

“诶，我家孩子变成超跑涂装了！？”
“而且现场都被联动了！？”
“这个好想去现场看，好想拍照！”
“我也想给自己的角色做一个！”
“能在现实里看到的我家孩子也太好了吧！”

这种感觉。

【最重要】
绝对不要把原角色画成另一个人。
五官、眼睛、发型、发色、表情、年龄感、服装印象、配色、透明感、氛围，以及角色独有的可爱和魅力，必须优先保留。

这张图的主角不是街景，也不是整辆车，
而是“超跑车身侧面巨大绘制出来的角色本人”。

构图请使用有冲击力的斜侧面构图：
画面左侧稍微露出超跑车头，
画面中央到右侧大面积展示车身侧面。

最优先目标是：
即使在时间线缩略图里，
车身侧面的角色脸部、眼睛、角色名 logo 也能一瞬间被看到。

角色的巨大主视觉必须放在车身侧面的中心位置，并且非常大。
尤其要强化脸部特写，
让眼睛和表情成为最吸引视线的部分。

不一定要完整展示全身。
可以只展示上半身到膝上范围，
重点是让脸、头发、眼睛、服装，以及角色本身的可爱、美丽和高级暧昧感最大化呈现。

不要只是把原图衣服生硬贴到车上。
请将原图中的服装、颜色、元素、气质和世界观，
重新设计成适合超跑官方纪念涂装广告的视觉。

超跑涂装整体配色应由 AI 根据原图角色的发色、眼睛颜色、服装颜色、小物件和背景氛围自然提取，
组合成最适合该角色的车身涂装设计。

整体要高级、可爱、有透明感，
华丽但不杂乱，
像真正的官方纪念超跑联动活动设计。

【亮度与可读性】
不要做成太暗的夜景或地下车库照片。
请使用明亮下午、晴天，或白色柔和自然光下的城市街头、车展现场或高端商场外场景。
车身下方、车头、背景建筑不要黑成一片。
整体画面要明亮、干净，偏高调，适合在社交媒体时间线上快速吸引注意。

角色脸部周围尤其要明亮，
让眼睛、脸颊、头发透明感、服装质感、小物件闪光都能一眼看清。

【现场联动感】
这不只是普通的痛车或超跑涂装，
而是“整个现场也被这个角色的纪念超跑联动活动轻微染上主题色”的画面。

请自然加入以下元素：

・超跑车身侧面的巨大角色主视觉
・角色名「【角色名】」
・罗马字 logo「【罗马字】」
・大而清晰的角色名 logo
・短句宣传文案
・纪念超跑联动风格徽章
・限定感的速度线、赛车编号、品牌贴纸式装饰
・小型副视觉
・符合角色氛围的花、星星、丝带、光、羽毛、宝石、蕾丝、魔法阵、时钟、海、天空、和风纹样、赛博线条等元素
・活动展板
・现场海报
・柱子广告
・LED 展示屏
・地贴或小型引导装饰
・让人一眼看出“现场真的在举办这个企划”的统一设计感

LED 屏、活动展板或背景广告牌上，
请用手机也能看清的大小，自然加入短文字，例如：

「【罗马字】 Limited Memorial Supercar」
「【角色名】 纪念超跑」
「本日限定展示」
「SPECIAL WRAPPED SUPERCAR」

图中文字要少。
禁止小号长文。
即使用手机看也要能读清楚，只放短而强的词句，例如：

「【角色名】」
「【罗马字】」
「SPECIAL WRAPPED SUPERCAR」
「Limited Memorial Supercar」
「去见你，我家孩子。」
「【角色名】，驶入现实。」

其中主文案优先使用：
「去见你，我家孩子。」
或
「【角色名】，驶入现实。」

文字必须清晰可读。
如果文字容易崩坏，不要强行加入长句，
只保留角色名、logo 和短文案，并放大处理。

【舞台】
舞台是日本城市街头、车展现场、高端商场外、品牌快闪活动区或赛车场展示区。
时间以晴朗下午，或白色柔和自然光为主，
选择最能衬托原图角色透明感和可爱感的明亮空气感。

场景中可以自然出现：
干净街道、玻璃幕墙、展台灯光、活动围栏、品牌快闪装置、LED 屏、路面反射、拍照人群、城市建筑、展示地台等元素，
让画面看起来像“真的在日本现场偶然拍到的一张照片”。

但背景不要喧宾夺主。
场景只是舞台，
主角始终是“车身侧面的巨大角色涂装”。

现场可以放 2 到 3 个正在用手机拍摄这辆涂装超跑的人。
但人物不要放得太大，不要占据前景。

人物应放在远处、展台边缘、街边或背景区域，
用背影或侧影的小人物来强化“现场真的很受关注”的氛围。
绝对不要挡住车身侧面的巨大角色视觉。

【视觉方向】
高质量实拍风社交媒体照片
日本城市街头或车展现场
官方动画联动纪念超跑
现场轻度联动包装
车身侧面的巨大角色是主角
脸和眼睛最吸引视线
明亮、干净、高调画面
像现场偶然拍到的真实感
让人想立刻拍照的特别感
高级可爱的官方广告设计
克制暧昧感与清洁感并存
现实感与梦幻感并存
时间线上一眼就能看懂

【容易爆火的关键演出】
・车身侧面的角色脸部必须非常大
・眼睛即使在缩略图中也要醒目
・重点展示车身侧面，而不是车头
・不要只是超跑照片，要像“现场联动纪念超跑活动”
・活动展板、柱子广告、海报、LED 屏、地贴要有少量联动
・整体不要太暗，要明亮好看
・拍照路人只放少量小人物，用来制造话题感
・文字少、短、清楚、可读
・不要变成廉价痛车，要像高级官方活动
・只加入 1 到 2 个高级、暧昧、漂亮、有记忆点的主视觉姿势，不要低俗或露骨
・让人第一眼觉得“这好像真的会存在”
・让观众自然想到“我也想给自己的角色做一个”

【避免】
把原角色画成别人
改变脸部或眼睛印象
角色太小
超跑本身或背景过于抢眼
角色涂装只在车身边缘小小出现
像把原图粗糙贴上去的廉价合成
过度痛车感
广告元素太乱
文字太多
读不清的 logo 或崩坏文字
擅自加入固定名字“NOZOMU”或“のぞむ”
使用与输入角色名不同的名字
变成欧美街头、地下车库、非法赛车或低俗车模氛围
车身结构、轮胎、车门、透视不自然
人物太多导致主角不明确
前景人物太大影响角色可见度
整体过暗、发灰、沉闷
未成年感角色的暧昧表现
过度暴露、强调内衣、露骨性姿势
只是漂亮但缺乏话题性和事件感

整体请做成一张能让人瞬间理解：

“我家孩子真的作为官方纪念超跑驶入现实，
而且整个现场也被这个角色轻轻染上了主题氛围”

的画面。

画面要明亮、清晰、有冲击力，
看起来真实存在，
并且非常适合在社交媒体上传播。
